papers.title: Multiscale Structure of Eigenstate Thermalization
papers.abstract: The eigenstate thermalization hypothesis provides a framework for understanding thermalization in isolated quantum many-body systems by characterizing statistical properties of local observables in energy eigenstates. Here we demonstrate that distributions of matrix elements in macroscopic systems may depend not only on the macrostate parameters, such as the densities of local conserved charges, but generally also on the properties of ensembles used in sampling eigenstates. To this end, we depart from the conventional analysis of microcanonical windows and consider statistical ensembles with an adjustable scale parameter prescribing the magnitude of charge fluctuations. We specifically consider an integrable field theory that permits efficient numerical sampling of matrix elements and reliable extrapolation to the thermodynamic limit. Moreover, in this system, we identify a class of states that enables explicit closed-form computation of the suppression rate of matrix elements. Our findings reveal an underlying multiscale structure of matrix elements captured by a non-analytic fluctuation-scale dependence of algebraic exponents governing their statistical properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：eigenstate thermalization hypothesis（本征态热化假设）、statistical ensembles（统计系综）、closed-form computation（闭式解析计算）。；研究对象：孤立量子多体系统中的本征态热化现象，具体研究可积场论中局域可观测量矩阵元的多尺度结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本征态热化假设中矩阵元的分布不仅依赖于宏观态参数（如局域守恒荷密度），还依赖于采样本征态所用系综的涨落尺度；矩阵元统计性质由非解析的涨落尺度依赖的代数指数控制，揭示了其多尺度结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本征态热化假设中矩阵元的分布不仅依赖于宏观态参数（如局域守恒荷密度），还依赖于采样本征态所用系综的涨落尺度；矩阵元统计性质由非解析的涨落尺度依赖的代数指数控制，揭示了其多尺度结构。；创新点：首次揭示矩阵元分布对系综涨落尺度的非解析依赖关系，并建立其多尺度结构框架。摘要未突出说明与已有本征态热化假设工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用可调尺度参数的统计系综（替代传统微正则窗口分析），在可积场论中通过高效数值采样矩阵元并外推到热力学极限；同时识别出一类允许闭式解析计算矩阵元抑制率的态。

papers.title: Gapped 1/9 Magnetization Plateau in the Anisotropic Kagome Antiferromagnet Y-kapellasite
papers.abstract: Fractional magnetization plateaus provide a sensitive probe of many-body spin states in frustrated quantum magnets, yet their microscopic origin in kagome antiferromagnets remains unresolved. This is particularly true of the mysterious $1/9$ plateau, which is predicted by theory but infrequently observed in experiment. Here, we investigate this problem in the $S = 1/2$ anisotropic kagome antiferromagnet Y-kapellasite, Y$_3$Cu$_9$(OH)$_{19}$Cl$_8$, using pulsed-field magnetization measurements on single crystals and high-field $^{35}$Cl NMR. We identify a hierarchy of field-induced fractional features, including $1/3$ and $1/9$ plateaus, as well as a weaker low-field feature. Analysis of the NMR spectra and the magnetic susceptibility across the $1/9$ plateau demonstrate that it is accompanied by an ordered local spin configuration, a strong suppression of low-energy spin fluctuations and activated behavior, consistent with a gapped fractional state. These features differ from those in the only other material YCu$_3$(OH)$_6$Br$_2$[Br$_{1-y}$(OH)$_y$] in which this plateau is observed, implying a surprising robustness of the $1/9$ state to the details of the underlying magnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“pulsed-field magnetization measurements on single crystals and high-field \(^{35}\)Cl NMR”（脉冲场磁化测量和高温核磁共振），属于实验手段。；研究对象：各向异性kagome反铁磁体Y-kapellasite（Y₃Cu₉(OH)₁₉Cl₈）中的1/9磁化平台及其微观起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Y-kapellasite中观测到1/9和1/3磁化平台，其中1/9平台伴随有序局域自旋构型、低能自旋涨落的强烈抑制以及激活行为，表明其为有能隙的分数量子态。该平台的特征与另一材料YCu₃(OH)₆Br₂[Br₁₋y(OH)ₓ]中观测到的1/9平台不同，说明该分数量子态对底层磁性的细节具有出人意料的鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Y-kapellasite中观测到1/9和1/3磁化平台，其中1/9平台伴随有序局域自旋构型、低能自旋涨落的强烈抑制以及激活行为，表明其为有能隙的分数量子态。该平台的特征与另一材料YCu₃(OH)₆Br₂[Br₁₋y(OH)ₓ]中观测到的1/9平台不同，说明该分数量子态对底层磁性的细节具有出人意料的鲁棒性。；创新点：首次在Y-kapellasite中系统研究了1/9磁化平台，并通过NMR和磁化率揭示了其有能隙分数量子态的本质，同时通过与另一唯一观测到该平台的材料的对比，强调了该分数量子态对磁性细节的鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 单晶脉冲场磁化测量、高场\(^{35}\)Cl核磁共振（NMR）谱学、磁化率分析。

papers.title: Anisotropic Defect Diffusion in Layered CsPbBr$_\mathrm{x}$I$_\mathrm{3-x}$ Perovskites
papers.abstract: Mixed-halide perovskites offer a route to enhance phase stability and modify optoelectronic properties. Here, we use large-scale molecular dynamics simulations with a reactive force field to investigate defects in CsPbBr$_\mathrm{x}$I$_\mathrm{3-x}$ perovskites, focusing on how defect mobility can be controlled and the stability of the material may be improved by layered ordering of Br and I anions in layers. Our results show that layered halide ordering induces strongly anisotropic defect diffusion: migration proceeds readily along the layers, whereas diffusion across them is strongly suppressed. For Cs defects, this anisotropy originates from directional lattice strain and the associated octahedral tilting, while halide migration is governed by an interplay between strain and preferential local halide bonding configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：large-scale molecular dynamics simulations（大规模分子动力学模拟）、reactive force field（反应力场）。；研究对象：CsPbBrₓI₃₋ₓ混合卤化物钙钛矿中的缺陷扩散行为，特别是Br和I阴离子层状有序排列对缺陷迁移的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 卤素层状有序排列导致缺陷扩散具有强各向异性：沿层方向扩散容易，而跨层扩散被强烈抑制。Cs缺陷的各向异性源于方向性晶格应变及关联的八面体倾斜，卤素缺陷迁移则受应变与局域卤素键合构型的共同调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：卤素层状有序排列导致缺陷扩散具有强各向异性：沿层方向扩散容易，而跨层扩散被强烈抑制。Cs缺陷的各向异性源于方向性晶格应变及关联的八面体倾斜，卤素缺陷迁移则受应变与局域卤素键合构型的共同调控。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用反应力场（reactive force field）进行大规模分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Light-driven octupolar inverse Faraday effect and multipolar order in Mott insulators
papers.abstract: Hidden multipolar orders in spin-orbit-coupled Mott insulators provide a promising setting for correlated quantum matter, yet their control and detection remain major challenges. Here, we demonstrate that circularly polarized light enables both in $4d^2/5d^2$ systems with edge-sharing octahedra. Using a Floquet Schrieffer-Wolff expansion of a driven Hubbard-Kanamori model, we derive a low-energy multipolar Hamiltonian with two qualitatively new light-driven terms. One is an effective static field that couples linearly to the magnetic octupole, realizing an octupolar inverse Faraday effect. The other is a bond-dependent anisotropic exchange interaction absent in equilibrium. These two couplings are the key result of this work: the first provides a direct optical handle on hidden octupolar order, while the second reorganizes the multipolar exchange landscape and opens an enlarged Kitaev-like multipolar liquid regime. Their interplay produces a nonequilibrium multipolar phase space inaccessible in equilibrium, enabling optical tuning among antiferro-octupolar, ferro-octupolar, partially polarized ferro-quadrupolar, Ising octupolar, and multipolar liquid phases. We further show that the induced multipolar order couples to the lattice, generating reversible trigonal and tetragonal distortions that provide structural fingerprints in pump-probe experiments. Our work establishes a general mechanism for the optical generation, control, and detection of hidden multipolar quantum states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“Floquet Schrieffer-Wolff expansion”、“derive a low-energy multipolar Hamiltonian”等理论推导关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：自旋-轨道耦合Mott绝缘体（具体为具有边共享八面体结构的4d²/5d²体系）中的隐藏多极序，以及圆偏振光对其的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 圆偏振光可以在Mott绝缘体中产生两种全新的光驱动耦合：一种是线性耦合到磁八极子的有效静态场（实现八极子逆法拉第效应），另一种是键依赖的各向异性交换作用。这两种耦合的相互作用使得在非平衡态下能够光学调控多种多极相，包括反铁八极子、铁八极子、部分极化铁四极子、伊辛八极子和多极液体相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：圆偏振光可以在Mott绝缘体中产生两种全新的光驱动耦合：一种是线性耦合到磁八极子的有效静态场（实现八极子逆法拉第效应），另一种是键依赖的各向异性交换作用。这两种耦合的相互作用使得在非平衡态下能够光学调控多种多极相，包括反铁八极子、铁八极子、部分极化铁四极子、伊辛八极子和多极液体相。；创新点：1. 首次提出并证明了圆偏振光可以直接线性驱动磁八极子，即“八极子逆法拉第效应”，为光学操控隐藏的八极子序提供了直接手段。2. 发现了光诱导的键依赖各向异性交换作用，该作用在平衡态下不存在，可以重构多极交换作用景观并扩大Kitaev-like多极液体相区域。3. 揭示了光诱导的多极序与晶格之间的耦合，会产生可逆的三角和四方畸变，为泵浦-探测实验提供了结构上的可观测指纹。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体使用了Floquet-Schrieffer-Wolff展开方法，对一个受驱动的Hubbard-Kanamori模型进行推导，从而得到低能多极哈密顿量。

papers.title: Mutual Linearity in Nonequilibrium Langevin Dynamics
papers.abstract: Understanding how nonequilibrium systems respond to perturbations is a central challenge in physics. In this work, we establish mutual linearity in nonequilibrium overdamped Langevin systems. This theory provides a framework for controlling and designing nonequilibrium responses in continuous systems. When a dynamical parameter is locally perturbed at a single position, the stationary densities at any two positions are linearly related. It further leads to mutual linearity among different stationary state-current observables. We also extend the mutual linearity to non-stationary relaxation processes in the Laplace domain. Our theory reveals that mutual linearity in both discrete and continuous systems originates from the same one-dimensional response structure. We further show that mutual linearity is robust under finite-width perturbations. As an application, we demonstrate the mutual linearity and its finite-width robustness in the F$_1$-ATPase rotary motor model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“establish mutual linearity”、“provides a framework”、“our theory reveals”等理论构建和推导关键词。；研究对象：非平衡过阻尼朗之万系统（nonequilibrium overdamped Langevin systems），具体应用实例为F₁-ATP酶旋转马达模型（F₁-ATPase rotary motor model）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非平衡过阻尼朗之万系统中，当动力学参数在单个位置受到局部扰动时，任意两个位置的稳态密度之间存在线性关系；该线性关系进一步扩展到稳态流观测量，并可推广至拉普拉斯域中的非稳态弛豫过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非平衡过阻尼朗之万系统中，当动力学参数在单个位置受到局部扰动时，任意两个位置的稳态密度之间存在线性关系；该线性关系进一步扩展到稳态流观测量，并可推广至拉普拉斯域中的非稳态弛豫过程。；创新点：揭示了离散系统和连续系统中的互线性（mutual linearity）均源于同一维响应结构，并证明了该线性关系在有限宽度扰动下具有鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于非平衡朗之万动力学（nonequilibrium Langevin dynamics），采用过阻尼近似，通过局部扰动方法建立响应结构，并在拉普拉斯域中分析非稳态过程。

papers.title: Energy-Resolved Quantum Geometry from Středa Response: Driven-Dissipative Bosonic Lattices and Disordered Systems
papers.abstract: The Středa formula links the Hall conductivity of an insulator to the magnetic-field response of its particle density, providing a local and universal probe of the topological Chern number. Beyond this quantized response, an energy-resolved Středa marker can be defined from the magnetic response of the density of states, revealing detailed features of the quantum geometry of Bloch bands. We show that driven-dissipative bosonic lattices provide direct access to both the integrated and energy-resolved Středa responses. Our scheme uses controlled pumping with uniform strength and random phases across the lattice, together with uniform loss, to yield a Lorentzian filter of eigenmode occupations. For generic dispersive bands, this enables reconstruction of a coarse-grained energy-resolved Středa response, establishing these platforms as versatile probes of anomalous spectral flow and energy-resolved quantum geometry. As a striking application, we show that this marker elucidates the fate of topological bands under strong disorder, capturing the quantum-geometric structure underlying topological Anderson insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Středa公式、理论框架、方案提出。；研究对象：驱动-耗散玻色子晶格（driven-dissipative bosonic lattices）以及无序系统中的拓扑能带（包括拓扑安德森绝缘体）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 驱动-耗散玻色子晶格能够直接提供积分和能量分辨的Středa响应，从而作为探测反常谱流和能量分辨量子几何的通用平台；该标记还能揭示强无序下拓扑能带的命运，捕捉拓扑安德森绝缘体背后的量子几何结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：驱动-耗散玻色子晶格能够直接提供积分和能量分辨的Středa响应，从而作为探测反常谱流和能量分辨量子几何的通用平台；该标记还能揭示强无序下拓扑能带的命运，捕捉拓扑安德森绝缘体背后的量子几何结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Středa公式的理论框架，提出利用均匀强度、随机相位的泵浦和均匀损耗来构建本征模占据的洛伦兹滤波器，从而重建粗粒化的能量分辨Středa响应。

papers.title: Microscopic Magnetism of A(TiO)Cu4(PO4)4 (A = Ba, Pb, Sr): 31P and 63,65Cu NMR Study
papers.abstract: We report a comprehensive NMR study of the chiral square-cupola antiferromagnet Pb(TiO)Cu$_4$(PO$_4$)$_4$ and compare its microscopic hyperfine and local-field parameters with the Ba/Sr analogues in the $A$(TiO)Cu$_4$(PO$_4$)$_4$ family. Above $T_{\rm N}\simeq 6.7$ K, the $^{31}$P Knight shift tracks the bulk susceptibility and yields nearly isotropic transferred hyperfine couplings $H_{\rm hf}^{[010]}=6.77(3)$ and $H_{\rm hf}^{[001]}=6.19(3)$ kOe/$μ_{\rm B}$. Below $T_{\rm N}$, the frequency-swept $^{31}$P spectrum splits into three lines, in contrast to the four-line pattern reported for BaTCPO. The line separation tracks the onset of the static $^{31}$P internal field with a power-law exponent $β\simeq 0.23$, consistent with quasi-two-dimensional criticality. Crystal-rotation $^{31}$P NMR in the ordered state resolves all eight symmetry-related P sites and their site-dependent anisotropy. In the ordered state, zero-field $^{63,65}$Cu NMR gives a Cu-site internal field $B_{\rm int}=14.50(6)$ T and a quadrupole frequency $ν_Q=32.72(5)$ MHz, while point-charge electric-field-gradient calculations including Sternheimer corrections yield an on-site Cu hole occupancy $n_d=0.20(4)$, consistent with a ligand-hole-dominated charge-transfer character. Comparing PbTCPO with BaTCPO and SrTCPO, we find that the transferred hyperfine coupling $H_{\rm hf}$ varies across the series, reflecting changes in local Cu-O-P covalency, whereas the ordered-state $^{31}$P internal field in PbTCPO is $69.5$ mT, considerably higher than in BaTCPO ($35.6$ mT) and SrTCPO ($34.6$ mT). This enhancement is not captured by dipolar terms alone and points to the combined effects of transferred contributions and stacking-dependent cancellation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：NMR study（核磁共振研究）、Knight shift、zero-field NMR。；研究对象：手性方-杯状反铁磁体 \( A(\text{TiO})\text{Cu}_4(\text{PO}_4)_4 \) 家族（\( A = \text{Ba}, \text{Pb}, \text{Sr} \)），重点研究 Pb(TiO)Cu₄(PO₄)₄ 的微观磁性，并与 Ba/Sr 类似物对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Pb(TiO)Cu₄(PO₄)₄ 中，有序态下 \( ^{31}\text{P} \) 谱分裂为三条线（而非 BaTCPO 的四条线），且其内部场（69.5 mT）显著高于 BaTCPO（35.6 mT）和 SrTCPO（34.6 mT），该增强无法仅由偶极项解释，而是源于转移超精细贡献与堆叠依赖的抵消效应的共同作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Pb(TiO)Cu₄(PO₄)₄ 中，有序态下 \( ^{31}\text{P} \) 谱分裂为三条线（而非 BaTCPO 的四条线），且其内部场（69.5 mT）显著高于 BaTCPO（35.6 mT）和 SrTCPO（34.6 mT），该增强无法仅由偶极项解释，而是源于转移超精细贡献与堆叠依赖的抵消效应的共同作用。；创新点：首次通过 NMR 系统比较了 \( A(\text{TiO})\text{Cu}_4(\text{PO}_4)_4 \) 家族中不同 A 位元素（Ba、Pb、Sr）对超精细耦合、有序态内部场及局域 Cu-O-P 共价性的影响，揭示了 Pb 化合物中异常增强的内部场及其微观起源。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用 \( ^{31}\text{P} \) 和 \( ^{63,65}\text{Cu} \) 核磁共振（NMR）实验，包括：高温区 Knight 位移测量、低温频率扫描谱、晶体旋转 NMR、零场 NMR；并结合点电荷电场梯度计算（含 Sternheimer 修正）提取 Cu 位空穴占据数。

papers.title: MatterSim-MT: A multi-task foundation model for in silico materials characterization
papers.abstract: Accurate property characterization is a major bottleneck in materials design. While first-principles methods and task-specific machine-learning models have driven important progress, they remain fundamentally limited in scalability and generalizability across the vast space of structures and properties relevant to real-world materials design. We present MatterSim-MT, a multi-task foundation model for in silico materials simulation and property characterization. The model is pretrained on over 35 million first-principles-labeled structures covering 89 elements, temperatures up to 5000 K and pressures up to 1000 GPa, and is fine-tuned on various properties including Bader charges, magnetic moments, Born effective charges, and dielectric matrices. Out of the box, MatterSim-MT not only serves as a foundation model for predicting material structure, dynamics and thermodynamics, its multi-task architecture also enables a wide range of complex simulations that cannot be captured by potential energy surfaces alone. For example, we demonstrate pressure-dependent LO-TO phonon splitting in SiC with close agreement with experiment, electric hysteresis in ferroelectric BaTiO3, and the cationic-to-anionic redox transition during delithiation of a Li-rich cathode material. Finally, we show that MatterSim-MT scales well with more data and parameters, can be efficiently fine-tuned to higher levels of theory, and can be efficiently extended to new systems via active learning. Overall, we believe this approach provides a scalable route to accurate in silico materials characterization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：foundation model, pretrained, first-principles-labeled structures, fine-tuned, simulations）；研究对象：材料性质表征，包括Bader电荷、磁矩、Born有效电荷、介电矩阵，以及具体体系如SiC的LO-TO声子劈裂、铁电BaTiO₃的电滞回线、富锂正极材料的脱锂氧化还原转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MatterSim-MT作为一个多任务基础模型，能够同时预测材料的结构、动力学和热力学性质，并实现仅靠势能面无法捕捉的复杂模拟（如压力依赖的LO-TO声子劈裂、铁电电滞回线、氧化还原转变），且与实验吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MatterSim-MT作为一个多任务基础模型，能够同时预测材料的结构、动力学和热力学性质，并实现仅靠势能面无法捕捉的复杂模拟（如压力依赖的LO-TO声子劈裂、铁电电滞回线、氧化还原转变），且与实验吻合良好。；创新点：提出了一种多任务基础模型框架，能够统一处理多种材料性质预测，并实现超越传统势能面方法的复杂模拟（如压力依赖的声子劈裂和电滞回线），同时具有良好的可扩展性和微调效率。
papers.method_zh: 基于超过3500万个第一性原理标记结构（覆盖89种元素、温度高达5000 K、压力高达1000 GPa）进行预训练，随后针对多种性质（Bader电荷、磁矩、Born有效电荷、介电矩阵）进行微调。模型架构为多任务基础模型，支持主动学习扩展至新体系。

papers.title: Interfacial control of hot-carrier extraction and photostability in two-dimensional materials
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) are promising materials for next-generation optoelectronic devices, yet their implementation is hindered by limited sample stability and challenges in forming reliable electrical contacts. Here, by utilizing time-domain THz emission spectroscopy we directly probe charge carrier dynamics in monolayer WS2 on gold (Au) and fused silica (SiO2) as a function of interface morphology. For laser excitation above the band gap of WS2, we independently extract effective transport times for both electrons and holes and find that discontinuous WS2 contacts on rough Au generate larger net photocurrents than uniform, strongly coupled interfaces - a counterintuitive observation attributed to imbalanced electron and hole transfer from WS2 to Au. Crucially, we demonstrate that ultrafast charge extraction and separation suppress recombination-driven energy release and thereby prevent photo-induced degradation under ambient conditions, eliminating the need for encapsulation. These findings redefine interfacial design as a central control parameter for both performance and stability in 2D optoelectronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“利用时域太赫兹发射光谱（time-domain THz emission spectroscopy）直接探测电荷载流子动力学”，并描述了具体的实验观测和对比。；研究对象：单层二硫化钨（monolayer WS2）与金（Au）和熔融石英（SiO2）构成的界面体系，具体研究界面形貌对光生热载流子提取和材料光稳定性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在粗糙金基底上形成的不连续WS2接触，比均匀强耦合的界面能产生更大的净光电流，这一反直觉现象归因于电子和空穴从WS2向金的不平衡转移。同时，超快电荷提取和分离能抑制复合驱动的能量释放，从而在环境条件下防止光致降解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在粗糙金基底上形成的不连续WS2接触，比均匀强耦合的界面能产生更大的净光电流，这一反直觉现象归因于电子和空穴从WS2向金的不平衡转移。同时，超快电荷提取和分离能抑制复合驱动的能量释放，从而在环境条件下防止光致降解。；创新点：重新定义了界面设计作为二维光电器件性能和稳定性的核心控制参数。具体创新在于：1）揭示了界面形貌（粗糙度、连续性）对电荷提取效率的反直觉影响；2）证明了无需封装，仅通过超快电荷提取即可实现环境条件下的光稳定性。
papers.method_zh: 时域太赫兹发射光谱（time-domain THz emission spectroscopy）。通过该技术，在高于WS2带隙的激光激发下，独立提取了电子和空穴的有效输运时间。

papers.title: Checkerboard Bose Hubbard Ladders using Transmon Arrays
papers.abstract: Adding a sublattice bias to the two dimensional Bose Hubbard model greatly enriches the available physics, and introduces knobs which can be used to control and interrogate the quantum state. We describe the physics of this checkerboard Bose Hubbard model and how it can be explored using transmon arrays. We show that the sublattice bias brings the commensurate superfluid phase into an experimentally accessible regime, and gives new probes. We characterize the superfluid and insulating phases, with careful attention to finite size effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：describe the physics、characterize the superfluid and insulating phases、finite size effects）；研究对象：棋盘型（checkerboard）Bose-Hubbard模型，以及利用transmon阵列实现该模型的物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 子晶格偏置（sublattice bias）可将公度超流相（commensurate superfluid phase）引入实验可及的区域，并提供新的探测手段；论文系统表征了超流相和绝缘相，并仔细考虑了有限尺寸效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：子晶格偏置（sublattice bias）可将公度超流相（commensurate superfluid phase）引入实验可及的区域，并提供新的探测手段；论文系统表征了超流相和绝缘相，并仔细考虑了有限尺寸效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析，具体为对棋盘型Bose-Hubbard模型进行物理描述，并分析其在transmon阵列中的实现方案，同时关注有限尺寸效应。

papers.title: Anomalous magnetotransport in a non-collinear correlated kagome ferromagnet MgMn6Sn6
papers.abstract: Magnetic kagome metals provide a fertile platform for exploring unusual magnetotransport phenomena arising from the intricate interplay between electronic topology, electron correlations, and magnetic order. MgMn6Sn6 is a room-temperature kagome ferromagnet with strong in-plane magnetic anisotropy. Here, we report a combined study of single-crystal neutron diffraction (SCND) and magnetotransport properties of MgMn6Sn6, supported by first-principles calculations. Our SCND measurements reveal a non-collinear arrangement of Mn magnetic moments within the basal plane of the kagome bilayer. The Hall conductivity shows a substantial intrinsic contribution of approximately 0.29 e^2/h per kagome layer, which is nearly isotropic with respect to the field orientation. At low temperatures, the anomalous Hall conductivity develops a pronounced anisotropic extrinsic component, highlighting the directional sensitivity of scattering processes. The significantly large value of the Sommerfeld coefficient, in the absence of f-electrons, underscores enhanced electron correlation. Therefore, the non-collinear kagome ferromagnet MgMn6Sn6 is a promising candidate for studying the effects of electron correlation on magnetotransport properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合第一性原理计算）。判断依据：关键词“combined study of single-crystal neutron diffraction (SCND) and magnetotransport properties”、“first-principles calculations”。；研究对象：非共线铁磁体MgMn6Sn6，一种具有强面内磁各向异性的室温kagome金属，以及其反常磁输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MgMn6Sn6中Mn磁矩在kagome双层基面内呈非共线排列；其霍尔电导率具有约0.29 e²/h每kagome层的巨大本征贡献，且低温下出现显著的各向异性非本征分量，同时存在增强的电子关联效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MgMn6Sn6中Mn磁矩在kagome双层基面内呈非共线排列；其霍尔电导率具有约0.29 e²/h每kagome层的巨大本征贡献，且低温下出现显著的各向异性非本征分量，同时存在增强的电子关联效应。；创新点：首次通过单晶中子衍射直接揭示了MgMn6Sn6中Mn磁矩的非共线排列，并系统研究了其各向异性反常霍尔效应与电子关联的关联，指出该材料是研究电子关联对磁输运影响的理想平台。摘要未突出说明与已有kagome铁磁体相比的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 单晶中子衍射（SCND）、磁输运测量（包括霍尔效应和电导率测量）、第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Shuttling of $\mathbb{Z}_4$ parafermions in an electronic ladder model
papers.abstract: Parafermions with non-Abelian statistics have been proposed as a promising platform for quantum computation, potentially enabling a broader set of topologically protected gates than Majorana fermions. The experimental and theoretical exploration of these exotic quasiparticles remains challenging, as their stability is linked to strong electron-electron interactions. A key step toward practical applications is the controlled shuttling of parafermionic modes, which is required for implementing geometric braiding operations. In the present work, we investigate the real-time dynamics of the elementary shuttling process by applying a combination of the density matrix renormalization group and the time-dependent variational principle approaches. We analyze the transport of $\mathbb{Z}_4$ parafermion edge states and assess the corresponding adiabatic speed limit under experimentally relevant conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：density matrix renormalization group (DMRG)、time-dependent variational principle (TDVP)、real-time dynamics。；研究对象：电子梯子模型中的 $\mathbb{Z}_4$ parafermion 边缘态及其可控穿梭（shuttling）过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过实时动力学模拟，研究了 $\mathbb{Z}_4$ parafermion 边缘态的基本穿梭过程，并在实验相关条件下评估了其绝热速度极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过实时动力学模拟，研究了 $\mathbb{Z}_4$ parafermion 边缘态的基本穿梭过程，并在实验相关条件下评估了其绝热速度极限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）与含时变分原理（TDVP）方法，对基本穿梭过程的实时动力学进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Bulk-mediated reflection of chirality-protected surface spin waves
papers.abstract: Surface spin waves of the Damon-Eshbach type exhibit intrinsically nonreciprocal transport properties with a chiral dynamical field structure that localizes counterpropagating waves at opposite film surfaces. Such chirality has been predicted to suppress direct backscattering in thin films within frequency ranges free of bulk modes. However, how chirality influences reflection in thicker three-dimensional magnetic media, where a dense spectrum of bulk excitations overlaps with surface waves, remains unclear. Here we demonstrate that, in micrometer-thick yttrium iron garnet films, reflection of the chiral Damon-Eshbach wave from the boundary of the magnetic medium is accompanied by excitation of spatially localized thickness-quantized bulk modes, whereas reciprocal backward-volume waves reflect nearly elastically. Brillouin light scattering spectroscopy, infrared thermography, and micromagnetic simulations reveal standing bulk excitations at the reflecting boundary and quantify the associated magnon energy accumulation and dissipation. These results identify bulk-mode excitations as the physical pathway enabling reversal of chirally localized surface waves in thick films, thereby defining the limits of chirality-based backscattering immunity and providing a general framework for wave transport in nonreciprocal magnetic media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合了实验与模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“Brillouin light scattering spectroscopy, infrared thermography, and micromagnetic simulations”等实验与模拟手段。；研究对象：微米厚钇铁石榴石（YIG）薄膜中手性保护的Damon-Eshbach型表面自旋波的反射行为，以及体模激发对其反射的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在厚磁性薄膜中，手性Damon-Eshbach表面波的反射会激发空间局域的厚度量子化体模，导致能量积累与耗散，从而破坏了手性保护的反向散射免疫性；而反向体波则近乎弹性反射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在厚磁性薄膜中，手性Damon-Eshbach表面波的反射会激发空间局域的厚度量子化体模，导致能量积累与耗散，从而破坏了手性保护的反向散射免疫性；而反向体波则近乎弹性反射。；创新点：揭示了在体模与表面波频谱重叠的厚膜中，体模激发是实现手性局域表面波反转的物理途径，从而明确了手性抗背散射的适用极限。摘要未突出说明与已有理论预测的直接对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 布里渊光散射光谱学、红外热成像技术以及微磁学模拟。

papers.title: Spectral Dynamics in Deep Networks: Feature Learning, Outlier Escape, and Learning Rate Transfer
papers.abstract: We study the evolution of hidden-weight spectra in wide neural networks trained by (stochastic) gradient descent. We develop a two-level dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) that jointly tracks bulk and outlier spectral dynamics for spiked ensembles whose spike directions remain statistically dependent on the random bulk. We apply this framework to two settings: (1) infinite-width nonlinear networks in mean-field/$μ$P scaling and (2) deep linear networks in the proportional high-dimensional limit, where width, input dimension, and sample size diverge with fixed ratios. Our theory predicts how outliers evolve with training time, width, output scale, and initialization variance. In deep linear networks, $μ$P yields width-consistent outlier dynamics and hyperparameter transfer, including width-stable growth of the leading NTK mode toward the edge of stability (EoS). In contrast, NTK parameterization exhibits strongly width-dependent outlier dynamics, despite converging to a stable large-width limit. We show that this bulk+outlier picture is descriptive of simple tasks with small output channels, but that tasks involving large numbers of outputs (ImageNet classification or GPT language modeling) are better described by a restructuring of the spectral bulk. We develop a toy model with extensive output channels that recapitulates this phenomenon and show that edge of the spectrum still converges for sufficiently wide networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT)、theoretical framework、prediction。；研究对象：深度神经网络（wide neural networks）在梯度下降训练过程中的隐藏权重谱（hidden-weight spectra）动力学，包括谱的体（bulk）与离群值（outlier）的联合演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在深度线性网络中，μP参数化能实现宽度一致的离群值动力学和超参数迁移，而NTK参数化则表现出强宽度依赖性；对于输出通道数大的任务（如ImageNet分类、GPT语言建模），谱的体结构重组比离群值演化更能描述学习过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在深度线性网络中，μP参数化能实现宽度一致的离群值动力学和超参数迁移，而NTK参数化则表现出强宽度依赖性；对于输出通道数大的任务（如ImageNet分类、GPT语言建模），谱的体结构重组比离群值演化更能描述学习过程。；创新点：首次在DMFT框架中同时处理体谱与离群值谱的耦合演化，并揭示了不同参数化（μP vs NTK）下谱动力学的宽度依赖性差异，以及大规模输出任务中谱体结构重组的主导作用。
papers.method_zh: 发展了两级动力学平均场理论（two-level DMFT），联合追踪尖峰系综（spiked ensembles）中体与离群值的谱动力学，并应用于两种设定：（1）平均场/μP标度下的无限宽非线性网络；（2）比例高维极限下的深度线性网络（宽度、输入维度和样本量以固定比例发散）。

papers.title: Cluster Dynamics Stay Fast-Until Tricriticality
papers.abstract: Cluster Monte Carlo algorithms are widely regarded as the most effective route to overcoming critical slowing down in lattice spin systems. Whether this acceleration persists in the presence of vacancies and multicritical fluctuations, however, remains unresolved. We address this question through a systematic dynamic-scaling study of hybrid cluster-local update schemes in the two-dimensional Blume-Capel model, which exhibits a line of continuous Ising-like transitions terminating at a tricritical point. Along the entire critical line, hybrid dynamics retain the near-optimal efficiency of pure cluster updates despite the presence of annealed vacancies. Strikingly, this acceleration collapses precisely at tricriticality, where the dynamic critical exponent reverts to the local-update value. We trace this breakdown to the correlated percolation of vacancies, whose emergent system-spanning geometry obstructs nonlocal relaxation in the spin sector. Our results identify a fundamental geometric limitation of cluster acceleration at tricriticality and establish vacancy percolation as the mechanism controlling dynamic universality in hybrid Monte Carlo dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：动态标度研究、混合簇-局域更新方案、蒙特卡洛算法。；研究对象：二维Blume-Capel模型中的临界动力学，特别是沿连续Ising型转变线直至三临界点的行为，以及空位存在下的加速效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混合簇-局域更新动力学沿整个临界线保持接近纯簇更新的高效加速，但在三临界点处加速完全失效，动态临界指数退化为局域更新值。该失效归因于空位的关联逾渗，其系统尺度的几何结构阻碍了自旋部分的非局域弛豫。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混合簇-局域更新动力学沿整个临界线保持接近纯簇更新的高效加速，但在三临界点处加速完全失效，动态临界指数退化为局域更新值。该失效归因于空位的关联逾渗，其系统尺度的几何结构阻碍了自旋部分的非局域弛豫。；创新点：首次揭示了三临界点处簇算法加速失效的根本几何机制——空位逾渗，并建立了空位逾渗作为控制混合蒙特卡洛动力学动态普适性的机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合簇-局域更新方案的动态标度研究，对二维Blume-Capel模型进行系统分析。

papers.title: Electronic excitations in the Shastry-Sutherland compound SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$
papers.abstract: SrCu2(BO3)2 (SCBO) is a paradigmatic realization of the Shastry-Sutherland model, hosting geometrically frustrated spin dimers and a variety of quantum magnetic phases and phenomena. Although its magnetic properties have been extensively studied, the high-energy electronic excitations that determine the crystal-field environment and Cu-O hybridization have remained largely unexplored. Here we combine Cu L3-edge resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS), broadband optical spectroscopy, and electronic-structure calculations to determine the relevant local and interband excitation energy scales in SCBO. RIXS resolves a well-defined manifold of localized Cu2+ d-d excitations between 1.8 and 2.4 eV, whose energies and polarization dependence are well reproduced by multireference quantum-chemistry calculations. In contrast, optical spectroscopy identifies charge-transfer excitations with an absorption onset near 1.2-1.6 eV and a broader higher-energy structure around 4.5 eV, which are qualitatively captured by DFT+U calculations. Taken together, these results define the characteristic energy scales of d-d and CT excitations, offering quantitative benchmarks for computational frameworks and providing essential input for refining superexchange-based magnetic models of this prototypical frustrated quantum antiferromagnet.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：结合了Cu L3-edge RIXS、宽带光学光谱等实验手段，以及多参考量子化学计算和DFT+U计算。；研究对象：Shastry-Sutherland化合物SrCu₂(BO₃)₂（SCBO）中的电子激发，包括局域d-d激发和电荷转移（CT）激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过RIXS和光学光谱分别确定了SCBO中局域Cu²⁺的d-d激发能量范围（1.8–2.4 eV）和电荷转移激发的吸收边（约1.2–1.6 eV）及更高能结构（约4.5 eV），为超交换磁学模型提供了定量基准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过RIXS和光学光谱分别确定了SCBO中局域Cu²⁺的d-d激发能量范围（1.8–2.4 eV）和电荷转移激发的吸收边（约1.2–1.6 eV）及更高能结构（约4.5 eV），为超交换磁学模型提供了定量基准。；创新点：首次系统研究了SCBO中此前未被探索的高能电子激发（d-d和CT激发）的能量尺度，并提供了实验与计算相结合的定量基准。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：Cu L₃边共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）、宽带光学光谱。计算方法：多参考量子化学计算（用于d-d激发）、DFT+U计算（用于电荷转移激发）。

papers.title: Finite-q photon-drag shift current in two-dimensional massive chiral Dirac fermions
papers.abstract: We investigate the photon-drag shift current in an isotropic single-valley two-dimensional massive chiral Dirac model with chirality index $J=1,2,3$ by directly evaluating the full finite-$q$ non-vertical response beyond the perturbative small-$q$ regime. Our central result is that chirality qualitatively reorganizes the sign topology of the finite-$q$ photocurrent $\mathbf{ j}(\mathbf{ q})$. For $J=1$, the photocurrent remains broadly positive, whereas higher-chirality sectors ($J \ge 2$) generically develop internal zero-current contours and sign reversals within the kinematically allowed region. We further show that the photocurrent is symmetry-constrained to be purely transverse, $\mathbf{j}(\mathbf{q}) \propto \hat{\mathbf{z}}\times\mathbf{q}$, and vanishes in the strictly vertical-transition limit $q=0$ in centrosymmetric systems. Pauli blocking further shapes the response by selecting the active portion of the resonance contour, while its extinction at large $Δ$ or $q$ follows from a simple kinematic cutoff. These results establish the isotropic massive chiral Dirac problem as a symmetry-controlled benchmark for chirality-dependent finite-$q$ shift currents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“investigate”“directly evaluating”“symmetry-constrained”等理论分析术语，未提及任何实验手段或数值计算。；研究对象：各向同性单谷二维有质量手征狄拉克费米子模型（手征指数J=1,2,3）中的光子拖曳位移电流（photon-drag shift current）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 手征性（chirality）会定性重构有限波矢q下光电流j(q)的符号拓扑结构：J=1时光电流整体为正，而J≥2时在运动学允许区域内出现零电流等高线和符号反转。此外，光电流被对称性约束为纯横向（j(q) ∝ ẑ×q），且在中心反演对称系统中严格垂直跃迁极限（q=0）下消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：手征性（chirality）会定性重构有限波矢q下光电流j(q)的符号拓扑结构：J=1时光电流整体为正，而J≥2时在运动学允许区域内出现零电流等高线和符号反转。此外，光电流被对称性约束为纯横向（j(q) ∝ ẑ×q），且在中心反演对称系统中严格垂直跃迁极限（q=0）下消失。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 直接计算完整有限q非垂直响应（beyond perturbative small-q regime），即不采用微扰小q近似，通过解析或半解析方法评估全波矢依赖的光电流响应函数。

papers.title: Tamed Feynman-Kac diffusion processes: Killing-branching intertwine
papers.abstract: Relaxation to equilibrium of a drifted Brownian motion is quantified by a probability density function, whose main (multiplicative) entry is an inferred Feynman-Kac kernel of the Schrödinger semigroup operator. Although seemingly devoid of a natural probabilistic significance (except for its explicit path integral definition), the pertinent kernel relaxes to equilibrium as well. The implicit Feynman-Kac potential ${\cal{V}}(x)$, continuous, confining and bounded from below, may take negative values. If positive, ${\cal{V}}(x)$ can be interpreted as the killing rate of the decaying diffusion process. In case of relaxing F-K kernels the killing effects are tamed (often overcompensated). The taming inavoidably appears in conjunction with the existence of the negativity subdomains of ${\cal{V}}(x)$ in $R$. If locally ${\cal{V}}(x) < 0$, its sign inversion $- {\cal{V}}(x)$ can be interpreted as the branching (cloning, alternatively bifurcation) rate in the course of the other wise free random motion. The arising killed diffusion processes with branching, we interpret as the possible path-wise background of tamed (relaxing) Feynman-Kac diffusions. We present acomputer-assisted path-wise arguments, towards a consistency of the killing/branching taming scenario, for a number of nonlinear model systems in one space dimension. Special attention is paid to Feynman-Kac potential shapes, presumed to be in the double well form, where an analytic access to eigenvalues and eigenfunctions is scarce beyond the semiclassical regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“Feynman-Kac kernel”、“Schrödinger semigroup operator”、“path integral definition”等理论框架，以及“computer-assisted path-wise arguments”表明包含计算辅助的理论分析。；研究对象：Feynman-Kac扩散过程，具体研究其中“驯化”（tamed）的漂移布朗运动及其与“杀死-分支”（killing-branching）过程的交织关系。物理现象涉及扩散过程的弛豫、势阱中的量子本征值问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Feynman-Kac势函数 \( \mathcal{V}(x) \) 若为正，可解释为扩散过程的杀死率；若为负，其符号反转 \( -\mathcal{V}(x) \) 可解释为分支（克隆/分叉）率。这种杀死与分支的相互作用构成了“驯化”Feynman-Kac扩散的路径背景，并在一维非线性模型系统中通过计算机辅助路径论证得到一致性验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Feynman-Kac势函数 \( \mathcal{V}(x) \) 若为正，可解释为扩散过程的杀死率；若为负，其符号反转 \( -\mathcal{V}(x) \) 可解释为分支（克隆/分叉）率。这种杀死与分支的相互作用构成了“驯化”Feynman-Kac扩散的路径背景，并在一维非线性模型系统中通过计算机辅助路径论证得到一致性验证。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Feynman-Kac路径积分、Schrödinger半群算子、概率密度函数弛豫分析。计算手段：计算机辅助的路径论证（computer-assisted path-wise arguments），针对一维非线性模型系统（包括双阱势形状）进行数值分析。

papers.title: Probabilistic denoising for reliable signal extraction in spectroscopy
papers.abstract: While deep learning offers powerful capabilities for scientific research, its application is often hindered by a lack of quantitative reliability. To address this, we introduce a probabilistic denoising framework that simultaneously extracts denoised signals and element-wise predictive uncertainties from noisy data. We demonstrate this approach on three-dimensional angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy data, showing that the model reliably recovers the spectral features of a cuprate superconductor from Poisson-distributed noise with an average count of only 0.02 electrons per voxel. Crucially, we show that these predicted uncertainties can be propagated into subsequent superconducting gap analyses, enabling quantitative parameter extraction with scientifically meaningful error bars. Furthermore, we validate the broad applicability of our approach by successfully extending it to two-dimensional X-ray diffraction data. Ultimately, this approach establishes uncertainty-aware deep learning not merely as a visualization tool, but as a rigorous framework for scientific data analysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算方法）。关键词：deep learning、probabilistic denoising、angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy、X-ray diffraction。；研究对象：光谱学数据中的信号提取问题，具体应用于铜氧化物超导体的三维角分辨光电子能谱（3D ARPES）数据和二维X射线衍射（XRD）数据。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种概率性去噪框架，能够从极低信噪比（平均每体素仅0.02个电子的泊松噪声）的ARPES数据中可靠恢复光谱特征，并将预测的不确定性传递到后续超导能隙分析中，从而获得具有科学意义的误差棒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种概率性去噪框架，能够从极低信噪比（平均每体素仅0.02个电子的泊松噪声）的ARPES数据中可靠恢复光谱特征，并将预测的不确定性传递到后续超导能隙分析中，从而获得具有科学意义的误差棒。；创新点：将深度学习从单纯的“可视化工具”提升为具有定量可靠性的科学数据分析框架，首次实现了不确定性感知的深度学习在光谱去噪中的端到端应用，并验证了不确定性可传播至后续物理参数提取。
papers.method_zh: 概率性深度学习去噪框架，用于同时提取去噪信号和逐元素预测不确定性；应用于三维ARPES数据和二维XRD数据。

papers.title: Ferroelectric domains in methylammonium lead iodide perovskite thin-films
papers.abstract: We explore the ferroic properties of methylammonium lead iodide perovskite solar cells by Piezoresponse Force Microscopy (PFM). In vertical and horizontal PFM imaging, we find domains of alternating polarization with a width of 90 nm which we identify as polarized ferroelectric domains. High-resolution photo-conductive atomic force micrographs under illumination also show alternating charge carrier extraction patterns which we attribute to the local vertical polarization components within the ferroelectric domains. The correlation of the sample properties with Atomic Force and Kelvin Probe Force Micrographs evidence the piezo-electric nature of the domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Piezoresponse Force Microscopy (PFM)、Atomic Force Micrographs、Kelvin Probe Force Micrographs。；研究对象：甲基铵铅碘钙钛矿（methylammonium lead iodide perovskite）薄膜中的铁电畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在垂直和水平压电力显微镜成像中，观察到宽度约90纳米的交替极化畴，被识别为极化铁电畴；光照下的高分辨率光导原子力显微镜图像也显示出与铁电畴内局部垂直极化分量相关的交替电荷载流子提取图案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在垂直和水平压电力显微镜成像中，观察到宽度约90纳米的交替极化畴，被识别为极化铁电畴；光照下的高分辨率光导原子力显微镜图像也显示出与铁电畴内局部垂直极化分量相关的交替电荷载流子提取图案。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 压电力显微镜（PFM，包括垂直和水平模式）、光导原子力显微镜（photo-conductive AFM）、原子力显微镜（AFM）以及开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM）。

papers.title: Elastocapillary morphing of self-encapsulated droplets floating at the oil-air interface
papers.abstract: Self-encapsulated droplets floating at an oil--air interface undergo striking shape changes during evaporation, including flattening and localized loss of membrane tension leading to crumpling and wrinkling. Here we combine experiments, modeling and simulations to obtain predictive morphological maps. We perform contact-angle and evaporation experiments on water droplets coated by a hydrophobin protein film and floating in a fluorinated oil, providing reference profiles and volume-loss sequences for quantitative validation. We develop an axisymmetric mechanics framework in which equilibria follow from minimization of a total free energy combining surface energies, membrane strain energy and gravitational potential, subject to volume and contact-line constraints. A quasi-convex tension-relaxation rule accounts for compression-free states and enables coexistence of taut, wrinkled (one principal tension vanishes) and crumpled (both vanish) membrane domains. A finite element algorithm computes quasi-static morphing under volume reduction; key parameters are identified by fitting the reference contact-angle profile and then used without further tuning. The model reproduces the experimentally observed shape evolution and resolves the associated stress redistribution. Systematic parameter scans yield morphological phase diagrams governed by the Bond number, the oil--droplet surface-tension ratio and the density ratio. For buoyant droplets, crumpling relocates between exposed and submerged caps as parameters vary; for heavy droplets, a crossover to circumferential wrinkling along the immersed sidewall emerges. Wall-meniscus variations shift phase boundaries and can suppress bottom crumpling, consistent with wall-affected experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。关键词：experiments, modeling, simulations, finite element algorithm。；研究对象：漂浮在油-空气界面的自封装液滴（水液滴包裹疏水蛋白膜，漂浮在氟化油中）在蒸发过程中的弹性毛细形态变化（包括扁平化、起皱和皱缩）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合实验、建模和仿真，获得了预测性的形态相图，揭示了液滴在蒸发过程中因膜张力松弛而出现的皱缩与起皱区域随参数（邦德数、油-液滴表面张力比、密度比）变化的规律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合实验、建模和仿真，获得了预测性的形态相图，揭示了液滴在蒸发过程中因膜张力松弛而出现的皱缩与起皱区域随参数（邦德数、油-液滴表面张力比、密度比）变化的规律。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上进行了接触角和蒸发实验（水液滴包裹疏水蛋白膜，漂浮在氟化油中），获取参考轮廓和体积损失序列；理论上建立了轴对称力学框架，通过最小化总自由能（表面能、膜应变能、重力势能）并考虑体积和接触线约束来求解平衡态；采用准凸张力松弛规则处理无压缩状态，允许膜区域共存（紧绷、起皱、皱缩）；数值上使用有限元算法计算准静态形态演化，通过拟合参考接触角轮廓确定关键参数。

papers.title: Droplet Deformation and Emulsion Rheology in Two-Dimensional Odd Stokes Flow
papers.abstract: We study the deformation of a two-dimensional viscous droplet in simple shear in the presence of odd viscosity. We derive an analytical solution for the droplet shape and surrounding flow field within the framework of odd Stokes flow, allowing for differences in both even and odd viscosity between the droplet and the surrounding fluid. This solution yields closed-form expressions for the macroscopic apparent even and odd viscosities of a dilute emulsion. We show that, provided all viscosity differences remain moderate, the steady-state Taylor deformation parameter satisfies $D_T^\infty = \text{Ca} + \mathcal{O}(\text{Ca}^2)$ so that the leading-order droplet deformation is unchanged from the classical (even-viscous) result. Nevertheless, pronounced effects emerges beyond leading order, where our direct numerical simulations reveal odd-viscous differences to the droplet deformation. In addition, we show that the flow is influenced only by the difference in odd viscosity between the droplet and the medium and not on their individual values. Our analysis clarifies how odd viscosity might modify the effective rheology of dilute emulsions and provides a framework for interpreting droplet-based measurements of odd-viscous response. Key words: odd viscosity $|$ droplets $|$ emulsions $|$ surface tension $|$ chiral fluids
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：推导解析解、数值模拟、无实验数据。；研究对象：二维粘性液滴在简单剪切流中的形变，以及由液滴构成的稀乳液在奇粘性（odd viscosity）影响下的流变学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在奇粘性存在下，液滴稳态泰勒形变参数的一阶项与经典（偶粘性）结果相同，但高阶项出现显著差异；奇粘性对流动的影响仅取决于液滴与介质之间的奇粘性差值，而非各自绝对值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在奇粘性存在下，液滴稳态泰勒形变参数的一阶项与经典（偶粘性）结果相同，但高阶项出现显著差异；奇粘性对流动的影响仅取决于液滴与介质之间的奇粘性差值，而非各自绝对值。；创新点：首次在二维奇斯托克斯流中解析求解了液滴形变问题，并给出了稀乳液宏观表观偶粘性和奇粘性的闭式表达式，揭示了奇粘性差异对乳液有效流变学的修正机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用奇斯托克斯流（odd Stokes flow）理论框架，推导液滴形状及周围流场的解析解；结合直接数值模拟（DNS）研究高阶效应。

papers.title: Beyond the conventional Emery model: crucial role of long-range hopping for cuprate superconductivity
papers.abstract: The Emery model is the quintessential model for cuprate superconductors. In his eponymous paper, Emery only considered the next-nearest-neighbor oxygen-copper hopping. Later, also the relevance of nearest- and next-nearest oxygen-oxygen hoppings has been pointed out. Using dynamical vertex approximation, we find a superconducting dome consistent with cuprates. However, long-range hoppings beyond the three conventional hopping parameters are necessary for the quantitatively correct phase diagram and for a proper d-wave order parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：dynamical vertex approximation（动力学顶点近似）。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体，具体为Emery模型（三带模型）及其扩展，研究长程跳跃对超导相图和d波序参量的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长程跳跃（超出传统三个跳跃参数）对于获得与铜氧化物定量一致的相图以及正确的d波超导序参量至关重要；仅包含传统三个跳跃参数的Emery模型无法给出定量正确的超导穹顶。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长程跳跃（超出传统三个跳跃参数）对于获得与铜氧化物定量一致的相图以及正确的d波超导序参量至关重要；仅包含传统三个跳跃参数的Emery模型无法给出定量正确的超导穹顶。；创新点：首次在动力学顶点近似框架下系统揭示了超出传统Emery模型（仅包含最近邻氧-铜跳跃、最近邻和次近邻氧-氧跳跃）的长程跳跃对铜氧化物超导相图定量正确性和d波序参量形式的决定性作用。
papers.method_zh: 动力学顶点近似（Dynamical Vertex Approximation, DΓA），一种超越动力学平均场理论（DMFT）的强关联电子结构计算方法。

papers.title: Exploring the Potential of Ternary Blending for Two and Three-Junction RAINBOW Solar Cells
papers.abstract: The efficiency of organic photovoltaics (OPV) has been steadily increasing over the past decade until reaching the 20\% milestone. Multijunction architectures provide a promising approach to further enhance performance. Here we explore the potential of a spectral splitting geometry, referred to as RAINBOW, in which subcells are placed side-by-side and externally connected, thus minimizing the fabrication and current matching challenges found in vertically stacked configurations. First, we tested 7 different binaries with bandgaps spanning from 1.98 to 1.16 eV. The systems with the widest and narrowest gaps suffered greater losses and so we evaluate if ternary mixing could help to overcome these limitations by evaluating 5 different ternaries. Generally speaking, ternary mixing tunes the Voc, and when morphology and energy levels are well aligned, the overall PCE can be boosted in the spectral region where the subcell should absorb, as is the case for PTB7-Th:COTIC-4F:BTP-eC9 when operating as red subcell. Device simulations help to identify the 2-junction and 3-junction configurations with highest PCEs, all of which include ternaries. We fabricate proof-of-concept RAINBOW devices using scalable methods in which the subcells are deposited by meniscus-guided blade coating. The efficiency improves from 12.9\% in single-junction devices to 15.9\% in 2-junction devices (16.4\% in simulations) and 17.3\% in 3-junction devices (17.7\% in simulations), confirming the viability of the RAINBOW architecture for scalable, high-efficiency OPVs. Finally, detailed balance analysis indicates that the potential of this geometry can be very high provided that high efficiency wide bandgap (2-2.5eV) materials become available.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“Device simulations”（器件模拟）和“fabricate proof-of-concept RAINBOW devices using scalable methods”（使用可扩展方法制备概念验证器件）。；研究对象：有机光伏（OPV）中的RAINBOW构型太阳能电池，具体研究二元和三元共混体系在2-结和3-结叠层器件中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过三元共混优化子电池的光伏性能，结合RAINBOW光谱分裂几何结构，实现了从单结12.9%到2结15.9%（模拟16.4%）和3结17.3%（模拟17.7%）的效率提升，验证了该构型用于可扩展高效OPV的可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过三元共混优化子电池的光伏性能，结合RAINBOW光谱分裂几何结构，实现了从单结12.9%到2结15.9%（模拟16.4%）和3结17.3%（模拟17.7%）的效率提升，验证了该构型用于可扩展高效OPV的可行性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用弯月面引导刮涂法沉积子电池；计算上使用器件模拟（具体方法未明确说明）和详细平衡分析（detailed balance analysis）评估效率极限。

papers.title: Selectivity- and Activity-Aware Catalyst Descriptors for CO$_2$ Hydrogenation on Alloy Nanocatalysts using Machine-Learned Force Fields
papers.abstract: Adsorption energy distributions (AEDs) have emerged as a powerful and increasingly adopted descriptor for catalytic performance in high-entropy alloys and, more recently, in conventional metallic alloy nanocrystal catalysts. By accounting for diverse adsorption sites and crystallographic facets, AEDs more fully represent nanoparticle-based catalytic surfaces and show strong promise for accelerating rational design and discovery of heterogeneous catalysts, especially for CO$_2$ hydrogenation. However, previous approaches have not sufficiently resolved facet-specific contributions, despite the catalytic significance and prevalence of certain Miller planes in nanoscale catalysts, limiting their applicability in predicting activity and selectivity. Here, we introduce an updated facet-resolved framework for predicting catalytic activity, which also enables insight into selectivity toward C1 products. Universal machine-learned force fields trained on Open Catalyst Project data were employed to compute adsorption energetics across 226 experimentally observed metals, binary alloys, and ternary alloys, encompassing 1.4 million adsorption sites on 2,626 crystallographically distinct surfaces. Using statistical and unsupervised learning techniques, we analyzed facet-specific AEDs to identify highly active and methanol-selective facets. Our approach provides insight into the relationship between structure and catalytic performance metrics like activity and selectivity, and presents a set of alloy compositions and their respective surface orientations for experimental validation toward highly selective CO$_2$ hydrogenation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learned force fields、Open Catalyst Project data、statistical and unsupervised learning techniques。；研究对象：合金纳米催化剂（包括实验观测到的金属、二元合金和三元合金）用于CO₂加氢反应，重点关注不同晶面（Miller planes）对催化活性和选择性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入晶面分辨的吸附能分布（AEDs）框架，能够更准确地预测合金纳米催化剂对CO₂加氢反应的催化活性，并识别出对甲醇具有高选择性的晶面与合金组分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入晶面分辨的吸附能分布（AEDs）框架，能够更准确地预测合金纳米催化剂对CO₂加氢反应的催化活性，并识别出对甲醇具有高选择性的晶面与合金组分。；创新点：在已有吸附能分布（AEDs）描述符基础上，首次明确区分并解析了不同晶面对催化性能的贡献，从而能够同时预测催化活性和对C1产物（如甲醇）的选择性，弥补了此前方法未能充分解析晶面特异性贡献的局限。
papers.method_zh: 使用基于Open Catalyst Project数据训练的通用机器学习力场（machine-learned force fields），计算了226种实验观测到的金属、二元合金和三元合金在2626个晶体学不同表面上的140万个吸附位点的吸附能。采用统计和无监督学习技术分析晶面分辨的AEDs。

papers.title: Epitaxial growth of beta-bismuthene on Sb2Te3
papers.abstract: Over the past decades, two-dimensional crystals have attracted considerable interest as promising materials for electronic and optoelectronic applications. Among them, graphene analogs composed of heavy atoms occupy a particularly distinctive niche due to their enhanced spin-orbit interaction. Here, we present an epitaxial heterointerface formed by beta-bismuthene on Sb2Te3, a well-known three-dimensional topological insulator. Using scanning tunneling microscopy, we systematically investigated the effects of Bi coverage and substrate temperature on nucleation processes, island morphology, and atomic structure. In addition, substrate-induced defects were identified throughout the bismuthene lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用扫描隧道显微镜”进行系统研究，属于实验手段。；研究对象：β-铋烯（beta-bismuthene）在三维拓扑绝缘体Sb₂Te₃上的外延异质界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控Bi覆盖度和衬底温度，系统研究了β-铋烯在Sb₂Te₃上的成核过程、岛状形貌和原子结构，并在铋烯晶格中识别出衬底诱导的缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控Bi覆盖度和衬底温度，系统研究了β-铋烯在Sb₂Te₃上的成核过程、岛状形貌和原子结构，并在铋烯晶格中识别出衬底诱导的缺陷。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM），用于观察成核过程、岛状形貌和原子结构；分子束外延（MBE）生长（摘要中虽未明确写“MBE”，但“外延生长”和“覆盖度/温度调控”暗示了MBE方法）。

papers.title: Ground states of quantum XY dipoles on the Archimedean lattices
papers.abstract: We report numerical ground states for the dipolar XY spin model, which describes extended antiferromagnetic interactions in two-dimensional arrays of polar molecules and two-level Rydberg atoms. Carrying out large-scale density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations, we compute ground state properties on nine of the eleven Archimedean lattices--tilings of the plane by regular polygons. Four of these host trivial paramagnets, while another four develop collinear Neel magnetic order, as was found previously for the square lattice. For the ordered states, we calculate the hydrodynamic parameters (magnetization, susceptibility, and stiffness) and compare to linear spin wave theory. We also investigate the triangular lattice, for which we find several competing phases including coplanar magnetism, stripe density wave order, and a possible spin liquid; their relative stability is sensitive to the long-range couplings present in our dipolar model. Finally, the Archimedean classification is completed by the kagome lattice, which we argue in a companion work is likely to be a Dirac spin liquid.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations、numerical ground states。；研究对象：二维阿基米德晶格上的偶极XY自旋模型，该模型描述极性分子和两能级里德伯原子阵列中的扩展反铁磁相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在11种阿基米德晶格中的9种上，有4种晶格呈现平庸顺磁态，另外4种（包括方形晶格）呈现共线奈尔磁有序；三角晶格存在多个竞争相（共面磁性、条纹密度波序、可能的自旋液体）；而kagome晶格在另一篇工作中被认为可能是狄拉克自旋液体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在11种阿基米德晶格中的9种上，有4种晶格呈现平庸顺磁态，另外4种（包括方形晶格）呈现共线奈尔磁有序；三角晶格存在多个竞争相（共面磁性、条纹密度波序、可能的自旋液体）；而kagome晶格在另一篇工作中被认为可能是狄拉克自旋液体。；创新点：首次系统性地对9种阿基米德晶格上的偶极XY模型基态进行了数值研究，并利用阿基米德晶格分类完成了对三角晶格和kagome晶格竞争相的探讨。摘要未突出说明与之前仅针对方形晶格的研究相比的具体改进。
papers.method_zh: 大规模密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）计算，并辅以线性自旋波理论计算流体力学参数（磁化率、刚度等）进行比较。

papers.title: Harnessing Structural Disorder: Unraveling Hydrogen Evolution in Monolayer Amorphous Carbon via First-Principles Simulations and Machine-Learned Potentials
papers.abstract: Disorder and defective coordination in the catalytic plane are crucial for enhancing the Hydrogen Evolution Reaction (HER) on two-dimensional catalysts. Amorphous materials are disordered, making them catalytically adaptive for many reactions. In this work, the HER capabilities of Monolayer Amorphous Carbon (MAC) were studied in comparison with crystalline carbon derivatives, such as pristine graphene (GE) and graphyne derivatives. MAC generated from melt-quench simulations revealed a diverse framework of predominantly sp2 and sp3 carbons with numerous 5-, 6-, and 7-membered rings. Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations investigated free-energy variations in hydrogen adsorption for each material. According to Sabatier's principle, optimum activity is achieved when the Gibbs free energy (Delta GH) change approaches zero. Crystalline carbon materials possess limited active sites, with beta-graphyne showing the best Delta GH value of +0.34 eV. The adsorption study for MAC was conducted in 30 distinct local environments, where core structural properties were analyzed against varying radii. Calculations showed a Delta GH distribution for MAC ranging from -0.02 eV to +1.35 eV. To evaluate activity across the entire MAC surface, a MACE MLIP foundation model was finetuned, achieving optimal energy and force fitting of 1.67 meV/atom and 29.15 meV/A, respectively. The MLIP predicted Delta GH values from -0.91 eV to +1.70 eV, with approximately 15% of sites exhibiting values below +0.25 eV. Feature analysis revealed that 7-membered rings, curvature, and ripple height enhance HER activity. Our findings suggest that, with careful optimization of local features, MAC can be tuned to compete with noble metal catalysts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“First-Principles Simulations”（第一性原理模拟）、“Machine-Learned Potentials”（机器学习势）、“Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations”（密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：单层非晶碳（Monolayer Amorphous Carbon, MAC）的析氢反应（Hydrogen Evolution Reaction, HER）催化性能，并与晶态碳衍生物（如原始石墨烯、石墨炔）进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层非晶碳（MAC）因其结构无序性，拥有大量不同局域环境（如五、六、七元环），其析氢反应（HER）活性位点分布广泛，部分位点的吉布斯自由能（ΔG_H）接近零，表明通过优化局部结构特征，MAC有望成为可与贵金属催化剂竞争的HER催化剂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层非晶碳（MAC）因其结构无序性，拥有大量不同局域环境（如五、六、七元环），其析氢反应（HER）活性位点分布广泛，部分位点的吉布斯自由能（ΔG_H）接近零，表明通过优化局部结构特征，MAC有望成为可与贵金属催化剂竞争的HER催化剂。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：首次系统地利用第一性原理模拟和机器学习势，将结构无序性（非晶态）与二维碳材料的催化性能（HER）直接关联，并揭示了特定拓扑缺陷（如七元环）和几何特征（曲率、波纹高度）对活性的增强作用。
papers.method_zh: 1. 通过熔融淬火（melt-quench）分子动力学模拟生成MAC结构。2. 使用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算不同材料上氢吸附的吉布斯自由能变化（ΔG_H）。3. 采用微调的MACE（一种等变消息传递神经网络）机器学习原子间势（MLIP）模型，拟合整个MAC表面的能量和力，并预测全表面的ΔG_H分布。

papers.title: Finite temperature pair density wave superconductivity in $d$-wave altermagnets
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that altermagnetism provides a field-free mechanism for stabilizing finite-momentum superconductivity in two dimensions. Using a non-perturbative static path approximation Monte Carlo approach, we show that a d-wave altermagnet supports a robust pair-density-wave (PDW) phase that persists over a finite temperature window despite strong thermal fluctuations. The underlying mechanism originates from momentum-dependent spin splitting, which effectively enhances pairing instabilities at finite center-of-mass momentum without Zeeman fields. We identify distinct thermal scales associated with phase coherence, gap closing, and pseudogap formation, and establish characteristic spectroscopic and real-space signatures of the PDW state. Our results reveal altermagnetism as a robust route to thermally stable finite-momentum superconductivity and provide experimentally testable signatures for altermagnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate, non-perturbative static path approximation Monte Carlo approach, show）；研究对象：d波交变磁体（d-wave altermagnet）中的有限动量超导态，具体为配对密度波（PDW）相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交变磁性为二维体系中稳定有限动量超导态提供了一种无需外磁场的机制；d波交变磁体在有限温度窗口内支持稳健的PDW相，并具有明确的相变温度尺度与谱学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交变磁性为二维体系中稳定有限动量超导态提供了一种无需外磁场的机制；d波交变磁体在有限温度窗口内支持稳健的PDW相，并具有明确的相变温度尺度与谱学特征。；创新点：首次证明交变磁性本身（而非外加塞曼场）即可通过动量依赖的自旋劈裂增强有限质心动量配对不稳定性，从而在有限温度下稳定PDW相，并给出了可实验检验的谱学与实空间特征。
papers.method_zh: 非微扰静态路径近似蒙特卡洛方法（static path approximation Monte Carlo approach），用于处理强热涨落下有限温度超导态。

papers.title: Bias-Engineered Synthetic Antiferromagnets Hosting sub-20 nm Zero-Field Skyrmions at Room Temperature
papers.abstract: Synthetic antiferromagnetic skyrmions (SAFsk) are nanoscale, topologically protected spin textures with strong potential for spintronic technologies because of their high stability and the absence of the skyrmion Hall effect. However, robust zero field stabilization remains a central challenge. Here, a synthetic antiferromagnetic (SAF) bias system is introduced as a novel strategy to stabilize both ferromagnetic skyrmions (FMsk) and SAFsk at zero field. Ferromagnetic (FM) and SAF multilayers are designed, fabricated and integrated with the SAF bias system to enable controlled skyrmion stabilization and polarity setting via multilayer design and a preparatory field cycle. Combining quantitative and high-sensitivity magnetic force microscopy (MFM) with micromagnetic modeling, reliable zero field skyrmion formation is demonstrated and sub 20nm SAFsk are directly observed, the smallest SAFsk reported to date. Moreover, the SAF bias system concept introduced here offers a robust and scalable route to bias future skyrmion multilayers, as its compensated nature suppresses domain formation and preserves a uniform exchange field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：designed, fabricated, integrated, magnetic force microscopy, micromagnetic modeling）；研究对象：合成反铁磁斯格明子（SAFsk）及其在零磁场下的室温稳定化，具体材料为铁磁（FM）与合成反铁磁（SAF）多层膜体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入SAF偏置系统，成功在零磁场下稳定了铁磁斯格明子（FMsk）和合成反铁磁斯格明子（SAFsk），并直接观测到尺寸小于20 nm的SAFsk，这是迄今报道的最小尺寸。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入SAF偏置系统，成功在零磁场下稳定了铁磁斯格明子（FMsk）和合成反铁磁斯格明子（SAFsk），并直接观测到尺寸小于20 nm的SAFsk，这是迄今报道的最小尺寸。；创新点：提出并实现了SAF偏置系统这一新策略，利用其补偿特性抑制杂散场导致的畴形成，从而在零场下稳定斯格明子，且该方法具有可扩展性，可推广至未来斯格明子多层膜体系。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：高灵敏度磁力显微镜（MFM）进行定量成像；理论工具：微磁学模拟（micromagnetic modeling）。样品制备涉及多层膜设计与制备，以及预备场循环（preparatory field cycle）实现极性设定。

papers.title: Hydrodynamics and boundary-induced phase transitions in the $n$-species particle-exchange process
papers.abstract: The $n$-species particle-exchange process (PEP($n$)) is an exclusion process in which particles of $n$ different species exchange positions on neighbouring sites with rates chosen such that the invariant measure on the discrete torus is a product measure. We address the large-scale hydrodynamic behaviour of this process which yields a system of $n$ coupled inviscid Burgers equations. This system of conservation laws is shown to admit Riemann invariants for arbitrary $n$ from which explicit solutions of the Riemann problem in terms of shock waves and rarefaction fans are obtained. We also introduce the open PEP($n$), in which particles are exchanged with boundary reservoirs. For a distinguished manifold of boundary rates, we prove that the invariant measure is the same product measure as in the periodic system. The hydrodynamic description in terms of Riemann invariants is used to derive the stationary phase diagram explicitly in terms of microscopic boundary rates. In the generic case, the steady state exhibits $2n+1$ phases, with boundary-induced phase transitions analogous to those of the single-species asymmetric simple exclusion process.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：hydrodynamic behaviour（流体动力学行为）、invariant measure（不变测度）、Riemann invariants（黎曼不变量）、phase diagram（相图）。；研究对象：n种粒子交换过程（PEP(n)），即一种排斥过程，其中n种不同种类的粒子在相邻格点上以特定速率交换位置，使得离散环上的不变测度为乘积测度。研究还引入了开放边界条件下的PEP(n)系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该过程的大尺度流体动力学行为由n个耦合的无粘Burgers方程描述，且对于任意n，该系统均存在黎曼不变量，从而可显式求解黎曼问题（激波和稀疏波）。在开放边界条件下，系统稳态相图包含2n+1个相，并存在边界诱导的相变，类似于单物种非对称简单排斥过程（ASEP）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该过程的大尺度流体动力学行为由n个耦合的无粘Burgers方程描述，且对于任意n，该系统均存在黎曼不变量，从而可显式求解黎曼问题（激波和稀疏波）。在开放边界条件下，系统稳态相图包含2n+1个相，并存在边界诱导的相变，类似于单物种非对称简单排斥过程（ASEP）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过推导大尺度流体动力学极限，得到耦合的守恒律方程组；利用黎曼不变量求解黎曼问题；通过边界速率与不变测度的关系，显式推导稳态相图。

papers.title: Emergent Dynamic Magnetic Ground State in a Mixed 3d/5d Heavy Fermion System CaCu3Ir4O12
papers.abstract: Quantum-disordered magnetic ground states are challenging to identify in three-dimensional (3D) oxides, where strong exchange pathways typically favour long-range magnetic order or spin freezing. The quadruple perovskite $\mathrm{CaCu_3Ir_4O_{12}}$, crystallizing in the cubic $Im\bar{3}$ structure, provides a 3D lattice where $\mathrm{Cu^{2+}}$ $3d$ moments are coupled to an extended Ir $5d$ network, offering a rare platform for probing quantum-disordered magnetism in a mixed $3d/5d$ electron system. Here, we combine bulk probes, including DC and AC magnetic susceptibility, and heat capacity measurements (down to $50~\mathrm{mK}$), along with the local microscopic probe muon spin relaxation ($μ$SR) (down to $40~\mathrm{mK}$), to investigate the true magnetic ground state of $\mathrm{CaCu_3Ir_4O_{12}}$. Despite strong antiferromagnetic interactions ($θ_{\mathrm{W}} \sim -200~\mathrm{K}$, with an applied-field dependence), no signature of long-range magnetic ordering or spin freezing is detected down to the lowest measured temperatures. Furthermore, our in-depth zero-field (ZF) and longitudinal-field (LF) $μ$SR characterizations confirm strong quantum spin fluctuations and the truly dynamic nature of the local moments down to $40~\mathrm{mK}$. These results establish $\mathrm{CaCu_3Ir_4O_{12}}$ as a promising 3D quantum-disordered magnet and a well-characterized platform for exploring fluctuation-dominated states in correlated $3d/5d$ oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到结合了多种实验手段（bulk probes、μSR）进行测量。；研究对象：混合3d/5d电子体系中的量子无序磁性基态，具体化合物为四方钙钛矿CaCu₃Ir₄O₁₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CaCu₃Ir₄O₁₂中，尽管存在强反铁磁相互作用（θ_W ~ -200 K），但在低至40 mK的温度下未检测到长程磁有序或自旋冻结，而是观测到强烈的量子自旋涨落和局域磁矩的动态性质，表明该体系是一种三维量子无序磁体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CaCu₃Ir₄O₁₂中，尽管存在强反铁磁相互作用（θ_W ~ -200 K），但在低至40 mK的温度下未检测到长程磁有序或自旋冻结，而是观测到强烈的量子自旋涨落和局域磁矩的动态性质，表明该体系是一种三维量子无序磁体。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 直流与交流磁化率测量、比热测量（低至50 mK）、以及零场和纵场μ子自旋弛豫（μSR）技术（低至40 mK）。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal McKean-Vlasov Equations: From Stationary Instabilities to Travelling Waves
papers.abstract: Nonreciprocal interactions, in which action-reaction symmetry is broken, provide a powerful route to collective dynamics that cannot be captured by equilibrium free-energy minimisation. Here, we introduce and analyse a two-species nonreciprocal McKean-Vlasov equation derived from an underlying system of interacting stochastic particles. Combining linear stability analysis, weakly nonlinear arguments, pseudo-spectral simulations, and Langevin particle dynamics, we show that the structure of nonreciprocity controls the onset and nature of collective order. For spatially uniform weak nonreciprocity, asymmetry shifts the critical diffusion threshold but produces only stationary instabilities, indicating that uniform imbalance alone is insufficient to generate sustained time-dependent motion. In contrast, spatially modulated nonreciprocity fundamentally enriches the dynamics: depending on its symmetry and coupling to the interaction potential, the homogeneous state can lose stability through Hopf bifurcations, giving rise to standing and travelling wave states. We identify both subcritical and supercritical Hopf transitions, relate the selected patterns to Landau saturation coefficients, and show that travelling waves can emerge even in the weak-nonreciprocity regime without explicit microscopic run-and-chase rules. Direct Langevin simulations confirm that these oscillatory and travelling states persist at the particle level and are not artefacts of the continuum mean-field description. Our results establish nonreciprocal McKean-Vlasov equations as a minimal framework for understanding how spatially structured asymmetric interactions generate self-organized motion, dynamical phase transitions, and nonequilibrium collective order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算与模拟）。关键词：linear stability analysis, weakly nonlinear arguments, pseudo-spectral simulations, Langevin particle dynamics。；研究对象：非互易相互作用下的两物种McKean-Vlasov方程，以及由此产生的集体动力学行为，包括驻波和行波态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空间均匀的非互易性仅能改变临界扩散阈值并产生静态不稳定性，不足以产生持续的时间依赖运动；而空间调制的非互易性可通过Hopf分岔产生驻波和行波态，且行波可在弱非互易性下出现，无需显式的微观追逐规则。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空间均匀的非互易性仅能改变临界扩散阈值并产生静态不稳定性，不足以产生持续的时间依赖运动；而空间调制的非互易性可通过Hopf分岔产生驻波和行波态，且行波可在弱非互易性下出现，无需显式的微观追逐规则。；创新点：建立了非互易McKean-Vlasov方程作为理解空间结构化的非对称相互作用如何产生自组织运动、动力学相变和非平衡集体序的最小框架。摘要未突出说明与已有具体模型或方程的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 线性稳定性分析、弱非线性论证、伪谱数值模拟、朗之万粒子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Noncollinear antiferromagnetic structure and physical properties of CrRhAs with distorted kagome lattice
papers.abstract: CrRhAs was theoretically proposed to be a kagome metal with unusual magnetic ground states; however, little is known about its magnetic structure and physical properties experimentally. Here, we present an experimental investigation of CrRhAs with ZrNiAl-type structure and a distorted Cr kagome lattice. CrRhAs is an antiferromagnet with TN = 149 K. Powder neutron diffraction analysis reveals a noncollinear antiferromagnetic structure with propagation vector k = (1/3, 1/3, 1/2), which features a ferromagnetic second nearest neighbor coupling in the kagome plane that is different from the prediction in previous density functional theory calculations. Furthermore, CrRhAs exhibits anomalous electrical transport properties which are possibly related to multiband effects and strong spin fluctuations. For the temperature-dependent longitudinal resistivity \r{ho}xx, it is semiconductinglike above TN and becomes metallic below TN . The Hall coefficients exhibit two sign changes near 70 and 300 K. Combined with the results of heat capacity measurements, a large Kadowaki-Woods ratio α = 33.9 μΩ cm mol2 K2/J2 is obtained. The above results suggest CrRhAs is a strongly correlated kagome metal with multiband and noncollinear magnetic structure features.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimental investigation”、“powder neutron diffraction analysis”、“electrical transport properties”、“heat capacity measurements”等实验手段。；研究对象：CrRhAs化合物，具有ZrNiAl型结构和扭曲的Cr kagome晶格，是一种反铁磁kagome金属。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CrRhAs在TN=149 K时形成非共线反铁磁结构，传播矢量为k=(1/3, 1/3, 1/2)，其kagome面内铁磁第二近邻耦合与先前密度泛函理论预测不同；该材料表现出异常电输运性质，并具有较大的Kadowaki-Woods比值，表明其为强关联kagome金属。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CrRhAs在TN=149 K时形成非共线反铁磁结构，传播矢量为k=(1/3, 1/3, 1/2)，其kagome面内铁磁第二近邻耦合与先前密度泛函理论预测不同；该材料表现出异常电输运性质，并具有较大的Kadowaki-Woods比值，表明其为强关联kagome金属。；创新点：首次通过实验确定了CrRhAs的磁结构，发现其非共线反铁磁序与理论预测不同，并揭示了其强关联多带特征。
papers.method_zh: 粉末中子衍射分析确定磁结构；电阻率测量（纵向电阻率ρxx）和霍尔系数测量研究电输运性质；热容测量获取Kadowaki-Woods比值。

papers.title: Exciton-mediated optical control of liquid-solid friction
papers.abstract: Interfacial friction in nanofluidic systems can arise from fluctuation-induced coupling between liquid charge fluctuations and the internal excitations of the confining solid. Here, we develop a microscopic theory of exciton-mediated solid-liquid friction based on the coupling between optically generated excitons and charge fluctuations in water. We distinguish between static excitons, localized by disorder or functionalization, and dynamic excitons, which interact with water through polarization fluctuations. In both cases, we derive analytical formulas for the excitonic friction, which is experimentally tunable and can significantly reduce the slip length and thereby the hydraulic permeability of nanochannels. Applying our framework to carbon nanotubes, we quantitatively reproduce the recent measurements of Kistwal et al., showing a reduction of nanotube diffusion under optical excitation, without fitting parameters. More broadly, our results establish excitons as a mechanism to optically control nanofluidic transport and suggest that excitonic photoluminescence could provide an optical probe of flow velocity inside nanochannels.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a microscopic theory”“derive analytical formulas”，属于理论推导，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：激子介导的固液摩擦现象，具体体系为纳米通道（如碳纳米管）中水与固体界面之间的摩擦，以及激子（静态与动态）对摩擦的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激子（包括静态和动态）可通过与水中电荷涨落的耦合显著影响固液摩擦，从而减小滑移长度并降低纳米通道的水力渗透性；该理论无参数拟合地定量复现了碳纳米管中光激发下扩散减小的实验测量结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激子（包括静态和动态）可通过与水中电荷涨落的耦合显著影响固液摩擦，从而减小滑移长度并降低纳米通道的水力渗透性；该理论无参数拟合地定量复现了碳纳米管中光激发下扩散减小的实验测量结果。；创新点：首次提出激子作为光学调控纳米流体输运的机制，并指出激子光致发光可作为纳米通道内流速的光学探针。
papers.method_zh: 基于激子与水中电荷涨落耦合的微观理论，分别对静态激子（由无序或功能化局域化）和动态激子（通过极化涨落与水相互作用）推导出激子摩擦的解析公式。

papers.title: Dislocations in (011)-oriented vertical Bridgman $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ substrates
papers.abstract: Dislocation in (011)-oriented $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ substrates grown by the vertical Bridgman method was investigated using X-ray topography (XRT), combined with X-ray reticulography. Transmission XRT reveals dislocations lying on the (001) plane and extending along [010], forming arrays associated with domain boundaries. Dislocations on the (011) plane were also identified but differ from those responsible for line-shaped pits on (001) epilayers. Reflection XRT shows good agreement with transmission XRT and enables classification of dislocation types based on contrast features. Reticulography confirms domain boundaries with misorientation on the order of 1E-5 rad, providing insight into defect formation relevant to epi-growth and device performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“X-ray topography (XRT)”、“X-ray reticulography”、“transmission XRT”、“reflection XRT”等具体实验表征手段。；研究对象：采用垂直布里奇曼法生长的(011)取向β-Ga₂O₃衬底中的位错缺陷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在(011)取向β-Ga₂O₃衬底中，位错主要沿[010]方向分布在(001)面上，并形成与畴界相关的位错阵列；同时存在(011)面上的位错，但其特征与(001)外延层中导致线状蚀坑的位错不同。畴界的取向差约为10⁻⁵弧度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在(011)取向β-Ga₂O₃衬底中，位错主要沿[010]方向分布在(001)面上，并形成与畴界相关的位错阵列；同时存在(011)面上的位错，但其特征与(001)外延层中导致线状蚀坑的位错不同。畴界的取向差约为10⁻⁵弧度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 主要使用X射线形貌术（XRT），包括透射XRT和反射XRT，并结合X射线网格照相术（X-ray reticulography）进行位错类型分类和畴界表征。

papers.title: Spin-lattice coupling enables adaptive adsorption in magneticallydriven electrocatalysts
papers.abstract: A major challenge in electrochemistry is to decouple the reactive intermediates of a catalytic cycle to optimise their energies independently. During the oxygen evolution reaction (OER), such energy interdependence results from the need to generate multiple adsorbates at the same site and sets the minimum overpotential. Here, we show that an external stimulus, such as a magnetic field, can relax the scaling relationships between intermediates during the OER. Spectroscopic measurements and Density Functional Theory simulations in Ni-Fe oxyhydroxides reveal that applying a magnetic field alters surface chemisorption and injects structural flexibility at the interface. We interpret these observations as a consequence of stimulated changes in the spin-lattice coupling, which allow access to quasi-degenerate oxygenated intermediates that modulate the reaction energy demands. Our findings redefine the scaling limitations as state-projected rather than intrinsic and establish external stimulation as a strategy to navigate multi-state energy landscapes in electrocatalysis and sensing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中提及“Spectroscopic measurements”（光谱测量）和“Density Functional Theory simulations”（密度泛函理论模拟）。；研究对象：Ni-Fe羟基氧化物（Ni-Fe oxyhydroxides）在析氧反应（OER）中的表面化学吸附行为，以及磁场对自旋-晶格耦合的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 施加磁场可通过改变自旋-晶格耦合，在Ni-Fe羟基氧化物表面引入结构柔性，从而打破析氧反应中间体之间的传统标度关系，降低反应过电位。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：施加磁场可通过改变自旋-晶格耦合，在Ni-Fe羟基氧化物表面引入结构柔性，从而打破析氧反应中间体之间的传统标度关系，降低反应过电位。；创新点：首次提出外部磁场刺激可作为策略，通过激发自旋-晶格耦合变化来“状态投影式”地重新定义标度限制，而非将其视为固有性质，从而在电催化中实现多态能量景观的导航。
papers.method_zh: 光谱测量（具体技术未明确说明）与密度泛函理论（DFT）模拟相结合。

papers.title: Point-gap topology of damped magnon excitations in skyrmion strings
papers.abstract: We theoretically study the non-Hermitian topology of magnons with finite lifetimes due to Gilbert damping. By incorporating the spin-wave theory and perturbation theory for the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation including nonlocal damping terms, we analytically evaluate the spectral winding number for point gaps, which indicates the existence of the non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE). We find that the NHSE can occur even in the absence of nonlocal damping. In the presence of nonlocal damping along one direction, we show that the winding number for an energy band with a unique minimum is determined from the sign of the wave number at the band minimum. We demonstrate these results using a model that hosts a skyrmion-string lattice as a steady state. We further investigate spin-wave propagation dynamics excited by a magnetic-field pulse and show that the propagation direction changes drastically from band to band depending on the presence of local and nonlocal damping, consistent with the nontrivial winding numbers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“theoretically study”、“analytically evaluate”、“demonstrate using a model”。；研究对象：论文研究的是斯格明子弦（skyrmion strings）晶格中具有有限寿命的阻尼磁振子（damped magnon excitations）的非厄米拓扑性质，具体关注点间隙拓扑（point-gap topology）与非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现即使在没有非局域阻尼的情况下，非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）仍可发生；在存在沿某一方向的非局域阻尼时，能带极小值处的波数符号决定了该能带的绕数（winding number）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现即使在没有非局域阻尼的情况下，非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）仍可发生；在存在沿某一方向的非局域阻尼时，能带极小值处的波数符号决定了该能带的绕数（winding number）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自旋波理论与针对包含非局域阻尼项的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程的微扰理论，解析计算了点间隙的谱绕数（spectral winding number），并通过磁场脉冲激发的自旋波传播动力学进行了验证。

papers.title: Effective Gilbert damping in the stochastic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation
papers.abstract: Quasi particle based (e.g. Boltzmann equation) studies of spin wave transport often assume that their scattering rates follow the simple form $η=αω$, with the Gilbert damping $α$ and frequency $ω$. In this work, we examine the effective damping $α_{eff,T}=η/ω$ observed in atomistic spin dynamics, when temperature and spin wave interactions are introduced for a 1D spin chain. We extract the dynamical correlation functions from spin trajectories propagated using the stochastic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation, and fit the dynamical structure factor, yielding the dispersion and scattering rates for a wide range of temperatures. The resulting effective damping can be very different from the initially constant Gilbert value. It exhibits a temperature and crystal momentum scaling which we explain based on interactions with the Gilbert bath and spin wave scattering by changes in local magnetic order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：stochastic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation（随机LLG方程）、atomistic spin dynamics（原子自旋动力学）、数值拟合。；研究对象：一维自旋链中，在有限温度和自旋波相互作用下的有效Gilbert阻尼（effective damping）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有效阻尼α_eff,T与初始设定的常数Gilbert阻尼α显著不同，表现出温度和晶体动量的依赖关系，这种依赖源于与Gilbert热库的相互作用以及局域磁序变化导致的自旋波散射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有效阻尼α_eff,T与初始设定的常数Gilbert阻尼α显著不同，表现出温度和晶体动量的依赖关系，这种依赖源于与Gilbert热库的相互作用以及局域磁序变化导致的自旋波散射。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程模拟一维自旋链的动力学轨迹，从中提取动力学关联函数，并通过拟合动力学结构因子（dynamical structure factor）获得不同温度下的色散关系和散射率。

papers.title: Revisiting Ferroelectricity Beyond Polar Space Groups
papers.abstract: Ferroelectricity, a hallmark of spontaneous inversion-symmetry breaking, has been a central concept in condensed matter physics and functional materials research, yet recent discoveries are revealing that switchable polarization can emerge in forms far richer than allowed by the conventional symmetry-based paradigm. Fractional quantum ferroelectricity and ionic-conductor ferroelectricity challenge the long-standing association of ferroelectricity exclusively with polar space groups. In this Review, we reconcile these emerging phenomena within the Berry-phase modern theory of polarization. We emphasize that polarization in insulating periodic crystals is not a single-valued vector, but a multivalued lattice quantity defined modulo a polarization quantum. Consequently, nonpolar crystals may possess nonzero formal polarization, and adiabatic paths connecting symmetry-equivalent structures can produce quantized changes in polarization without violating symmetry principles. The symmetry of this multivalued formal polarization is governed by a generalized Neumann principle. We further show that the large polarization changes induced by long-range ion migration in both fractional quantum ferroelectrics and ionic-conductor ferroelectrics can be naturally understood through the topological definition of oxidation state, which links ionic transport to quantized charge transfer and polarization change. We discuss the physical accessibility of these unconventional polarization states, highlighting the roles of switching pathways, boundary conditions, and domain-wall dynamics, particularly in systems such as $α$-In$_2$Se$_3$. Finally, we suggest that the most promising functionality of these materials may lie not in conventional bulk ferroelectric switching, but in the creation and control of charged interfaces and domain walls arising from discontinuities in formal polarization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Berry-phase modern theory of polarization、generalized Neumann principle、topological definition of oxidation state）；研究对象：非常规铁电性，包括分数量子铁电性（fractional quantum ferroelectricity）和离子导体铁电性（ionic-conductor ferroelectricity），以及相关材料如α-In₂Se₃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非极性晶体可以具有非零的形式极化（formal polarization），且通过绝热路径连接对称等价结构可产生量子化的极化变化，从而在超越传统极性空间群框架下实现可切换极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非极性晶体可以具有非零的形式极化（formal polarization），且通过绝热路径连接对称等价结构可产生量子化的极化变化，从而在超越传统极性空间群框架下实现可切换极化。；创新点：将分数量子铁电性和离子导体铁电性统一纳入现代极化理论框架，指出极化是模极化量子（polarization quantum）的多值晶格量，并揭示长程离子迁移导致的极化变化可通过氧化态的拓扑定义自然理解。
papers.method_zh: 基于Berry相位的现代极化理论（Berry-phase modern theory of polarization），结合广义诺伊曼原理（generalized Neumann principle）和氧化态的拓扑定义（topological definition of oxidation state）进行理论分析。

papers.title: Rabi-coupling-induced three-component quantum droplet in ultracold Bose gases
papers.abstract: We uncover a new mechanism for realizing three-component quantum droplets in ultracold Bose gases, where only one inter-species interaction is attractive. In this scheme, the inter-species attraction leads to a self-bound binary droplet, and the third component joins through Rabi coupling with one component of the binary droplet. We find that a stronger Rabi coupling leads to a larger fraction of the third component, but also destabilizes the entire droplet due to the involvement of more repulsive forces. Such instability can be remedied by a finite detuning between the Rabi-coupled components. We demonstrate these results in realistic Na-Rb mixtures, using both thermodynamic analyses and numerical simulations based on extended Gross-Pitaevskii equations.
