Our work outlines a general route for stabilizing multi-component droplets by bridging an existing binary droplet with additional components via suitable single-particle fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：thermodynamic analyses, numerical simulations, extended Gross-Pitaevskii equations）；研究对象：超冷玻色气体中由Rabi耦合诱导的三组分量子液滴（具体体系：Na-Rb混合物）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过仅引入一种吸引性种间相互作用形成自束缚二元液滴，再借助Rabi耦合将第三组分接入，可稳定实现三组分量子液滴；有限失谐可补偿因强Rabi耦合引入的排斥力导致的不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过仅引入一种吸引性种间相互作用形成自束缚二元液滴，再借助Rabi耦合将第三组分接入，可稳定实现三组分量子液滴；有限失谐可补偿因强Rabi耦合引入的排斥力导致的不稳定性。；创新点：提出一种通过单粒子场（Rabi耦合）将额外组分桥接到已有二元液滴上，从而稳定多组分液滴的通用方案，区别于传统依赖多种吸引相互作用的机制。
papers.method_zh: 热力学分析（thermodynamic analyses）与基于扩展Gross-Pitaevskii方程（extended Gross-Pitaevskii equations）的数值模拟。

papers.title: Water adsorption on a model silicate surface: wollastonite (100)
papers.abstract: Water adsorption on silicate surfaces is a critical yet poorly understood process relevant to, e.g., mineral weathering and cement hydration. This study investigates the structure of water overlayers on a model calcium silicate, the lowest-energy (100) surface of wollastonite (CaSiO3). It combines atomically resolved non-contact atomic force microscopy (nc-AFM), acquired with qPlus sensors and functionalized tips in ultrahigh vacuum (UHV), with density functional theory (DFT) calculations employing the metaGGA r2SCAN+rVV10 functional. Adding incremental doses of water to the sample at cryogenic temperatures produces distinct structures governed by the competition between water-surface and water-water interactions. With two water molecules per surface unit cell, water-surface interactions dominate: In line with previous theoretical predictions, adsorbates follow the surface lattice. As the coverage increases, intermolecular hydrogen bonding competes with bonding to the surface, leading to the emergence of complex, coexisting patterns. While their small energy differences prevent an unambiguous identification of the most stable structure by DFT, the experimentally observed symmetries help constrain plausible structural models. Above a critical density of four water molecules per unit cell, water-water interactions prevail, and water clusters are formed. The results provide an atomic-scale framework for understanding water interactions with calcium silicate surfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。关键词：non-contact atomic force microscopy (nc-AFM)、density functional theory (DFT) calculations。；研究对象：水在硅酸盐矿物表面的吸附行为，具体体系为硅灰石（wollastonite, CaSiO₃）的(100)表面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温下逐步增加水分子覆盖度，水-表面相互作用与水-水相互作用的竞争导致水层结构从遵循表面晶格（低覆盖度）演变为复杂共存图案（中等覆盖度），最终形成水团簇（高覆盖度）。当每个表面晶胞水分子数达到4个时，水-水相互作用占主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温下逐步增加水分子覆盖度，水-表面相互作用与水-水相互作用的竞争导致水层结构从遵循表面晶格（低覆盖度）演变为复杂共存图案（中等覆盖度），最终形成水团簇（高覆盖度）。当每个表面晶胞水分子数达到4个时，水-水相互作用占主导。；创新点：首次通过原子级实验观测（nc-AFM）结合高精度DFT计算，揭示了水在钙硅酸盐模型表面（硅灰石(100)）上从单分子吸附到团簇形成的完整覆盖度依赖结构演化，并明确了水-表面与水-水相互作用的竞争机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用qPlus传感器和功能化针尖在超高真空（UHV）中进行原子分辨非接触原子力显微镜（nc-AFM）成像；理论上使用metaGGA r2SCAN+rVV10泛函进行密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Breaking the Trade-off: Bulk 2D Ising Superconductivity with High Tc and Giant Interlayer Spacing via a Unique Chain Intercalation in (BaS)1/3TaS2
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) are promising platforms for low dimensional superconductivity. However, in conventional intercalated systems, achieving a high superconducting transition temperature (Tc) often comes at the expense of reduced interlayer spacing and weakened 2D character. Here, we overcome this long-standing compromise through a unique chain-like intercalation strategy. We report the synthesis and properties of a new polymorph, (BaS)1/3TaS2, in which a distinctive Ba-S-S-Ba chain structure is inserted between TaS2 bilayers. This unique configuration breaks the bulk c axis mirror symmetry while achieving exceptional interlayer decoupling, with an inter-bilayer spacing of 12.75 Å-more than three times that of pristine 2H-TaS2. By suppressing interlayer electronic coupling, this structural evolution allows local inversion symmetry breaking within individual TaS2 layers to dominate. This prevents compensation of the Ising spin-orbit fields typical of centrosymmetric bulk phases, enabling robust 2D Ising superconductivity. Remarkably, the compound exhibits an enhanced Tc without sacrificing its large interlayer spacing, thereby breaking the conventional trade-off between large spacing/high anisotropy and high Tc. Comprehensive transport, magnetic, and thermodynamic measurements confirm its robust superconducting state. Our work establishes a versatile intercalation framework for designing bulk-like 2D Ising superconductors, providing a new route to reconcile competing material demands and expanding the scope of Ising superconductivity research.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“合成”、“输运、磁性和热力学测量”等实验手段。；研究对象：一种新型插层化合物 (BaS)1/3TaS2，其中独特的链状 Ba-S-S-Ba 结构插入 TaS2 双层之间，实现块体中的二维伊辛超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过独特的链状插层策略，在 (BaS)1/3TaS2 中同时实现了高超导转变温度（Tc）和巨大的层间距（12.75 Å），打破了传统插层体系中高 Tc 与大层间距/高各向异性之间的权衡，并获得了稳健的块体二维伊辛超导电性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过独特的链状插层策略，在 (BaS)1/3TaS2 中同时实现了高超导转变温度（Tc）和巨大的层间距（12.75 Å），打破了传统插层体系中高 Tc 与大层间距/高各向异性之间的权衡，并获得了稳健的块体二维伊辛超导电性。；创新点：提出并实现了一种链状插层策略，在保持块体材料宏观结构的同时，通过打破体相 c 轴镜面对称性并极大增强层间解耦（层间距为原始 2H-TaS2 的三倍以上），使得单层 TaS2 内的局域反演对称性破缺占主导，从而避免了中心对称体相中伊辛自旋轨道场的补偿效应，实现了块体中的二维伊辛超导。
papers.method_zh: 合成新多型体 (BaS)1/3TaS2；进行了全面的输运、磁性和热力学测量以表征超导态。

papers.title: Frustration of harmonic and solitonic helimagnetism on the body-centered tetragonal lattice of GdAlSi
papers.abstract: The triangular lattice antiferromagnet (TLAF) with nearest-neighbor exchange interaction is a model platform in the field of frustrated magnetism. Here, anharmonic ('up-up-down') and harmonic magnetic states compete, because a helimagnetic wave and its higher harmonic are degenerate in energy. We show that a body-centered tetragonal lattice (BCTL) can realize a similar frustration of harmonic and anharmonic helimagnetic states, and that the tetragonal magnetic Weyl semimetal GdAlSi realizes this scenario. In an applied magnetic field, resonant elastic X-ray scattering reveals a competition of harmonic cycloidal and solitonic double-Q states, well consistent with mean-field calculations. Our work provides a new paradigm for frustration physics in BCTL materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论计算）。判断依据：摘要中提及“resonant elastic X-ray scattering”（实验手段）和“mean-field calculations”（理论计算）。；研究对象：体心四方晶格（BCTL）材料GdAlSi中的谐波与孤子型螺旋磁性竞争现象，以及由此产生的阻挫物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在体心四方晶格中，谐波（cycloidal）与孤子型双Q（double-Q）磁态在磁场下竞争，类似于三角晶格反铁磁体中的“上-上-下”与谐波螺旋磁态竞争，为BCTL材料中的阻挫物理提供了新范式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在体心四方晶格中，谐波（cycloidal）与孤子型双Q（double-Q）磁态在磁场下竞争，类似于三角晶格反铁磁体中的“上-上-下”与谐波螺旋磁态竞争，为BCTL材料中的阻挫物理提供了新范式。；创新点：首次在体心四方晶格体系中实现类似三角晶格反铁磁体中的谐波与非谐波螺旋磁态阻挫，并具体在磁性Weyl半金属GdAlSi中验证了这一物理场景。
papers.method_zh: 共振弹性X射线散射（resonant elastic X-ray scattering）实验，结合平均场（mean-field）理论计算。

papers.title: Physics-informed operator learning for transferable energy-dissipative microstructure dynamics
papers.abstract: Phase-field simulations provide mechanistic descriptions of microstructure evolution, but repeated high-fidelity integration over long horizons and broad parameter spaces remains computationally expensive. We present PFNet, a physics-informed neural operator framework that advances microstructural states by learning conditional evolution operators rather than direct correlations. PFNet combines a diffusion-inspired U-Net with periodic padding, entropy-based state conditioning and thermodynamic-parameter modulation to encode boundary consistency, instantaneous ordering state and changes in the free-energy landscape. For Cahn-Hilliard coarsening, PFNet achieves accurate one-step prediction and stable autoregressive rollouts across composition, gradient-energy coefficient, coarsening stage and morphology class, with errors concentrated near diffuse interfaces and topology-changing regions. The same framework extends to a four-channel martensitic-transformation benchmark without martensite-specific redesign. These results indicate that physics-informed operator learning can provide transferable surrogates for phase-field dynamics and broader energy-dissipative dynamical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：physics-informed neural operator framework、phase-field simulations、computationally expensive）；研究对象：微结构演化动力学，具体包括Cahn-Hilliard粗化过程以及马氏体相变基准问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PFNet框架能够通过学习条件演化算子实现跨组分、梯度能系数、粗化阶段和形态类别的稳定自回归预测，且误差主要集中在扩散界面和拓扑变化区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PFNet框架能够通过学习条件演化算子实现跨组分、梯度能系数、粗化阶段和形态类别的稳定自回归预测，且误差主要集中在扩散界面和拓扑变化区域。；创新点：提出了一种可迁移的物理信息算子学习方法，无需针对特定微结构（如马氏体）重新设计网络，即可适用于不同能量耗散动力学系统。
papers.method_zh: 物理信息神经算子框架（PFNet），结合扩散启发的U-Net、周期性填充、基于熵的状态条件化以及热力学参数调制。

papers.title: Topological Characterization of Discrete-Time Classical Stochastic Processes: Dual Role of Point-Gap Topology
papers.abstract: We present topological characterization of classical stochastic processes described by discrete-time Markov chains on lattices. We point out that point-gap topology of stochastic matrices entails two distinct physical consequences that hinge on the choice of the reference point. The point-gap topology around a generic reference point is related to the direction of transport, and nontrivial topology around the origin of the complex spectrum of a stochastic matrix implies non-Markovianity caused by, e.g., feedback control. On the basis of this characterization, we identify the topological origin of directed transport in a classic experiment of Maxwell's demon [S. Toyabe et al., Nat. Phys. 6, 988 (2010)] and find the topological nature of feedback control beyond thermodynamic interpretation. We demonstrate that a topologically enforced non-Markovian classical stochastic process can be simulated by a Markovian quantum master equation, indicating a topological form of quantum advantage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We present topological characterization”“We point out”“We identify”等理论推导与概念分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟的具体手段。；研究对象：离散时间经典随机过程，具体为格点上的马尔可夫链，以及与之相关的输运方向、非马尔可夫性、反馈控制等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 点-隙拓扑在随机矩阵中具有双重物理作用：围绕一般参考点的拓扑与输运方向相关，而围绕原点（复谱零点）的非平凡拓扑则意味着由反馈控制等引起的非马尔可夫性。该拓扑框架可解释麦克斯韦妖实验中的定向输运，并揭示反馈控制的拓扑本质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：点-隙拓扑在随机矩阵中具有双重物理作用：围绕一般参考点的拓扑与输运方向相关，而围绕原点（复谱零点）的非平凡拓扑则意味着由反馈控制等引起的非马尔可夫性。该拓扑框架可解释麦克斯韦妖实验中的定向输运，并揭示反馈控制的拓扑本质。；创新点：首次将点-隙拓扑应用于经典随机过程，并揭示其与输运方向及非马尔可夫性的双重关联；指出反馈控制具有超越热力学解释的拓扑本质；提出一种拓扑形式的量子优势，即用马尔可夫量子过程模拟拓扑强制的非马尔可夫经典过程。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：点-隙拓扑（point-gap topology）分析，应用于随机矩阵的复谱结构；结合经典实验（S. Toyabe et al., Nat. Phys. 2010）进行拓扑起源的识别；通过马尔可夫量子主方程模拟拓扑强制的非马尔可夫经典随机过程。

papers.title: Physics Aware Representation Learning on Electronic Charge Density for Materials Property Prediction
papers.abstract: The fundamental quantity governing the mechanical and thermodynamic properties of a crystalline solid is its electronic charge density. Yet, its direct use for the rapid prediction of materials properties remains challenging due to its high dimensionality. Here, we present a physics-informed deep learning framework that directly predicts mechanical and thermodynamic properties from the three-dimensional electronic charge density derived from density functional theory (DFT). The proposed approach first utilizes a three-dimensional convolutional autoencoder for unsupervised dimensionality reduction, compressing a high-resolution charge-density grid (128 x 128 x 128) into a compact latent representation (16 x 16 x 16 x 16) while preserving physically meaningful features, as confirmed by negligible reconstruction errors across diverse crystal systems. The compressed latent-space representation of charge density is then used by two different regression models for property prediction: Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) and Attention-based 3D Convolutional Neural Networks (Att CNN), and their performance is compared. Combining composition-based descriptors (Material Agnostic Platform for Informatics and Exploration or MAGPIE) with electronic charge density data further improves the model accuracy. Using a dataset of about 6059 inorganic compounds spanning multiple crystal symmetries, the models achieve strong predictive performance for bulk modulus K (R2 = 0.94), Young's modulus E (R2 = 0.88), shear modulus G (R2 = 0.87), formation energy Eform (R2 = 0.96), and Debye temperature Θ (R2 = 0.89). This work establishes electronic charge density as a transferable, physics-grounded descriptor for materials property prediction, requiring ~ 1/25 the computational resources of full-fledged DFT calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：deep learning framework、density functional theory (DFT)、dimensionality reduction、regression models。；研究对象：无机晶体材料的力学和热力学性质。具体性质包括：体模量 (K)、杨氏模量 (E)、剪切模量 (G)、形成能 (Eform) 和德拜温度 (Θ)。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作证明，从DFT计算得到的三维电子电荷密度，经过深度学习框架压缩后，可以作为预测材料力学和热力学性质的有效且可迁移的物理描述符，其预测精度高，且计算成本仅为完整DFT计算的约1/25。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作证明，从DFT计算得到的三维电子电荷密度，经过深度学习框架压缩后，可以作为预测材料力学和热力学性质的有效且可迁移的物理描述符，其预测精度高，且计算成本仅为完整DFT计算的约1/25。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，主要创新在于：1. 直接利用三维电子电荷密度作为物理描述符，而非传统的成分或结构特征。2. 通过自编码器实现物理上有意义的降维，使得高维电荷密度数据可用于快速性质预测。3. 展示了该方法的可迁移性和计算效率优势。
papers.method_zh: 1. 使用三维卷积自编码器对高分辨率（128x128x128）的DFT电荷密度网格进行无监督降维，压缩为紧凑的潜空间表示（16x16x16x16）。2. 将压缩后的潜空间表示分别输入两种回归模型进行性质预测：LightGBM和基于注意力机制的3D卷积神经网络（Att CNN）。3. 将基于成分的描述符（MAGPIE）与电荷密度数据结合，以进一步提高模型精度。4. 数据集包含约6059种跨越多种晶体对称性的无机化合物。

papers.title: A Hardware-aware Hopfield Network with a Nonlinear Memristor Array for Robust Associative Memory with Superlinear Capacity
papers.abstract: Associative memory retrieves complete patterns from partial or corrupted inputs and constitutes a primitive form of generative inference. Classical Hopfield networks (CHN) provide a canonical framework for associative memory but suffer from limited memory capacity. Recently, modern Hopfield networks (MHN) were introduced to achieve higher capacity by using explicit pattern-wise storage and neurons with the softmax activation function, which makes the MHN vulnerable to noise and the hardware implementation complicated due to its network size varying with the number of stored patterns. Here, we introduce a hardware-aware Hopfield network (HHN), in which the intrinsic nonlinear current-voltage characteristics of a charge-trap memristor are leveraged to engineer the energy landscape of the HN, increasing the memory capacity. Using a 25 x 25 nonlinear memristor array, we demonstrate reliable reconstruction of corrupted patterns with memory capacity far exceeding the classical limit (K ~ 0.14N, where N is the number of neurons). The HHN preserves Hopfield-type energy-minimization dynamics and remains robust to synaptic conductance noise. Large-scale simulations on high-dimensional image data reveal an empirical memory capacity scaling of K ~ 0.3 x N^1.2 under a fixed synaptic budget. These results establish HHN as a scalable hardware-native architecture for low-power associative memory and generative inference.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中同时描述了使用“25 x 25非线性忆阻器阵列”进行实验演示，以及“大规模高维图像数据模拟”进行性能标定。；研究对象：基于忆阻器硬件的联想记忆神经网络，具体为一种硬件感知的霍普菲尔德网络（HHN），利用电荷陷阱忆阻器的非线性电流-电压特性来构建。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该硬件感知霍普菲尔德网络（HHN）的记忆容量远超经典霍普菲尔德网络的极限（K ~ 0.14N），在固定突触预算下，经验容量标度律为 K ~ 0.3 × N^1.2，并且对突触电导噪声具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该硬件感知霍普菲尔德网络（HHN）的记忆容量远超经典霍普菲尔德网络的极限（K ~ 0.14N），在固定突触预算下，经验容量标度律为 K ~ 0.3 × N^1.2，并且对突触电导噪声具有鲁棒性。；创新点：提出了一种硬件原生（hardware-native）的霍普菲尔德网络架构（HHN），通过利用忆阻器固有的非线性特性（而非像现代霍普菲尔德网络那样依赖复杂的软max激活函数和随模式数量变化的网络规模）来提升记忆容量，从而在保持霍普菲尔德型能量最小化动力学的同时，简化了硬件实现并增强了抗噪能力。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，使用一个25×25的非线性忆阻器阵列构建HHN，并演示其对损坏模式的重建。理论上，通过大规模高维图像数据模拟，拟合出经验记忆容量标度律。核心是利用忆阻器的非线性电流-电压特性来工程化霍普菲尔德网络的能量景观。

papers.title: Hybrid-order topology in two-dimensional nonsymmorphic antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: We theoretically demonstrate hybrid-order topology in a two-dimensional nonsymmorphic antiferromagnet. Utilizing a generic antiferromagnetic Dirac model with a symmetry-allowed, momentum-dependent spin-density-wave (SDW) mass, we show that a single bulk insulating phase exhibits distinct topological boundary manifestations governed solely by the termination geometry. For screw-compatible edges, nonsymmorphic screw symmetry protects gapless first-order edge states. In contrast, for a $45^\circ$ diamond-shaped termination, the screw symmetry is broken at the boundary, resulting in gapped edges. However, the finite geometry still preserves magnetic mirror symmetries $\mathcal{M}_x\mathcal{T}$ and $\mathcal{M}_y\mathcal{T}$, which enforce an alternating pattern of edge masses, thereby binding zero-dimensional corner states. This second-order phase is characterized by a quantized quadrupole moment, with corner states pinned to zero energy by the chiral symmetry. We further demonstrate that explicit lattice perturbations can selectively gap the first-order edge modes while robustly preserving the corner states. Our work establishes a symmetry-based route to a termination-controlled duality between first- and second-order topology in magnetic nonsymmorphic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretically demonstrate”“utilizing a generic model”“we show”等表述，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：二维非对称性反铁磁体中的混合阶拓扑现象，具体基于一个具有动量依赖自旋密度波（SDW）质量项的反铁磁狄拉克模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单一体绝缘相中，仅通过改变边界终止几何（如螺旋对称性兼容的边或45°菱形边界），即可分别实现一阶拓扑边缘态或二阶拓扑角态，即一阶与二阶拓扑之间的终止可控对偶性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单一体绝缘相中，仅通过改变边界终止几何（如螺旋对称性兼容的边或45°菱形边界），即可分别实现一阶拓扑边缘态或二阶拓扑角态，即一阶与二阶拓扑之间的终止可控对偶性。；创新点：首次在磁性非对称性体系中提出并证明“混合阶拓扑”概念，即同一体相可通过边界终止几何在受螺旋对称性保护的一阶边缘态与受磁镜对称性保护的二阶角态之间切换，并展示了晶格微扰可选择性地破坏一阶边缘态而保留二阶角态。
papers.method_zh: 采用对称性分析结合通用反铁磁狄拉克模型，引入对称性允许的动量依赖SDW质量项，通过分析边界对称性（螺旋对称性、磁镜对称性）和拓扑不变量（四极矩）来表征不同终止下的边界态行为。

papers.title: Floquet second-order topological insulator in strained graphene
papers.abstract: Graphene provides a canonical setting for Floquet band engineering, where circularly polarized light can dynamically open topological gaps at Dirac points and generate nonequilibrium Hall responses. Here we show that uniaxial strain and off-resonant circularly polarized light with tunable incidence angle enable a controllable route to Floquet higher-order topology in graphene. Using a strained honeycomb tight-binding model with Peierls coupling and a high-frequency expansion for the effective Floquet Hamiltonian, we find that strain drives the Dirac cones toward the Dirac-merging (semi-Dirac) critical regime, where the light-induced mass becomes strongly anisotropic. For oblique incidence, the projected drive is effectively elliptically polarized and, in combination with strain, stabilizes a phase with gapped edges but robust in-gap corner modes in finite geometries, realizing a Floquet second-order topological insulator. We characterize the phase diagram via the Chern number and a crystalline-symmetry-quantized polarization invariant. Finally, first-principles-informed tight-binding calculations corroborate the predicted topological evolution in strained graphene nanostructures. Our results identify driven strained graphene as a realistic and tunable platform for realizing and diagnosing Floquet higher-order topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章（关键词：tight-binding model、high-frequency expansion、first-principles-informed tight-binding calculations）；研究对象：应变石墨烯（strained graphene）在圆偏振光驱动下的Floquet高阶拓扑绝缘体相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过单轴应变和可调入射角的非共振圆偏振光，可以在石墨烯中实现Floquet二阶拓扑绝缘体，其特征为体态能隙、边缘能隙但存在稳健的角态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过单轴应变和可调入射角的非共振圆偏振光，可以在石墨烯中实现Floquet二阶拓扑绝缘体，其特征为体态能隙、边缘能隙但存在稳健的角态。；创新点：首次提出在石墨烯中通过应变与斜入射圆偏振光的协同作用，可控地实现Floquet高阶拓扑绝缘体，并揭示了从狄拉克锥到半狄拉克临界区的光致质量各向异性机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用含Peierls耦合的应变蜂窝紧束缚模型，结合高频展开方法推导有效Floquet哈密顿量；通过陈数（Chern number）和晶体对称性量子化的极化不变量表征相图；最后用第一性原理参数化的紧束缚计算验证应变石墨烯纳米结构中的拓扑演化。

papers.title: Coherent Nonreciprocal Valley Transport in Dirac/Weyl Semimetals
papers.abstract: Nonreciprocal electronic transport, defined as a directional asymmetry between the forward and backward two-terminal responses, typically requires a built-in inversion-breaking feature of the host material or an applied field, such as magnetic order, magnetochiral coupling, polar lattice distortion, or a superconducting state. Here, we show that a single electrostatic barrier whose shape lacks inversion symmetry can drive coherent nonreciprocal transport in a Dirac or Weyl channel without any of these ingredients. The mechanism is geometric: across a barrier with two qualitatively distinct refraction interfaces (one vertical and one oblique), forward- and backward-propagating wave packets experience different Fermi-surface-mismatch sequences at the entrance and exit faces. Using coherent split-operator Dirac wave-packet simulations with realistic device parameters, we show that in a channel with isotropic (untilted) energy dispersion, an inversion-asymmetric (right-angle) triangular barrier produces strong charge-mode rectification, establishing its purely geometric origin. Adding a Dirac-cone tilt turns the same shape into a coherent valley-resolved diode whose dichroic structure flips sign across the Dirac point. Strikingly, a mirror-symmetric (isosceles) triangle with two oblique faces exhibits valley-polarized transmission while remaining exactly reciprocal. Oblique interfaces and tilt together do not suffice; the essential ingredient is a sequence of geometrically distinct interface types.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“show that”、“using coherent split-operator Dirac wave-packet simulations”、“establishing its purely geometric origin”，属于理论计算与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：狄拉克/外尔半金属中的非互易谷输运现象，具体研究在无磁场、无磁序、无超导等传统非互易条件时，仅通过几何形状不对称的静电势垒实现电荷与谷极化的定向输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 一个形状缺乏反演对称性的静电势垒（如直角三角形势垒）可以在狄拉克/外尔通道中驱动相干非互易输运，其机制是纯几何的：向前和向后传播的波包在势垒入口和出口经历不同的费米面失配序列。此外，通过引入狄拉克锥倾斜，可将同一形状转变为相干谷分辨二极管，其二向色性在狄拉克点处符号翻转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：一个形状缺乏反演对称性的静电势垒（如直角三角形势垒）可以在狄拉克/外尔通道中驱动相干非互易输运，其机制是纯几何的：向前和向后传播的波包在势垒入口和出口经历不同的费米面失配序列。此外，通过引入狄拉克锥倾斜，可将同一形状转变为相干谷分辨二极管，其二向色性在狄拉克点处符号翻转。；创新点：首次提出仅通过势垒几何形状的不对称性（而非材料本征反演破缺或外加场）即可实现非互易输运，并揭示了“几何上不同类型的界面序列”是实现非互易性的关键要素，而非单纯的倾斜界面或狄拉克锥倾斜。
papers.method_zh: 采用相干分裂算符狄拉克波包模拟（coherent split-operator Dirac wave-packet simulations），结合实际器件参数，对具有各向同性（无倾斜）和各向异性（有倾斜）能量色散的狄拉克通道中的三角形势垒进行输运模拟。

papers.title: Fine-tuning a vision-language model for fracture-surface morphology recognition
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for scientific image understanding, but general-purpose models often lack the domain-specific visual knowledge required for reliable materials characterization. In this work, we fine-tuned an open-source VLM (Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct) for fracture-surface image analysis using a curated dataset of 13,168 open-source, literature-mined fracture-surface images. Morphology annotations were generated by GPT-5.2-Reasoning (high) from both the images and relevant excerpts of their source papers, and the dataset was further enriched with targeted manual collection and rotation-based augmentation. The resulting specialist model outperforms flagship proprietary multimodal models on a benchmark of 100 manually annotated images. It achieves a precision of 0.92, compared to 0.35 for the base Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, 0.58 for GPT-5.5-Reasoning (high), and 0.78 for Gemini 3.1 Pro-Reasoning (high). Dataset ablations show that manual collection of rare-feature images and augmentation via image rotation are both beneficial to improve recognition of less common fracture morphology features. We further discuss integrated use of the fine-tuned model with proprietary models to combine fracture-specific visual accuracy with broader multimodal reasoning for autonomous fractography. Although focused on fracture-surface images, this work demonstrates how VLMs can be adapted through targeted collection and fine-tuning on novel feature images to recognize those features and support downstream decision-making in autonomous microscopy workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。关键词：fine-tuned、dataset curation、benchmark、dataset ablations。；研究对象：断口表面形貌（fracture-surface morphology）的图像识别，具体为材料科学中的断口分析。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过微调开源视觉-语言模型（Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct），在断口表面形貌识别任务上，模型精度从基线的0.35提升至0.92，超越多个旗舰闭源多模态模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过微调开源视觉-语言模型（Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct），在断口表面形貌识别任务上，模型精度从基线的0.35提升至0.92，超越多个旗舰闭源多模态模型。；创新点：展示了通过针对性收集稀有特征图像和旋转增强，可有效提升视觉-语言模型对罕见断口形貌特征的识别能力，并提出了将微调模型与闭源模型结合用于自主断口分析的集成策略。
papers.method_zh: 使用13,168张文献挖掘的断口表面图像构建数据集，由GPT-5.2-Reasoning（高）根据图像和论文摘要生成形貌标注，并辅以人工收集和旋转增强。微调模型为Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct，评估基准为100张人工标注图像。

papers.title: Revisiting magnetoelectric response in collinear antiferromagnetic zigzag chains: A downfolding approach beyond conventional low-energy models
papers.abstract: Magnetoelectric (ME) effects in antiferromagnets provide a fertile platform for exploring symmetry-driven cross-correlated responses. However, their microscopic origin remains elusive and is often obscured in simplified low-energy descriptions. In this study, we revisit the microscopic mechanism of the ME effect in a collinear antiferromagnetic zigzag chain by employing a multi-orbital tight-binding model that explicitly includes both $s$- and $p$-orbital degrees of freedom. Using analytical and numerical calculations based on the Kubo formula, we demonstrate that the ME response is governed by orbital degrees of freedom activated through $s$--$p$ hybridization, while the spin contribution vanishes due to spin conservation. To elucidate the low-energy description, we derive an effective Hamiltonian projected onto the $s$-orbital subspace using the Schur complement. We show that a naive application of the Kubo formula within this effective model fails to capture the ME response. This issue is resolved by systematically incorporating vertex corrections in terms of orbital hybridization into the response functions. Furthermore, by introducing a quasiparticle renormalization scheme, we formulate a renormalized Kubo formula that preserves conservation laws and accurately reproduces the full multi-orbital results. Our analysis revisits the conventional low-energy perspective and reveals that the ME effect originates from virtual interorbital processes encoded in vertex corrections, rather than from the bare low-energy Hamiltonian. The effective framework developed here provides a unified microscopic understanding of orbital-driven ME responses and offers a systematic route to incorporate hybridization effects beyond simple low-energy models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：multi-orbital tight-binding model、Kubo formula、Schur complement、vertex corrections、quasiparticle renormalization scheme。；研究对象：共线反铁磁锯齿链中的磁电效应（magnetoelectric effect），具体关注其微观起源与低能描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁电响应由通过s-p杂化激活的轨道自由度主导，自旋贡献因自旋守恒而消失；该效应源于虚拟的轨道间过程（编码在顶点修正中），而非裸低能哈密顿量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁电响应由通过s-p杂化激活的轨道自由度主导，自旋贡献因自旋守恒而消失；该效应源于虚拟的轨道间过程（编码在顶点修正中），而非裸低能哈密顿量。；创新点：揭示了传统低能模型直接应用Kubo公式无法捕捉磁电响应的根本原因，并系统性地发展了包含轨道杂化顶点修正的有效框架，从而统一了轨道驱动磁电响应的微观理解。
papers.method_zh: 采用包含s和p轨道自由度的多轨道紧束缚模型，基于Kubo公式进行解析和数值计算；利用Schur complement推导投影到s轨道子空间的有效低能哈密顿量；通过引入顶点修正和准粒子重整化方案，构建了保持守恒律的重整化Kubo公式。

papers.title: Anomalous Phase-Coherence Scaling in a Quantum-Critical Dirac Semimetal
papers.abstract: We have investigated the weak antilocalization (WAL) in the pressurized Dirac semimetal $α$-(BEDT-TTF)$_2$I$_3$ across a correlation-driven quantum phase transition to a charge-ordered insulating state and evaluated the phase coherence length $L_φ$ and its temperature scaling under various pressures from the low-temperature magnetoconductivity. In the high-pressure regime, the system exhibits the conventional two-dimensional dephasing behavior ($L_φ \propto T^{-p}$ with $p \approx 1/2$), characteristic of electron-electron scattering in diffusive conductors. As the pressure approaches the critical pressure ($P_c \sim 1.2$ GPa), the temperature exponent is suppressed to $p \sim 0.3$, while $L_φ$ remains large ($700\text{-}800$ nm at 0.5 K). This anomalous scaling suggests nontrivial inelastic scattering associated with Dirac electrons near the quantum critical point. The persistence of WAL across the transition supports a gapless or nearly gapless quantum phase transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：investigated、evaluated、low-temperature magnetoconductivity。；研究对象：加压下的狄拉克半金属 α-(BEDT-TTF)₂I₃，及其在关联驱动的量子相变（向电荷有序绝缘态转变）过程中的弱反局域化（WAL）效应和相位相干长度标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在接近量子临界点（P_c ~ 1.2 GPa）时，相位相干长度的温度标度指数从常规二维扩散体系的 p ≈ 1/2 异常地抑制至 p ~ 0.3，表明量子临界点附近存在与狄拉克电子相关的非弹性散射。WAL在整个相变过程中持续存在，支持该量子相变为无隙或近无隙的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在接近量子临界点（P_c ~ 1.2 GPa）时，相位相干长度的温度标度指数从常规二维扩散体系的 p ≈ 1/2 异常地抑制至 p ~ 0.3，表明量子临界点附近存在与狄拉克电子相关的非弹性散射。WAL在整个相变过程中持续存在，支持该量子相变为无隙或近无隙的。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过测量不同压力下的低温磁导率，提取并分析相位相干长度 L_φ 及其温度标度（L_φ ∝ T^{-p}）。

papers.title: Nonadiabatic Theory of Phonon Magnetic Moments in Insulators and Metals
papers.abstract: We develop a nonadiabatic theory of phonon magnetic moments applicable to both insulators and metals. By relating the phonon magnetic moment to the force-velocity response of ions in a magnetic field, we derive a gauge-invariant expression using a gauge-covariant Wigner expansion. The formalism naturally separates Fermi-sea and Fermi-surface contributions and captures the full dependence on phonon frequency. In gapped systems, our theory reduces to previous adiabatic expressions in the low-frequency limit. Beyond this limit, it reveals additional contributions arising from resonant interband processes and the Fermi surface. Applying our theory to Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_x$Te, we find that the Fermi-surface contribution substantially enhances the phonon magnetic moment, reproducing the same order of magnitude as the experimental observation. Our results provide a unified framework for describing phonon magnetic moments beyond the adiabatic regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a nonadiabatic theory、derive a gauge-invariant expression、formalism。；研究对象：声子磁矩（phonon magnetic moments）在绝缘体（insulators）和金属（metals）中的非绝热理论，具体应用于Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非绝热框架下，声子磁矩包含费米海和费米面贡献，且费米面贡献在Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe中显著增强声子磁矩，使其与实验观测数量级一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非绝热框架下，声子磁矩包含费米海和费米面贡献，且费米面贡献在Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe中显著增强声子磁矩，使其与实验观测数量级一致。；创新点：建立了适用于绝缘体和金属的统一非绝热声子磁矩理论，揭示了超出绝热近似（beyond the adiabatic regime）的共振带间过程和费米面贡献，而此前理论仅适用于低频极限下的绝热情形。
papers.method_zh: 采用规范协变Wigner展开（gauge-covariant Wigner expansion），将声子磁矩与磁场中离子的力-速度响应（force-velocity response）关联，推导出规范不变表达式。

papers.title: Multilane Asymmetric Exclusion Process with stationary Bernoulli measure
papers.abstract: We consider an Asymmetric Exclusion Process evolving on parallel mutually interacting lanes with neighbouring nearest hoppings of hardcore particles. Number of particles on each lane is conserved. We find a choice of the hopping rates, for which the process has Bernouilli stationary product measure, and calculate the stationary particle currents as a function of average particle densities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Asymmetric Exclusion Process、stationary Bernoulli measure、hopping rates。；研究对象：多车道非对称排斥过程（Multilane Asymmetric Exclusion Process），即硬核粒子在平行且相互作用的车道上的最近邻跳跃输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 找到了使该过程具有伯努利平稳乘积测度的一组跳跃速率，并计算了作为平均粒子密度函数的稳态粒子流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：找到了使该过程具有伯努利平稳乘积测度的一组跳跃速率，并计算了作为平均粒子密度函数的稳态粒子流。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用非平衡统计物理中的排斥过程理论框架，通过构造特定跳跃速率条件，推导出系统的平稳乘积测度，并解析计算稳态粒子流。

papers.title: Topological superconductivity in a Hubbard model for twisted bilayer cuprates
papers.abstract: We investigate the emergence of nontrivial topology in a twisted cuprate bilayer described by the Hubbard model in the weak-interaction regime. Our results show that the topological character depends sensitively on the doping level. For $U/t=3.85$, the Chern number assumes a value of $\pm 8$ in the electron-doped case, whereas it vanishes (0) in the hole-doped regime. The presence of nontrivial topology is further supported by an analysis the associated edge states and their chirality in a finite-width geometry, while keeping full correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“Hubbard model”、“Chern number”、“分析边缘态”，属于理论计算与模型分析。；研究对象：扭曲双层铜氧化物（twisted bilayer cuprates）中的拓扑超导性，具体由Hubbard模型描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱相互作用下，扭曲铜氧化物双层体系的拓扑性质对掺杂水平高度敏感：电子掺杂时陈数为±8，呈现非平庸拓扑；空穴掺杂时陈数为0，拓扑平庸。边缘态及其手性进一步支持了非平庸拓扑的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱相互作用下，扭曲铜氧化物双层体系的拓扑性质对掺杂水平高度敏感：电子掺杂时陈数为±8，呈现非平庸拓扑；空穴掺杂时陈数为0，拓扑平庸。边缘态及其手性进一步支持了非平庸拓扑的存在。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Hubbard模型（弱相互作用区间，U/t=3.85），通过计算陈数（Chern number）以及有限宽度几何下的边缘态和手性分析来研究拓扑性质，同时保持完全关联（full correlations）。

papers.title: Fluctuation-driven chiral ferromagnetism
papers.abstract: In general, quantum fluctuations are suppressed in ferromagnetic materials because they admit a simple unfrustrated ground state, greatly limiting the scope of phenomena that can be observed in these materials. In this work, we show how magnetization-non-conserving couplings fundamentally alter this paradigm by demonstrating the existence of a chiral ferromagnet that is stabilized by quantum fluctuations. More specifically, we show how these spin-orbit interactions modify the classical phase diagram; whereas a classical analysis predicts only collinear states, we observe fluctuation-stabilized phases, including a ferromagnet with large orbital chirality and a chiral stripe regime. We elucidate how such couplings spontaneously generate a scalar orbital chirality, in contrast to conventional mechanisms which rely upon a field-induced canting of vector chiral order. The resultant chiral states exhibit distinct transport signatures, namely an enhanced thermal Hall effect, and are of direct relevance to moiré heterostructures, Rydberg-atom arrays, and solid-state materials featuring non-Kramers spins.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“show how”“demonstrate”“elucidate”等理论推导和模型分析关键词，未提及实验或计算具体手段。；研究对象：手性铁磁体（chiral ferromagnet），具体涉及由量子涨落稳定、具有大轨道手性的铁磁态和手性条纹相，并关联到莫尔异质结、里德伯原子阵列和非Kramers自旋固体材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁化不守恒的自旋-轨道耦合可改变经典相图，使原本仅存在共线态的体系出现由量子涨落稳定的手性铁磁态，并自发产生标量轨道手性，而非传统机制中由场诱导的矢量手性倾斜。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁化不守恒的自旋-轨道耦合可改变经典相图，使原本仅存在共线态的体系出现由量子涨落稳定的手性铁磁态，并自发产生标量轨道手性，而非传统机制中由场诱导的矢量手性倾斜。；创新点：揭示了量子涨落可稳定手性铁磁态这一反直觉现象，并指出其手性来源于标量轨道手性的自发产生，区别于传统矢量手性倾斜机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过经典相图与量子涨落修正的对比，研究自旋-轨道相互作用对磁序的影响；未使用具体数值方法（如DMRG、DFT等），摘要未明确说明具体理论框架。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Open Hypothesis Learning from Autonomous Scanning Probe Microscopy Experiments
papers.abstract: Autonomous experimentation has transformed microscopy and materials discovery by enabling closed-loop optimization including imaging and spectroscopy tuning, strucutre property relationship discovery, and exploration of combinatorial libraries. However, most current workflows remain limited to selecting measurements within fixed objective or hypothesis spaces, rather than generating new physical models from experimental data. Here, we introduce an open hypothesis-learning framework that combines symbolic regression with large-language-model-based physical evaluation and implement it for autonomous scanning probe microscopy. Symbolic regression generates candidate analytical relationships directly from sparse measurements, while the language-model evaluator ranks these candidates according to physical plausibility, scaling behavior, and consistency with known mechanisms. We demonstrate the approach on autonomous piezoresponse force microscopy measurements of ferroelectric domain switching in a PZT thin film. Starting from five seed measurements, the workflow evolves from physically incomplete candidate expressions toward interpretable voltage-time growth laws consistent with kinetic domain-wall motion. This work extends autonomous microscopy from closed-loop optimization toward open hypothesis discovery, where candidate physical laws emerge from the experiment itself rather than being specified in advance. More broadly, the framework establishes a route for integrating symbolic regression, physical reasoning, and adaptive experimentation into hierarchical autonomous scientific workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据：自主实验（autonomous experimentation）、符号回归（symbolic regression）、大语言模型物理评估（large-language-model-based physical evaluation）、压电响应力显微镜实验（piezoresponse force microscopy measurements）。；研究对象：铁电畴翻转（ferroelectric domain switching）在PZT薄膜（PZT thin film）中的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作从少量初始测量数据出发，通过符号回归与大语言模型评估的迭代，演化出与动力学畴壁运动一致的电压-时间生长规律（voltage-time growth laws），实现了从实验数据中自主发现可解释物理定律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作从少量初始测量数据出发，通过符号回归与大语言模型评估的迭代，演化出与动力学畴壁运动一致的电压-时间生长规律（voltage-time growth laws），实现了从实验数据中自主发现可解释物理定律。；创新点：将自主显微镜从固定目标/假设空间的闭环优化（closed-loop optimization）拓展为开放假设发现（open hypothesis discovery），使候选物理定律由实验本身生成而非预先指定。摘要未突出说明与已有符号回归或自主实验框架的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 结合符号回归（symbolic regression）从稀疏测量数据中生成候选解析关系，并利用基于大语言模型（LLM）的物理评估器（physical evaluator）根据物理合理性、标度行为及与已知机制的一致性对候选表达式进行排序。实验平台为自主扫描探针显微镜（autonomous scanning probe microscopy），具体实施于压电响应力显微镜（piezoresponse force microscopy）。

papers.title: Majorana bound states in chiral ferromagnet-superconductor heterostructures revisited
papers.abstract: Majorana zero modes are central to the pursuit of fault-tolerant topological quantum computation. While traditionally sought in one-dimensional hybrid nanowires, a robust alternative platform involves heterostructures combining superconductors with noncollinear magnets. This work focuses on a particularly promising system: a chiral ferromagnet hosting a magnetic skyrmion coupled to a superconducting film containing a superconducting vortex. Such skyrmion-vortex pairs have recently been realized experimentally and are theorized to harbor localized Majorana states, offering a potential pathway for braiding operations. We present a comprehensive theoretical analysis of the low-energy quasiparticle bound states in these heterostructures. Extending previous studies, we develop an analytical framework for the Majorana wavefunctions as well as the wavefunctions and spectrum of other lowlying states within a Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach. Our analytical results explicitly demonstrate the critical role of spin-orbit coupling for the stabilization of Majorana modes and provides approximate analytical expressions for low-lying states localized at the vortex, both with and without an accompanying skyrmion. The derived analytical results show excellent agreement with numerical simulations. We further elucidate the role of realistic effects, including vector potentials and texture perturbations from stray magnetic fields, to assess their impact.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretical analysis、analytical framework、Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach、numerical simulations）；研究对象：手性铁磁体-超导体异质结中的斯格明子-涡旋对体系，具体为手性铁磁体中的磁性斯格明子与超导薄膜中的超导涡旋耦合形成的复合结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋-轨道耦合对马约拉纳零能模的稳定起关键作用；解析推导的低能态波函数和能谱与数值模拟高度吻合，并揭示了矢量势和杂散磁场等实际效应对马约拉纳态的影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋-轨道耦合对马约拉纳零能模的稳定起关键作用；解析推导的低能态波函数和能谱与数值模拟高度吻合，并揭示了矢量势和杂散磁场等实际效应对马约拉纳态的影响。；创新点：在已有研究基础上，首次建立了包含马约拉纳波函数及所有低能态波函数和能谱的完整解析框架，明确量化了自旋-轨道耦合对马约拉纳模稳定性的作用，并系统评估了矢量势和杂散磁场纹理扰动等实际效应的影响。
papers.method_zh: 基于Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）方法的解析理论框架，推导马约拉纳波函数及其他低能束缚态的波函数和能谱，并结合数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Does a Fractional Quantum Hall Edge Have a Protected Intrinsic Dipole Moment?
papers.abstract: We investigate the claims by Park and Haldane [Phys. Rev. B 90, 045123 (2014)] of an intrinsic protected value of the electric dipole moment at the physical edge of fractional quantum Hall (FQH) systems. Contrary to prevailing expectations, we find that the edge dipole takes the expected intrinsic value only in certain very special cases. We identify key limitations in earlier numerical studies and employ density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) methods to accurately compute the ground-state dipole. We focus on three representative systems: the $ν=1/3$-vacuum edge, the $ν=2/3$-vacuum edge, and the interface between Pfaffian and anti-Pfaffian phases. We find that the expected intrinsic dipole value occurs only at $ν=1/3$, whereas the other systems do not exhibit the claimed intrinsic value. We give arguments based on composite fermions as to why hierarchy states should generally not have protected intrinsic dipoles. These results have important implications for the energetics and edge structure of FQH states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）方法、复合费米子论证、数值计算。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔（FQH）系统的物理边界。具体包括：ν=1/3-真空边界、ν=2/3-真空边界，以及Pfaffian相与反Pfaffian相之间的界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分数量子霍尔系统边界并不普遍存在受保护的本征电偶极矩。只有在ν=1/3的特殊情况下，边界偶极矩才取到预期的本征值；而在ν=2/3边界和Pfaffian/反Pfaffian界面等其他体系中，该本征值并不存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分数量子霍尔系统边界并不普遍存在受保护的本征电偶极矩。只有在ν=1/3的特殊情况下，边界偶极矩才取到预期的本征值；而在ν=2/3边界和Pfaffian/反Pfaffian界面等其他体系中，该本征值并不存在。；创新点：指出了Park和Haldane此前关于FQH边界存在受保护本征电偶极矩的论断（Phys. Rev. B 90, 045123 (2014)）仅在特定情况下成立，并识别了早期数值研究中的关键局限性。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）方法精确计算基态偶极矩。同时，基于复合费米子理论给出理论论证，解释为何层级态（hierarchy states）通常不具有受保护的本征偶极矩。

papers.title: Disentangling bulk and surface electronic structure using targeted cleave planes in RuO$_2$
papers.abstract: Rutile RuO$_2$ has attracted significant interest due to its putative unconventional electronic and magnetic properties and its proximity to superconductivity. However, the measurement and interpretation of its electronic structure has been complicated by a strongly three-dimensional crystal structure. Here, we demonstrate how the preparation of targeted $(110)$ and $(100)$ surfaces via focused ion beam (FIB)-engineered cleaving allows the acquisition of high-quality measurements of the electronic structure using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Our results demonstrate that ARPES spectra of RuO$_2$ are, in fact, largely dominated by signatures of distinct surface electronic states. From comparison with density-functional theory, we resolve a surface termination-dependent variation of these, and disentangle them from highly-three-dimensional bulk states and surface resonances. Moreover, we find a marked role of the substantial spin-orbit coupling of the Ru 4$d$ orbitals in the surface region, where a breaking of spatial inversion symmetry leads to significant Rashba-type spin splittings of the surface bands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES)、focused ion beam (FIB)-engineered cleaving、与密度泛函理论对比）；研究对象：金红石相RuO₂的电子结构，特别是体态与表面态的区分，以及表面自旋轨道耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RuO₂的ARPES谱主要由表面电子态主导，而非体态；通过制备特定解理面（(110)和(100)），可区分高度三维的体态与表面态，并发现表面空间反演对称性破缺导致显著的Rashba型自旋劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RuO₂的ARPES谱主要由表面电子态主导，而非体态；通过制备特定解理面（(110)和(100)），可区分高度三维的体态与表面态，并发现表面空间反演对称性破缺导致显著的Rashba型自旋劈裂。；创新点：通过FIB工程化解理获得特定晶面，首次系统区分了RuO₂中高度三维的体态与表面终止依赖的表面态，并揭示了表面区域Ru 4d轨道强自旋轨道耦合导致的Rashba自旋劈裂。
papers.method_zh: 利用聚焦离子束（FIB）工程化解理制备特定(110)和(100)表面，结合角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量电子结构，并与密度泛函理论（DFT）计算结果进行对比分析。

papers.title: Bootstrapping ground state properties of classical frustrated magnets
papers.abstract: We introduce a method based on semidefinite programming that produces rigorous two-sided bounds on ground state energy densities and correlation functions of translation-invariant classical spin models on infinite lattices. In this method, the challenge of non-convex optimization on an infinite lattice is replaced with a hierarchy of finite-size convex optimizations arising from positivity conditions that any probability distribution over spin configurations must satisfy. This adapts the Lasserre hierarchy in the theory of polynomial optimization to the context of frustrated magnetism, and we prove convergence of this hierarchy in the thermodynamic limit. Our method subsumes the Luttinger--Tisza method and further applies to non-quadratic Hamiltonians and non-Bravais lattices, thus addressing limitations of prior analytical methods. We apply the method to various two-dimensional frustrated spin models, where it brackets the energy densities and observables accurately across large parameter ranges with typical run times of seconds per parameter point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“semidefinite programming”、“convex optimizations”、“Lasserre hierarchy”、“polynomial optimization”。；研究对象：经典阻挫自旋模型，特别是二维阻挫自旋模型（如三角晶格、笼目晶格等非布拉维晶格上的阻挫系统）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于半定规划的严格方法，能够对无限大晶格上平移不变经典自旋模型的基态能量密度和关联函数给出双侧严格界限，并证明了该方法在热力学极限下的收敛性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于半定规划的严格方法，能够对无限大晶格上平移不变经典自旋模型的基态能量密度和关联函数给出双侧严格界限，并证明了该方法在热力学极限下的收敛性。；创新点：该方法统一并超越了传统的Luttinger-Tisza方法，能够处理非二次型哈密顿量和非布拉维晶格，从而克服了先前解析方法的局限性。摘要未突出说明该方法在数值效率或可扩展性方面的具体创新细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用半定规划（Semidefinite Programming）构建层级凸优化方案（Lasserre hierarchy），将无限晶格上的非凸优化问题转化为有限尺寸的凸优化问题。该方法基于自旋构型概率分布必须满足的正定性条件。

papers.title: Direct Experimental Test of Conformal Invariance via Grazing Scattering: A Proposal for X-ray and Neutron Experiments
papers.abstract: We propose a test of conformal invariance in critical phenomena based on the study of a two-point correlation function in the presence of a boundary. This two-point function can be studied using X-ray or neutron scattering in the conditions of total reflection (so-called grazing scattering). The conformal Ward identity in momentum space is here expressed as a differential constraint on the scattering cross-section, as a function of the momentum transfer and the scattering angle. Experimental verification, using e.g. binary alloys, appears well within the existing techniques. This would be the first direct experimental test of conformal invariance in critical phenomena, a symmetry widely assumed but never directly verified.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose a test、conformal Ward identity、differential constraint）；研究对象：临界现象中的共形不变性，具体通过边界存在下的两点关联函数进行检验，建议使用二元合金等体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种通过X射线或中子掠射散射实验直接检验临界现象中共形不变性的方法，该对称性虽被广泛假设但从未被直接验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种通过X射线或中子掠射散射实验直接检验临界现象中共形不变性的方法，该对称性虽被广泛假设但从未被直接验证。；创新点：首次提出可直接实验验证临界现象中共形不变性的方案，而非仅依赖理论假设或间接证据。
papers.method_zh: 利用全反射条件下的X射线或中子散射（即掠射散射），将动量空间中的共形Ward恒等式表达为散射截面关于动量转移和散射角的微分约束。

papers.title: Quantum spin liquid on a 3D bipartite lattice of spin trimers stabilized by enhanced effective anisotropy
papers.abstract: Quantum spin liquids (QSLs) represent highly entangled states of matter in which frustration-induced quantum fluctuations suppress any symmetry-breaking phase transition down to absolute zero, giving rise to fractionalized excitations and emergent gauge fields. Theoretically, bond anisotropy can stabilize QSLs even on bipartite lattices, as exemplified by the Kitaev honeycomb model; however, no material has so far been established to realize such a state as its true ground state. Here we identify the three-dimensional spin-trimer magnet KBa$_3$Ca$_4$Cu$_3$V$_7$O$_{28}$ as a promising candidate for a bipartite quantum spin liquid persisting to the lowest temperatures. Strongly coupled Cu$^{2+}$ trimers form effective pseudospin-1/2 degrees of freedom upon cooling, which in turn constitute a three-dimensional bipartite network. Bulk thermodynamic measurements, neutron scattering, $μ$SR, and NMR detect no spin freezing or symmetry-breaking phase transition down to 20 mK, but instead reveal a gapless dynamical ground state with algebraic spin autocorrelations. Complementary Monte Carlo and exact-diagonalization calculations show that this state is stabilized by a strong enhancement of effective anisotropy: a weak microscopic Cu-Cu exchange anisotropy of approximately 15 percent is generically amplified at the trimer level, producing effective pseudospin-pseudospin interaction anisotropies of 60 to 100 percent. Our results establish trimer-based networks as a promising platform for realizing anisotropy-stabilized quantum entangled states, even in three-dimensional bipartite systems with only weak microscopic anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“bulk thermodynamic measurements, neutron scattering, μSR, and NMR”等实验手段，以及“Monte Carlo and exact-diagonalization calculations”等计算方法。；研究对象：三维自旋三聚体磁体 KBa₃Ca₄Cu₃V₇O₂₈ 中的量子自旋液体态，具体为基于Cu²⁺三聚体形成的三维二分网络中的量子自旋液体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料在低至20 mK的温度下未出现自旋冻结或对称性破缺相变，而是表现出具有代数自旋自关联的无能隙动力学基态，从而被确认为一种三维二分量子自旋液体的候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料在低至20 mK的温度下未出现自旋冻结或对称性破缺相变，而是表现出具有代数自旋自关联的无能隙动力学基态，从而被确认为一种三维二分量子自旋液体的候选材料。；创新点：首次在三维二分晶格体系中，通过有效各向异性的增强（微观Cu-Cu交换各向异性约15%被三聚体层级放大至60-100%）稳定了量子自旋液体态，建立了三聚体网络作为实现各向异性稳定化量子纠缠态的平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：体热力学测量、中子散射、μSR（μ子自旋弛豫）、NMR（核磁共振）。计算方面：蒙特卡洛模拟、精确对角化计算。

papers.title: Emergence of Tsallis Statistics from a Self-Referential Nonlinear Operator: A Variational Framework
papers.abstract: We develop a variational thermodynamic framework for statistical systems governed by a self-referential nonlinear operator Omega characterized by structural exponents alpha > 0, beta >= 0, a symmetric kernel K, and a self-coupling constant kappa >= 0. The central object is the self-consistency entropy S[Psi] = -D_KL(Psi || Omega Psi), which vanishes at the fixed points of Omega and serves as a natural Lyapunov functional. Within the local kernel (mean-field) approximation, minimization of the free energy F = U - T S admits the Tsallis q-exponential distribution as an equilibrium state, with the entropic index q = alpha + beta emerging directly from the fixed-point structure of the operator rather than being postulated. The framework yields a consistent thermodynamic description, including a generalized equation of state PV = (2 - q) T, response functions, and a critical temperature associated with spontaneous symmetry breaking. The relation q = alpha + beta connects independently measurable structural exponents of the feedback mechanism to the observed tail index, providing a parameter-free criterion that distinguishes this approach from superstatistics, constrained entropy maximization, and q-deformed formalisms. This work establishes an operator-theoretic foundation for nonextensive statistical mechanics in which nonlinear self-referential feedback naturally generates Tsallis statistics in the mean-field limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“variational thermodynamic framework”“self-referential nonlinear operator”“fixed-point structure”等理论框架术语，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：统计力学中由自指非线性算子描述的统计系统，具体研究在平均场近似下Tsallis统计（非广延统计力学）的涌现机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在局域核（平均场）近似下，自由能极小化自然导出Tsallis q-指数分布作为平衡态，且熵指数q = α + β直接由算子的不动点结构决定，而非人为假设。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在局域核（平均场）近似下，自由能极小化自然导出Tsallis q-指数分布作为平衡态，且熵指数q = α + β直接由算子的不动点结构决定，而非人为假设。；创新点：建立了非线性自指反馈机制与Tsallis统计之间的算子理论基础，将熵指数q与反馈算子的结构指数α、β直接关联，提供了区别于超统计、约束熵最大化和q-变形形式主义的无参数判据。
papers.method_zh: 变分热力学框架：构建自洽熵S[Ψ] = -D_KL(Ψ || ΩΨ)，在局域核（平均场）近似下对自由能F = U - T S进行变分极小化，推导出广义状态方程、响应函数及自发对称破缺临界温度。

papers.title: Diffusive transport from spatially correlated random phase kicks
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of a single-particle wave packet on a one-dimensional lattice subject to periodic random phase kicks with finite spatial correlation length. This stroboscopic setting provides a controllable model of dephasing in driven quantum systems. Using a momentum-space formulation, we show that the evolution is governed by an accumulated phase whose structure determines the spreading of the wave packet. We find that the phase kicks strongly suppress ballistic transport and induce diffusion at long times. We derive an explicit analytical expression for the diffusion coefficient as a function of the correlation length, in excellent agreement with numerical simulations. Our results uncover a simple mechanism by which spatially correlated phase noise controls quantum transport, and provide a quantitatively testable prediction for diffusion in periodically driven lattice systems. Possible experimental realizations in cold-atom platforms are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：study, show, derive, analytical expression, numerical simulations）；研究对象：一维晶格上单粒子波包在周期性随机相位敲击下的动力学，特别是具有有限空间关联长度的退相干效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空间关联的随机相位敲击会强烈抑制弹道输运，并在长时间尺度上诱导扩散行为；扩散系数与关联长度之间存在明确的解析关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空间关联的随机相位敲击会强烈抑制弹道输运，并在长时间尺度上诱导扩散行为；扩散系数与关联长度之间存在明确的解析关系。；创新点：揭示了空间关联相位噪声控制量子输运的简单机制，并给出了在周期性驱动晶格系统中扩散的可定量检验的预测。摘要未突出说明与已有退相干模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用动量空间表述分析波包演化，推导扩散系数的解析表达式，并通过数值模拟验证理论结果。

papers.title: Breakdown of Adiabatic Scaling and Noise-Induced Functional Synchronization in Deeply Quiescent Excitable Systems
papers.abstract: Coherence resonance (CR) characterizes noise-induced regularity in excitable systems, yet its evaluation in quiescent biological media is often obscured by flattened energy landscapes and complex nonlinear dynamics. In this study, we investigate the stochastic dynamics of a 3D Sherman-Rinzel-Keizer (SRK) model driven by multiplicative Feller noise. We show that traditional extremal evaluations of CR encounter a "bathtub effect" a broad resonance valley that can lead to statistical inaccuracies. To address this, we propose a logarithmic centroid extraction method, which filters out stochastic jitter and recovers the underlying adiabatic Kramers scaling with high linearity (R^2 > 0.95). Furthermore, we identify the physical boundary where this adiabatic approximation breaks down under the strong-noise limit. Extending our analysis to gap-junction coupled systems, we observe a noise-induced transition from sub-threshold physiological shivering (characterized by statistical correlation but negligible functional output) to macroscopic functional synchronization. Our results provide a mathematical framework for extracting optimal noise intensities in broad energy valleys and offer insights into how quiescent biological systems utilize stochastic fluctuations for functional recovery
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：模型驱动、数值分析、数学框架提取。；研究对象：三维Sherman-Rinzel-Keizer（SRK）模型驱动的可激发系统，具体研究噪声诱导的相干共振（CR）及功能同步现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统极值评估方法在平坦能量景观中会遭遇“浴缸效应”（宽共振谷导致统计误差），而提出的对数质心提取方法能恢复高线性度的绝热Kramers标度；在强噪声极限下绝热近似失效，且耦合系统中噪声可诱导从亚阈值生理颤抖到宏观功能同步的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统极值评估方法在平坦能量景观中会遭遇“浴缸效应”（宽共振谷导致统计误差），而提出的对数质心提取方法能恢复高线性度的绝热Kramers标度；在强噪声极限下绝热近似失效，且耦合系统中噪声可诱导从亚阈值生理颤抖到宏观功能同步的转变。；创新点：首次指出传统CR极值评估在平坦能量景观中的“浴缸效应”并给出修正方法；明确了绝热近似在强噪声极限下的物理边界；揭示了静息可激发系统中噪声从亚阈值相关到宏观功能同步的转变机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用三维SRK模型，引入乘性Feller噪声驱动；提出对数质心提取方法以过滤随机抖动；通过线性拟合评估绝热Kramers标度的恢复程度（R²>0.95）；分析间隙连接耦合系统的噪声诱导同步转变。

papers.title: Landau free energy and the absence of spontaneous magnetization of the one-dimensional Ising model
papers.abstract: We revisit the problem of spontaneous magnetization of the one-dimensional Ising model from the Landau free energy perspective. To this end, we define and calculate the density of states of the one-dimensional Ising model following a technique introduced by Ising. The observed monotonicity property of the density of states suggests heuristically that the model does not exhibit spontaneous magnetization at any finite temperature. Subsequently, we solve the model exactly in the thermodynamic limit by employing the maximum-term approximation, which is feasible due to the simple analytical expression of the density of states. We also show that the Landau free energy is an increasing function of $|m|$ and its second derivative at $m=0$ is positive and non-analytic in temperature, proving rigorously the absence of spontaneous magnetization of the model at any finite temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“Landau free energy”、“density of states”、“maximum-term approximation”、“rigorously proving”。；研究对象：一维伊辛模型的自发磁化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从朗道自由能角度严格证明了一维伊辛模型在任何有限温度下都不存在自发磁化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从朗道自由能角度严格证明了一维伊辛模型在任何有限温度下都不存在自发磁化。；创新点：从朗道自由能视角重新审视一维伊辛模型的自发磁化问题，并严格证明了其不存在自发磁化，同时揭示了朗道自由能在m=0处的二阶导数对温度的非解析性。
papers.method_zh: 采用伊辛引入的技术计算态密度，利用态密度的单调性进行启发式论证，并通过最大项近似在热力学极限下精确求解模型，最后分析朗道自由能对磁化强度m的依赖关系及其在m=0处的二阶导数。

papers.title: Coupling an elastic string to an active bath: the emergence of inverse damping
papers.abstract: We consider a slow elastic string with Klein-Gordon dynamics coupled to a bath of run-and-tumble particles. We derive and solve the induced Langevin-Klein-Gordon string dynamics with explicit expressions for the streaming term, friction coefficient, and noise variance. These parameters are computed exactly in a weak coupling expansion. The induced friction is a sum of two terms: one entropic, proportional to the noise variance as in the Einstein relation for a thermal equilibrium bath, and a frenetic contribution that can take both signs. The frenetic part wins for higher bath persistence, making the total friction negative, and hence creating a wave instability akin to inverse Landau damping. However, this acceleration decreases and eventually disappears when the propulsion speed of the active particles becomes much higher. Detailed simulations confirm the initial growth driven by this anti-damping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：derive, solve, weak coupling expansion, simulations）；研究对象：耦合到活性浴（run-and-tumble particles bath）的慢速弹性弦（Klein-Gordon动力学弦）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性浴可诱导出负的总摩擦系数，产生类似逆朗道阻尼的波动不稳定性；但当活性粒子推进速度过高时，这种加速效应会减弱并最终消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性浴可诱导出负的总摩擦系数，产生类似逆朗道阻尼的波动不稳定性；但当活性粒子推进速度过高时，这种加速效应会减弱并最终消失。；创新点：发现活性浴诱导的摩擦由熵项（正比于噪声方差，类似热平衡爱因斯坦关系）和可正可负的“狂热项”（frenetic contribution）组成，且当浴的持久性（persistence）较高时狂热项占优导致负摩擦，揭示了活性浴中逆阻尼的微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 弱耦合展开（weak coupling expansion）解析推导Langevin-Klein-Gordon弦动力学中的流项、摩擦系数和噪声方差；辅以数值模拟验证初始增长阶段。

papers.title: Hot biexcitons driven by extreme optical confinement
papers.abstract: A powerful means to understanding condensed matter that possesses a multi-constituent, non-isolated, and complex nature, with a preeminent example being two-dimensional (2D) materials, is studying many-body interactions. However, experimentally observing high-order many-body interactions is a daunting task due to its heavy reliance on the abundance of low-order complexes. Here, we report the observation of four-body hot biexcitons in an energetically unfavorable bilayer of tungsten disulfide (WS2) through creating extreme optical confinement. Specifically, we integrate a non-radiative bound state in the continuum (BIC) into a photonic crystal (PhC) defect cavity, forming a quasi-three-dimensional (q-3D) but open confinement for photons at the driving frequency. The extremely confined photons in both reciprocal and physical spaces then excite inherently unproductive two-body hot excitons situated slightly above the indirect bandgap so efficiently that they form overwhelmed higher-order four-body hot biexcitons. Distinctively, these hot biexcitons exhibit substantial valley polarization and coherence at room temperature, which we attribute to the topological nature of BICs and the associated q-3D confinement with an orbital angular momentum. Besides achieving room-temperature biexcitons, the q-3D confinement could be valuable for higher-order interactions, such as triexcitons, and many other many-body phenomena, including Bose-Einstein condensation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：observation, report, integrate, excite。；研究对象：二硫化钨（WS2）双层中的热双激子（hot biexcitons），以及通过极端光学局域（extreme optical confinement）实现的多体相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在能量上不利的WS2双层中，通过极端光学局域实现了四体热双激子的观测，这些热双激子在室温下表现出显著的谷极化和相干性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在能量上不利的WS2双层中，通过极端光学局域实现了四体热双激子的观测，这些热双激子在室温下表现出显著的谷极化和相干性。；创新点：首次在WS2双层中观测到四体热双激子，并利用BIC的拓扑性质和准三维局域（含轨道角动量）在室温下实现显著的谷极化和相干性。摘要未突出说明与以往双激子研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 将非辐射连续谱束缚态（BIC）集成到光子晶体（PhC）缺陷腔中，形成准三维（q-3D）但开放的光子局域结构，用于驱动频率下的光子局域；通过极端局域的光子激发间接带隙上方的热激子，进而形成高阶热双激子。

papers.title: Analytical Solution to the Kronig-Penney Model with Harmonic Oscillator Wells: Insights to Tight-Binding
papers.abstract: The celebrated Kronig-Penney model traditionally has been formulated with square well potentials representing atomic centres. Here, we use a slightly more realistic potential, the truncated harmonic oscillator, in lieu of square well potentials, and solve the model analytically. We derive the energy dispersion and wave functions for this model. This configuration has some important similarities and differences compared to the usual model. In particular, we write the governing equation in a form suggestive of the tight-binding approximation, as can be done for the usual model. In this way, it is straightforward to derive an expression for the tunneling amplitude used in tight-binding in terms of the harmonic oscillator potential parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical solution、derive、model。；研究对象：Kronig-Penney模型，但将传统的方势阱替换为截断谐振子势，用于描述周期性势场中的电子能带结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 使用截断谐振子势替代方势阱后，该模型仍可解析求解，并得到了能量色散关系和波函数。该模型与标准Kronig-Penney模型既有重要相似性也有差异，且其控制方程可写成紧束缚近似的形式，从而直接导出用谐振子势参数表示的隧穿振幅表达式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：使用截断谐振子势替代方势阱后，该模型仍可解析求解，并得到了能量色散关系和波函数。该模型与标准Kronig-Penney模型既有重要相似性也有差异，且其控制方程可写成紧束缚近似的形式，从而直接导出用谐振子势参数表示的隧穿振幅表达式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析求解。具体为：将Kronig-Penney模型中的方势阱替换为截断谐振子势，通过求解薛定谔方程得到解析的能带和波函数，并将方程形式与紧束缚近似建立联系。

papers.title: Susceptibilities and Patterning: A Primer on Linear Response in Bayesian Learning
papers.abstract: These notes introduce the theory of susceptibilities as developed in [arXiv:2504.18274, arXiv:2601.12703] for interpreting neural networks. The susceptibility of an observable $φ$ to a data perturbation is defined as a derivative of a posterior expectation, which by the fluctuation--dissipation theorem equals a posterior covariance. Different choices of $φ$ yield different objects: per-sample losses give the influence matrix (the Bayesian influence function of [arXiv:2509.26544]), while component-localized observables give the structural susceptibility matrix that pairs model components with data patterns. The susceptibility matrix is (up to a factor of $nβ$) the Jacobian of the map from data distributions to structural coordinates; its pseudo-inverse provides a linearized solution to the patterning problem of [arXiv:2601.13548]: finding data perturbations that produce a desired structural change. We motivate the theory from its statistical-mechanical foundations, then give a detailed exposition of susceptibilities, their empirical estimators, and their connection to the geometry of the loss landscape.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduces the theory、statistical-mechanical foundations、theoretical exposition。；研究对象：该论文的研究对象并非具体的凝聚态物理材料或体系，而是**神经网络**。它从统计力学和贝叶斯学习的角度，研究神经网络对数据扰动的线性响应（磁化率）及其与模型结构变化（图案化）之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文建立了神经网络中可观测量的后验期望对数据扰动的导数（磁化率）与后验协方差之间的等价关系（涨落-耗散定理）。通过定义不同的可观测量，该理论框架可以统一描述影响函数（针对样本损失）和结构磁化率矩阵（将模型组件与数据模式配对），并提供了通过数据扰动实现特定结构变化的线性化解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文建立了神经网络中可观测量的后验期望对数据扰动的导数（磁化率）与后验协方差之间的等价关系（涨落-耗散定理）。通过定义不同的可观测量，该理论框架可以统一描述影响函数（针对样本损失）和结构磁化率矩阵（将模型组件与数据模式配对），并提供了通过数据扰动实现特定结构变化的线性化解。；创新点：摘要未突出说明该工作相对于已有研究的单一、具体的创新点，但其核心贡献在于：1）将统计力学中的磁化率/涨落-耗散定理系统性地引入到贝叶斯学习框架中，用于解释神经网络；2）通过统一“影响矩阵”和“结构磁化率矩阵”的概念，为理解数据扰动如何影响模型结构（图案化问题）提供了一个线性化的理论工具。
papers.method_zh: 该工作完全基于**理论推导**。它从统计力学基础出发，形式化地定义了磁化率，并详细阐述了其经验估计量以及与损失景观几何的联系。论文引用了其前期工作（arXiv:2504.18274, arXiv:2601.12703）作为理论发展的基础。

papers.title: Multilayer model for coatings with arbitrary layers for superconducting radio-frequency applications
papers.abstract: We extend the multilayer model of \etal{Kubo} for superconductor-insulator-superconductor (SIS) structures in two ways: first, by generalizing it to arbitrary sequences of layers of arbitrary type, i.e. superconducting, normal conducting, and insulating; and second, by accounting for all contributions, including ohmic losses and dielectric effects. We examine the maximum applicable field for $(\text{SI})^n\text{S}$ structures. We find that the optimum configuration corresponds to the $n=1$ case. However, the thickness of the superconducting coating layers can be reduced to below their penetration depth with minor performance penalty. We discuss the ability to model transitions in SS bilayers by introducing a set of virtual layers that represent the transition region through interpolated parameters. We find degradation of the maximum applicable field with thicker transition layers, and a larger effective penetration depth of the electromagnetic fields. Furthermore, the surface impedance of the multilayer structure is calculated using the Leontovich boundary condition, yielding a formulation suitable for integration into finite element simulations. Additionally, the Poynting theorem is used to determine the loss contributions of individual layers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：extend the multilayer model、generalizing、calculate、formulation。；研究对象：用于超导射频（SRF）应用的任意层状涂层结构，包括超导体-绝缘体-超导体（SIS）结构、超导-超导（SS）双层结构等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于(SI)^nS结构，最优配置对应n=1的情况；超导涂层厚度可减至穿透深度以下而性能损失较小；过渡层越厚，最大可施加场退化越严重，电磁场有效穿透深度越大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于(SI)^nS结构，最优配置对应n=1的情况；超导涂层厚度可减至穿透深度以下而性能损失较小；过渡层越厚，最大可施加场退化越严重，电磁场有效穿透深度越大。；创新点：将原有仅适用于SIS结构的模型推广至任意类型（超导、正常导体、绝缘体）的任意层序列，并全面考虑了欧姆损耗和介电效应；通过引入虚拟层和插值参数，实现了对SS双层中过渡区的建模。
papers.method_zh: 基于Kubo等人的多层模型进行推广，采用Leontovich边界条件计算多层结构的表面阻抗，并利用坡印廷定理确定各层的损耗贡献。

papers.title: Reducibility of native weighted graphs on Rydberg Arrays
papers.abstract: We investigate the classical reducibility of random unit-disk graph (UDG) instances of the maximum independent set (MIS) and maximum weighted independent set (MWIS) problems, which can be natively realised in Rydberg atom quantum processors. Using state-of-the-art kernelisation techniques, we systematically probe how far classical preprocessing can simplify such native optimisation problems of varying size and connectivity. While many small or sparse instances can be fully reduced, dense graphs often retain finite irreducible kernels even after extensive reductions. Introducing vertex weights tends to increase reducibility, whereas extending the interaction range in the underlying UDG connectivity suppresses the reduction efficiency. By exploring where classical reductions cease to be effective, we aim to delineate the regime of problem instances that remain computationally demanding - those most relevant for testing and benchmarking near-term quantum optimisation hardware. We find that for the remaining finite kernels, quantum execution would require non-native embeddings with substantial resource overheads, suggesting that directly running native instances may be more practical than embedding a reduced kernel.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：investigate、classical reducibility、kernelisation techniques、classical preprocessing。；研究对象：Rydberg原子量子处理器中天然实现的随机单位圆盘图（UDG）上的最大独立集（MIS）和最大加权独立集（MWIS）问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典预处理（核化）能完全简化许多小规模或稀疏的图实例，但稠密图常保留有限不可约核；引入顶点权重倾向于提高可简化性，而延长相互作用范围则抑制简化效率。对于剩余有限核，量子执行需要非原生嵌入并带来大量资源开销，直接运行原生实例可能更实用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典预处理（核化）能完全简化许多小规模或稀疏的图实例，但稠密图常保留有限不可约核；引入顶点权重倾向于提高可简化性，而延长相互作用范围则抑制简化效率。对于剩余有限核，量子执行需要非原生嵌入并带来大量资源开销，直接运行原生实例可能更实用。；创新点：系统界定了经典简化失效的问题实例区域，并指出这些实例对测试和基准测试近期量子优化硬件最为相关；同时揭示了直接运行原生实例比嵌入简化核更实际。
papers.method_zh: 使用最先进的核化（kernelisation）技术，系统探测经典预处理对不同大小和连通性的原生优化问题的简化程度。

papers.title: Physics-Inspired Probabilistic Computing for Extremely Large-Scale MIMO Detection in Future 6G Wireless Systems
papers.abstract: Extremely large-scale multiple-input multiple-output (XL-MIMO) architectures are a key enabler of forthcoming 6G wireless communication networks by allowing high data rates through massive spatial multiplexing. Here, we approach these problems with physics-inspired unconventional computing based on Ising machines (IMs). For binary modulation, probabilistic IMs (PIMs) and oscillator-based IMs achieve optimal ML detection with systems up to 2048x2048 antennas with only 100 iterations, matching optimal sphere decoder performance for computationally treatable sizes and outperforming the minimum mean-square error (MMSE) industrial standard. For M-QAM up to 256, a generalized PIM-inspired framework, based on d-dimensional probabilistic variables (p-dits) that directly encode QAM symbols, shows low bit-error-rate across sizes up to 256x256 antennas, outperforming or matching MMSE with reduced algorithmic complexity. Unlike the binary mapping, the p-dit interaction matrix is independent of the QAM order, enabling adaptive MIMO modulation. These results show a promising scalable paradigm for XL MIMO detection in future 6G networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Ising machines (IMs)、probabilistic computing、algorithmic complexity。；研究对象：未来6G无线通信系统中极大规模多输入多输出（XL-MIMO）信号检测问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于伊辛机（Ising machines）的物理启发式概率计算可在极大规模天线系统（如2048×2048）中实现最优最大似然检测性能，且仅需100次迭代；对于高阶QAM调制，基于p-dit的广义概率框架在降低算法复杂度的同时，性能优于或持平工业标准MMSE。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于伊辛机（Ising machines）的物理启发式概率计算可在极大规模天线系统（如2048×2048）中实现最优最大似然检测性能，且仅需100次迭代；对于高阶QAM调制，基于p-dit的广义概率框架在降低算法复杂度的同时，性能优于或持平工业标准MMSE。；创新点：将物理启发的伊辛机计算范式首次应用于XL-MIMO检测，并提出了可自适应调制阶数的p-dit概率计算框架，避免了传统二进制映射中随QAM阶数增长的复杂度。
papers.method_zh: 采用概率伊辛机（PIMs）和振荡器伊辛机进行二进制调制下的最优检测；针对M-QAM调制，提出基于d维概率变量（p-dits）的广义PIM框架，直接编码QAM符号，且p-dit相互作用矩阵与QAM阶数无关。

papers.title: Universal Symmetry-Breaking Dynamics at Continuous Phase Transitions: Evidence for a New Dynamical Critical Exponent
papers.abstract: Uncovering and understanding universal dynamics in matter far from equilibrium remains a key challenge. In this work, we identify a so far unrecognized form of universal behavior that emerges after a sudden symmetry-breaking quench at continuous phase transitions. Our key observation is that the order-parameter fluctuations in Ising models exhibit a compelling temporal collapse across a wide range of system sizes and quench strengths, indicative of an emergent single-variable scaling form. This phenomenon can be explained by introducing a so far unknown dynamical critical exponent for the underlying continuous phase transition. We find evidence for a lower critical effective dimension of this universal regime: it is observed in the 2D quantum and 3D and 4D classical Ising models, but not in the 1D quantum or 2D classical cases. Our results suggest that our observed universal far-from-equilibrium scaling may extend beyond the Ising models studied here and could more broadly characterize systems with non-conserved order parameters, opening new avenues for exploring universal dynamics both theoretically and in current experimental platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：universal dynamics, scaling form, dynamical critical exponent, Ising models）；研究对象：连续相变中对称性破缺后的非平衡动力学，具体以伊辛模型（Ising models）为研究对象，涵盖1D/2D量子伊辛模型及2D/3D/4D经典伊辛模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在连续相变中，突然施加对称性破缺淬火后，序参量涨落表现出一种此前未被识别的普适标度行为（时间塌缩），该行为可通过引入一个新的动力学临界指数来解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在连续相变中，突然施加对称性破缺淬火后，序参量涨落表现出一种此前未被识别的普适标度行为（时间塌缩），该行为可通过引入一个新的动力学临界指数来解释。；创新点：首次识别出连续相变中对称性破缺淬火后的一种新型普适动力学行为，并提出了一个此前未知的动力学临界指数；同时发现该普适行为存在一个临界有效维度下限（在2D量子、3D和4D经典伊辛模型中存在，但在1D量子或2D经典伊辛模型中不存在）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟相结合，通过分析不同系统尺寸和淬火强度下伊辛模型的序参量涨落，提取单变量标度形式，并检验该普适行为在不同维度（1D-4D）和模型类型（量子/经典）中的存在性。

papers.title: Characterizing bulk properties of gapped phases by smeared boundary conformal field theories: Role of duality in unusual ordering
papers.abstract: We study the classification of the gapped phases or massive renormalization group (RG) flows dual to the massless RG flows under changing the sign of the coupling constants. Whereas our formalism is based on combining Higgs- or Nambu-Goldstone-type arguments with Cardy's smeared boundary conformal field theories (SBCFTs), several puzzling structures arise. More specifically, the established Higgs or Nambu-Goldstone type arguments on the duality imply that the natural basis for the gapped states should be constructed from a set of smeared Ishibashi states, which are unphysical in boundary critical phenomena. Hence, the module of the gapped phases can be outside of that of boundary critical phenomena, whereas one can still calculate characterizing quantities by applying SBCFTs to the models. For example, we demonstrate that the massive RG flow dual to the massless RG flow from the tricritical Ising model to the Ising model, one of the simplest massless RG flows, has this unusual structure. This can be regarded as a quantum field-theoretic analogue of order-disorder coexistence in lattice models. More generally, the resultant gapped phases usually spontaneously break non-group-like symmetry (or noninvertible symmetry). Our work provides systematic quantum field theoretic descriptions of such unusual phases with spontaneous symmetry breaking of non-group-like (or noninvertible) symmetries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“massive renormalization group flows”、“conformal field theories”、“quantum field-theoretic analogue”。；研究对象：有能隙相（gapped phases）或大质量重整化群流（massive RG flows）的分类，特别是与耦合常数符号改变下无质量RG流对偶的结构，以及其中非群状对称性（non-group-like symmetry）或不可逆对称性（noninvertible symmetry）的自发破缺。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于对偶性的Higgs或Nambu-Goldstone型论证表明，有能隙态的自然基应由一组在边界临界现象中非物理的涂抹Ishibashi态构成，因此有能隙相的模可以超出边界临界现象的范畴；这类有能隙相通常自发破缺非群状（或不可逆）对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于对偶性的Higgs或Nambu-Goldstone型论证表明，有能隙态的自然基应由一组在边界临界现象中非物理的涂抹Ishibashi态构成，因此有能隙相的模可以超出边界临界现象的范畴；这类有能隙相通常自发破缺非群状（或不可逆）对称性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合Higgs或Nambu-Goldstone型论证与Cardy的涂抹边界共形场论（SBCFTs）框架，通过将SBCFT应用于模型来计算表征量，并以三临界Ising模型到Ising模型的无质量RG流的对偶大质量RG流为例进行演示。

papers.title: Active Control of Topological Exceptional Points in Non-Hermitian Metasurfaces
papers.abstract: Active control and ultrafast switching of non-Hermitian photonic systems are essential for next-generation reconfigurable optical technologies. Here, we demonstrate dynamic temporal manipulation of EPs in the terahertz (THz) regime using optically excited germanium (Ge) as an active medium. By exploiting pump-probe delay as a continuous tuning parameter, we achieve sub-picosecond eigenmode switching (~0.5 ps) and realize a complete time-resolved EP encirclement within ~2 ps, enabling direct observation of topological phase accumulation. At EP, the metasurface exhibits highly asymmetric transmission for circularly polarized light, characteristic of chiral mode response. Furthermore, we observe ultrafast eigenmode switching and topological phase evolution within ~1 ps, achieving >99% cross-polarization modulation depth. The measured results show strong agreement with theoretical modeling, with a high Petermann factor of approximately 10^3, confirming the effectiveness of the design. Our work establishes pump-probe delay time as a dynamical control parameter for EP topology, introducing a new regime of ultrafast non-Hermitian photonics for high-speed switching, enhanced sensitivity, and tunable polarization control in the THz domain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate dynamic temporal manipulation”、“measured results show strong agreement with theoretical modeling”，涉及实验观测和理论建模对比。；研究对象：非厄米超表面中的拓扑奇异点（Exceptional Points, EPs），具体在太赫兹（THz）波段，以光激发锗（Ge）作为活性介质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用泵浦-探测延迟时间作为连续调谐参数，实现了亚皮秒级本征模切换（~0.5 ps）和完整的时间分辨EP环绕（~2 ps），直接观测到拓扑相位积累；在EP处超表面表现出高度不对称的圆偏振光传输，并实现>99%的交叉偏振调制深度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用泵浦-探测延迟时间作为连续调谐参数，实现了亚皮秒级本征模切换（~0.5 ps）和完整的时间分辨EP环绕（~2 ps），直接观测到拓扑相位积累；在EP处超表面表现出高度不对称的圆偏振光传输，并实现>99%的交叉偏振调制深度。；创新点：首次将泵浦-探测延迟时间确立为EP拓扑动力学的控制参数，实现了超快（亚皮秒）非厄米光子学调控，为太赫兹波段高速开关、增强灵敏度和可调偏振控制开辟新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用光激发锗作为活性介质，通过泵浦-探测延迟时间动态调控太赫兹波段非厄米超表面的EP；理论上通过模型计算与实验测量结果对比，并提取Petermann因子（~10^3）验证设计有效性。

papers.title: Entanglement-informed distributed wavefunction approach to scalable quantum many-body systems
papers.abstract: We show that the entanglement structure of quantum many-body states defines a natural and optimal distributed representation for their simulation. An arbitrary entanglement cut induces a bipartite decomposition of the wavefunction, mapping its distribution onto that of the entanglement spectrum. In this representation the Hamiltonian application, the core of Krylov-subspace methods, reduces to local contractions and communication-optimal operations. Using benchmarks from different methods and models, we demonstrate near-linear scaling for sufficiently large systems and identify entanglement spectrum fragmentation as a key factor controlling computational cost. This establishes entanglement as an organizing principle and unified, method-independent, route for scaling up quantum many-body simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：distributed representation、simulation、Krylov-subspace methods、benchmarks。；研究对象：量子多体系统的可扩展模拟方法，具体关注波函数的纠缠结构及其在分布式计算中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子多体态的纠缠结构定义了一种自然且最优的分布式波函数表示，在该表示下哈密顿量应用可简化为局部收缩和通信最优操作，从而实现近线性标度行为；纠缠谱碎裂是控制计算成本的关键因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子多体态的纠缠结构定义了一种自然且最优的分布式波函数表示，在该表示下哈密顿量应用可简化为局部收缩和通信最优操作，从而实现近线性标度行为；纠缠谱碎裂是控制计算成本的关键因素。；创新点：将纠缠结构确立为量子多体模拟的可扩展性组织原则，提出一种与具体方法无关的统一路径，并识别出纠缠谱碎裂作为计算成本的关键控制因素。
papers.method_zh: 基于纠缠谱的分布式波函数表示方法，结合Krylov子空间方法（如Lanczos或Arnoldi算法），通过不同方法和模型的基准测试验证近线性标度。

papers.title: Typical Mixing and Rare-State Bottlenecks in Open Quantum Systems
papers.abstract: Mixing in open quantum systems is often summarized by a single worst-case time, even though that benchmark can be set by exponentially rare initial states. We show that for broad unstructured ensembles the nonlinear trace-distance relaxation curve itself concentrates around a deterministic mean. For Haar-random pure states this yields fixed-time concentration of the instantaneous trace distance to the steady state, which we term vertical concentration since typical relaxation curves bundle along the distance axis. Whenever the mean curve crosses the distance threshold with a finite slope, it converts this vertical concentration into a horizontal concentration of the mixing time, extending typicality from standard physical observables to a fundamentally non-observable dynamical quantity. This sharp concentration naturally raises the question of how the typical mixing timescale compares to the worst-case benchmark. We show that in a one-mode tail regime, this separation is controlled by the logarithmic ratio of extremal to typical initial-state overlaps for the slow left eigenoperator. This rare-state bottleneck law yields a hierarchy that is logarithmic in skin-effect settings, linear for boundary-supported many-body slow modes, and exponential in a protected-sector family where generic states mix rapidly while rare states stagnate. The framework also extends beyond Haar to exact and approximate unitary 2-designs and Hilbert-Schmidt/induced ensembles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及数学推导（如“非线性trace-distance relaxation曲线集中”“对数比率控制”）、概念分析（如“典型混合时间”“稀有态瓶颈”），未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：开放量子系统中的混合动力学，具体研究典型初始态与稀有初始态在混合时间上的差异，以及trace-distance弛豫曲线的统计集中行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于无结构系综（如Haar随机纯态），开放量子系统的trace-distance弛豫曲线在固定时刻围绕确定性均值集中（垂直集中），进而导致混合时间在阈值交叉处集中（水平集中）；典型混合时间与最坏情况混合时间之间的分离由慢左本征算符的极端与典型初始态重叠的对数比率控制，形成“稀有态瓶颈律”，该分离在不同系统中呈现对数、线性或指数层级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于无结构系综（如Haar随机纯态），开放量子系统的trace-distance弛豫曲线在固定时刻围绕确定性均值集中（垂直集中），进而导致混合时间在阈值交叉处集中（水平集中）；典型混合时间与最坏情况混合时间之间的分离由慢左本征算符的极端与典型初始态重叠的对数比率控制，形成“稀有态瓶颈律”，该分离在不同系统中呈现对数、线性或指数层级。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：使用Haar随机纯态系综、精确与近似酉2-设计、Hilbert-Schmidt/诱导系综；通过trace-distance弛豫曲线的统计集中性（垂直集中与水平集中）推导典型混合时间；引入“稀有态瓶颈律”量化典型与最坏情况混合时间的分离，并应用于skin-effect、边界支撑多体慢模、保护扇区等场景。

papers.title: Optimisation of TES design for the CRESST experiment
papers.abstract: The CRESST experiment aims at the direct detection of sub-GeV dark matter particles via elastic scattering off nuclei in different target crystals at cryogenic temperatures. The advancement in W-TES sensors allowed the CRESST detectors to reach energy thresholds of 10 eV and lower, opening the way to the exploration of dark matter masses as low as 70 MeV/c2. This work presents optimisation studies of W-TESs aimed at further improving the signal-to-noise ratio and overall detector performance. In particular, we investigate the thickness, dimensions and material composition of phonon collectors and assess their impact on detector response. The results demonstrate a significant performance enhancement and establish new benchmarks for the sensors used within CRESST.
