papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：optimisation studies、investigate、demonstrate、establish new benchmarks。；研究对象：CRESST实验中的W-TES（钨-过渡边缘传感器）设计优化，具体涉及声子收集器的厚度、尺寸和材料成分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过优化W-TES的设计参数（声子收集器的厚度、尺寸和材料成分），显著提升了信噪比和整体探测器性能，为CRESST实验中的传感器建立了新的性能基准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过优化W-TES的设计参数（声子收集器的厚度、尺寸和材料成分），显著提升了信噪比和整体探测器性能，为CRESST实验中的传感器建立了新的性能基准。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验优化研究：系统改变W-TES中声子收集器的厚度、尺寸和材料成分，评估这些参数对探测器响应的影响。

papers.title: svPITE: A Python package for the state-vector-based probabilistic imaginary-time evolution algorithm
papers.abstract: We present a Python package for ground-state preparation based on the probabilistic imaginary-time evolution algorithm, with particular focus on its state-vector-based implementation. A standard shot-based simulation is also supported, and results can be benchmarked against exact diagonalisation via a dedicated wrapper. The package enables efficient tuning of initial parameters, facilitating systematic exploration and optimisation of the method's performance. Starting from the prepared ground state, the strong interoperability with other packages further enables real-time evolution and the computation of spectral functions, such as the spin-spin dynamical structure factor.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：Python package、state-vector-based probabilistic imaginary-time evolution algorithm、shot-based simulation、exact diagonalisation。；研究对象：量子系统的基态制备，以及后续的实时演化和谱函数计算（如自旋-自旋动力学结构因子）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该Python软件包实现了基于态矢量的概率虚时演化算法，用于高效制备量子系统的基态，并支持与精确对角化进行基准测试。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该Python软件包实现了基于态矢量的概率虚时演化算法，用于高效制备量子系统的基态，并支持与精确对角化进行基准测试。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作主要贡献在于提供了一个可高效调优初始参数、便于系统探索和优化方法性能的Python软件包，并强调与其他软件包的强互操作性，从而支持从基态出发进行实时演化和谱函数计算。
papers.method_zh: 概率虚时演化算法（PITE）的态矢量实现，同时支持标准基于shot的模拟，并通过专用封装与精确对角化（exact diagonalisation）进行对比。

papers.title: Breaking QAOA's Fixed Target Hamiltonian Barrier: A Fully Connected Quantum Boltzmann Machine via Bilevel Optimization
papers.abstract: To overcome the limitations of classical partially connected Boltzmann machines and mainstream quantum Boltzmann machines (QBMs), this work extends the conventional circuit of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) to a bilevel optimization architecture and proposes a fully connected QBM. The inner-loop training simulates positive phase energy minimization based on the computational process of the conventional QAOA circuit, whereas the outer-loop training simulates negative phase contrastive divergence learning by optimizing the structural parameters of the target Hamiltonian. It is found that, first, the model exhibits superior performance using only a single layer (p=1) in the QAOA circuit, with an average probability of 0.9559 in measuring the target quantum state under noiseless conditions. Second, the model exhibits notable noise robustness. Under the typical noise level of current mainstream commercial quantum computing devices, the average probability of measuring the target quantum state reaches 0.6047; when the noise rises to a more stringent level with doubled intensity, this probability remains at 0.3859. In both scenarios, the target quantum state maintains the highest measurement probability among all detected states, with a value several times higher than that of the second-ranked state. This indicates that the model retains strong robustness even when noise meets or exceeds the upper limit of current mainstream commercial quantum computing devices. Third, under a block-by-block learning strategy with p=1 and only 10 measurement shots, the model consistently generates the target "qubit" grid image regardless of noise interference, demonstrating strong robustness in image generation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：bilevel optimization architecture、simulates、computational process、noiseless conditions、noise robustness。；研究对象：一种基于双层优化架构的全连接量子玻尔兹曼机（fully connected quantum Boltzmann machine），用于生成目标量子态和图像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在仅使用单层（p=1）QAOA电路时，无噪声条件下测量目标量子态的平均概率达0.9559；在主流商用量子计算机典型噪声水平下，该概率仍达0.6047，且目标态在所有检测态中保持最高测量概率，展现出强噪声鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在仅使用单层（p=1）QAOA电路时，无噪声条件下测量目标量子态的平均概率达0.9559；在主流商用量子计算机典型噪声水平下，该概率仍达0.6047，且目标态在所有检测态中保持最高测量概率，展现出强噪声鲁棒性。；创新点：突破了QAOA固定目标哈密顿量的限制，提出了一种全连接量子玻尔兹曼机，并首次将QAOA电路与双层优化结合用于量子玻尔兹曼机训练。
papers.method_zh: 将传统量子近似优化算法（QAOA）电路扩展为双层优化架构：内层训练模拟正相能量最小化（基于传统QAOA电路计算过程），外层训练通过优化目标哈密顿量的结构参数来模拟负相对比散度学习。采用逐块学习策略，使用10次测量（shots）进行图像生成测试。

papers.title: Volume-Independent Spectral Stability of Energy-Truncated Effective Hamiltonians in Quantum Spin Systems
papers.abstract: We prove a volume-uniform effective-Hamiltonian theorem for bounded finite-range quantum spin systems on possibly infinite lattices. For any finite target region, we construct an energy-truncated Hamiltonian and prove a volume-uniform spectral-overlap bound controlling the leakage of its low-energy spectral subspace into the high-energy spectral subspace of the original Hamiltonian. The bound may contain non-exponential spectral-window terms, but its cutoff-dependent remainder decays exponentially in the cutoff. In finite volume, this yields stability of low-lying eigenvalues, with eigenvalue errors controlled by the exponentially small cutoff-dependent remainder. In infinite volume, we prove the corresponding spectral-overlap estimate in the GNS representation of an infinite-volume ground state. Thus, for bounded finite-range interactions, we extend and strengthen the effective-Hamiltonian mechanism of Arad, Kuwahara, and Landau by replacing the finite-volume operator-norm formulation with a volume-uniform spectral-overlap formulation applicable in the thermodynamic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：prove（证明）、theorem（定理）、spectral-overlap bound（谱重叠界）、GNS representation（GNS表示）。；研究对象：量子自旋系统（quantum spin systems），具体为有界有限程相互作用的量子自旋系统，可在无限晶格上定义。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了对于有限程相互作用的量子自旋系统，存在一个体积均匀的谱重叠界，使得能量截断有效哈密顿量的低能谱子空间与原始哈密顿量的高能谱子空间之间的泄漏被指数级小的截断依赖余项所控制，从而在有限体积和热力学极限下均保证了低能本征值的稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了对于有限程相互作用的量子自旋系统，存在一个体积均匀的谱重叠界，使得能量截断有效哈密顿量的低能谱子空间与原始哈密顿量的高能谱子空间之间的泄漏被指数级小的截断依赖余项所控制，从而在有限体积和热力学极限下均保证了低能本征值的稳定性。；创新点：将原有有限体积下的算子范数表述替换为适用于热力学极限的体积均匀谱重叠表述，从而在无限体积下也建立了有效哈密顿量的稳定性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明：构造能量截断哈密顿量，并证明体积均匀的谱重叠界；在无限体积下，利用无限体积基态的GNS表示（Gelfand–Naimark–Segal representation）证明相应的谱重叠估计。该工作扩展并加强了Arad、Kuwahara和Landau的有效哈密顿量机制。

papers.title: Cellular-scale mechanism of cell crawling responding to substrate stiffness
papers.abstract: Biological cells are able to adapt their behaviour in response to environmental cues. Durotaxis is a phenomenon in which cells adjust their migration depending on the mechanical properties of a surrounding substrate. Although durotaxis has been studied more than two decades, basic cellular-scale mechanism of how cells regulate the motility responding to substrate stiffness remains to be elucidated. We address this issue by developing a theory utilising a mechanochemical model that integrates intracellular biochemical reactions with cellular deformation and substrate adhesion. Numerical analysis reveals that the characteristic speed and diffusion constant of cells change non-monotonically with respect to substrate stiffness, indicating the emergence of an optimal stiffness for migration. In addition, by introducing a memory effect that allows feedback from cell mechanics to the intracellular chemical reactions, the persistence time increases with substrate stiffness on a substrate softer than the optimal. We further investigate theoretically the origin of the non-monotonic dependence, that is comparable to the experimental observations, in terms of cell deformation and symmetry breaking in substrate adhesion. We believe that our study provides a unifying framework to understand complex durotactic cell migration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“developing a theory”、“mechanochemical model”、“Numerical analysis”。；研究对象：细胞趋硬性（durotaxis）迁移现象，即细胞根据基底刚度调控自身运动行为的机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细胞的迁移速度和扩散常数随基底刚度呈非单调变化，存在一个最优刚度值使迁移效率最高；在低于最优刚度的基底上，引入记忆效应后，细胞的持续运动时间随基底刚度增加而增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细胞的迁移速度和扩散常数随基底刚度呈非单调变化，存在一个最优刚度值使迁移效率最高；在低于最优刚度的基底上，引入记忆效应后，细胞的持续运动时间随基底刚度增加而增加。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个整合细胞内生化反应、细胞形变与基底粘附的机械化学模型，并通过数值分析进行理论计算。

papers.title: Fragility of Unidirectional Transport in Weakly Disordered Photonic Chern Insulators
papers.abstract: Photonic Chern insulators enable unidirectional light transport protected by nontrivial band topology -- essential for robust photonic integrated circuits and error-free communication. However, disorder from impurities or defects inevitably exists in practical applications, yet how weak disorder affects topological chiral edge states remains insufficiently understood. Here, we reveal a previously unrecognized mechanism by which weak disorder can disrupt robust propagation of chiral edge states in photonic Chern insulators, despite the preservation of global topological invariants. By randomly replacing a small number of magnetized rods with nonmagnetized impurities in a magnetic photonic crystal, we find that when the excitation frequency approaches the single impurity defect state frequency, weak coupling between spatially extended defect states forms a topologically trivial impurity band inside the topological gap. This enables coexistence and coupling of defect states and chiral edge states. The reciprocal "necklace state" transport channels formed by coupled defect states break the expected unidirectional propagation in topological Chern insulators with weak disorder. Our work reveals that topological chiral edge state and disorder interactions are more intricate than previously understood and provides new insights into stability and control of topological transport in realistic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“reveal”“find that”“enables”等理论分析词汇，并涉及能带结构、缺陷态耦合等计算概念，未提及具体实验手段。；研究对象：光子陈绝缘体中的手性边缘态在弱无序（非磁性杂质）影响下的单向输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使全局拓扑不变量保持不变，弱无序也能通过形成拓扑平庸的杂质带，使缺陷态与手性边缘态耦合，产生互易的“项链态”输运通道，从而破坏原本预期的单向传播。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使全局拓扑不变量保持不变，弱无序也能通过形成拓扑平庸的杂质带，使缺陷态与手性边缘态耦合，产生互易的“项链态”输运通道，从而破坏原本预期的单向传播。；创新点：揭示了弱无序破坏拓扑手性边缘态鲁棒传播的新机制——即杂质带与边缘态耦合形成互易输运通道，而非传统认为的拓扑保护完全抵抗弱无序。
papers.method_zh: 通过随机替换磁性光子晶体中的少量磁化介质柱为非磁化杂质，构建弱无序模型；分析单杂质缺陷态频率、杂质带形成以及缺陷态与边缘态的耦合机制。

papers.title: Asymptotic analysis of the energy for a ferroelectric nematic
papers.abstract: The variational model for a ferroelectric nematic bears close resemblance to the well-known energy model for micromagnetics. Despite this similarity, the two models operate in fundamentally distinct parameter regimes describing different physics. In this paper we establish that the ferroelectric nematic energy functional $Γ$-converges to the energy of a nematic with high elastic anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“变分模型”、“Γ-收敛”等数学理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：铁电向列相（ferroelectric nematic）液晶的能量模型，特别是其与微磁学能量模型的对比及高弹性各向异性极限下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铁电向列相的能量泛函在Γ-收敛意义下趋近于具有高弹性各向异性的向列相能量，揭示了两种模型在截然不同参数区间下的物理联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铁电向列相的能量泛函在Γ-收敛意义下趋近于具有高弹性各向异性的向列相能量，揭示了两种模型在截然不同参数区间下的物理联系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Γ-收敛（Γ-convergence）的渐近分析方法，对铁电向列相变分能量模型进行严格的数学极限分析。

papers.title: Quantum Annealing: Optimisation, Sampling, and Many-Body Dynamics
papers.abstract: Quantum annealing is a computational paradigm in which optimisation problems are mapped onto the energy landscape of an interacting quantum system and explored through its dynamical evolution. By continuously transforming a simple initial Hamiltonian into one whose ground state encodes the solution, the system traverses a complex landscape via a combination of quantum fluctuations, tunnelling processes, and dissipative dynamics. Unlike gate-based quantum computing, quantum annealing is a specialised and near-term approach aimed primarily at discrete optimisation and sampling tasks. While it is not expected to provide polynomial-time solutions to NP-hard problems in the worst case, it offers a physically motivated heuristic for navigating rugged energy landscapes that arise across science and engineering. Modern quantum annealers realise programmable spin systems with thousands of qubits, placing them among the largest controllable quantum devices currently available. As a result, their significance extends beyond optimisation: they also function as experimental platforms for studying non-equilibrium many-body quantum dynamics in regimes that are difficult to access using classical simulation. In this review we present an accessible introduction to the principles of quantum annealing, describe the main hardware platforms and algorithmic techniques, and analyse how tunnelling, spectral gaps, and open-system effects shape computational performance. We survey applications ranging from optimisation and machine learning to quantum simulation and many-body physics, and discuss the central challenges in benchmarking, scaling, and control. These perspectives position quantum annealing as a distinctive framework at the interface of optimisation, stochastic sampling, and programmable quantum dynamics, with a role that is complementary to both classical algorithms and gate-based quantum computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。关键词：review、principles、analysis、computational paradigm。；研究对象：量子退火（quantum annealing）作为一种计算范式，其核心研究对象包括：优化问题映射的量子自旋系统、非平衡多体量子动力学、以及可编程自旋系统（含数千量子比特）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子退火是一种面向离散优化和采样任务的近期专用计算范式，通过量子涨落、隧穿过程和耗散动力学探索复杂能量景观；它不仅是优化启发式方法，也是研究非平衡多体量子动力学的实验平台，其作用与经典算法和门型量子计算互补。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子退火是一种面向离散优化和采样任务的近期专用计算范式，通过量子涨落、隧穿过程和耗散动力学探索复杂能量景观；它不仅是优化启发式方法，也是研究非平衡多体量子动力学的实验平台，其作用与经典算法和门型量子计算互补。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：哈密顿量连续变换（从简单初始哈密顿量到编码解的基态哈密顿量）、量子隧穿、能谱间隙分析、开放系统效应分析。硬件平台：现代量子退火器（可编程自旋系统，数千量子比特）。算法技术：优化映射、采样技术。

papers.title: Giant-atom-enabled quantum optics with valley-polarized photons
papers.abstract: Valleytronics and valley photonics exploit the valley degree of freedom to encode and manipulate information. Here we show that photonic valleys can be selectively addressed in quantum optics using a simple two-level emitter, provided it is coupled nonlocally to the field, thereby realizing a so-called giant atom. Specifically, we consider a qubit coupled at multiple points to an engineered honeycomb lattice of resonators with detuned sublattice frequencies. By tailoring the geometry of the coupling points, the giant atom can be made to emit selectively into a single valley. The emitted photons thereby acquire a well-defined valley character and inherit the associated Berry curvature. By placing the qubit near a domain wall between regions of opposite sublattice detuning, whose interface supports valley-polarized edge modes, emission becomes chiral along the domain wall. This provides a promising route toward implementation of single-photon disorder-robust chiral emission without breaking time-reversal symmetry of the electromagnetic medium in platforms such as circuit QED.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show”“we consider”“by tailoring”等理论推导和设计性表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：基于“巨原子”（giant atom）与光子晶格中谷极化光子（valley-polarized photons）的量子光学体系，具体为耦合到工程化蜂窝状谐振子晶格（honeycomb lattice of resonators）中的两能级量子比特（qubit）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将两能级量子比特非局域地耦合到具有失谐子晶格频率的蜂窝状谐振子晶格，可以使其选择性地向单一谷发射光子，从而产生具有明确谷特征和贝里曲率的光子；在畴壁附近可实现手性发射，且无需打破电磁介质的时间反演对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将两能级量子比特非局域地耦合到具有失谐子晶格频率的蜂窝状谐振子晶格，可以使其选择性地向单一谷发射光子，从而产生具有明确谷特征和贝里曲率的光子；在畴壁附近可实现手性发射，且无需打破电磁介质的时间反演对称性。；创新点：首次提出利用“巨原子”非局域耦合机制在量子光学层面选择性地操控光子谷自由度，实现无需时间反演对称性破缺的单光子手性发射，为电路QED等平台中实现抗无序的手性单光子发射提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析：考虑一个量子比特在多个点耦合到工程化的蜂窝状谐振子晶格（子晶格频率失谐），通过设计耦合点的几何结构实现谷选择性发射；并分析在畴壁（domain wall）附近谷极化边缘模式导致的手性发射行为。

papers.title: XDecomposer: Learning Prior-Free Set Decomposition for Multiphase X-ray Diffraction
papers.abstract: Multiphase powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) analysis remains a fundamental bottleneck in structure identification, as real-world synthesis often produces complex mixtures whose constituent phases (components) cannot be reliably disentangled. While recent advances in representation-based crystal retrieval and generation suggest the possibility of inferring structures directly from PXRD, existing approaches largely assume single-phase inputs and break down in multiphase settings. Here, we present XDecomposer, a prior-free framework for joint decomposition and identification of multiphase XRD patterns without requiring candidate phase lists, structural templates, or prior knowledge of phase number. We formulate multiphase diffraction analysis as a set prediction problem, where the model infers an unordered set of phase-resolved components, their mixture proportions, and corresponding structural representations within a unified architecture. A phase-query-driven decomposition mechanism, together with diffraction-consistent physical reconstruction, enables accurate source separation while preserving crystallographic fidelity. Extensive experiments on both simulated and experimental datasets show that XDecomposer substantially improves reconstruction accuracy and phase identification across diverse chemical systems, while maintaining strong generalization to unseen mixtures. These results provide a practical route toward data-driven, source-resolved multiphase XRD analysis and reduce long-standing dependence on prior-guided iteratively phase matching. The code is openly available at https://github.com/Licht0812/XDecomposer
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法文章。判断依据：提出了一种基于深度学习的计算框架（XDecomposer），用于多相X射线衍射数据分析，属于数据驱动方法。；研究对象：多相粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）图谱的分解与物相识别问题，具体涉及多相混合物中未知晶体结构的分离与鉴定。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无需先验知识（如候选物相列表、结构模板或物相数目）的框架XDecomposer，能够同时实现多相XRD图谱的分解、物相比例估计和结构表征，显著提升了复杂混合物的重建精度和物相识别能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无需先验知识（如候选物相列表、结构模板或物相数目）的框架XDecomposer，能够同时实现多相XRD图谱的分解、物相比例估计和结构表征，显著提升了复杂混合物的重建精度和物相识别能力。；创新点：首次实现了无需先验物相列表或结构模板的多相XRD联合分解与识别，打破了传统方法对先验引导迭代匹配的长期依赖。
papers.method_zh: 基于Transformer架构的集合预测模型，采用“物相查询驱动分解机制”（phase-query-driven decomposition mechanism）和衍射一致性物理重建（diffraction-consistent physical reconstruction），将多相衍射分析转化为无序集合预测问题。

papers.title: The Kubo-Thermalization Correspondence
papers.abstract: Quantum thermalization describes how interacting quantum systems relax toward thermal equilibrium, a central problem in modern physics. Yet most experimental information on many-body systems comes from short-time transition spectroscopy, typically interpreted within Kubo's linear-response framework. These perspectives - long-time equilibration versus short-time response - seem fundamentally disconnected. Here we establish an exact link between them: the Kubo-Thermalization correspondence, which connects long-time thermalized magnetization under weak driving to short-time linear-response spectra for a spin coupled to a thermal bath. The correspondence holds even when the steady state differs substantially from the initial state and when each regime is individually difficult to describe theoretically. We experimentally confirm the correspondence using effective spin-1/2 impurities realized with ultracold fermions in two internal states coupled to a Fermi sea. Our results provide a rare exact statement about quantum thermalization and offer a novel route to infer thermalization dynamics from equilibrium response measurements in strongly interacting quantum systems, independent of microscopic details of the system-bath coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“establish an exact link”（建立精确联系）、“the Kubo-Thermalization correspondence”（提出对应关系），属于理论框架构建；同时有“experimentally confirm”（实验确认）部分，属于混合类型。；研究对象：量子热化过程，具体为自旋-1/2杂质（由超冷费米子实现）与费米海（热浴）耦合的量子多体系统，研究弱驱动下长时热化磁化与短时线性响应谱之间的对应关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了“Kubo-热化对应关系”，证明弱驱动下长时热化磁化与短时线性响应谱之间存在精确联系，即使稳态与初态差异显著、且两个区域各自难以理论描述时该对应仍成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了“Kubo-热化对应关系”，证明弱驱动下长时热化磁化与短时线性响应谱之间存在精确联系，即使稳态与初态差异显著、且两个区域各自难以理论描述时该对应仍成立。；创新点：首次在理论上严格建立了长时热化与短时线性响应之间的精确对应关系，并实验验证；该对应关系不依赖于系统-热浴耦合的微观细节，为从平衡态响应测量推断强相互作用量子系统的热化动力学提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：建立Kubo线性响应框架与长时热化之间的精确对应关系；实验验证：利用超冷费米子（两个内态）实现有效自旋-1/2杂质，耦合到费米海，测量短时线性响应谱与长时热化磁化。

papers.title: Pro-Tensor Network
papers.abstract: We introduce the pro-tensor network, a categorification of the tensor network, as a fully rigorous yet graphically transparent framework for studying the collection of many many-body theories, which we dub many-many-body theory. We provide a comprehensive toolbox for the graphical calculations using pro-tensor networks. As applications, we recover the Levin-Wen model as a "uniform" pro-tensor network and generalize a result of Kitaev and Kong by characterizing particles as modules over promonads. One can also interpret the string-net pro-tensor network as the space of symmetric tensor networks, thus our framework also applies to the study of generalized symmetry and topological holography. Notably, our generalization dispenses with the assumptions of semisimplicity, finiteness, and rigidity, potentially facilitating the exploration of many-body physics beyond these constraints.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：categorification（范畴化）、graphical framework（图形框架）、pro-tensor network（pro-张量网络）。；研究对象：多体理论集合（many-many-body theory），即对大量多体理论进行统一研究的框架，具体应用包括Levin-Wen模型、Kitaev-Kong理论中的粒子分类、广义对称性与拓扑全息术。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入pro-张量网络（张量网络的范畴化），建立了一个严格且图形透明的框架，用于统一研究大量多体理论；该框架无需半单性、有限性和刚性假设，可推广到更一般的多体物理系统。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入pro-张量网络（张量网络的范畴化），建立了一个严格且图形透明的框架，用于统一研究大量多体理论；该框架无需半单性、有限性和刚性假设，可推广到更一般的多体物理系统。；创新点：首次提出pro-张量网络作为张量网络的范畴化推广，并去除了传统框架中半单性、有限性和刚性等限制条件，从而拓展了多体物理研究的适用范围。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值计算的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用范畴化方法，将张量网络提升为pro-张量网络，并开发了一套用于图形计算的完整工具包。具体应用包括：将Levin-Wen模型重构为“均匀”pro-张量网络；将粒子刻画为promonad上的模，推广了Kitaev和Kong的结果；将弦网pro-张量网络解释为对称张量网络的空间。

papers.title: Colossal Magnetoresistance and Phonon Driven Exchange Dynamics in Eu$_5$Sn$_2$As$_6$
papers.abstract: The emergence of colossal magnetoresistance in a new generation of Eu$^{2+}$-based antiferromagnets is intriguing given stark contrasts to the archetypal perovskite manganites and doped Eu-chalcogenides. In this study the thermal conductivity and magnetostriction of Eu$_5$Sn$_2$As$_6$ -- one such representative -- have been measured to better understand the role of the crystal lattice. Both properties are strongly field-dependent and mirror the magnetization, saturating once the Eu$^{2+}$ moments are polarized. The field-enhancement of the phonon-dominated thermal conductivity is interpreted through the lifting of a degeneracy of spin configurations, and the subsequent saturation due to quenched magnetostrain in high field. Comparison with spin-glass insulators suggests that this phenomenon is not a byproduct but rather the driver of electron delocalization due to the suppression of strong phonon scattering arising from exchange frustration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：测量了热导率和磁致伸缩，并进行了场依赖性分析。；研究对象：Eu²⁺基反铁磁体 Eu₅Sn₂As₆，具体研究其晶格在巨磁电阻效应中的作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Eu₅Sn₂As₆ 的热导率和磁致伸缩强烈依赖于磁场，并与磁化强度同步饱和；巨磁电阻效应源于磁场抑制交换阻挫引起的强声子散射，进而驱动电子退局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Eu₅Sn₂As₆ 的热导率和磁致伸缩强烈依赖于磁场，并与磁化强度同步饱和；巨磁电阻效应源于磁场抑制交换阻挫引起的强声子散射，进而驱动电子退局域化。；创新点：揭示了在 Eu²⁺基反铁磁体中，巨磁电阻效应并非由电子机制主导，而是由晶格（声子）散射的抑制所驱动，这与传统的钙钛矿锰氧化物和掺杂 Eu 硫族化物形成鲜明对比。
papers.method_zh: 热导率测量、磁致伸缩测量，并结合磁场依赖性分析及与自旋玻璃绝缘体的对比。

papers.title: Electrically controlled Heat Assisted Magnetic Recording in Intercalated 2D Magnets
papers.abstract: The ever-increasing demand for fast, reliable, and energy-efficient information storage continues to push magnetic memory technologies toward their fundamental limits. Conventional scaling strategies, which rely on reducing bit size, inevitably run into the "magnetic recording trilemma," where signal-to-noise ratio, thermal stability, and writability cannot all be optimized simultaneously. Heat-assisted magnetic recording (HAMR) has emerged as the leading solution, enabling high-density storage by transiently heating the medium during the write cycle. However, the reliance on laser optics and plasmonic transducers restricts HAMR primarily to hard-disk drives, limiting its integration with on-chip or embedded architectures. Here, we demonstrate an electronic variant of HAMR in which Joule heating from low-current density current pulses facilitates data writing, while the anomalous Hall effect provides electronic readout. Employing intercalated 2D magnet Ni$_{1/4}$TaSe$_2$, we show direct evidence that current pulses heat the material above its Curie temperature, during which a small magnetic field of ~2mT (100 times smaller than the coercive field) enables efficient data writing. The all-electronic approach combined with the 2D magnetic medium creates timely opportunities to revisit the energy-assisted magnetization recording, enabling new recording schemes that combine fundamental novelty with technological impact.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、direct evidence、Joule heating、anomalous Hall effect、electronic readout。；研究对象：插层二维磁体 Ni₁/₄TaSe₂ 中的电控热辅助磁记录（HAMR）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过低电流密度脉冲产生的焦耳热将材料加热至居里温度以上，仅需约2 mT（远小于矫顽场）的小磁场即可实现高效数据写入，并利用反常霍尔效应进行电学读出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过低电流密度脉冲产生的焦耳热将材料加热至居里温度以上，仅需约2 mT（远小于矫顽场）的小磁场即可实现高效数据写入，并利用反常霍尔效应进行电学读出。；创新点：实现了全电学版本的热辅助磁记录（HAMR），摒弃了传统HAMR依赖激光光学和等离子体换能器的方案，将能量辅助磁记录与二维磁介质结合，为片上集成和嵌入式架构提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：施加低电流密度电流脉冲产生焦耳热，利用反常霍尔效应进行电学读出，测量磁场辅助下的磁化翻转行为。

papers.title: Moire based strain analysis in wurtzite GaAs -- rock-salt (Pb,Sn)Te core-shell nanowires grown by molecular beam epitaxy
papers.abstract: We investigate core/shell GaAs/(Pb,Sn)Te nanowire nanoheterostructures with wurtzite (wz) GaAs cores and (Pb,Sn)Te topological crystalline insulator shells. The nanostructures have been grown by molecular beam epitaxy using two distinct MBE systems dedicated to III-V, and IV-VI semiconductors. The interface structure of wz-GaAs/(Pb,Sn)Te nanowires is investigated using high resolution transmission electron microscopy, scanning transmission electron microscopy and geometric phase analysis. Misfit dislocations and moiré fringes are observed as a direct result of the lattice mismatch between the core and the shell materials, and used to estimate strain in crystalline topological insulator shells. Our results point to a possibility of using moiré patterns analysis as an alternative, for estimating strain in the core-shell nanowire structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：molecular beam epitaxy（分子束外延）、high resolution transmission electron microscopy（高分辨透射电镜）、scanning transmission electron microscopy（扫描透射电镜）、geometric phase analysis（几何相位分析）。；研究对象：纤锌矿结构GaAs核与岩盐结构(Pb,Sn)Te壳层构成的核-壳纳米线异质结构，其中壳层为拓扑晶体绝缘体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在纤锌矿GaAs/(Pb,Sn)Te核-壳纳米线中，由于核与壳材料之间的晶格失配，直接观察到了失配位错和莫尔条纹，并利用这些条纹估算了拓扑晶体绝缘体壳层中的应变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在纤锌矿GaAs/(Pb,Sn)Te核-壳纳米线中，由于核与壳材料之间的晶格失配，直接观察到了失配位错和莫尔条纹，并利用这些条纹估算了拓扑晶体绝缘体壳层中的应变。；创新点：提出了将莫尔条纹分析作为估算核-壳纳米线结构中应变的替代方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用分别用于III-V族和IV-VI族半导体的两套分子束外延系统生长纳米结构；利用高分辨透射电镜、扫描透射电镜和几何相位分析研究界面结构。

papers.title: Molecular dynamics simulation study of mechanical properties of 3C-SiC with extended defects
papers.abstract: In this study, large-scale molecular dynamics simulations with the Vashishta potential and the analytic bond-order potential (ABOP) were performed to investigate the effect of extended defects on the elastic properties of cubic silicon carbide (3C-SiC). Specifically, we focused on systems containing Shockley partial dislocations terminating stacking faults, along with double and triple dislocation complexes. The changes in the independent elastic stiffness constants C11, C12 and C44 upon varying the mentioned extended defects concentrations were quantified. Using the values of these constants, the effective bulk, shear, and Young's moduli were calculated for different defect types and concentrations. The moduli were calculated along particular crystallographic directions aligned with the mentioned defect configurations as well as evaluated using Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaging to provide overall orientation-independent characterization of the defect-altered lattice. The obtained results reveal a general trend of diminishing the material's stiffness with increasing densities of Shockley partial dislocations and dislocation complexes. Depending on the defect configuration, the average elastic moduli decrease by up to approximately 6 % with the Vashishta potential and up to about 4 % using the analytic bond-order potential. At this, triple dislocation complexes induce smaller perturbations. These findings demonstrate that extended defect networks can measurably modify the elastic response of 3C-SiC and should be considered in further scientific research and practical applications of this material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：molecular dynamics simulations（分子动力学模拟）、Vashishta potential、analytic bond-order potential。；研究对象：含有扩展缺陷（Shockley不全位错终止堆垛层错、双位错复合体、三位错复合体）的立方碳化硅（3C-SiC）的弹性性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着Shockley不全位错及位错复合体密度的增加，3C-SiC的刚度普遍降低；平均弹性模量最大下降约6%（Vashishta势）或约4%（ABOP势），其中三位错复合体引起的扰动较小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着Shockley不全位错及位错复合体密度的增加，3C-SiC的刚度普遍降低；平均弹性模量最大下降约6%（Vashishta势）或约4%（ABOP势），其中三位错复合体引起的扰动较小。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用大规模分子动力学模拟，分别使用Vashishta势和解析键序势（ABOP）计算不同扩展缺陷浓度下的独立弹性刚度常数C11、C12和C44，进而通过Voigt-Reuss-Hill平均以及沿特定晶向计算有效体模量、剪切模量和杨氏模量。

papers.title: Twisted Kagome Bilayers: Higher-Order Magic Angles, Topological Flat Bands, and Sublattice Interference
papers.abstract: We develop a low-energy continuum model to describe the moiré physics of heterostructures, which is a generalization of the celebrated Bistritzer-MacDonald (BM) method [R. Bistritzer and A. H. MacDonald, Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. U.S.A. 108, 12233 (2011)]. We take as an example the moiré physics of electrons in twisted bilayer kagomé (TBK) metals near $1/3$ filling where monolayer Dirac cones lie. We demonstrate the emergence of higher-order magic angles where significant local band flattening occurs as a high-order Van Hove singularity emerges and show how twisting alone can induce non-trivial topology. We, furthermore, show that while sublattice interference effects are present, their role is not as prominent as in monolayer kagome.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“develop a low-energy continuum model”、“generalization of the Bistritzer-MacDonald method”。；研究对象：扭曲双层Kagome金属（twisted bilayer kagomé metals, TBK）在1/3填充附近的莫尔超晶格物理，特别是单层狄拉克锥附近的电子行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了高阶魔角的存在，在该角度下出现高阶Van Hove奇点并导致显著的能带平坦化；仅通过扭转即可诱导非平庸拓扑性质；子晶格干涉效应存在，但其作用不如单层Kagome中显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了高阶魔角的存在，在该角度下出现高阶Van Hove奇点并导致显著的能带平坦化；仅通过扭转即可诱导非平庸拓扑性质；子晶格干涉效应存在，但其作用不如单层Kagome中显著。；创新点：将BM方法推广至Kagome晶格体系，揭示了扭曲双层Kagome中高阶魔角、拓扑平带以及子晶格干涉效应的独特行为。
papers.method_zh: 发展了低能连续模型，该模型是Bistritzer-MacDonald（BM）方法的推广，用于描述异质结的莫尔物理。

papers.title: Emergence of a correlated insulating state in bulk 1T-NbSe$_2$ via metal intercalation
papers.abstract: The 1T polymorph of NbSe$_2$, long confined to the monolayer limit, has remained inaccessible in bulk. Here, we report the realization of bulk 1T-NbSe$_2$ via electrochemical Sn intercalation. Transmission electron microscopy directly reveals the formation of the 1T structure induced by Sn intercalation. The intercalated samples exhibit insulating transport behavior, in stark contrast to metallic 2H-NbSe$_2$. Density functional theory calculations, however, predict a metallic band structure, highlighting the crucial role of emergent electronic correlations in the observed insulating state. Raman spectroscopy further reveals vibrational modes associated with Sn intercalation and possible charge density wave order. Our results establish electrochemical intercalation as an effective route to stabilize otherwise inaccessible bulk polytypes, positioning bulk 1T-NbSe$_2$ as a new platform for investigating correlated electronic states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论计算）。判断依据：透射电子显微镜、输运测量、拉曼光谱等实验手段，结合密度泛函理论计算。；研究对象：通过电化学插层实现块体1T相NbSe₂，以及其中出现的关联绝缘态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Sn插层首次在块体中获得1T-NbSe₂，该材料表现出绝缘性输运行为，与金属性的2H-NbSe₂形成鲜明对比，且该绝缘态源于电子关联效应而非能带结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Sn插层首次在块体中获得1T-NbSe₂，该材料表现出绝缘性输运行为，与金属性的2H-NbSe₂形成鲜明对比，且该绝缘态源于电子关联效应而非能带结构。；创新点：首次在块体形式中实现此前仅存在于单层极限的1T-NbSe₂，并证明电化学插层是稳定非平衡体相多型体的有效途径，为研究关联电子态提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 电化学插层法制备样品；透射电子显微镜（TEM）表征结构；电阻/输运测量；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算能带结构；拉曼光谱探测振动模式与可能的电荷密度波序。

papers.title: A Rayleigh criterion for mechanical instability: inducing activity by chemo-mechanical coupling
papers.abstract: Instabilities in thermodynamic systems are often undesirable, as they can lead to loss of control or even catastrophic behavior. Yet, the same mechanisms can also generate rich nonequilibrium behavior and may play a constructive role in living systems. We introduce a theoretical framework, inspired by Rayleigh's analysis of thermoacoustic instabilities, to study the emergence of mechanical activity. In particular, we derive Rayleigh-like criteria governing the onset of activity and the generation of rotational motion in a slow Newtonian probe coupled to driven chemical processes, described by Markov jump processes. These criteria are expressed in terms of the phase relation between entropic and frenetic contributions, providing a transparent condition for when chemical driving results in sustained rotational or active mechanical motion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical framework、derive criteria、Markov jump processes。；研究对象：机械活性（mechanical activity）的产生机制，具体为慢速牛顿探针（slow Newtonian probe）与受驱动化学过程（driven chemical processes）耦合时的力学不稳定性与旋转运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出类似瑞利判据（Rayleigh-like criteria）的条件，该判据以熵贡献（entropic）与 frenetic 贡献之间的相位关系表达，明确了化学驱动何时能产生持续旋转或主动机械运动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出类似瑞利判据（Rayleigh-like criteria）的条件，该判据以熵贡献（entropic）与 frenetic 贡献之间的相位关系表达，明确了化学驱动何时能产生持续旋转或主动机械运动。；创新点：将经典瑞利判据的思想推广到化学-力学耦合系统，为理解化学驱动如何诱导机械活性提供了基于相位关系的透明判据。
papers.method_zh: 基于瑞利对热声不稳定性（thermoacoustic instabilities）的分析思路，构建理论框架，将化学过程描述为马尔可夫跳跃过程（Markov jump processes），通过分析熵与 frenetic 贡献的相位关系推导不稳定性判据。

papers.title: On Fano effect in IR spectra of hydrogenated nanodiamonds
papers.abstract: Hydrogenated nanodiamonds may show a "transmission window" in infra-red spectra in the vicinity of diamond Raman frequency. This phenomenon is a manifestation of resonance coupling of incident photons with continuum states (Fano resonance). Hpwever, precise mechanism of appearence of the resonance and of related conductivity - surface hydrogenation or specific type of surface reconstruction - remains debatable. We present detailed analysis of infra-red spectra of nanodiamonds of different sizes (2.6-30 nm) possessing the "transmission window" and show that the C-H stretch vibrations of adsorbed functional groups cannot be responsible the the Fano resonance. At the same time, it is suggested that a bending mode of monohydride termination on nanodiamond (111) face may couple with diamond optical phonon, explaining the Fano resonance in some cases. The relative importance of the monohydride contribution and of the graphitic islets to the appearence of the "transmission window" and conductivity is likely dependent on dominating morphology and size distribution of nanodiamond grains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：analysis of infra-red spectra、suggested mechanism）；研究对象：氢化纳米金刚石的红外光谱中的“透射窗口”现象，即Fano共振效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氢化纳米金刚石红外光谱中的Fano共振并非由吸附官能团的C-H伸缩振动引起，而可能源于纳米金刚石(111)面单氢化终端的弯曲振动模式与金刚石光学声子的耦合；此外，单氢化贡献与石墨化小岛对“透射窗口”及电导率的相对重要性取决于纳米金刚石晶粒的形貌和尺寸分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氢化纳米金刚石红外光谱中的Fano共振并非由吸附官能团的C-H伸缩振动引起，而可能源于纳米金刚石(111)面单氢化终端的弯曲振动模式与金刚石光学声子的耦合；此外，单氢化贡献与石墨化小岛对“透射窗口”及电导率的相对重要性取决于纳米金刚石晶粒的形貌和尺寸分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但可推断：首次系统排除了C-H伸缩振动作为Fano共振来源的可能性，并提出了单氢化终端弯曲振动与光学声子耦合的新机制，同时指出形貌和尺寸分布对共振机制的影响）。
papers.method_zh: 对不同尺寸（2.6-30 nm）纳米金刚石的红外光谱进行详细分析，通过排除C-H伸缩振动贡献，并结合对单氢化终端弯曲振动模式的耦合机制进行推断。

papers.title: Non-Local Particle Flows Become Local When Considering Dissipative Stress
papers.abstract: Dense granular and suspension flows under inhomogeneous shear exhibit persistent particle motion in regions where the local yield criterion is subcritical, an apparent breakdown of locality that has motivated the development of a generation of nonlocal rheological models. Using particle-resolved simulations of frictionless dense suspensions in two-dimensional Kolmogorov flow, we show that two independent considerations together account for this signature. First, replacing the conventional shear stress by a shear-rate-weighted dissipative stress $τ_W=\langle τ\dot γ\rangle/\langle \dot γ\rangle$, which isolates the component of stress that performs irreversible work, restores the homogeneous $μ(J)$ law throughout the bulk of the flow, with the inferred friction remaining strictly above yield. Second, a simple geometric mixing-length construction, applied with conventional stresses and requiring no fluctuation input, accounts for the residual sub-yielding within a sub-diameter layer at flow reversals. Each approach is based on a different philosophy and mechanism, and together they suggest that much of the apparent non-locality in this geometry and frictionless case is an artefact of how stress is measured and averaged rather than an intrinsic breakdown of local rheology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：particle-resolved simulations、二维Kolmogorov流模拟）；研究对象：无摩擦稠密悬浮液在非均匀剪切下的颗粒流动行为，具体为二维Kolmogorov流中的颗粒运动与局部屈服准则的偏离现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入剪切率加权的耗散应力τ_W，可恢复均匀μ(J)定律在整个流场主体中的适用性；流动反转处亚屈服层的残余非局域性可通过简单的几何混合长度构造解释，表明该体系中表观非局域性主要源于应力测量与平均方式的人为效应，而非局域流变学的内在失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入剪切率加权的耗散应力τ_W，可恢复均匀μ(J)定律在整个流场主体中的适用性；流动反转处亚屈服层的残余非局域性可通过简单的几何混合长度构造解释，表明该体系中表观非局域性主要源于应力测量与平均方式的人为效应，而非局域流变学的内在失效。；创新点：提出用耗散应力替代传统剪切应力来恢复局部流变定律，并结合几何混合长度构造（无需涨落输入）解释残余非局域性，揭示了表观非局域性可能源于应力平均方式的人为效应。
papers.method_zh: 采用无摩擦稠密悬浮液的颗粒分辨模拟（particle-resolved simulations），在二维Kolmogorov流几何中进行计算，并引入剪切率加权的耗散应力τ_W = ⟨τγ̇⟩/⟨γ̇⟩进行分析。

papers.title: Pair-Breaking and Dimensionality in Spin-Orbit Coupled Superconductors
papers.abstract: The response of ultra-thin superconducting materials under parallel magnetic fields is often leveraged to obtain insight into the nature of the condensate, including features attributable to unconventional forms of pairing. Despite there being multiple competing mechanisms responsible for suppressing superconductivity, it is common for these analyses to overlook certain depairing channels. Here we report an analysis of thickness dependent superconductivity in thin films of \ce{LaBi2} using the multi-mechanism Kharitonov-Feigel'man framework . By resolving field-enhanced superconductivity in the thin-limit, we obtain an estimate the role of spin exchange scattering, in addition to paramagnetic and orbital effects. Our analyses offer insight into how fundamental quantities such as the critical temperature as well as Pauli limit are defined, recasting the landscape for how scattering times in two-dimensional superconductors can be interpreted.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：Kharitonov-Feigel'man framework、分析、估计）；研究对象：自旋-轨道耦合超导体LaBi₂薄膜中的超导电性，特别是厚度依赖的平行磁场响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过解析薄极限下场增强超导电性，获得了自旋交换散射、顺磁效应和轨道效应在超导抑制中的相对贡献，并重新定义了二维超导体中临界温度、Pauli极限等基本量的含义。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过解析薄极限下场增强超导电性，获得了自旋交换散射、顺磁效应和轨道效应在超导抑制中的相对贡献，并重新定义了二维超导体中临界温度、Pauli极限等基本量的含义。；创新点：在平行磁场下的超薄超导材料分析中，同时考虑了多个竞争退配对机制（尤其是自旋交换散射），而以往研究常忽略某些退配对通道。
papers.method_zh: 采用多机制Kharitonov-Feigel'man理论框架，分析LaBi₂薄膜厚度依赖的超导电性，并区分不同退配对通道（顺磁、轨道、自旋交换散射）的作用。

papers.title: Cooking crystalline candies and the ductile to brittle transition in concentrated suspensions
papers.abstract: The existence and origin of the ductile to brittle transition in non-Brownian suspensions and pastes is underexplored despite the ubiquity of such materials in practical applications. We demonstrate the phenomenon in candies of sugar crystals in a water-protein-fat matrix prepared by boiling a sugar-cream-butter mixture (known as 'fudge' in some countries). As cooking time or final cooking temperature increases, we observe a transition from a fluid to a ductile solid, then to a brittle solid that abruptly fractures in compression. We propose that this is driven by rising solid sugar crystal volume fraction, and indeed find the same sequence of behaviour in a suspension of non-Brownian calcite particles as the solid fraction moves from frictional jamming to random close packing. Particle-based simulations reveal the sensitivity of the observed phenomenon to boundary conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“实验演示”（demonstrate）、“粒子模拟”（particle-based simulations）以及“发现相同行为序列”（find the same sequence of behaviour）。；研究对象：非布朗悬浮体与膏状物中的“延性-脆性转变”（ductile to brittle transition）现象，具体以糖晶体在蛋白质-脂肪-水基质中的糖果（fudge）以及方解石颗粒悬浮液为模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着烹饪时间或最终温度升高（对应糖晶体体积分数增加），体系依次经历流体→延性固体→脆性固体的转变；该转变由固体颗粒体积分数从摩擦堵塞（frictional jamming）向随机密堆积（random close packing）演化驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着烹饪时间或最终温度升高（对应糖晶体体积分数增加），体系依次经历流体→延性固体→脆性固体的转变；该转变由固体颗粒体积分数从摩擦堵塞（frictional jamming）向随机密堆积（random close packing）演化驱动。；创新点：首次系统揭示了非布朗悬浮体/膏状物中延性-脆性转变的存在及其物理起源（固体体积分数驱动），并通过糖果这一日常体系与模型悬浮液实验及模拟相互验证。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过煮沸糖-奶油-黄油混合物制备糖果，观察不同烹饪时间/温度下的力学行为；对比实验采用非布朗方解石颗粒悬浮液，改变固体体积分数；计算上使用基于粒子的模拟（particle-based simulations）研究边界条件对现象的影响。

papers.title: Engineering a driven-dissipative bath of altermagnetic quantum magnons for controlling classical dynamics of spins hosting spin waves, domain walls, or skyrmions
papers.abstract: Using Schwinger-Keldysh field theory (SKFT), we engineer a dissipative and driven (i.e., out of equilibrium) bosonic bath acting on classical localized spins within a ferromagnetic insulator (FI) layer whose dynamics is governed by the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation, as is usually assumed in spintronics and magnonics. The bosonic bath is comprised of quantum magnons within a layer of altermagnetic insulator (AMI) that is attached to a conventional FI layer, often one of the key ingredients within spintronic and magnonic multilayers, so that interaction between slow classical (in the FI layer) and fast quantum (in the AMI layer) localized spins ensues. Such a bath, including its driving to produce a nonequilibrium distribution of altermagnetic magnons, generates a rich structure of the SKFT-derived extended LLG equation for classical spins within the FI layer. Our LLG equation contains two damping terms, both of which are spatially nonlocal and anisotropic, while one of them is also intrinsically non-Markovian, i.e., nonlocal in time. We demonstrate how to exploit these terms for tuning spintronic and magnonic effects within the FI layer of AMI/FI bilayers that involve spin wave or domain wall propagation, as well as skyrmion annihilation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用Schwinger-Keldysh场论（SKFT）进行理论推导，无实验或计算模拟数据。；研究对象：由铁磁绝缘体（FI）层与交变磁绝缘体（AMI）层组成的双层异质结，具体研究其中经典局域自旋（承载自旋波、畴壁或斯格明子）的动力学行为，以及由AMI层中量子磁振子构成的耗散驱动玻色子库。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出包含两个空间非局域且各向异性阻尼项的扩展LLG方程，其中一个阻尼项还具有内在的非马尔可夫性（时间非局域性），并展示了如何利用这些阻尼项调控FI层中的自旋波传播、畴壁运动及斯格明子湮灭等自旋电子学和磁子学效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出包含两个空间非局域且各向异性阻尼项的扩展LLG方程，其中一个阻尼项还具有内在的非马尔可夫性（时间非局域性），并展示了如何利用这些阻尼项调控FI层中的自旋波传播、畴壁运动及斯格明子湮灭等自旋电子学和磁子学效应。；创新点：首次将交变磁绝缘体（altermagnetic insulator）中的量子磁振子作为可调控的驱动-耗散玻色子库，引入到经典自旋动力学中，并揭示了由此产生的空间非局域、各向异性及非马尔可夫阻尼项对自旋波、畴壁和斯格明子动力学的调控潜力。
papers.method_zh: 采用Schwinger-Keldysh场论（SKFT）对AMI层中的量子磁振子进行非平衡（驱动-耗散）玻色子库的工程化建模，并基于此推导出FI层经典自旋的扩展Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert（LLG）方程。

papers.title: Activation in Vesicle-Mediated Signaling Shaped by Batch Arrival Statistics
papers.abstract: Vesicle-mediated secretion of ions or molecules is a central mechanism of cellular communication, for example in processes such as neurotransmission or hormone release. These events are inherently stochastic: vesicle fusions lead to bursts of variable sizes, releasing discrete packets of transmitters that are subsequently cleared or degraded. The dynamics break time-reversal symmetry due to the interplay of spontaneous bursts and continuous degradation. Using generating functions and a recursion relation, we derive an exact solution for the full time-dependent probability distribution of a general batch arrival-degradation model. This framework also enables a full analysis of first-passage times to a concentration threshold representing downstream activation. We show that activation kinetics are not determined by mean dynamics alone, but depend sensitively on the temporal statistics of arrival events, batch-size variability, and degradation. In particular, different arrival processes with identical mean rates can lead to qualitatively distinct first-passage behavior, reflecting the role of time-asymmetric fluctuations. We also discuss extensions incorporating vesicle depletion. Our results provide a transparent link between stochastic release dynamics and activation timing in vesicle-mediated signaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用生成函数和递归关系”、“推导出精确解”、“首次通过时间分析”等理论方法，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：囊泡介导的信号传导中的随机释放与激活动力学。具体涉及神经递质或激素释放中囊泡融合导致的离散脉冲式分泌，以及后续的降解/清除过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激活动力学不仅取决于平均释放速率，还敏感依赖于到达事件的时间统计、批次大小变异性和降解过程。具有相同平均速率的不同到达过程可导致定性不同的首次通过时间行为，体现了时间不对称涨落的作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激活动力学不仅取决于平均释放速率，还敏感依赖于到达事件的时间统计、批次大小变异性和降解过程。具有相同平均速率的不同到达过程可导致定性不同的首次通过时间行为，体现了时间不对称涨落的作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心创新在于：通过精确解析解揭示了批次到达统计（而非仅平均速率）对激活动力学的决定性影响，并展示了时间反演对称性破缺在信号激活中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 使用生成函数和递归关系，推导了通用批次到达-降解模型的全时依赖概率分布的精确解，并基于此进行首次通过时间分析（到达浓度阈值的时间分布）。

papers.title: Electrical Spin Pumping in Exchange-coupled Molecules
papers.abstract: Electron spins in single molecules are a promising platform for quantum information processing. However, their practical implementation as qubits requires reliable control at the single-entity level, including an efficient state initialization. Here, we demonstrate the remote, all-electrical initialization of the electron spin in single molecules: Using electron spin resonance scanning tunneling microscopy, we investigate coupled pairs of S=1/2 molecules (Fe-FePc), where one molecule serves as a readout and pumping unit for the neighboring one. We show that the exchange interaction between them enables angular momentum transfer, which allows for the control of the remote spin state via the direction and magnitude of the spin-polarized tunneling current and the exchange coupling strength. These results establish a general, all-electrical approach for remote spin initialization that is readily transferable to a wide range of spin-based quantum architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用电子自旋共振扫描隧道显微镜（ESR-STM）进行研究”，并描述了具体的实验观测结果。；研究对象：交换耦合的单分子对（Fe-FePc），具体为S=1/2的分子对，其中分子间通过交换相互作用耦合，研究远程电学自旋初始化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过交换相互作用，利用自旋极化隧穿电流的方向和大小以及交换耦合强度，可以实现对相邻分子自旋态的远程全电学初始化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过交换相互作用，利用自旋极化隧穿电流的方向和大小以及交换耦合强度，可以实现对相邻分子自旋态的远程全电学初始化。；创新点：实现了单分子层面远程、全电学的自旋初始化，该方法具有普适性，可推广至多种基于自旋的量子架构。摘要未突出说明与传统光泵浦或磁场初始化方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 电子自旋共振扫描隧道显微镜（ESR-STM），用于研究耦合分子对的自旋态操控与读取。

papers.title: Criticality around the Spinodal Point of First-Order Quantum Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: Universality and scaling are hallmarks of second-order phase transitions but are generally unexpected in first-order quantum phase transitions (FOQPTs). We present a microscopic theory showing that quantum criticality can emerge around the quantum spinodal point of FOQPTs where metastability disappears. We demonstrate that, at this instability, resonant local excitations dynamically decouple a Hilbert subspace characterized by an emergent discrete translational symmetry. Projecting the original Hamiltonian onto this subspace yields an effective Hamiltonian that exhibits a genuine second-order quantum phase transition (SOQPT) and the Kibble-Zurek scaling. We validate this framework in the tilted Ising chain which breaks Z_2 symmetry, and predict the absence of criticality in the staggered-field PXP model. This work indicates that the FOQPT dynamics is usually governed by an emergent critical point around the quantum spinodal point. Our study establishes a bridge between the dynamics of the FOQPT and SOQPT, and thus sheds new light on the long-standing conundrum of the dynamics of the FOQPT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：microscopic theory、effective Hamiltonian、projection method。；研究对象：一级量子相变（FOQPT）自旋亚稳态消失点（量子旋节点）附近的临界现象，具体以倾斜伊辛链（tilted Ising chain）和交错场PXP模型（staggered-field PXP model）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在一级量子相变的量子旋节点附近，可以涌现出类似二级量子相变的临界性和Kibble-Zurek标度行为，从而在一级与二级量子相变动力学之间建立桥梁。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在一级量子相变的量子旋节点附近，可以涌现出类似二级量子相变的临界性和Kibble-Zurek标度行为，从而在一级与二级量子相变动力学之间建立桥梁。；创新点：首次从微观理论证明一级量子相变动力学通常受量子旋节点附近涌现的临界点支配，揭示了FOQPT与SOQPT动力学之间的内在联系，为长期存在的一级量子相变动力学难题提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 微观理论推导：通过识别共振局域激发动态解耦出的希尔伯特子空间（具有离散平移对称性），将原始哈密顿量投影到该子空间，得到有效哈密顿量，并分析其二级量子相变特征。具体模型验证采用倾斜伊辛链和交错场PXP模型。

papers.title: Comparative Study of Potts Machine Dynamics and Performance for Max-k-Cut
papers.abstract: Combinatorial optimization problems in logistics, finance, energy, and scheduling routinely involve multi-state decision variables. Ising machines (IMs) require binary expansions (e.g., one-hot encoding) to encode such variables, whereas Potts machines (PMs) represent them natively. By doing so, PMs are expected to outperform IMs on multi-state problems. To the best of our knowledge, no systematic study of PM models has yet assessed whether this expectation holds. We therefore benchmark five representative PMs against a reference IM on Max-3-Cut and Max-4-Cut, using 800-vertex GSet graphs and random graphs of up to 50 vertices. Surprisingly, the reference IM still outperforms every PM, and the IM supremacy increases significantly in going from Max-3-Cut to Max-4-Cut. These results provide clear evidence that current PM dynamics underperform relative to binary approaches, even in regimes where they are presumed advantageous. We provide a way forward by quantifying the underperformance of current PMs, as well as by identifying three dynamical properties that correlate strongly with their performance ranking. Our work stresses the need for more systematic assessments of algorithmic performance in order to guide the design of more effective Potts machines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：benchmark（基准测试）、dynamics（动力学）、performance（性能）。；研究对象：Potts 机器（Potts machines, PMs）与 Ising 机器（Ising machines, IMs）在多状态组合优化问题（Max-k-Cut）上的性能对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Max-3-Cut 和 Max-4-Cut 问题上，参考的 Ising 机器性能仍然优于所有被测试的 Potts 机器，且随着状态数增加（从3到4），Ising 机器的优势显著扩大。当前 Potts 机器的动力学性能不如二进制编码方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Max-3-Cut 和 Max-4-Cut 问题上，参考的 Ising 机器性能仍然优于所有被测试的 Potts 机器，且随着状态数增加（从3到4），Ising 机器的优势显著扩大。当前 Potts 机器的动力学性能不如二进制编码方法。；创新点：首次对 Potts 机器模型进行系统性基准测试，以验证其是否在多状态问题上优于 Ising 机器。摘要未突出说明具体动力学模型名称或实现细节。
papers.method_zh: 对五种代表性 Potts 机器模型与一种参考 Ising 机器进行基准测试。测试问题为 Max-3-Cut 和 Max-4-Cut，使用 800 顶点的 GSet 图以及最多 50 顶点的随机图。

papers.title: Finite-Time Optimal Control by Noisy Traps
papers.abstract: The optimal control of passive systems in equilibrium typically favours quasistatic (infinite-time) protocols. We show that a breakdown of quasistatic optimality occurs when the controller itself is dissipative. Concretely, we study a Brownian particle confined by a harmonic trap with stochastically fluctuating stiffness, driven by an external protocol. When these fluctuations violate detailed balance, the probe-controller coupling continuously exchanges work with the system, altering the optimisation landscape. In this regime, optimal protocols are characterised by a finite duration which vanishes above a critical fluctuation strength. This transition can be directly observed in a short-time expansion of the mean work functional. When imposing an endpoint constraint, the transition to zero duration disappears and finite duration protocols remain optimal for all values of the controller fluctuations. These results demonstrate that finite-time optimality can emerge in passive systems under nonequilibrium control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study、show、characterised、demonstrate（理论分析与推导）。；研究对象：受谐波陷阱约束的布朗粒子，该陷阱的刚度存在随机涨落（即“噪声陷阱”），且涨落不满足细致平衡条件。研究的是在非平衡控制下，被动系统的有限时间最优控制问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当控制器本身具有耗散性（即陷阱刚度存在随机涨落且违反细致平衡）时，准静态（无限时间）协议不再最优，最优协议具有有限持续时间；当涨落强度超过临界值时，最优持续时间可降至零。若施加端点约束，则零持续时间消失，有限时间协议始终最优。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当控制器本身具有耗散性（即陷阱刚度存在随机涨落且违反细致平衡）时，准静态（无限时间）协议不再最优，最优协议具有有限持续时间；当涨落强度超过临界值时，最优持续时间可降至零。若施加端点约束，则零持续时间消失，有限时间协议始终最优。；创新点：揭示了在被动系统的非平衡控制中，由于控制器自身的耗散性（噪声陷阱的细致平衡破缺），有限时间最优性可以自然涌现，打破了传统平衡系统中准静态协议最优的认知。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体包括：构建布朗粒子在随机涨落谐波陷阱中的随机动力学模型，通过平均功泛函的短时展开分析最优控制协议的特征，并考察有无端点约束两种情况下的优化景观变化。

papers.title: Superconducting and correlated phases of an effective Hubbard model on the BCC lattice
papers.abstract: We investigate the electronic phases of an effective Hubbard model on the body-centered-cubic lattice, motivated by alkali-doped fulleride molecular solids. The model incorporates renormalized on-site interactions and an effective inverted Hund's coupling originating from electron-phonon interactions. To access complementary interaction regimes, we employ two theoretical approaches. In the intermediate-coupling regime, the on-site repulsive interaction is approximated by a long-range interaction in momentum space, yielding an exactly solvable Hatsugai-Kohmoto model supplemented by a BCS-type pairing term. Within this framework, we analyze the superconducting instability and demonstrate a first-order normal-superconducting phase transition, characterized by a discontinuous jump of the order parameter. In the strong-coupling regime, where pairing fluctuations are suppressed, we apply the spin rotationally invariant slave-boson formalism to map out the temperature-interaction phase diagram. This analysis reveals first-order transitions between a Fermi-liquid phase, an antiferromagnetic phase, and a Mott insulating phase, with a narrow intermediate region where all three phases compete. The resulting phase diagram captures the interplay of itinerancy, magnetic order, and Mott localization in three dimensions and provides a unified perspective on superconducting and correlation-driven phenomena in fulleride-inspired lattice systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：effective Hubbard model、theoretical approaches、exactly solvable Hatsugai-Kohmoto model、spin rotationally invariant slave-boson formalism。；研究对象：体心立方晶格上的有效哈伯德模型，受碱金属掺杂富勒烯分子固体启发，研究其超导相和关联电子相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中间耦合区，模型表现出由BCS型配对项驱动的超导不稳定性，并呈现一级正常-超导相变；在强耦合区，相图包含费米液体、反铁磁和莫特绝缘体之间的一级相变，以及三者竞争的窄中间区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中间耦合区，模型表现出由BCS型配对项驱动的超导不稳定性，并呈现一级正常-超导相变；在强耦合区，相图包含费米液体、反铁磁和莫特绝缘体之间的一级相变，以及三者竞争的窄中间区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用两种互补的理论方法：1）在中间耦合区，将局域排斥相互作用近似为动量空间长程相互作用，得到可精确求解的Hatsugai-Kohmoto模型并补充BCS型配对项；2）在强耦合区，应用自旋旋转不变的奴隶玻色子形式，绘制温度-相互作用相图。

papers.title: Lecture Notes on Statistical Physics and Neural Networks
papers.abstract: These lecture notes introduce some topics of classical statistical physics, particularly those that are relevant for neural networks and deep learning. Statistical physics is treated as a branch of probability theory or statistics, with the goal of making concepts such as phase transitions and the renormalization group accessible to readers without prior knowledge of physics. We introduce the Boltzmann-Gibbs distribution and the thermodynamic potentials on a finite configuration space, notably for Ising spins and spin-glass models on a lattice, and then define phase transitions as discontinuities that arise in the limit that the number of lattice points goes to infinity. We further introduce Hopfield networks and Boltzmann machines, which are governed by the same energy function as spin-glass models, and discuss the learning algorithm for restricted Boltzmann machines. In this algorithm hidden neurons are integrated out as in the renormalization group. Finally, modern deep learning is introduced, whose early developments were in part motivated by restricted Boltzmann machines in that they carry many layers of hidden neurons. A description of large language models is given.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：lecture notes、introduce、statistical physics、probability theory。；研究对象：经典统计物理中的若干主题，特别是与神经网络和深度学习相关的概念，包括伊辛模型、自旋玻璃模型、Hopfield网络、玻尔兹曼机以及大型语言模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本文通过将统计物理视为概率论或统计学的一个分支，向无物理背景的读者介绍了相变和重整化群等概念，并展示了这些概念如何与神经网络（如Hopfield网络、受限玻尔兹曼机）及深度学习（包括大型语言模型）的数学结构相联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本文通过将统计物理视为概率论或统计学的一个分支，向无物理背景的读者介绍了相变和重整化群等概念，并展示了这些概念如何与神经网络（如Hopfield网络、受限玻尔兹曼机）及深度学习（包括大型语言模型）的数学结构相联系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与概念讲解。具体包括：在有限构型空间上引入玻尔兹曼-吉布斯分布与热力学势；定义格点模型（伊辛模型、自旋玻璃）中的相变；引入Hopfield网络和玻尔兹曼机，并讨论受限玻尔兹曼机的学习算法（其中隐藏神经元通过类似重整化群的方式被积分掉）；最后对现代深度学习（特别是大型语言模型）进行描述。

papers.title: Genus-protected higher-order topological phases
papers.abstract: Higher-order topological phases (HOTPs) feature protected gapless modes on boundaries of higher codimension, such as the corners or hinges of a crystal. They are understood as being protected by lattice symmetries: If the latter are broken, it becomes possible to remove the boundary modes without closing the bulk gap. In this work, we present construction schemes for HOTPs protected solely by the bulk gap, by fundamental symmetries, and by the global topology of the system shape (its genus, or number of holes), independent of any crystalline symmetries. As long as the fundamental local symmetries are preserved, the resulting boundary states cannot be removed by any purely-surface perturbation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construction schemes（构造方案）、protected solely by the bulk gap（仅由体带隙保护）、independent of any crystalline symmetries（独立于任何晶体对称性）。；研究对象：高阶拓扑相（HOTPs），具体研究其边界态（如角态或铰链态）的保护机制，不依赖于晶格对称性，而是依赖于系统形状的全局拓扑（亏格，即孔洞数）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种仅由体带隙、基本对称性和系统形状的全局拓扑（亏格）保护的高阶拓扑相构造方案，其边界态无法被任何纯表面微扰移除，即使破坏晶格对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种仅由体带隙、基本对称性和系统形状的全局拓扑（亏格）保护的高阶拓扑相构造方案，其边界态无法被任何纯表面微扰移除，即使破坏晶格对称性。；创新点：首次提出高阶拓扑相可仅由系统形状的全局拓扑（亏格）保护，而无需依赖任何晶体对称性，突破了传统认知中晶格对称性对高阶拓扑相保护的必要性。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与论证。通过设计构造方案，论证高阶拓扑相的边界态保护机制从晶格对称性扩展到系统全局拓扑（亏格）和基本对称性。

papers.title: From Deposition Stress to Surface Reactivity: Strain-Dependent Hydrogen Evolution on Sputtered Platinum Thin Films
papers.abstract: Strain has emerged as a promising approach for tuning electrocatalytic properties, yet its role in sputter-deposited thin films remains poorly understood. In this work, magnetron-sputtered platinum (Pt) thin films with different stress states were prepared by varying the sputter pressure. The resulting changes in microstructure, residual strain, and hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) activity were investigated using complementary characterization techniques and density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Structural analysis reveals a transition of (111)-textured Pt thin films from dense and smooth films at low pressures, to more porous microstructures with increased roughness at higher pressures. Electrochemical measurements show that films deposited at low sputter pressure exhibit the highest HER activity, while higher sputter pressures lead to reduced activity despite increased surface area. DFT calculations demonstrate that lattice strain alters hydrogen adsorption energetics and surface coverage on Pt(111), providing a mechanistic explanation for the observed activity trends. Overall, the results highlight that HER activity in sputtered Pt thin films is governed by the interplay of residual strain, microstructure, and hydrogen coverage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：实验制备与表征（磁控溅射、电化学测量）结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。；研究对象：磁控溅射沉积的铂（Pt）薄膜，具体研究其残余应变对析氢反应（HER）活性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低溅射压力下沉积的Pt薄膜具有最高HER活性，而高溅射压力下尽管表面积增大，活性反而降低；DFT计算表明，晶格应变通过改变氢吸附能和表面覆盖度来调控活性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低溅射压力下沉积的Pt薄膜具有最高HER活性，而高溅射压力下尽管表面积增大，活性反而降低；DFT计算表明，晶格应变通过改变氢吸附能和表面覆盖度来调控活性。；创新点：揭示了溅射沉积Pt薄膜中残余应变、微观结构与氢覆盖度三者协同调控HER活性的机制，而以往研究对溅射薄膜中应变的作用认识不足。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：磁控溅射（改变溅射压力调控应力状态）、结构表征（微观结构、残余应变分析）、电化学测量（HER活性测试）。计算方法：密度泛函理论（DFT）计算氢吸附热力学。

papers.title: Quantum Electron Quasicrystal
papers.abstract: The strongly correlated phases of the homogeneous electron gas constitute the vocabulary of many-body condensed matter physics and find a natural realization in semiconductors. In this setting, recent neural-network variational Monte Carlo calculations discovered an unexpected quantum phase of matter in wide quantum wells: an electronic quasicrystal formed by a bilayer Wigner crystals with a 30-degrees twist. This state defies classical expectations and emerges in a regime dominated by quantum fluctuations. Here, we develop an analytical framework to reveal its origin. By computing zero-point energy corrections to bilayer Wigner crystal configurations, we show that quantum fluctuations qualitatively reshape the energetic landscape, destabilizing the classical honeycomb state and selecting the 30-degrees quasicrystalline ground state over a broad parameter range. Our results identify zero-point motion as the mechanism stabilizing the electronic quasicrystal and establish a route to spontaneous moiré physics driven by many-body quantum effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytical framework、zero-point energy corrections、energetic landscape）；研究对象：均匀电子气中宽量子阱内由双层Wigner晶体以30度扭转形成的电子准晶（quantum electron quasicrystal）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子零点运动（zero-point motion）是稳定30度扭转电子准晶的机制，量子涨落重塑了能量景观，使经典蜂窝态失稳，并在广泛参数范围内选择准晶基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子零点运动（zero-point motion）是稳定30度扭转电子准晶的机制，量子涨落重塑了能量景观，使经典蜂窝态失稳，并在广泛参数范围内选择准晶基态。；创新点：首次从解析角度揭示量子涨落（零点运动）作为稳定电子准晶的微观机制，建立了由多体量子效应驱动的自发莫尔物理（spontaneous moiré physics）路径。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算双层Wigner晶体构型的零点能修正，分析量子涨落对能量景观的定性影响，建立解析理论框架揭示电子准晶的起源。

papers.title: Anomalous Thomson Effect
papers.abstract: We propose an effect named the anomalous Thomson effect (ATE), analogous to the anomalous Hall effect and the anomalous Nernst effect (ANE). The anomalous Thomson coefficient (ATC) is derived as a function of the anomalous Nernst coefficient (ANC); hence, the ATC inherits the same mechanisms of the ANC. Specifically, we study a massive Dirac model for Fe3Sn2 to capture intrinsic Berry-curvature-driven transport. Our results show that the ATC is generally enhanced relative to the ANC. In the low-temperature limit, the ratio ATC/ANC approaches three. Since the relation between the ATE and the ANE is model-independent, we utilize experimental ANE data to infer experiment-related ATC for CoS2, Co3Sn2S2, and CeCrGe3. We find that the ATC for CeCrGe3 can be as large as fifteen times the ANC in the liquid-nitrogen temperature regime, making this effect highly attractive for solid-state thermoelectric refrigeration in this temperature range. It is important to emphasize that the proposed ATE can be directly verified using existing ANE data, without the need for additional equipment or measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose、derive、study a model、model-independent relation）；研究对象：反常汤姆孙效应（Anomalous Thomson Effect, ATE），一种类比于反常霍尔效应和反常能斯特效应的热电输运现象；具体材料包括Fe₃Sn₂、CoS₂、Co₃Sn₂S₂、CeCrGe₃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反常汤姆孙系数（ATC）与反常能斯特系数（ANC）之间存在模型无关的比例关系，在低温极限下ATC/ANC比值趋近于3；在液氮温区，CeCrGe₃的ATC可达ANC的15倍，使其在固态热电制冷方面具有吸引力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反常汤姆孙系数（ATC）与反常能斯特系数（ANC）之间存在模型无关的比例关系，在低温极限下ATC/ANC比值趋近于3；在液氮温区，CeCrGe₃的ATC可达ANC的15倍，使其在固态热电制冷方面具有吸引力。；创新点：首次提出“反常汤姆孙效应”这一概念，并建立其与反常能斯特效应的普适关系，使得无需额外实验设备即可利用现有ANC数据直接验证ATE。
papers.method_zh: 基于大质量狄拉克模型（massive Dirac model）计算Fe₃Sn₂的贝里曲率驱动输运；利用模型无关的ATC与ANC关系，从实验ANC数据推断ATC。

papers.title: Solvent-induced memory effects in a model electrolyte
papers.abstract: The fluctuations of ions in polar solvents remain poorly understood theoretically due to the complex coupling between ionic motion and solvent polarization. Indeed, while all-atom resolution can be achieved in numerical simulations, analytical approaches require suitable levels of coarse-graining. In this work, we describe ions and solvent molecules as interacting Brownian particles and use stochastic density functional theory to derive a generalized Langevin equation for the ionic charge density, explicitly accounting for solvent-mediated memory effects. In the regime where there is a clear timescale separation between fast solvent and slow ion dynamics, we obtain simple expressions for dynamical charge structure factors, which are validated by BD simulations. For slow solvents, we predict an emerging two-step relaxation in ionic dynamics. These results provide a mesoscopic approach for ion-solvent dynamics and open pathways to study fluctuation-induced phenomena in electrolytes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：stochastic density functional theory、generalized Langevin equation、analytical approaches）；研究对象：极性溶剂中离子与溶剂分子耦合的电解质体系，具体研究离子电荷密度的涨落动力学及溶剂介导的记忆效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在快溶剂-慢离子时间尺度分离条件下，获得了动态电荷结构因子的简洁表达式；对于慢溶剂情形，预测了离子动力学中出现两步弛豫过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在快溶剂-慢离子时间尺度分离条件下，获得了动态电荷结构因子的简洁表达式；对于慢溶剂情形，预测了离子动力学中出现两步弛豫过程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 将离子和溶剂分子描述为相互作用的布朗粒子，采用随机密度泛函理论推导出离子电荷密度的广义朗之万方程，并通过布朗动力学模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Winding feature and thermal evolution of the Dirac magnons in CrI$_3$
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional honeycomb lattice ferromagnet chromium tri-iodide (CrI$_3$) has attracted tremendous interest because it retains ferromagnetism down to the monolayer limit and hosts intriguing topological magnons. As a prototypical van der Waals magnet, CrI$_3$ provides an ideal platform for exploring the interplay between reduced dimensionality, magnetic order, and nontrivial spin excitations. Here, using inelastic neutron scattering together with improved sample quality, we uncover the magnon winding feature around the $K$-point of the hexagonal Brillouin zone, a key signature of Dirac magnons. In addition, we find that the magnon energy follows a $T^2$-renormalization behavior at elevated temperatures, consistent with magnon-magnon interactions. These results provide previously missing information on the magnon spectrum of CrI$_3$ and further consolidate the topological nature of its spin excitations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：inelastic neutron scattering（非弹性中子散射）、sample quality（样品质量）。；研究对象：二维蜂窝状晶格铁磁体三碘化铬（CrI₃）中的狄拉克磁子及其热演化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在六角布里渊区的K点附近观测到磁子的缠绕特征（winding feature），这是狄拉克磁子的关键标志；同时发现磁子能量在高温下遵循T²重正化行为，源于磁子-磁子相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在六角布里渊区的K点附近观测到磁子的缠绕特征（winding feature），这是狄拉克磁子的关键标志；同时发现磁子能量在高温下遵循T²重正化行为，源于磁子-磁子相互作用。；创新点：提供了此前缺失的CrI₃磁子谱信息，并进一步巩固了其自旋激发的拓扑性质。摘要未突出说明与以往实验的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 非弹性中子散射（inelastic neutron scattering），并结合改进的样品质量（improved sample quality）。

papers.title: Large Deviation Functions for Open Quantum Systems with a Strong Symmetry
papers.abstract: In open quantum systems with strong symmetries, the global scaled cumulant generating function (SCGF) is generally nonanalytic, so the Gärtner-Ellis theorem cannot directly yield the genuine large-deviation rate function. To address this issue, we propose that the theorem remains valid within blocks of the systems' operator space: we first obtain local rate functions for each block via the theorem and then recover the global one by minimization. This approach is justified by the dissipative freezing phenomenon in such systems. We demonstrate the scheme in an analytical model and a three-spin model with XX interaction. In the latter, we find that the vanishing of a nonanalytic point in the global SCGF under dephasing appears as an avoided ``level'' crossing, and we quantify this behavior using a degenerate perturbation theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：large deviation functions、Gärtner-Ellis theorem、degenerate perturbation theory。；研究对象：具有强对称性的开放量子系统，具体包括一个解析模型和一个具有XX相互作用的三自旋模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强对称性导致全局标度累积生成函数（SCGF）非解析时，可通过分块应用Gärtner-Ellis定理获得局部速率函数，再通过最小化恢复全局大偏差速率函数；在XX三自旋模型中，退相干使全局SCGF的非解析点消失，表现为避免的“能级”交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强对称性导致全局标度累积生成函数（SCGF）非解析时，可通过分块应用Gärtner-Ellis定理获得局部速率函数，再通过最小化恢复全局大偏差速率函数；在XX三自旋模型中，退相干使全局SCGF的非解析点消失，表现为避免的“能级”交叉。；创新点：提出在强对称性导致全局SCGF非解析时，通过分块应用Gärtner-Ellis定理来正确获得大偏差速率函数的方案，并利用耗散冻结现象为该方案提供合理性依据。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：大偏差理论（Gärtner-Ellis定理）、耗散冻结现象、简并微扰理论。具体模型：解析模型和XX相互作用三自旋模型。

papers.title: Disentangling magnetic and optical contributions in ultrafast dynamics of antiperovskite non-collinear antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Non-collinear antiferromagnets are a class of spin-polarized antiferromagnets in which chiral spin textures give rise to Berry-curvature-driven phenomena, such as the anomalous Hall effect (AHE), without net magnetization. We investigate the properties of thin films of antiperovskite non-collinear antiferromagnetic metals Mn3NiN and Mn3GaN using pump-probe experiments. In both materials, we observe a strong dependence of pump-polarization-independent dynamics, induced by femtosecond laser pulses, on the angle between the sample normal and the direction of probe propagation. In Mn3NiN, where the presence of a sizable AHE indicates the Γ4g phase, the measured magnetooptical (MO) signals acquire an additional, strong dependence on the external magnetic field when the probe pulses are incident at nonzero angles. In contrast, in Mn3GaN, where the absence of AHE indicates the Γ5g phase, the measured signals do not depend on the magnetic field. Using probe-polarization-resolved measurements combined with full optical modeling based on Yeh's formalism, we quantitatively separate magnetic and non-magnetic contributions to the measured signals. We show that in Mn3NiN, the observed magnetic field dependence results from field-controlled redistribution of magnetic domain populations, enabled by their piezomagnetic moments and detected by a Kerr-like MO effect, while this effect is absent in Mn3GaN. Temperature-dependent measurements reveal a change from single-step to two-step quenching dynamics with increasing temperature in Mn3NiN. This behavior contrasts with the nearly temperature-independent quenching dynamics reported for the non-collinear antiferromagnetic Heusler compound Mn3Sn, but resembles the crossover from type-I to type-II demagnetization dynamics in metallic ferromagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“pump-probe experiments”、“probe-polarization-resolved measurements”、“temperature-dependent measurements”。；研究对象：反钙钛矿非共线反铁磁金属薄膜 Mn₃NiN 和 Mn₃GaN 的超快动力学过程，特别是磁性和光学贡献的分离。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Mn₃NiN（Γ4g 相）中，非零入射角下的磁光信号对外磁场有强依赖性，源于压磁矩导致的磁畴分布场控重排，并通过类克尔磁光效应被探测到；而 Mn₃GaN（Γ5g 相）中无此效应。此外，Mn₃NiN 的淬灭动力学随温度升高从单步变为两步，与 Mn₃Sn 不同，但类似金属铁磁体中的 I 型到 II 型退磁动力学交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Mn₃NiN（Γ4g 相）中，非零入射角下的磁光信号对外磁场有强依赖性，源于压磁矩导致的磁畴分布场控重排，并通过类克尔磁光效应被探测到；而 Mn₃GaN（Γ5g 相）中无此效应。此外，Mn₃NiN 的淬灭动力学随温度升高从单步变为两步，与 Mn₃Sn 不同，但类似金属铁磁体中的 I 型到 II 型退磁动力学交叉。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒激光泵浦-探测实验（pump-probe experiments）、探针偏振分辨测量（probe-polarization-resolved measurements）、基于 Yeh 形式论的完整光学建模（full optical modeling based on Yeh's formalism）、变温测量。

papers.title: Charge-Transfer Induced Reactivity in sp Carbon Atomic Wires: Towards 0-D sp-sp2 Nanostructures
papers.abstract: Carbon Atomic Wires (CAWs) are finite linear chains of sp-hybridized carbon atoms. Here the electrochemical reduction of CAWs in the form of polyynes (i.e. with alternated single-triple bonds) is reported. Upon applying a reducing potential to a solution containing polydispersed hydrogen-capped polyynes, the formation of a black precipitate was observed. Electronic absorption spectroscopy confirmed the irreversible reaction of the carbon chains while excluding degradation or side reactions. Subsequent analyses revealed that the precipitate consisted of amorphous carbon nanoparticles with tunable diameters. This control over particle size is attributed to the modulation of growth kinetics through restricted mass transport toward the solid-liquid interface. Raman spectroscopy showed that the resulting material exhibits an amorphous sp-sp2 character, with a retained sp fraction exceeding 60%. Smaller nanoparticles displayed reduced disorder within the sp2 domains and a broader distribution of sp-chain lengths preserved in the amorphous matrix. Additional experiments on size-selected polyynes suggest that this synthesis method allows to better preserve the starting chain length in the final structure. Unlike previously reported amorphous sp-sp2 carbon networks, the nanoparticles produced in this study show remarkable stability under ambient conditions, retaining their sp character for times in excess of six months. These findings pave the way for future applications, particularly as further diameter tuning may enable access to the quantum-dot regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验操作（电化学还原）、观测现象（黑色沉淀形成）和表征手段（电子吸收光谱、拉曼光谱）。；研究对象：碳原子线（Carbon Atomic Wires, CAWs），具体为多炔（polyynes）形式的sp杂化碳原子线性链，以及其电化学还原后形成的0维sp-sp2杂化非晶碳纳米颗粒。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过对多分散的氢封端多炔溶液施加还原电位，可以不可逆地形成由非晶sp-sp2碳组成的纳米颗粒，且该颗粒的尺寸可通过限制固液界面的质量传输进行调控。所得纳米颗粒在环境条件下表现出超过六个月的优异稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过对多分散的氢封端多炔溶液施加还原电位，可以不可逆地形成由非晶sp-sp2碳组成的纳米颗粒，且该颗粒的尺寸可通过限制固液界面的质量传输进行调控。所得纳米颗粒在环境条件下表现出超过六个月的优异稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与以往非晶sp-sp2碳网络相比的具体创新点，但明确指出本工作合成的纳米颗粒在环境条件下具有前所未有的长期稳定性（超过六个月），且其尺寸可调，有望进入量子点领域。
papers.method_zh: 电化学还原法（施加还原电位）；电子吸收光谱（监测反应进程与排除副反应）；拉曼光谱（表征产物sp-sp2杂化特性及sp含量）；对产物进行后续分析（确定成分为非晶碳纳米颗粒，并测量其尺寸分布）。

papers.title: Quantum phase diagrams for bosons in hexagonal optical potentials: A continuous-space quantum Monte Carlo study
papers.abstract: Hexagonal optical lattices, emulating graphene and hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) structures, provide a versatile platform for exploring strongly correlated quantum matter. Using continuous-space exact diagonalization and quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we investigate the phase diagrams of ultracold bosons in honeycomb and h-BN lattices. For the honeycomb lattice, we find significant deviations from the standard Bose-Hubbard model even for strong lattice amplitudes. We observe suppressed Mott insulator lobes and the absence of higher-order insulating phases, attributed to strong density-assisted tunneling effects. In the h-BN case, a rich phase diagram emerges, featuring multiple Mott lobes with various sublattice occupations, driven by the interplay of lattice asymmetry, interactions, and particle filling. Our results highlight the necessity of continuous-space treatments for capturing the full complexity of bosonic quantum phases in hexagonal geometries, paving the way for experimental realizations with ultracold atoms and further theoretical work.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：continuous-space exact diagonalization, quantum Monte Carlo simulations）；研究对象：六角光学晶格（honeycomb lattice 和 h-BN lattice）中的超冷玻色子量子相图
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在蜂窝状晶格中，即使晶格振幅很强，标准Bose-Hubbard模型也会出现显著偏差，表现为Mott绝缘体瓣被抑制且高阶绝缘相缺失；在h-BN晶格中，由于晶格不对称性、相互作用和粒子填充的共同作用，出现了具有不同子格占据数的多个Mott瓣的丰富相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在蜂窝状晶格中，即使晶格振幅很强，标准Bose-Hubbard模型也会出现显著偏差，表现为Mott绝缘体瓣被抑制且高阶绝缘相缺失；在h-BN晶格中，由于晶格不对称性、相互作用和粒子填充的共同作用，出现了具有不同子格占据数的多个Mott瓣的丰富相图。；创新点：强调了连续空间处理对于捕捉六角几何中玻色子量子相完整复杂性的必要性，揭示了标准Bose-Hubbard模型在六角晶格中的局限性，并首次系统展示了h-BN型晶格中由不对称性驱动的丰富Mott相结构。
papers.method_zh: 连续空间精确对角化（continuous-space exact diagonalization）和量子蒙特卡洛模拟（quantum Monte Carlo simulations）

papers.title: Josephson spectroscopy study of kagome superconductors toward the deep point-contact regime
papers.abstract: Josephson scanning tunneling microscopy (JSTM) has emerged as an important technique for probing the superconducting order parameter at the atomic scale. However, the Josephson current in JSTM may behave quite differently when the coupling strength varies. Here, we push the junction to the deep point-contact regime, reaching a normal-state junction resistance of only 0.15 $h/2e^2 \simeq 2~{\rm k}Ω$. We demonstrate, using kagome superconductors, that the zero-bias conductance, a key characteristic of the Josephson current, deviates strongly from the quadratic dependence on the normal-state conductance upon entering the deep point-contact regime. Furthermore, we observe a striking saturation of the zero-bias conductance, which we show arises from the series resistance in the circuit. This also serves as a cautious reminder when interpreting zero-bias conductance saturation or quantization in studies of exotic physics such as that of Majorana zero modes if the tip-sample junction resistance is extremely small. Finally, we identify an optimum regime where JSTM can be used as an atomic-scale probe for studying pair-density wave states in materials with low superconducting transition temperature, such as AV3Sb5 kagome superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“Josephson scanning tunneling microscopy (JSTM)”、“demonstrate”、“observe”、“identify an optimum regime”。；研究对象：笼目超导体（kagome superconductors），具体涉及AV₃Sb₅体系，以及其中的约瑟夫森结输运行为、零偏压电导饱和现象，以及配对密度波（pair-density wave）态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在深点接触区（deep point-contact regime），零偏压电导对正常态电导的二次方依赖关系被打破，并出现由电路串联电阻导致的饱和现象；同时，研究确定了利用JSTM在原子尺度探测低超导转变温度材料中配对密度波态的最佳工作区间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在深点接触区（deep point-contact regime），零偏压电导对正常态电导的二次方依赖关系被打破，并出现由电路串联电阻导致的饱和现象；同时，研究确定了利用JSTM在原子尺度探测低超导转变温度材料中配对密度波态的最佳工作区间。；创新点：首次系统揭示了在深点接触区（结电阻远低于量子电阻）约瑟夫森电流行为与常规弱耦合区的显著偏离，并指出零偏压电导饱和可能被误认为马约拉纳零模等奇异物理信号，需谨慎解读。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 约瑟夫森扫描隧道显微镜（JSTM），通过将结区推至深点接触区（正常态结电阻低至约2 kΩ），测量零偏压电导随耦合强度的变化，并结合串联电阻效应分析。

papers.title: Sub-kelvin thermal conductivity of substrates and on-chip routing in quantum integrated systems
papers.abstract: The development of large-scale quantum systems increasingly relies on the close integration of heterogeneous components such as qubits, control electronics, and readout circuits, making thermal management at cryogenic temperatures a central challenge in such architectures. In this work, we present an experimental thermal study of two building blocks of such systems: the substrate and the on-chip routing. We first investigate the sub-kelvin thermal conductivity of four substrate materials: high-resistivity silicon, low-resistivity silicon, borosilicate, and sapphire. We report that high-resistivity silicon exhibits the highest thermal conductivity among the substrates studied ($5\cdot10^{-2}$~W/m$\cdot$K at 300~mK), while low-resistivity silicon, borosilicate, and sapphire show lower values ($8\cdot10^{-4}$~W/m$\cdot$K, 2$\cdot10^{-3}$~W/m$\cdot$K, and 2$\cdot10^{-3}$~W/m$\cdot$K at 300~mK, respectively). Ballistic conductance evaluation using a finite-element non-equilibrium Green's function approach further allows us to extract the phonon mean free path in each substrate and gives insights into the involved scattering mechanisms. Additionally, we employ a dedicated test vehicle to evaluate the impact of on-chip routing on the thermal conductance of the system. Our measurements with superconducting Nb routing lines reveal that the routing increases the in-plane thermal conductance of the system, but the substrate remains the dominant heat path. These results highlight the critical role of the substrate choice within quantum systems and underscore the importance of function partitioning through 3D integration approaches for more efficient thermal management in quantum architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimental thermal study、measurements、test vehicle）；研究对象：量子集成系统中衬底材料（高阻硅、低阻硅、硼硅玻璃、蓝宝石）的亚开尔文热导率，以及片上布线（超导Nb布线）对系统热导的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高阻硅在300 mK时热导率最高（5×10⁻² W/m·K），而低阻硅、硼硅玻璃和蓝宝石热导率较低（分别为8×10⁻⁴、2×10⁻³、2×10⁻³ W/m·K）；片上布线会增加面内热导，但衬底仍是主要热传导路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高阻硅在300 mK时热导率最高（5×10⁻² W/m·K），而低阻硅、硼硅玻璃和蓝宝石热导率较低（分别为8×10⁻⁴、2×10⁻³、2×10⁻³ W/m·K）；片上布线会增加面内热导，但衬底仍是主要热传导路径。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量四种衬底材料在亚开尔文温区的热导率；采用有限元非平衡格林函数（finite-element non-equilibrium Green's function）方法评估弹道电导，提取声子平均自由程；使用专用测试结构评估片上布线对系统热导的影响。

papers.title: Transformation-mediated twinning governs plasticity in body-centered cubic nanocrystals under extreme loading
