With $D_{\text{rot}}$ and the static ring profile $f_0$ measured from particle simulations, the resulting effective theory reproduces multiple independent orientation- and density-sector diagnostics with no further adjustable parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：statistical field theory, non-linear field theory, effective theory）；研究对象：二维紧致黎曼流形上具有淬火随机相互作用的布朗粒子系统，具体以球面S²上的受阻布朗粒子为模拟对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大量粒子极限下，系统密度场会绝热地集中到一个缓慢进动的大圆环上，其低能动力学由实射影平面ℝP²上的非线性sigma模型（NLSM）在(0+1)维描述，且仅由一个低能常数——旋转扩散系数D_rot决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在大量粒子极限下，系统密度场会绝热地集中到一个缓慢进动的大圆环上，其低能动力学由实射影平面ℝP²上的非线性sigma模型（NLSM）在(0+1)维描述，且仅由一个低能常数——旋转扩散系数D_rot决定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 发展了受阻场（F²）模型，这是一种描述自旋玻璃动力学的非线性场论；结合粒子模拟验证了绝热维度约化现象；采用玻恩-奥本海默近似分离慢速取向与快速密度涨落，并通过对称性分析推导出低能有效理论。

papers.title: Structural effects of liquid infiltration of 3Y-Zirconia with Sc, Mg and Y
papers.abstract: The current work has investigated the effect of co-doping 3Y-Zirconia (3YSZ) with Sc, Mg and Y by wet infiltration. Pre-sintered discs of 3YSZ were immersed in diluted nitric acid solutions containing Sc, Mg or Y, and combinations of the three, trapping liquid within the porosities of the samples. Upon drying, the cations are maintained inside the pellet, making the basis for the co-doping. After sintering, mass increase confirms the co-doping effect and X-ray diffraction analysis show clear variations in atomic structure depending on the doping element. Rietveld refinements show that the wet-infiltrated samples contain the tetragonal t, t double prime and cubic c-phase in various fractions depending on the doping elements. Sc-infiltrated samples show a tendency to higher tetragonality, while the Mg-infiltrated sample obtained a single cubic phase. The multi-phase wet-infiltrated samples have a similar phase separation after sintering as 5Y-Zirconia (5YSZ), as calculated by the tetragonality deviation parameter. 3YSZ and 5YSZ sintered for 0 hours and 2 hours at 1500 degrees C show the effect of sintering time on the phase segregation. To evaluate the material properties in an application-based perspective, the Knoop hardness, translucency and grain size was measured. We conclude that liquid infiltration is a viable route to perform co-doping of Zirconia with various co-doping elements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了“wet infiltration”（湿法浸渍）、“X-ray diffraction”（X射线衍射）、“Rietveld refinements”（Rietveld精修）、“Knoop hardness”（努氏硬度）等实验手段。；研究对象：3Y-氧化锆（3YSZ）通过湿法浸渍共掺杂Sc、Mg、Y元素后的结构效应，包括相组成、晶格畸变、硬度、透光性及晶粒尺寸。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 湿法浸渍可有效实现氧化锆的共掺杂，不同掺杂元素导致不同的相分离行为：Sc掺杂倾向于提高四方性，Mg掺杂可获得单一立方相，而多元素共掺杂样品的相分离行为与5Y-氧化锆（5YSZ）类似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：湿法浸渍可有效实现氧化锆的共掺杂，不同掺杂元素导致不同的相分离行为：Sc掺杂倾向于提高四方性，Mg掺杂可获得单一立方相，而多元素共掺杂样品的相分离行为与5Y-氧化锆（5YSZ）类似。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 湿法浸渍（将预烧结的3YSZ圆片浸入含Sc、Mg、Y的稀硝酸溶液中，干燥后烧结）；X射线衍射（XRD）结合Rietveld精修分析相组成；通过质量增加确认共掺杂效果；测量努氏硬度、透光性和晶粒尺寸。

papers.title: From Bulk to Surface: Structure and Dynamics of Amorphous Alumina from Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics
papers.abstract: Understanding the atomic-scale structure and dynamics of amorphous oxide surfaces is essential for interpreting their chemical reactivity, mechanical stability, and interfacial behavior, yet direct experimental characterization remains challenging. We employ Deep Potential (DP) molecular dynamics to generate large-scale, ab initio-quality models of amorphous Al$_2$O$_3$ bulk glasses and melt-quenched free surfaces, enabling a quantitative analysis of both structure and relaxation dynamics with statistical confidence inaccessible to direct ab initio simulation. The trained DP model reproduces experimental liquid and glass structure, captures the cooling-rate dependence of the bulk glass transition, and corrects systematic biases in the polyhedral populations predicted by widely used classical force fields. At the free surface, mass density recovers to bulk values over ~10 $\unicode{x212B}$, while local coordination requires a slightly wider subsurface region to fully converge. The outermost layer is oxygen-enriched, exhibits altered polyhedral connectivity with contracted Al-O bonds, and hosts a broad population of under-coordinated motifs (notably AlO$_3$ and OAl$_2$) whose abundances are governed by glass stability. These reactive Lewis acid and Br$\unicode{x00F8}$nsted base sites are locally paired in a manner consistent with bond-valence compensation, yet remain spatially dispersed rather than aggregating into extended clusters. Despite this pronounced structural heterogeneity, the surface relaxes on the same timescale as the bulk and exhibits a comparable glass transition temperature, suggesting that the disordered surface is kinetically stable once formed. Together, these results establish a molecular-level picture of amorphous alumina surfaces and demonstrate the capability of machine-learned potentials to resolve structure-property relationships in disordered oxide interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Deep Potential molecular dynamics、ab initio-quality models、machine-learned potentials。；研究对象：非晶氧化铝（amorphous Al₂O₃）的体相玻璃和熔淬自由表面的原子尺度结构与动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非晶氧化铝表面存在氧富集、配位缺陷（如AlO₃和OAl₂）等结构异质性，但这些缺陷在空间上分散而非聚集；表面与体相具有相似的弛豫时间和玻璃化转变温度，表明无序表面一旦形成便具有动力学稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非晶氧化铝表面存在氧富集、配位缺陷（如AlO₃和OAl₂）等结构异质性，但这些缺陷在空间上分散而非聚集；表面与体相具有相似的弛豫时间和玻璃化转变温度，表明无序表面一旦形成便具有动力学稳定性。；创新点：利用机器学习势（Deep Potential）实现了对非晶氧化铝表面结构与动力学的统计可靠分析，纠正了经典力场在多面体分布上的系统偏差，并首次揭示了表面缺陷的局域配对与空间分散特性。
papers.method_zh: 采用深度势能分子动力学（Deep Potential molecular dynamics）生成大规模、从头算精度的非晶Al₂O₃体相玻璃和熔淬自由表面模型，并进行结构与弛豫动力学的定量分析。

papers.title: Squeezed Vibrational States in Superfluid Helium
papers.abstract: Ultrafast birefringence oscillations observed in superfluid helium provide evidence for anisotropic quantum squeezing of quasiparticle pairs. The measured response is a superposition of contributions from all vibrational modes, with dominant contributions from rotons, maxons, and Pitaevskii's plateau. The nonzero initial phase follows naturally from multimode interference.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了“观察到”（observed）超快双折射振荡，并描述了测量到的响应特征。；研究对象：超流氦（Superfluid Helium）中的量子声子（振动）态，特别是各向异性量子压缩的准粒子对（包括旋子、麦克斯韦子和皮塔耶夫斯基平台对应的模式）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超流氦中观测到的超快双折射振荡为各向异性量子压缩的准粒子对提供了实验证据。该响应是所有振动模式贡献的叠加，其非零初始相位自然地源于多模干涉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超流氦中观测到的超快双折射振荡为各向异性量子压缩的准粒子对提供了实验证据。该响应是所有振动模式贡献的叠加，其非零初始相位自然地源于多模干涉。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 超快双折射测量（Ultrafast birefringence oscillations）。通过分析双折射振荡信号，提取了所有振动模式的叠加贡献。

papers.title: Light-Induced Even-Wave Spin Splittings in Nonmagnetic Centrosymmetric Systems with Spin-Orbit Coupling
papers.abstract: Spin splitting underpins a vast range of spin-dependent phenomena. Traditionally, two primary mechanisms generate such splitting: relativistic spin-orbit coupling (SOC) and nonrelativistic magnetic exchange coupling (MEC). Governed by distinct symmetry constraints, they produce splittings of opposite parity -- odd for SOC and even for MEC -- a dichotomy that underpins the distinct spin physics of nonmagnetic and magnetic systems. In this work, we break this dichotomy by demonstrating the dynamic generation of even-parity spin splitting in centrosymmetric, nonmagnetic systems driven by circularly polarized light. We show that the symmetry of the induced splitting is controlled by the angular character of the underlying orbitals, enabling the realization of s-wave, d-wave, and g-wave spin-split band structures identical to those of ferromagnets and altermagnets. Furthermore, we find that these spin-split bands can naturally host a Chern insulator phase. We also discuss the associated spin and orbital magnetization. Our results establish a direct and previously unrecognized conceptual link between the two fundamental mechanisms of spin splitting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中未提及实验手段或计算模拟，主要基于对称性分析和理论推导（如“demonstrate the dynamic generation”“show that the symmetry is controlled”）。；研究对象：非磁性中心对称体系中由圆偏振光诱导的偶数宇称自旋劈裂现象，具体涉及s波、d波、g波自旋劈裂能带结构以及陈绝缘体相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非磁性中心对称体系中，通过圆偏振光可以动态产生偶数宇称的自旋劈裂，其对称性由轨道角动量特征控制，从而在非磁性体系中实现类似铁磁体或交变磁体的自旋劈裂能带，并自然支持陈绝缘体相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非磁性中心对称体系中，通过圆偏振光可以动态产生偶数宇称的自旋劈裂，其对称性由轨道角动量特征控制，从而在非磁性体系中实现类似铁磁体或交变磁体的自旋劈裂能带，并自然支持陈绝缘体相。；创新点：打破了传统认知中自旋劈裂的奇偶性二分法（SOC产生奇宇称劈裂，MEC产生偶宇称劈裂），首次在非磁性中心对称体系中通过光场动态实现偶数宇称自旋劈裂，建立了两种基本自旋劈裂机制之间的直接概念联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论对称性分析与模型推导。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如是否使用紧束缚模型、k·p微扰或第一性原理），仅提及基于轨道角动量特征控制对称性。

papers.title: Measurement-induced phase transitions in disordered fermions
papers.abstract: Measurement-induced phase transitions are nonequilibrium transitions between phases characterized by distinct entanglement scaling behaviors, driven by the competition between unitary dynamics and measurements. Despite recent numerical efforts, how quenched disorder affects these transitions remains unclear. In this work, we study a $d$-dimensional noninteracting fermionic system subject to both quenched disorder and continuous monitoring of the local particle density, and derive an effective field theory describing its long-time universal behaviors. We find that the system is governed by the same nonlinear sigma model as in the case of clean monitored fermions, with disorder entering only through a modification of model parameters. This result suggests that the presence or absence of a measurement-induced phase transition is unaffected by the introduction of disorder: in spatial dimensions d>1, a transition occurs between an area x log law phase and an area law phase, whereas in d=1, the system exhibits only an area law phase and no transition. Numerical results further demonstrate that both clean and disordered one-dimensional free fermions exhibit area-law behavior when the system size is large enough.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：推导有效场论、非线性sigma模型、数值模拟。；研究对象：受无序（quenched disorder）影响的非相互作用费米子体系中的测量诱导相变（measurement-induced phase transitions）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无序的引入不会改变测量诱导相变的有无：在空间维度d>1时，体系仍存在面积×对数律相与面积律相之间的相变；在d=1时，体系仅呈现面积律相，无相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序的引入不会改变测量诱导相变的有无：在空间维度d>1时，体系仍存在面积×对数律相与面积律相之间的相变；在d=1时，体系仅呈现面积律相，无相变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 推导d维非相互作用费米子体系在淬火无序与连续局域粒子数监测下的有效场论（非线性sigma模型），并结合数值计算对比一维清洁与无序自由费米子的大尺度行为。

papers.title: Engineering Quantum Many-Body Scars through Lattice Geometry
papers.abstract: Quantum many-body scars enable persistent non-ergodic dynamics in otherwise thermalizing systems, yet their stabilization typically relies on fine-tuned initial states or engineered Hamiltonian perturbations. Here we show that lattice geometry alone can serve as a powerful and experimentally accessible control knob for inducing and enhancing scarring. By transforming a one-dimensional chain into a quasi-one-dimensional triangle-decorated lattice, we find that the fully polarized state -- normally thermalizing in the PXP model -- exhibits pronounced fidelity revivals, slow entanglement growth, and strong overlap with a tower of weakly entangled eigenstates. We trace this behavior to a geometry-induced restructuring of the constrained Hilbert space, whereby the adjacency graph decomposes into hypercube subgraphs that enforce coherent population transfer and stabilize an emergent approximate $\mathrm{su}(2)$ algebra. We propose a direct implementation in programmable arrays of tweezer-trapped Rydberg atoms, where the triangle-decorated geometry can be realized using spatial light modulators and the resulting scarring dynamics probed via time-resolved measurements of excitation density. Our results establish lattice connectivity as a design principle for engineering non-ergodic dynamics in constrained quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：show, trace, propose, establish；无实验数据或计算模拟细节）；研究对象：量子多体疤痕（quantum many-body scars）在约束量子系统中的非遍历动力学，具体以PXP模型和三角形装饰晶格（triangle-decorated lattice）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅通过改变晶格几何结构（从一维链变为准一维三角形装饰晶格），即可诱导并增强量子多体疤痕效应，使原本热化的完全极化态表现出显著的保真度回复、缓慢纠缠增长以及与弱纠缠本征态塔的强重叠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅通过改变晶格几何结构（从一维链变为准一维三角形装饰晶格），即可诱导并增强量子多体疤痕效应，使原本热化的完全极化态表现出显著的保真度回复、缓慢纠缠增长以及与弱纠缠本征态塔的强重叠。；创新点：首次提出晶格连通性（lattice connectivity）本身可作为设计非遍历动力学的控制旋钮，无需精细调节初始态或哈密顿量微扰，并给出了具体的几何实现方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过约束希尔伯特空间的邻接图分解为超立方子图，揭示几何诱导的相干布居转移和近似su(2)代数稳定性；提出在可编程镊子囚禁里德伯原子阵列中的直接实验实现方案（使用空间光调制器实现三角形装饰几何，通过时间分辨激发密度测量探测疤痕动力学）。

papers.title: Competing nonlinearities, criticality, and order-to-chaos transition in deep networks
papers.abstract: Deep neural networks owe their expressive power to nonlinear activation functions. The effective field theory of signal propagation at initialization reveals a few distinct universality classes of activations that exhibit different depth scaling. Tuning across these, especially with analytical control, is an open problem. We show that a statistical mixture of activations, where each neuron independently and randomly draws its activation from a two-component distribution with mixing fraction $p$, provides a new mechanism for a continuous phase transition. Applied to a mixture of Tanh and Swish, the transition is sharp in the depth scaling of the preactivation variance, separating a variance-collapsing from a variance-inflating phase; at $p_c$, the network acquires statistical scale invariance, with depth-independent variance, without sacrificing smoothness. This resolves a longstanding tension, where scale-invariant propagation has previously required the non-smooth ReLU family, rendering such networks ill-suited to curvature-based optimizers, physics-informed architectures, and neural-network quantum states. We corroborate the transition through variance propagation, parallel and perpendicular susceptibilities, and Lyapunov exponents. Training multilayer perceptrons on real datasets reveals non-monotonic test performance as a function of $p$, with an optimum near the theoretically predicted $p_c$, confirming that the initialization-level transition has direct consequences for learned representations. The quenched activation disorder acts as a structural regularizer, suppressing memorization of corrupted labels while preserving generalization. Our framework establishes statistical activation mixtures as a controlled tool for navigating the phase diagram of deep network universality classes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值实验验证）。判断依据：核心是建立有效场论框架和相图分析，并通过数值模拟（方差传播、李雅普诺夫指数）和真实数据集训练进行验证。；研究对象：深度神经网络在初始化时的信号传播行为，具体研究激活函数的统计混合（statistical mixture of activations）如何导致新的相变和普适类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将Tanh和Swish两种激活函数按一定比例随机混合，可以在初始化时实现一个连续的相变。在临界混合比例p_c处，网络获得统计尺度不变性（方差与深度无关），且无需牺牲激活函数的平滑性，从而解决了此前尺度不变传播必须依赖非平滑ReLU家族的矛盾。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将Tanh和Swish两种激活函数按一定比例随机混合，可以在初始化时实现一个连续的相变。在临界混合比例p_c处，网络获得统计尺度不变性（方差与深度无关），且无需牺牲激活函数的平滑性，从而解决了此前尺度不变传播必须依赖非平滑ReLU家族的矛盾。；创新点：首次提出并系统分析了“统计激活混合物”作为一种可控工具，用于在深度网络普适类的相图中导航。该机制在初始化层面实现了连续相变，且临界点附近的网络在真实任务中表现出最优的测试性能，同时具有结构正则化效应，能抑制对错误标签的记忆。
papers.method_zh: 有效场论（信号传播理论）、方差传播分析、平行与垂直磁化率计算、李雅普诺夫指数分析；并在真实数据集（如CIFAR等）上训练多层感知机，测试泛化性能。

papers.title: Microsopic Theory of Spin Polarons in Chern Ferromagnets
papers.abstract: We develop a microscopic theory of charged excitations in an SU(2) Chern ferromagnet and obtain closed-form wavefunctions for a hierarchy of charge-$e$ spin polaron states binding an arbitrary number of spin flips. In an ideal Chern-$1$ band with a normal-ordered contact interaction, we show that these polarons are exact eigenstates of the Hamiltonian with the same energy as single-hole excitations. Away from this ideal limit, we promote these states to a variational family by introducing a single size parameter and a geometry-informed single-particle dressing. Our momentum-space wavefunctions admit two equivalent representations: a ratio of Jastrow factors of Weierstrass functions of relative momenta or an antisymmetrized geminal product of particle-hole wavefunctions. The latter enables efficient evaluation of overlaps and expectation values for large system sizes and many spin flips. Benchmarking in the lowest Landau level, the single-spin-flip ansatz achieves $\gtrsim 99\%$ overlap with exact diagonalization and accurately captures binding energies, while the multi-spin-flip energies interpolate smoothly toward the large-texture (skyrmion) regime. For Chern bands with tunable quantum geometry, we find that interaction-generated single particle dispersion quickly destabilizes the spin polarons once quantum geometry becomes sufficiently non-uniform. When such dispersion is suppressed, however, the bound states persist deeper into the non-uniform regime, with the binding energy slowly decreasing and the bound state becoming larger as the quantum geometry becomes more concentrated. Our results provide a microscopic foundation for analyzing doped Chern ferromagnets in moiré platforms and lay the groundwork for variational wavefunctions of multi-polaron excitations and phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a microscopic theory、closed-form wavefunctions、exact eigenstates、variational family。；研究对象：SU(2) 陈数铁磁体中的自旋极化子（spin polaron）激发态，具体为携带电荷-e、束缚任意数量自旋翻转的准粒子态，以及其在理想陈数-1能带和可调量子几何下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在理想陈数-1能带中，自旋极化子是哈密顿量的精确本征态，能量与单空穴激发相同；在非理想情况下，通过变分波函数可精确描述单自旋翻转和多自旋翻转极化子，其能量随自旋翻转数增加平滑过渡到斯格明子（skyrmion）大纹理区域。量子几何的非均匀性会破坏极化子稳定性，但若抑制相互作用产生的单粒子色散，束缚态可在更不均匀的几何中存活。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在理想陈数-1能带中，自旋极化子是哈密顿量的精确本征态，能量与单空穴激发相同；在非理想情况下，通过变分波函数可精确描述单自旋翻转和多自旋翻转极化子，其能量随自旋翻转数增加平滑过渡到斯格明子（skyrmion）大纹理区域。量子几何的非均匀性会破坏极化子稳定性，但若抑制相互作用产生的单粒子色散，束缚态可在更不均匀的几何中存活。；创新点：首次为陈数铁磁体中的自旋极化子提供了微观波函数解析形式，建立了从单自旋翻转到多自旋翻转（斯格明子）的统一变分框架，并揭示了量子几何非均匀性对极化子稳定性的关键影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用微观理论推导，构建了闭式波函数（包括Jastrow因子比和反对称化粒子-空穴对乘积两种等价表示），引入单一尺寸参数和几何信息单粒子缀饰作为变分族；在最低朗道能级中通过精确对角化进行基准测试（重叠度≥99%），并分析可调量子几何陈数能带中的稳定性。

papers.title: Charge Scrambling in Strong-to-Weak Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract: Strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB) is diagnosed by nonlinear correlators, but its direct static implication for conserved charge fluctuations is not automatic. We show that, for continuous symmetries, long-range Rényi-1 correlator, together with a sufficiently rapid approach to its nonzero asymptotic value, forces subsystem charge indefiniteness: the block-charge variance has an extensive lower bound; equivalently, the truncated symmetry expectation has extensive curvature. This gives a precise static fluctuation footprint of charge scrambling. We construct examples to show that the implication is conditional and non-reversible: dephased superfluids retain Rényi-1 SWSSB with subextensive charge variance when the Rényi-1 tail is too slow, while sparse fixed-charge projectors have extensive charge variance but no local charge-transfer Rényi-1 order or long-range conditional mutual information. Finally, we introduce a \emph{twist overlap} correlator, which serves as an analogue of charge variance applicable to both discrete and continuous symmetries. This naturally decomposes local block-charge fluctuations into strong- and weak-symmetry channels. We found that the weak-symmetry channel isolates coherent charge fluctuations and is directly related to the Wigner--Yanase skew information. Taken together, these results give a unified understanding for distinguishing nonlinear SWSSB order, local charge indefiniteness, and coherent charge fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中讨论的是理论概念（如Rényi-1关联函数、子系统电荷方差、twist overlap关联子等），未提及实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：强到弱自发对称性破缺（SWSSB）中的电荷乱序（charge scrambling）现象，特别是连续对称性下子系统电荷涨落的静态特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于连续对称性，长程Rényi-1关联函数若足够快地趋近非零渐近值，则必然导致子系统电荷方差具有广延下界（即电荷乱序的静态涨落足迹）；反之，若Rényi-1尾部衰减过慢，则SWSSB可伴随次广延电荷方差（如退相超流体的例子）。此外，引入的“twist overlap”关联子可统一刻画离散和连续对称性下的电荷涨落，并将局域电荷涨落分解为强对称和弱对称通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于连续对称性，长程Rényi-1关联函数若足够快地趋近非零渐近值，则必然导致子系统电荷方差具有广延下界（即电荷乱序的静态涨落足迹）；反之，若Rényi-1尾部衰减过慢，则SWSSB可伴随次广延电荷方差（如退相超流体的例子）。此外，引入的“twist overlap”关联子可统一刻画离散和连续对称性下的电荷涨落，并将局域电荷涨落分解为强对称和弱对称通道。；创新点：首次系统阐明SWSSB与电荷乱序（电荷方差广延性）之间的条件性关系，并引入twist overlap关联子作为统一诊断工具，将局域电荷涨落分解为强/弱对称通道，揭示弱对称通道与相干电荷涨落的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用Rényi-1关联函数、子系统电荷方差、截断对称性期望曲率等静态量，构造退相超流体和稀疏固定电荷投影算符等示例，并引入twist overlap关联子与Wigner-Yanase偏斜信息建立联系。

papers.title: Dynamical cooling driven by self-similar fronts in the 2D nonlinear Schrödinger model
papers.abstract: We analyze the dynamics towards partial thermalization and subsequent cooling in the defocusing two-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger model, using direct simulations and insights from the wave-kinetic equations (WKE) and a fourth-order differential approximation model (DAM). We show that the evolving WKE spectrum exhibits two distinct similarity ranges--the quasi-thermal core and the ultraviolet tail--whereas in the DAM, an additional range of infrared self-similarity appears. By stretching the quasi-thermal region, the self-similar fronts drive an effective dynamical cooling process towards the formal but ill-defined equilibrium state at vanishing temperature--analogous to an ultraviolet catastrophe in a system of classical waves.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：wave-kinetic equations (WKE)、fourth-order differential approximation model (DAM)、direct simulations、分析动力学过程）；研究对象：二维聚焦非线性薛定谔模型（defocusing 2D nonlinear Schrödinger model）中的部分热化及后续冷却动力学过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维非线性薛定谔模型中，自相似前沿通过拉伸准热核心区域，驱动系统向形式上的零温平衡态发生有效的动力学冷却，这一过程类似于经典波系统中的紫外灾难。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维非线性薛定谔模型中，自相似前沿通过拉伸准热核心区域，驱动系统向形式上的零温平衡态发生有效的动力学冷却，这一过程类似于经典波系统中的紫外灾难。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 直接数值模拟、波动力学方程（WKE）分析、四阶微分近似模型（DAM）分析。

papers.title: The Interplay of Data Structure and Imbalance in the Learning Dynamics of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Real-world datasets are inherently heterogeneous, yet how per-class structural differences and sampling imbalance shape the training dynamics of diffusion models-and potentially exacerbate disparities-remains poorly understood. While models typically transition from an initial phase of generalization to memorizing the training set, existing theory assumes homogeneous data, leaving open how class imbalance and heterogeneity reshape these dynamics. In this work, we develop a high-dimensional analytical framework to study class-dependent learning in score-based diffusion models. Analyzing a random-features model trained on Gaussian mixtures, we derive the feature-covariance spectrum to characterize per-class generalization and memorization times. We reveal the explicit hierarchy governing these dynamics: class variance is the primary determinant of learning order-consistently favoring higher-variance classes-while centroid geometry plays a secondary role. Sampling imbalance acts as a modulator that can reverse this ordering and, under strong imbalance, forces minority classes to acquire distinct, delayed speciation times during backward diffusion. Together, these results suggest that diffusion models can memorize some classes while others remain insufficiently learned. We validate our theoretical predictions empirically using U-Net models trained on Fashion MNIST.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算验证）。判断依据：关键词“high-dimensional analytical framework”、“derive”、“theoretical predictions”、“empirically validate”。；研究对象：扩散模型（score-based diffusion models）在训练过程中的类依赖学习动力学，具体以高斯混合数据（Gaussian mixtures）和随机特征模型（random-features model）为研究对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扩散模型的学习顺序主要由类方差决定（高方差类优先学习），而质心几何起次要作用；采样不平衡可以逆转这一顺序，并在强不平衡下导致少数类在反向扩散过程中出现延迟的“特化时间”（speciation times），从而使得模型可能记住某些类而其他类尚未充分学习。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扩散模型的学习顺序主要由类方差决定（高方差类优先学习），而质心几何起次要作用；采样不平衡可以逆转这一顺序，并在强不平衡下导致少数类在反向扩散过程中出现延迟的“特化时间”（speciation times），从而使得模型可能记住某些类而其他类尚未充分学习。；创新点：首次在理论上揭示了数据异质性（类间结构差异）与采样不平衡如何共同塑造扩散模型的训练动力学，特别是类方差、质心几何与不平衡度之间的层级调控关系，以及不平衡导致少数类出现延迟特化现象。
papers.method_zh: 构建高维解析框架，分析基于随机特征模型（random-features model）在混合高斯数据上的训练，推导特征协方差谱以刻画每类的泛化与记忆时间；并用U-Net模型在Fashion MNIST数据集上进行实验验证。

papers.title: Higher-order interactions in ecology can be hidden in plain sight
papers.abstract: Higher-order interactions are increasingly recognized as a key component of ecological dynamics. However, we show that higher-order Lotka-Volterra dynamics can, in some scenarios, be accurately reproduced by effective pairwise models fitted to the same abundance time series. Consequently, higher-order interactions cannot, in general, be inferred from time-series data alone. We further identify a fundamental problem of mechanistic identifiability, whereby distinct interaction mechanisms generate nearly indistinguishable dynamics, potentially leading to accurate yet misleading ecological interpretations. Our results highlight the need to complement time-series data with additional ecological information to infer interaction structure reliably.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：higher-order Lotka-Volterra dynamics、effective pairwise models、mechanistic identifiability。；研究对象：生态系统中高阶相互作用（higher-order interactions）的动力学机制及其可识别性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高阶Lotka-Volterra动力学在某些场景下可以被有效成对模型精确再现，因此仅凭时间序列数据无法可靠推断高阶相互作用的存在；不同相互作用机制可能产生几乎不可区分的动力学，导致看似准确但具有误导性的生态学解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高阶Lotka-Volterra动力学在某些场景下可以被有效成对模型精确再现，因此仅凭时间序列数据无法可靠推断高阶相互作用的存在；不同相互作用机制可能产生几乎不可区分的动力学，导致看似准确但具有误导性的生态学解释。；创新点：揭示了高阶相互作用在时间序列数据中可能“隐藏”于成对模型之下的现象，并指出存在根本性的机制可识别性问题，即不同相互作用机制可产生几乎相同的动力学行为。摘要未突出说明具体数学或统计方法上的创新。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与动力学分析，具体为对比高阶Lotka-Volterra模型与有效成对模型在相同丰度时间序列上的拟合效果，并分析机制可识别性问题。

papers.title: Macroscopic entanglement between two magnon modes via two-tone driving of a superconducting qubit
papers.abstract: The cavity-mediated coupling between magnons in an yttrium-iron-garnet (YIG) sphere and a superconducting qubit has recently been demonstrated as a new platform for preparing macroscopic quantum states. Here, based on this system, we propose to entangle two magnon modes in two YIG spheres by driving the qubit with a two-tone field and by appropriately choosing the frequencies and strengths of the two driving fields. We show that strong entanglement can be achieved with fully feasible parameters. We further provide a detection scheme for experimentally verifying the entanglement. Our results indicate that macroscopic entanglement between two magnon modes in two millimeter-sized YIG spheres, involving more than $10^{18}$ spins, can be realized using currently available parameters, which finds promising applications in fundamental studies, such as macroscopic quantum mechanics and the test of unconventional decoherence theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we propose”“we show”“we further provide”等表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟，属于理论方案设计。；研究对象：两个钇铁石榴石（YIG）球体中的磁振子模式，通过超导量子比特与腔场耦合实现宏观纠缠。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过双音驱动超导量子比特并合理选择驱动场的频率与强度，可以在两个毫米尺寸YIG球体（涉及超过10^18个自旋）的两个磁振子模式之间实现强纠缠，且所用参数在当前实验条件下完全可行。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过双音驱动超导量子比特并合理选择驱动场的频率与强度，可以在两个毫米尺寸YIG球体（涉及超过10^18个自旋）的两个磁振子模式之间实现强纠缠，且所用参数在当前实验条件下完全可行。；创新点：提出利用双音驱动超导量子比特而非传统腔场中介的方式，实现两个宏观YIG球体中磁振子模式之间的纠缠，并给出了完全基于现有实验参数的可行性论证。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与参数分析。具体包括：基于腔-磁振子-超导量子比特耦合系统的哈密顿量建模，采用双音驱动场调控量子比特，并设计纠缠验证的探测方案。

papers.title: Elastic and structural anisotropy in silica thin films for gravitational-wave detectors
papers.abstract: The thermal noise of mirror coatings for gravitational-wave detectors critically depends on the elastic properties of the constituent materials. Data analyses and theoretical models typically assume each material is homogeneous and isotropic, but isotropy has never been explicitly verified. Using Brillouin light scattering (BLS), we demonstrate for the first time that ion-beam-sputtered SiO2 -- a material still viable for future mirror coatings -- exhibits cylindrical elastic symmetry, with in-plane isotropy but a notable 6% compressive anisotropy along the film normal. This anisotropy remains unchanged after the post-deposition heat treatment currently used in ground-based detectors (500 $^\circ$C, 10 h) but is nearly eliminated at 900 $^\circ$C. Infrared reflectivity experiments support these findings by directly revealing heterogeneities in the distribution of bridging and non-bridging oxygen structures along the growth axis. While BLS measures the real part of the elastic constants at GHz frequencies, the data reveal negligible contributions from mechanical relaxations in the kHz-GHz range, making BLS a valid substitute for low-frequency properties obtained from standard anisotropy-insensitive techniques. Our results highlight that restoring isotropy through heat treatment -- by softening the material, enabling more than 7% out-of-plane expansion, and smoothing out structural heterogeneities -- may play a key role in reducing thermal noise. This proof-of-concept study extends beyond silica, providing critical insights for the design of future coatings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：Brillouin light scattering (BLS)、Infrared reflectivity experiments。；研究对象：离子束溅射沉积的二氧化硅（SiO₂）薄膜，用于引力波探测器的反射镜涂层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次实验证实离子束溅射的SiO₂薄膜具有圆柱弹性对称性，即面内各向同性但沿膜法线方向存在约6%的压缩各向异性；这种各向异性在500°C热处理后不变，但在900°C热处理后几乎消除。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次实验证实离子束溅射的SiO₂薄膜具有圆柱弹性对称性，即面内各向同性但沿膜法线方向存在约6%的压缩各向异性；这种各向异性在500°C热处理后不变，但在900°C热处理后几乎消除。；创新点：首次直接验证了引力波探测器涂层材料（SiO₂）的弹性各向异性，并证明BLS可替代传统各向异性不敏感的低频测量技术；同时提出通过高温热处理恢复各向同性（伴随超过7%的面外膨胀和结构不均匀性消除）可能是降低热噪声的关键途径。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用布里渊光散射（BLS）测量弹性常数（GHz频率下的实部），并结合红外反射光谱揭示沿生长轴的桥氧与非桥氧结构分布的不均匀性。

papers.title: Two-mode geometry controls multiscale organization in bipartite systems
papers.abstract: Many complex systems are organized around complementary roles and naturally described as bipartite networks. Unveiling their multiscale structure presents a fundamental challenge because coarse-graining procedures must preserve role separation, whereas standard approaches collapse it via one-mode projections. Here we introduce a Laplacian-based renormalization framework that operates directly on the bipartite architecture, enabling scale transformations while retaining role differentiation. Using controlled bipartite ensembles at criticality, we show that structural imbalance systematically reshapes organization across scales while leaving scaling properties invariant, revealing a separation between universality and geometry. Applying the coarse-graining framework to empirical bipartite networks, we uncover nontrivial multiscale hierarchies for both roles. In contrast, renormalization performed after one-mode projection -- which truncates diffusion paths to nearest neighbors -- yields qualitatively different structures. Our results identify two-mode geometry as a fundamental constraint for revealing multiscale organization in systems with role separation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Laplacian-based renormalization framework、bipartite networks、coarse-graining。；研究对象：二分网络（bipartite systems）中的多尺度组织结构，特别是具有角色分离（role separation）的复杂系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二分网络中，结构不平衡（structural imbalance）会系统性地重塑跨尺度的组织方式，但保持标度性质不变，揭示了普适性与几何结构之间的分离；而传统的一模投影（one-mode projection）方法会截断扩散路径，导致定性不同的结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二分网络中，结构不平衡（structural imbalance）会系统性地重塑跨尺度的组织方式，但保持标度性质不变，揭示了普适性与几何结构之间的分离；而传统的一模投影（one-mode projection）方法会截断扩散路径，导致定性不同的结构。；创新点：提出了一种直接保留二分网络角色分离特性的粗粒化重整化方法，避免了传统一模投影方法对多尺度结构的破坏，并揭示了“双模几何”（two-mode geometry）作为揭示角色分离系统中多尺度组织的基本约束条件。
papers.method_zh: 基于拉普拉斯算子的重整化框架（Laplacian-based renormalization framework），直接作用于二分网络架构，实现尺度变换同时保留角色区分。使用临界状态下的受控二分系综（controlled bipartite ensembles at criticality）进行理论分析，并应用于经验二分网络。

papers.title: Local droplet etching-assisted quantum dot epitaxy for telecom C-band quantum light emitters
papers.abstract: Significant progress in quantum light sources for quantum communication applications requires reproducible and symmetric quantum emitters acting as single-photon sources capable of generating entangled photons on demand at specific telecom wavelengths. Here, we propose telecom-emitting epitaxial quantum dots (QDs) fabricated using the local droplet etching (LDE) approach. The resulting well-defined, low-density ($10^9$/cm$^2$) QDs based on In$_{x}$Ga$_{1-x}$As are formed in symmetric LDE nanoholes (in-plane aspect ratio of 1.14) in In$_{0.52}$Al$_{0.48}$As. Detailed transmission electron microscopy provides comprehensive insight into the structural integrity, interface quality, and compositional profiles of the QDs, which underpin their promising optical properties. Photoluminescence spectroscopy reveals narrow emission lines (0.2 meV) and high optical quality, while second-order autocorrelation measurements confirm clear single-photon emission, with $g^{(2)}(0)=0.07\pm0.02$ under above-band continuous-wave excitation and $g^{(2)}(0)=0.16 \pm 0.18$ under pulsed excitation. Precise numerical modeling, combining multiband $\boldsymbol{k} \cdot \boldsymbol{p}$ and configuration-interaction methods, supports the optical characterization and identifies thermal excitation pathways that explain the persistence of emission up to liquid-nitrogen temperatures. These results highlight the versatility of the LDE approach for integrating new material systems and pave the way toward scalable fabrication of quantum light sources with tailored emission properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算）。判断依据：关键词“fabricated”、“transmission electron microscopy”、“Photoluminescence spectroscopy”、“second-order autocorrelation measurements”表明主要工作是实验制备与表征；同时包含“Precise numerical modeling, combining multiband k·p and configuration-interaction methods”，表明有理论计算支持。；研究对象：基于InGaAs的量子点，具体为通过局部液滴刻蚀（LDE）方法在InAlAs势垒层中制备的、发射波长在电信C波段的单光子发射器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用局部液滴刻蚀（LDE）方法成功制备了低密度、结构对称的InGaAs量子点，该量子点展现出极窄的发射线宽（0.2 meV）和优异的单光子发射特性（g²(0)低至0.07），其发射波长覆盖电信C波段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用局部液滴刻蚀（LDE）方法成功制备了低密度、结构对称的InGaAs量子点，该量子点展现出极窄的发射线宽（0.2 meV）和优异的单光子发射特性（g²(0)低至0.07），其发射波长覆盖电信C波段。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，创新点在于将LDE方法应用于InAlAs材料体系，成功制备出性能优异的电信C波段单光子发射器，展示了该方法在集成新型材料系统和可扩展制备量子光源方面的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验制备**：采用局部液滴刻蚀（LDE）方法在In₀.₅₂Al₀.₄₈As材料中形成对称的纳米孔洞，并在其中生长InₓGa₁₋ₓAs量子点。

papers.title: Pontus-Mpemba effect in cavity quantum electrodynamics
papers.abstract: The quantum Pontus-Mpemba effect is a counterintuitive phenomenon in which a quantum system relaxes faster through a two-step evolution protocol than through a single, unquenched relaxation. This work proposes its realization in cavity quantum electrodynamics using the Jaynes-Cummings model with photon loss. The model captures the coherent interaction between a two-level atom and a single quantized mode of a lossy cavity, providing a minimal yet realistic setting to explore dissipative quantum dynamics. Restricting the analysis to the single-excitation sector, the dynamics feature damped vacuum Rabi oscillations for weak dissipation that transition to near-exponential atomic decay under strong dissipation. A sudden quench of the cavity decay rate generates distinct relaxation trajectories from the same initial atom-cavity state. The atomic excitation then displays a non-monotonic, accelerated decay, where a trajectory with a quenched dissipation relaxes faster than fixed-loss evolution. The effect originates from the interplay between coherent atom-photon exchange and cavity dissipation, establishing a clear and experimentally accessible realization of the quantum Pontus-Mpemba effect in both optical and circuit QED platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：proposes its realization、model captures、restricting the analysis、the dynamics feature）；研究对象：腔量子电动力学（cavity quantum electrodynamics）中的量子Pontus-Mpemba效应，具体采用Jaynes-Cummings模型描述二能级原子与单模损耗腔的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过突然改变腔的衰减率（quench），从同一初始原子-腔态出发的演化轨迹中，原子激发态展现出非单调的加速衰减，即经历淬火耗散的轨迹比固定耗散的轨迹更快弛豫，实现了量子Pontus-Mpemba效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过突然改变腔的衰减率（quench），从同一初始原子-腔态出发的演化轨迹中，原子激发态展现出非单调的加速衰减，即经历淬火耗散的轨迹比固定耗散的轨迹更快弛豫，实现了量子Pontus-Mpemba效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于Jaynes-Cummings模型并引入光子损耗，将分析限制在单激发子空间，研究弱耗散下的阻尼真空拉比振荡和强耗散下的近指数原子衰减，并通过突然改变腔衰减率来比较不同弛豫轨迹。

papers.title: Density diversity in training data governs thermodynamic transferability of machine learning interatomic potentials
papers.abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) offer first-principles accuracy with reduced computational cost, but their transferability across different thermodynamic states remains questionable, particularly for fluid systems where molecules experience local environments far from crystalline equilibrium. Here, we demonstrate that diversifying the density of training configurations, rather than temperature, is the most effective strategy for building thermodynamically transferable MLIPs within a fixed computational budget. We first show that foundation MLIPs trained on solid-state databases accurately describe liquid-like densities but fail at gas-like conditions, while molecular-database-trained models exhibit the opposite behavior. Controlled from-scratch training and distillation experiments confirm that density-diverse datasets resolve both failure modes, whereas temperature-diverse datasets cannot compensate for missing density regimes. Coordination number analysis reveals the physical origin of this behavior: local coordination topology is more susceptible to density than temperature, leading to further structural diversity. These results establish density diversity as a design principle for thermodynamically transferable MLIPs and provide a validation framework for assessing the thermodynamic coverage of both foundation and from-scratch models, enabling reliable atomistic simulation of fluid-phase processes across diverse operating conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)、training、distillation experiments、coordination number analysis。；研究对象：机器学习原子间势（MLIP）在流体系统（包括液体和气体状态）中的热力学可迁移性，具体关注训练数据密度多样性对模型性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在固定计算预算下，训练配置的密度多样性（而非温度多样性）是构建热力学可迁移MLIP的最有效策略；密度缺失会导致模型在特定热力学状态下失效，而温度多样性无法弥补这一缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在固定计算预算下，训练配置的密度多样性（而非温度多样性）是构建热力学可迁移MLIP的最有效策略；密度缺失会导致模型在特定热力学状态下失效，而温度多样性无法弥补这一缺陷。；创新点：明确提出“密度多样性”作为热力学可迁移MLIP的设计原则，并建立评估基础模型和从头模型热力学覆盖范围的验证框架。摘要未突出说明与已有迁移性研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 使用基础MLIP（基于固态数据库或分子数据库训练）进行性能测试；进行从头训练（from-scratch training）和蒸馏实验（distillation experiments）；通过配位数分析（coordination number analysis）揭示物理机制。

papers.title: Dynamical Signatures of Floquet Topology in Wave Packet Dynamics
papers.abstract: Periodically driven quantum systems, known as Floquet systems, provide a versatile platform for engineering novel topological phases absent in static settings. However, dynamically characterizing these non-equilibrium topological invariants remains a challenge. Here, we develop a Floquet perturbation theory in the extended Hilbert space to analytically describe the center-of-mass (CoM) dynamics of a wave packet. When applied to the driven Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, our theory reveals that the CoM exhibits multi-frequency Zitterbewegung oscillations, whose spectral composition and phase are directly tied to the system's Floquet band structure. Crucially, we find that band inversions at topological phase transitions imprint distinct signatures in the CoM dynamics, including the emergence of low-frequency modes and phase shifts of the oscillatory trajectory. These dynamical signatures offer a practical protocol for detecting Floquet topological invariants, which we demonstrate for both high-frequency and strongly driven regimes. Our work establishes CoM dynamics as a simple and experimentally accessible probe for exploring topological phase transitions in Floquet systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“develop a Floquet perturbation theory”、“analytically describe”、“our theory reveals”。；研究对象：Floquet系统中的波包动力学，具体以驱动Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 波包质心（CoM）的多频率Zitterbewegung振荡的频谱成分和相位直接关联于Floquet能带结构；拓扑相变处的能带反转会在质心动力学中留下独特特征，包括低频模式的出现和振荡轨迹的相移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：波包质心（CoM）的多频率Zitterbewegung振荡的频谱成分和相位直接关联于Floquet能带结构；拓扑相变处的能带反转会在质心动力学中留下独特特征，包括低频模式的出现和振荡轨迹的相移。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 在扩展希尔伯特空间中发展了Floquet微扰理论，用于解析描述波包质心动力学，并应用于驱动SSH模型。

papers.title: Temporal Coarse-Graining as the Origin of Macroscopic Friction in Quantum Spin Chains via Data-Driven Liouvillian Extraction
papers.abstract: Understanding the emergence of macroscopic irreversible hydrodynamics from the reversible unitary dynamics of isolated quantum many-body systems remains a fundamental challenge. Conventional approaches often force spin density dynamics into purely diffusive models, obscuring the microscopic interplay of pressure, spin current, and local friction. Furthermore, reconciling true irreversibility with strictly unitary evolution raises profound questions about the role of the observer's temporal resolution. In this paper, we introduce a fully data-driven framework based on generalized Extended Dynamic Mode Decomposition (gEDMD) integrated with the Mori-Zwanzig projection. By expanding the observable dictionary to explicitly include spin currents, we directly extract the Navier-Stokes hydrodynamic coefficients from a chaotic XXZ spin chain across varying temporal coarse-graining scales. Our unconstrained extraction reveals a profound physical dichotomy: the mechanical elasticity ($c^2$) is intrinsically derived from the exact unitary dynamics, preserving strict microscopic reversibility. In stark contrast, the macroscopic friction ($γ$) and kinematic viscosity ($ν$) exhibit zero net dissipation, oscillating rapidly around zero in the exact-derivative limit. We demonstrate that genuine macroscopic transport cannot be established without finite temporal coarse-graining. By introducing a finite observation timescale ($Δt_{\rm cg} > 0$), the system passes through a distinct crossover timescale where these reversible fluctuations average out, establishing an intermediate functional regime that yields strictly positive friction and viscosity. Our results clearly demonstrate that macroscopic friction in isolated quantum systems is not an absolute property, but fundamentally an emergent phenomenon dictated by the temporal resolution of the observer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：data-driven framework、generalized Extended Dynamic Mode Decomposition (gEDMD)、Mori-Zwanzig projection、理论推导。；研究对象：孤立量子多体系统中的宏观摩擦现象，具体以混沌XXZ自旋链为模型体系，研究其从可逆幺正动力学到不可逆宏观输运的涌现机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 宏观摩擦并非孤立量子系统的固有属性，而是依赖于观测者时间粗粒化分辨率的涌现现象：在精确导数极限下摩擦系数和粘滞系数围绕零快速振荡，仅当引入有限观测时间尺度（Δt_cg > 0）后，这些可逆涨落被平均掉，才产生严格正的摩擦和粘滞系数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：宏观摩擦并非孤立量子系统的固有属性，而是依赖于观测者时间粗粒化分辨率的涌现现象：在精确导数极限下摩擦系数和粘滞系数围绕零快速振荡，仅当引入有限观测时间尺度（Δt_cg > 0）后，这些可逆涨落被平均掉，才产生严格正的摩擦和粘滞系数。；创新点：首次通过无约束的数据驱动提取，揭示了力学弹性（c²）源于严格可逆的幺正动力学，而宏观摩擦（γ）和粘滞（ν）在精确导数极限下净耗散为零，从而明确论证了时间粗粒化是孤立量子系统中宏观不可逆输运建立的必要前提。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于广义扩展动态模式分解（gEDMD）与Mori-Zwanzig投影相结合的全数据驱动框架，通过扩展可观测量字典显式包含自旋流，直接从混沌XXZ自旋链中提取不同时间粗粒化尺度下的Navier-Stokes流体动力学系数（弹性系数c²、摩擦系数γ、运动粘滞系数ν）。

papers.title: A renormalization-group inspired lattice-based framework for piecewise generalized linear models
papers.abstract: We formally introduce a class of models inspired by renormalization group (RG) theory, built on additive hierarchical expansions analogous to those appearing in functional ANOVA and mixed-effects models. Like ReLU convolutional neural networks, they are almost everywhere locally linear; unlike ReLU networks, their partition structure is explicit, interpretable, and easy to modify or constrain. In these models, one defines a multidimensional lattice partition of the input space and uses it to scaffold variations in regression parameters. Each dimension of the lattice corresponds to an attribute by which the statistics of the problem may vary. The parameters are themselves expressed in the form of an expansion, where each term captures variations relative to a lower (coarser) interaction scale. These models admit multiple equivalent interpretations: as piecewise GLMs, as hierarchical mixed-effects regressions, or as regression trees with structured parameter sharing. Since RG motivates the design of these models, we use techniques from statistical physics -- specifically replica analysis -- to study their generalization properties. Specifically, we analyze the behavior of the Watanabe-Akaike Information Criterion (WAIC) as a proxy for generalization loss. This analysis yields two practical results: (i) guidance on the lattice design as a function of dataset size and predictor dimensionality; and (ii) a principled scaling law for the regularization prior when adding higher-order terms to the expansion so that one can increase model complexity without an expected increase in generalization loss. We evaluate the methodology on public datasets and find performance competitive against both blackbox methods and other intrinsically interpretable approaches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：renormalization group theory, replica analysis, statistical physics techniques）；研究对象：基于重正化群启发的格子框架，用于分段广义线性模型（piecewise GLMs）的统计学习与回归问题，属于统计物理与机器学习交叉领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过复制分析（replica analysis）研究了Watanabe-Akaike信息准则（WAIC）作为泛化损失代理的行为，得到了两个实用结果：一是根据数据集大小和预测变量维度指导格子设计；二是为添加高阶项时提供正则化先验的标度律，使得增加模型复杂度不会预期增加泛化损失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过复制分析（replica analysis）研究了Watanabe-Akaike信息准则（WAIC）作为泛化损失代理的行为，得到了两个实用结果：一是根据数据集大小和预测变量维度指导格子设计；二是为添加高阶项时提供正则化先验的标度律，使得增加模型复杂度不会预期增加泛化损失。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：重正化群（RG）启发的加性层次展开模型（类似功能ANOVA和混合效应模型）；分析工具：统计物理中的复制分析（replica analysis）研究泛化性质；验证手段：在公开数据集上评估，与黑箱方法及其他可解释方法对比。

papers.title: Parameter estimation for kappa distributions using the EM algorithm in the superstatistical framework
papers.abstract: Kappa distributions are widely used in space plasma physics to model velocity distribution functions with extended tails. However, parameter estimation in these distributions presents a fundamental challenge: the kappa distribution does not belong to the exponential family, which prevents the direct application of analytically tractable maximum likelihood methods. In this work we propose a solution to this problem based on data augmentation: we introduce the inverse temperature $β$ as a gamma-distributed latent variable, thereby recovering the exponential family structure in the complete-data likelihood. This enables an implementation of the expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm in analytically closed form, with E-step and M-step derived from sufficient statistics. Our approach is agnostic with respect to the underlying physical mechanism generating fluctuations of $β$, which is a central aspect of the Beck-Cohen superstatistics framework, allowing a statistically rigorous treatment without compromising physical interpretability. We demonstrate that the method converges to the usual maximum likelihood estimators by applying it to synthetic data. Our results suggest that EM offers a computationally efficient and conceptually clear alternative for inference in superstatistical systems with temperature fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。判断依据：提出基于EM算法的参数估计方法，属于统计推断与数据分析框架，未涉及实验或具体材料计算。；研究对象：空间等离子体物理中具有扩展尾部的κ分布（kappa distribution）的参数估计问题，特别是超统计（superstatistical）框架下温度涨落系统的统计推断。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入逆温度β作为服从伽马分布的隐变量，将κ分布恢复为指数族结构，从而实现了期望最大化（EM）算法的解析闭式求解，为超统计系统中的参数估计提供了计算高效且概念清晰的替代方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入逆温度β作为服从伽马分布的隐变量，将κ分布恢复为指数族结构，从而实现了期望最大化（EM）算法的解析闭式求解，为超统计系统中的参数估计提供了计算高效且概念清晰的替代方案。；创新点：首次将EM算法应用于κ分布参数估计，解决了其不属于指数族而无法直接使用最大似然方法的根本困难，同时保持了与超统计框架的物理可解释性。
papers.method_zh: 基于数据增广的期望最大化（EM）算法：将逆温度β作为隐变量，利用完整数据似然的指数族结构，推导出具有充分统计量的E步和M步解析表达式。该方法与Beck-Cohen超统计框架兼容，不依赖β涨落的特定物理机制。

papers.title: Signature structure of quadratic response under Zeno-Schur coarse graining in open quantum systems
papers.abstract: Quadratic response tensors arise naturally in quantum kinetic descriptions, such as the quantum linear Boltzmann equation (QLBE), where they encode the coupled structure of drift and fluctuations beyond simple positive-definite forms. Motivated by this class of systems, we investigate how such response structures are modified under monitoring-induced coarse graining. Within the Gorini--Kossakowski--Sudarshan--Lindblad (GKSL) framework and under time-scale separation, Zeno elimination of fast degrees of freedom generates a subtractive renormalization with Schur-complement structure. As a result, positive definiteness of the response tensor is not preserved: coupling between slow and rapidly damped sectors can induce negative directions even when the microscopic tensor is strictly positive. We formulate a minimal effective flow capturing this mechanism and show that the competition between Schur-induced compression and anisotropic perturbations organizes the dynamics into distinct signature sectors. The resulting structure appears to be robust within the class of models considered and, in appropriate regimes, may be experimentally accessible. Our results establish a general framework for how quadratic response structures, as encountered in QLBE-type dynamics, are dynamically reorganized under Zeno-induced coarse graining.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“investigate”“formulate”“establish a general framework”，属于理论分析，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：开放量子系统中的二次响应张量结构，特别是受Zeno-Schur粗粒化过程影响的响应行为。具体体系为量子线性玻尔兹曼方程（QLBE）类动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在GKSL框架下，通过Zeno消除快自由度产生的Schur补结构会导致二次响应张量的正定性被破坏：慢-快耦合可在微观张量严格正定时诱导出负方向，从而形成不同的符号特征扇区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在GKSL框架下，通过Zeno消除快自由度产生的Schur补结构会导致二次响应张量的正定性被破坏：慢-快耦合可在微观张量严格正定时诱导出负方向，从而形成不同的符号特征扇区。；创新点：揭示了Zeno粗粒化过程中二次响应张量正定性丧失的机制，并建立了Schur压缩与各向异性扰动竞争所导致的符号扇区结构，该结构在相关模型中具有鲁棒性且可能实验可观测。
papers.method_zh: 基于Gorini–Kossakowski–Sudarshan–Lindblad（GKSL）主方程框架，采用时间尺度分离下的Zeno消除方法，结合Schur补结构进行减除重整化，并构建最小有效流模型分析动力学。

papers.title: Frustrated Dynamics of Distance Matrices
papers.abstract: We introduce the Frustrated Distance Matrix (FDM) model, a dynamic extension of the static distance-matrix ensemble on S^2 analyzed by Bogomolny, Bohigas, and Schmit (BBS). Its entries are pairwise geodesic distances between N Brownian particles on the sphere evolving under quenched random pairwise couplings linear in those distances. Where the static BBS theory recovers geometric information about the underlying manifold from spectra of distance matrices on i.i.d.\ samples, the time-resolved FDM spectrum carries information about structural changes of the underlying point process. The particle dynamics realize one such change: a fast collapse from a uniform configuration onto a one-dimensional ring, followed by slow rotational drift of the ring orientation; the particle-level picture provides the ground truth against which spectral diagnostics are calibrated. We find that the static BBS template is preserved at every time, with the dynamics entering as a redistribution of spectral mass within that template, sharp enough to flag ring formation. We propose self-averaging of the bulk density as the mechanism behind this preservation, verified by an i.i.d.-resample comparison, and extract a small set of spectral diagnostics of the structural change computable from the distance matrix alone. We suggest that our diagnostics can be applied in other similar inverse-problem settings: financial correlation matrices, graph and network adjacency spectra, similarity matrices in molecular dynamics, and dynamics on parameter manifolds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce model、dynamic extension、theoretical framework、spectral diagnostics。；研究对象：Frustrated Distance Matrix (FDM) 模型，即球面上布朗粒子间受挫动力学下的距离矩阵动态演化，以及由此产生的点过程结构变化（从均匀分布坍缩为一维环）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 静态BBS距离矩阵谱模板在每一时刻均被保留，动力学仅表现为谱质量在该模板内的重新分布，且这种重新分布足够尖锐以标记环结构的形成。体密度的自平均效应是谱模板得以保持的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：静态BBS距离矩阵谱模板在每一时刻均被保留，动力学仅表现为谱质量在该模板内的重新分布，且这种重新分布足够尖锐以标记环结构的形成。体密度的自平均效应是谱模板得以保持的机制。；创新点：将静态距离矩阵系综（BBS理论）动态化，提出FDM模型，并揭示动力学如何通过谱质量重分布而非谱形改变来编码点过程的结构变化。摘要未突出说明与已有动态谱方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟。具体包括：在S^2上引入N个布朗粒子，其成对测地距离受淬火随机耦合（与距离线性相关）驱动演化；通过对比i.i.d.重采样验证自平均机制；从距离矩阵本身提取少量谱诊断量。

papers.title: Perturbative, Nonperturbative and Exact Aspects of Crystalline Phases in the Gross-Neveu Model
papers.abstract: We study the crystalline phase of the $O(2N)$ Gross--Neveu model with a chemical potential for $a \leq N-2$ of the fermions. We analyze the problem in three independent ways: using perturbative QFT methods, a semiclassical large $N$ analysis, and integrability techniques (both at finite and large $N$). The resulting picture is consistent across all three approaches: at sufficiently large chemical potential $h$, an inhomogeneous phase emerges in which $a$-particle bound states condense and which, at large $N$, corresponds to a periodically oscillating chiral condensate. In this phase, the usual dynamically generated scale $Λ$ is replaced by two new dynamically generated scales $Λ_{\rm n}$ and $Λ_{\rm c}$. These two scales govern the multiple nonperturbative effects in the theory, corresponding in particular to the mass gaps of neutral and charged excitations on top of the inhomogeneous vacuum, respectively. They also control the nonperturbative corrections to observables such as the free energy and provide the parameters characterizing the oscillatory profile of the mean field at large $N$. In this paper, we provide the necessary details of each of the three methods, thereby complementing the results announced in a previous, shorter publication.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到使用“perturbative QFT methods”、“semiclassical large N analysis”和“integrability techniques”三种理论方法，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：O(2N) Gross-Neveu模型中的晶相（crystalline phase），具体研究在化学势作用下、费米子数为a ≤ N-2时的非均匀相（inhomogeneous phase）及其物理性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在足够大的化学势h下，该模型出现非均匀相，其中a粒子束缚态凝聚，并在大N极限下对应周期性振荡的手征凝聚体。该相中，通常的动态生成标度Λ被两个新标度Λ_n和Λ_c取代，分别控制中性激发和带电激发的质量间隙，以及自由能等可观测量的非微扰修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在足够大的化学势h下，该模型出现非均匀相，其中a粒子束缚态凝聚，并在大N极限下对应周期性振荡的手征凝聚体。该相中，通常的动态生成标度Λ被两个新标度Λ_n和Λ_c取代，分别控制中性激发和带电激发的质量间隙，以及自由能等可观测量的非微扰修正。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体创新点，但指出本文提供了三种方法的必要细节，补充了先前较短发表物中宣布的结果。
papers.method_zh: 采用三种独立理论方法：1）微扰量子场论方法；2）半经典大N分析；3）可积性技术（包括有限N和大N情形）。三种方法得到一致结果。

papers.title: Universal Neural Propagator: Learning Time Evolution in Many-Body Quantum Systems
papers.abstract: Conventional approaches to simulating quantum many-body dynamics produce a single trajectory: if the Hamiltonian or the initial state is changed, the computation must be re-performed. Recent efforts toward foundation models have begun to address this limitation, yet existing methods transfer across either Hamiltonians or initial states, but not both. In this work, we introduce the Universal Neural Propagator (UNP), a single, unified model that learns the functional mapping from driving protocols to time-evolution propagators. Trained in an entirely self-supervised way, a single UNP model predicts dynamics across a function space of driving protocols and an exponentially large Hilbert space of initial states simultaneously. We benchmark on a two-dimensional driven Ising model and demonstrate the UNP's accuracy and transferability across product and entangled initial states, as well as for both in- and out-of-distribution driving protocols. The UNP remains accurate at system sizes beyond exact diagonalization, and can be efficiently fine-tuned across all initial states using observable data. By shifting the object of learning from quantum states to operators, this work opens a route toward transferable simulation of driven quantum matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：functional mapping、self-supervised、learning operators。；研究对象：多体量子系统的时间演化，具体以二维驱动伊辛模型（two-dimensional driven Ising model）为基准测试体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种名为“通用神经传播子”（Universal Neural Propagator, UNP）的统一模型，能够同时学习不同驱动协议和不同初始态（包括乘积态和纠缠态）下的时间演化传播子，并在超出精确对角化能力的系统尺寸上保持准确性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种名为“通用神经传播子”（Universal Neural Propagator, UNP）的统一模型，能够同时学习不同驱动协议和不同初始态（包括乘积态和纠缠态）下的时间演化传播子，并在超出精确对角化能力的系统尺寸上保持准确性。；创新点：已有基础模型要么只能迁移到不同哈密顿量，要么只能迁移到不同初始态，而UNP首次实现了同时跨驱动协议和跨指数大希尔伯特空间初始态的迁移学习。此外，该工作将学习对象从量子态（quantum states）转变为算符（operators），为驱动量子物质的可迁移模拟开辟了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用完全自监督学习（self-supervised）的方式训练神经网络，学习从驱动协议（driving protocols）到时间演化传播子（time-evolution propagators）的函数映射。模型通过可观测数据（observable data）进行高效微调。

papers.title: Systematic construction of quantum many-body scars in frustrated Rydberg arrays
papers.abstract: Quantum many-body scars in Rydberg atom arrays have thus far only been observed on bipartite lattices, leaving open the question of whether and how they survive frustration, and what the appropriate initial states are that lead to nonthermal dynamics. We introduce a graph-theoretic framework to find suitable candidates for scarring on arbitrary lattices. Our framework predicts two distinct mechanisms: type-I scars generalize the bipartite case by using locally entangled states to overcome mild frustration, while type-II scars exploit strong frustration to pin part of the lattice, leaving the remainder to oscillate freely. We numerically demonstrate both mechanisms and uncover an exponential family of scarred trajectories on the hexagonal lattice that can encode information protected from thermalization. Our results establish scarring as a generic feature of Rydberg systems beyond one dimension and provide an experimentally accessible route to systematically probing non-thermal dynamics in quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。关键词：graph-theoretic framework、numerically demonstrate。；研究对象：Rydberg原子阵列中的量子多体疤痕（quantum many-body scars）在阻挫晶格上的存在性与构造方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个图论框架，在任意晶格上系统构造量子多体疤痕，揭示了两种不同机制：I型疤痕通过局域纠缠态克服轻度阻挫，II型疤痕利用强阻挫钉扎部分晶格使剩余部分自由振荡。在六角晶格上发现指数级数量的疤痕轨迹，可编码免受热化的信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个图论框架，在任意晶格上系统构造量子多体疤痕，揭示了两种不同机制：I型疤痕通过局域纠缠态克服轻度阻挫，II型疤痕利用强阻挫钉扎部分晶格使剩余部分自由振荡。在六角晶格上发现指数级数量的疤痕轨迹，可编码免受热化的信息。；创新点：首次将量子多体疤痕从二分晶格推广到任意阻挫晶格，并系统分类了两种疤痕机制，揭示了六角晶格上指数级疤痕轨迹的存在。
papers.method_zh: 图论框架（graph-theoretic framework）用于寻找疤痕候选态；数值模拟验证两种疤痕机制。

papers.title: Enhancing Cryo-EM Density Map Segmentation in Phenix for Improved Atomic Model Building
papers.abstract: We introduce PhenixCraft, a fully automated pipeline for building atomic models from cryo-EM density maps. By integrating AlphaFold predictions, we enhance the map-segmentation step in Phenix during model building, addressing challenges posed by noise and artifacts that traditionally hinder this step. Our results demonstrate PhenixCraft's superior performance in TM-scores and sequence accuracy, significantly improving upon the limitations and inefficiencies of traditional model building using Phenix.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法文章。关键词：fully automated pipeline、integrating AlphaFold predictions、map-segmentation step。；研究对象：冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）密度图，具体为从密度图中构建原子模型的过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过整合AlphaFold预测，PhenixCraft在模型构建中显著提升了地图分割步骤的性能，在TM-score和序列准确性上优于传统方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过整合AlphaFold预测，PhenixCraft在模型构建中显著提升了地图分割步骤的性能，在TM-score和序列准确性上优于传统方法。；创新点：针对传统Phenix模型构建中噪声和伪影导致的地图分割困难，提出利用AlphaFold预测来增强分割步骤，实现全自动且更准确的原子模型构建。
papers.method_zh: 全自动流水线PhenixCraft，集成AlphaFold预测以增强Phenix软件中的地图分割步骤，用于从冷冻电镜密度图构建原子模型。

papers.title: Concurrence of Symmetry Breaking and Nonlocality Phase Transitions in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Diffusion models undergo a phase transition in a critical time window during generation dynamics, with two complementary diagnoses of criticality. The symmetry breaking picture views the critical window as when trajectories bifurcate into different semantic minima of the energy landscape, whereas the nonlocality picture views the critical window as when local denoising fails. We study whether two notions of such phase transitions are concurrent in modern diffusion transformers. By evaluating the dynamics and outcomes of the generation trajectory, we observe a near-simultaneous occurrence of the non-locality and symmetry breaking critical times. Our work is the first to unify the two notions of phase transitions in practice: it provides a concrete diagnostic for when and why diffusion models rely on conditioning and global denoising, enabling principled evaluation of model efficiency and guiding the design of architectures and sampling schemes that avoid unnecessary computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算分析）。判断依据：摘要提到“evaluating the dynamics and outcomes of the generation trajectory”，涉及对生成轨迹的动力学评估，属于理论建模与数值分析，未提及具体实验手段。；研究对象：扩散模型（diffusion models）在生成动力学过程中发生的相变现象，具体关注对称性破缺（symmetry breaking）与非局域性（nonlocality）两种相变诊断的并发性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在现代扩散变换器（diffusion transformers）中，非局域性相变与对称性破缺相变的临界时间几乎同时发生，首次在实践上统一了这两种相变概念。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在现代扩散变换器（diffusion transformers）中，非局域性相变与对称性破缺相变的临界时间几乎同时发生，首次在实践上统一了这两种相变概念。；创新点：首次在实践上统一了扩散模型中对称性破缺与非局域性两种相变概念，提供了判断扩散模型何时及为何依赖条件化与全局去噪的具体诊断方法，为模型效率评估和架构设计提供指导。
papers.method_zh: 通过评估生成轨迹的动力学过程与最终输出结果，分析对称性破缺与非局域性两种临界时间的时序关系。具体方法包括对生成轨迹的动力学诊断和结果分析，但摘要未明确说明使用的具体数值或理论框架（如是否涉及能量景观分析、去噪过程建模等）。

papers.title: Mixed-Parity Altermagnetism in Collinear Spin-Orbital Magnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism has so far mainly been understood in its even- and odd-parity forms. We show that collinear antiferromagnets with zero net magnetization can also host mixed-parity spin splitting, namely neither purely even nor purely odd in momentum. We identify the symmetry conditions for such mixed-parity altermagnetism and show that, in two dimensions, it can arise in spin-orbital magnets when the two antiparallel spin sectors are related by a single mirror symmetry. Using a two-sublattice two-orbital model, we demonstrate that circularly polarized light induces mixed-parity altermagnetism at finite staggered potential and odd-parity spin-orbital altermagnetism at zero staggered potential. Mixed-parity altermagnetism thereby emerges as the intermediate spin-split regime between even- and odd-parity altermagnetism when spin splitting and zero net magnetization are maintained. Spin-resolved orbital Edelstein effects provide a complementary electrical probe of the underlying spin-orbital order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show”“We identify”“Using a model”“We demonstrate”等表述，属于理论推导和模型计算。；研究对象：共线自旋-轨道磁体中的混合宇称交变磁性（mixed-parity altermagnetism），具体为一种在动量空间中既非纯偶宇称也非纯奇宇称的自旋劈裂现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零净磁化的共线反铁磁体中，可以存在混合宇称的自旋劈裂（即既非纯偶宇称也非纯奇宇称），并揭示了其对称性条件；在二维情况下，当两个反平行自旋扇区由单一镜面对称性关联时，混合宇称交变磁性可在自旋-轨道磁体中产生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零净磁化的共线反铁磁体中，可以存在混合宇称的自旋劈裂（即既非纯偶宇称也非纯奇宇称），并揭示了其对称性条件；在二维情况下，当两个反平行自旋扇区由单一镜面对称性关联时，混合宇称交变磁性可在自旋-轨道磁体中产生。；创新点：首次提出并系统描述了混合宇称交变磁性这一介于偶宇称与奇宇称交变磁性之间的中间自旋劈裂机制，并指出自旋分辨的轨道Edelstein效应可作为探测底层自旋-轨道序的电学手段。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（识别混合宇称交变磁性的对称性条件）；构建双子格双轨道模型（two-sublattice two-orbital model）进行理论计算；通过圆偏振光诱导实现混合宇称交变磁性（有限交错势下）和奇宇称自旋-轨道交变磁性（零交错势下）。

papers.title: Field-induced asymmetric band flattening and ideal quantum geometry in rhombohedral graphene
papers.abstract: Rhombohedral graphene exhibits an exceptionally diverse array of correlated phases that depend sensitively on the displacement field. Compiling reported phases into a unified phase diagram reveals a pronounced field-dependent electron-hole asymmetry: correlated states on the hole-doped side emerge at small displacement fields, whereas the fractional quantum anomalous Hall effect (FQAHE) is observed exclusively on the electron-doped side under large displacement fields. This stark asymmetry highlights the need to understand how flat bands evolve with displacement fields. Here, we directly visualize the field-induced electron-hole asymmetric band flattening in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene (R5G) using nanospot angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy with electrostatic gating. Beyond gap opening and spectral weight redistribution indicative of layer polarization, the gating field drives a strongly asymmetric modification of the flat bands: the flat valence band (FVB) evolves into an M-shaped dispersion at high field, whereas the flat conduction band (FCB) progressively flattens with increasing field. Comparison with calculations identifies critical parameters governing the band curvature of R5G, from which the resulting finite Berry curvature and near-ideal quantum geometry support the emergence of topological phases under electron doping at large fields. These results establish a direct link between the asymmetric phase diagram, band structure evolution, and quantum geometry, providing a microscopic framework for understanding correlated and topological phases in rhombohedral graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：directly visualize, nanospot angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy with electrostatic gating）；研究对象：菱方堆叠五层石墨烯（R5G）中，由位移场诱导的能带结构演化及其与电子-空穴不对称相图、量子几何的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验直接观察到位移场在菱方五层石墨烯中诱导出电子-空穴不对称的能带展平效应：空穴掺杂侧的平价带在高场下演变为M形色散，而电子掺杂侧的平导带则随场增强而逐渐展平。这种不对称的能带演化与有限贝里曲率和近理想量子几何共同支持了电子掺杂侧在大位移场下拓扑相（如分数量子反常霍尔效应）的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验直接观察到位移场在菱方五层石墨烯中诱导出电子-空穴不对称的能带展平效应：空穴掺杂侧的平价带在高场下演变为M形色散，而电子掺杂侧的平导带则随场增强而逐渐展平。这种不对称的能带演化与有限贝里曲率和近理想量子几何共同支持了电子掺杂侧在大位移场下拓扑相（如分数量子反常霍尔效应）的出现。；创新点：首次通过直接实验观测，将菱方石墨烯中高度不对称的电子-空穴相图与位移场依赖的能带结构演化及量子几何特性直接关联起来，为理解该体系中关联和拓扑相的微观起源提供了实验框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用静电栅控纳米光斑角分辨光电子能谱（nanospot ARPES），并结合第一性原理计算进行对比分析。

papers.title: Frustrated magnetic order in hybrid Kitaev spin-orbital models
papers.abstract: Spin-orbital generalization of Kitaev model provides a robust extension to the original Kitaev model. However, real materials often exhibit competing interactions that break exact solvability which can give rise to new phases. Motivated by recent microscopic proposals of coexisting Yao-Lee and Kitaev couplings, we investigate the fate of the ground state when two independent exactly solvable spin liquid Hamiltonians each originally formulated on different lattice geometries are combined on a common lattice environment. We first focus on the hybrid Kitaev's honeycomb and square-lattice model. Using self-consistent mean-field analysis and perturbative calculation, we show that the strong-Kitaev regime yields magnetic order in the spin sector, while the orbital sector retains its topological order. We further analyze the hybridization of the Yao-Lee and square-lattice models and find that the model exhibits a rich evolution of Majorana Dirac bands and Lifshitz transitions. Remarkably, when the Yao-Lee and square-lattice couplings are equal and opposite, the model restores its exact solvability with a single itinerant Majorana flavor. These results demonstrate that hybrid spin liquid platforms may host various emergent phases beyond conventional exactly solvable limits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：self-consistent mean-field analysis, perturbative calculation（自洽平均场分析、微扰计算）。；研究对象：混合Kitaev自旋-轨道模型，具体研究将Kitaev六角晶格模型与Yao-Lee模型（或方晶格模型）耦合后的混合体系，探讨其基态相图与涌现的拓扑序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强Kitaev耦合区域，自旋部分出现磁有序，而轨道部分保持拓扑序；当Yao-Lee与方晶格耦合强度相等且符号相反时，模型恢复精确可解性，并产生单一游走Majorana费米子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强Kitaev耦合区域，自旋部分出现磁有序，而轨道部分保持拓扑序；当Yao-Lee与方晶格耦合强度相等且符号相反时，模型恢复精确可解性，并产生单一游走Majorana费米子。；创新点：首次系统研究了两个原本在不同晶格上独立精确可解的自旋液体哈密顿量在共同晶格环境中的混合效应，揭示了超越传统精确可解极限的丰富涌现相，并发现了恢复精确可解性的特殊耦合条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽平均场分析和微扰计算，分析混合Kitaev六角晶格与方晶格模型；进一步对Yao-Lee与方晶格模型的杂化进行能带分析，研究Majorana狄拉克带和Lifshitz相变。

papers.title: Singular Behavior of Observables at Hopf Bifurcations
papers.abstract: Hopf bifurcations are a universal route to self-sustained oscillations in driven systems. Despite the absence of any singular stationary state, we show that time-averaged observables generically exhibit singularities at the onset of oscillations. The origin of this behavior is geometric: phase averaging over the emergent periodic attractor eliminates odd powers of the oscillation amplitude, while the squared amplitude varies smoothly with the distance from the bifurcation. Consequently, the excess of any smooth time-averaged observable admits an integer-power expansion; observables remain finite but display discontinuities in finite-order derivatives. This yields an Ehrenfest-like hierarchy of Hopf singularities, in which the first nonanalytic derivative is determined by the lowest-order coupling between the observable and the limit-cycle waveform that survives phase averaging. Generic observables therefore exhibit kink singularities, while symmetry or geometric cancellations can suppress lower-order couplings and shift nonanalyticity to higher derivatives. We demonstrate this mechanism in chemical, electronic, and climate oscillators. Our results identify supercritical Hopf bifurcations as a universal mechanism for nonanalytic observable behavior, where singular features arise without any underlying singular stationary state. They thus provide a generic setting for singular behavior without divergence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：show、identify、demonstrate mechanism，无实验或计算细节描述）；研究对象：Hopf分岔（Hopf bifurcations）驱动的自持振荡系统中，时间平均可观测量（time-averaged observables）的奇异行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Hopf分岔点，尽管不存在任何奇异的稳态，时间平均可观测量仍普遍表现出奇异性（如导数不连续），其根源是相平均的几何效应，而非稳态的奇异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Hopf分岔点，尽管不存在任何奇异的稳态，时间平均可观测量仍普遍表现出奇异性（如导数不连续），其根源是相平均的几何效应，而非稳态的奇异性。；创新点：揭示了超临界Hopf分岔作为一种无需奇异稳态即可产生非解析可观测量行为的普适机制，将奇异行为与分岔动力学直接关联，而非依赖于传统稳态奇异性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过相平均（phase averaging）和振幅展开（amplitude expansion）推导出时间平均可观测量的整数幂级数展开，并建立类似Ehrenfest分级的奇异性层级；在化学、电子和气候振荡器三个实例中演示该机制。

papers.title: Dynamical correlations in a dissipative XXZ spin chain
papers.abstract: We study dynamical spin correlations in a dissipative XXZ spin chain subject to uniform local spin-loss and pumping. Starting from a mixed steady state that is featureless albeit possessing finite magnetization, rich dynamics emerges in time-dependent two-point correlators evaluated on top of it. For unitary evolution in which the reservoir is absent, the longitudinal correlators reproduce the established hierarchy of spin-transport universality classes - ballistic, Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) superdiffusive, and diffusive - across the phase diagram. However, for finite magnetization, additional ballistic light cone propagation gets superimposed on the previous universality classes, arising from magnon propagation.The transverse correlator displays very fast, exponential decay of correlations without wavefront propagation in the easy-plane case. At the isotropic point, it follows KPZ scaling due to $SU(2)$ symmetry, while in the easy-axis regime, it is characterized by ballistic spreading of correlations. Under full Lindbladian dynamics, the universality classes are preserved at early times, while the correlations acquire an overall exponential damping in the long-time limit. In terms of methods, we have used vectorized TEBD for numerical simulations and exact analytical results obtained via a Pfaffian representation and the third-quantization framework for the noninteracting XX case.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytical results、numerical simulations、vectorized TEBD、Pfaffian representation、third-quantization framework）；研究对象：耗散XXZ自旋链中的动力学自旋关联函数，具体研究在均匀局域自旋损耗和泵浦作用下的自旋输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限磁化强度下，纵向关联函数在无耗散时重现了弹道、KPZ超扩散和扩散三种输运普适类，但叠加了源于磁子传播的额外弹道光锥传播；横向关联函数在易平面区呈指数衰减，在易轴区呈弹道传播，在SU(2)对称的各向同性点则遵循KPZ标度。在完整林德布拉德动力学下，早期普适类保持不变，长时间极限下关联函数整体呈指数衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限磁化强度下，纵向关联函数在无耗散时重现了弹道、KPZ超扩散和扩散三种输运普适类，但叠加了源于磁子传播的额外弹道光锥传播；横向关联函数在易平面区呈指数衰减，在易轴区呈弹道传播，在SU(2)对称的各向同性点则遵循KPZ标度。在完整林德布拉德动力学下，早期普适类保持不变，长时间极限下关联函数整体呈指数衰减。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用矢量化TEBD（时间演化块消去）进行数值模拟，对无相互作用XX情况采用Pfaffian表示和第三量子化框架获得精确解析结果。

papers.title: Sculpting Spin-Wave Landscapes via Curvature of 2D Magnonic Crystals
papers.abstract: Engineering the dispersion relation is one of the key ingredients enabling the application of spin waves in computational elements. One way to engineer the spin-wave band structure is to create an artificial magnonic crystal, which can be used to design specific band gaps or dispersion branches. However, creating a two-dimensional magnonic crystal usually requires removing material, which dramatically decreases the decay lengths of spin waves. Here, we present a method to manipulate the demagnetizing field landscape by utilizing large-area curvilinear nanotemplates consisting of three-dimensional nanopyramids arranged in a square lattice with a period of 400 nm. In a 50-nm-thick Permalloy film grown on these curvilinear templates, we experimentally observe a complete in-plane band gap together with flat-band modes that exhibit strong real-space localization of the spin waves in the pyramid valleys. Micro-focused Brillouin light scattering measurements corroborate the numerically predicted dispersion and reveal the possibility of opening and closing this gap by varying the external magnetic field. Our results establish three-dimensional-templated continuous films as a versatile platform for two-dimensional signal processing and magnonic computing elements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimentally observe、Micro-focused Brillouin light scattering measurements、numerically predicted dispersion）；研究对象：基于三维纳米金字塔阵列（周期400 nm）的弯曲纳米模板上生长的50 nm厚坡莫合金薄膜中的自旋波（磁子）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维弯曲磁子晶体中实验观测到完整的平面内带隙以及平带模式，这些平带模式表现出自旋波在金字塔谷处的强实空间局域化，且该带隙可通过外加磁场调控开闭。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维弯曲磁子晶体中实验观测到完整的平面内带隙以及平带模式，这些平带模式表现出自旋波在金字塔谷处的强实空间局域化，且该带隙可通过外加磁场调控开闭。；创新点：提出通过三维弯曲纳米模板调控退磁场分布来工程化自旋波能带结构，避免了传统二维磁子晶体因去除材料导致自旋波衰减长度显著降低的问题，实现了连续薄膜中的完整带隙与平带局域模式。
papers.method_zh: 利用大面积弯曲纳米模板（三维纳米金字塔方阵）制备连续坡莫合金薄膜；采用微聚焦布里渊光散射（micro-focused Brillouin light scattering）实验测量自旋波色散，并结合数值模拟进行对比验证。

papers.title: Lattice Tadpoles
papers.abstract: We prove several rigorous results about the asymptotic behaviour of the numbers of tadpoles (or lassos) embedded in a lattice, including cases where the head is subject to a constraint like being unknotted, or where the tail pierces the surface spanned by the head.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：prove rigorous results（证明严格结果）、asymptotic behaviour（渐近行为）。；研究对象：嵌入在晶格中的“tadpoles”（或“lassos”）的计数问题。具体研究的是这类图结构在晶格中的数量渐近行为，并考虑了头部受约束（如不打结）或尾部穿透头部所张曲面等特殊情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文严格证明了晶格中“tadpoles”数量在渐近极限下的若干行为，包括头部受约束（如不打结）或尾部穿透头部所张曲面等情形下的计数规律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文严格证明了晶格中“tadpoles”数量在渐近极限下的若干行为，包括头部受约束（如不打结）或尾部穿透头部所张曲面等情形下的计数规律。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 该研究采用严格的数学证明方法，属于组合数学与统计力学中的图计数理论。具体框架涉及对晶格中嵌入的图结构（tadpoles）进行渐近分析。

papers.title: Kink-kink correlations in nonlinear quenches across a quantum critical point
papers.abstract: When a quantum system exhibiting a second order phase transition is quenched across the critical point in large but finite time, the dynamics are not adiabatic in the critical region and the Kibble-Zurek (KZ) mechanism provides a framework to determine local observables such as the mean defect density. However, to find higher-point functions, one has to go beyond the KZ paradigm asshown in recent works on one-dimensional transverse field Ising model (TFIM) following a linear quench. It has been found that (i) besides the KZ scale, the quench dynamics depend on another length scale that arises due to the finite phase difference between the low energy modes, and (ii) contrary to the expectations based on the KZ mechanism, in general, the correlation functions do not decay exponentially with distance. Motivated by these results for the linear quench, we are interested in understanding if these properties are universal, and consider the 1D TFIM when the transverse field varies algebraically in the vicinity of the critical field. We focus on the equal-time,longitudinal kink-kink correlation function at the end of the quench from the paramagnetic to the ferromagnetic phase, and find that (i) the correlator depends only on the KZ length for superlinear quenches, otherwise an additional dephasing length is required to describe it, and (ii) the dephased correlator decays as a compressed exponential with an exponent that changes continuously with the quench exponent. Our results are obtained using an adiabatic perturbation theory, analytical arguments and exact numerical integration of the relevant equations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：adiabatic perturbation theory、analytical arguments、exact numerical integration。；研究对象：一维横场伊辛模型（1D TFIM）在非线性淬火（横场在临界点附近代数变化）过程中的动力学，具体关注从顺磁相到铁磁相的淬火后等时纵向扭结-扭结关联函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于超线性淬火，扭结-扭结关联函数仅由Kibble-Zurek（KZ）长度决定；对于亚线性淬火，还需引入一个额外的退相位长度来描述。退相位后的关联函数呈压缩指数衰减，其指数随淬火指数连续变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于超线性淬火，扭结-扭结关联函数仅由Kibble-Zurek（KZ）长度决定；对于亚线性淬火，还需引入一个额外的退相位长度来描述。退相位后的关联函数呈压缩指数衰减，其指数随淬火指数连续变化。；创新点：将先前在线性淬火下发现的、超越KZ机制的关联函数行为（额外长度尺度、非指数衰减）推广到非线性淬火情形，揭示了这些性质是否具有普适性，并发现关联函数的衰减形式（压缩指数及其连续变化的指数）与淬火指数直接相关。
papers.method_zh: 采用绝热微扰理论、解析论证以及对相关运动方程进行精确数值积分。

papers.title: Building informative materials datasets beyond targeted objectives
papers.abstract: Materials science data collection can be expensive, making the reuse and long-term utility of datasets critical important for future discovery campaigns. In practice, researchers prioritize a subset of properties due to research interests. However, ignoring a subset of outcomes in data collection campaigns potentially generate datasets poorly suited for future learning tasks. Here, we present a framework for dataset construction that maximizes informativeness for target properties of interest while preserving performance on untargeted ones. Our approach uses diversity-aware selection to ensure broad coverage of the materials space. In noisy experimental dataset construction, we find that without our diversity-aware framework, prediction performance on untargeted properties can degrade by up to 40% relative to random sampling, whereas applying our framework yields improvements of up to 10% . For targeted properties, performance can degrade with respect to random sampling by up to 12.5% without diversity, while our framework achieves gains of up to 25%. Incorporating diversity into dataset construction not only preserves informativeness for the targeted properties, but also improves materials coverage for potential future objectives. As a result, the constructed datasets remain broadly informative across considered and unconsidered outcomes, ensuring unbiased quality entries and mitigating cold-start limitations in subsequent modeling and discovery campaigns.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论框架+实验数据分析）。关键词：framework for dataset construction、diversity-aware selection、noisy experimental dataset construction。；研究对象：材料科学数据集构建方法，不针对特定材料体系，而是研究如何构建具有广泛信息量的材料数据集。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在构建材料数据集时，若只关注目标性质而忽略非目标性质，会导致非目标性质的预测性能相比随机采样下降高达40%；而采用多样性感知的框架，可使目标性质预测性能提升高达25%，非目标性质提升高达10%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在构建材料数据集时，若只关注目标性质而忽略非目标性质，会导致非目标性质的预测性能相比随机采样下降高达40%；而采用多样性感知的框架，可使目标性质预测性能提升高达25%，非目标性质提升高达10%。；创新点：提出了一种在构建数据集时同时兼顾目标性质与非目标性质信息量的框架，解决了传统数据收集仅关注特定性质导致数据集对未来学习任务适应性差的问题。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种基于多样性感知选择（diversity-aware selection）的数据集构建框架，通过确保对材料空间的广泛覆盖来最大化数据集的信息量。研究基于含噪声的实验数据集构建场景，并与随机采样方法进行性能对比。

papers.title: Microscopic evidence for imaginary charge density wave in a kagome metal
papers.abstract: Dissipationless charge transport without any energy loss is one of the most fascinating phenomena in condensed matter physics. This extraordinary state manifests in two well-established systems: superconductors and quantum Hall systems. A proposed third category is associated with chiral loop current order, characterized by the spontaneous formation of microscopic electric current loops. The microscopic origin of these currents stems from imaginary hopping terms, conceptualized as an imaginary charge density wave (iCDW). Despite extensive investigations, its existence remains highly controversial. Here we report site-selective spectroscopic evidence for a pure iCDW in the kagome nonmagnetic metal CsV$_3$Sb$_5$. Nuclear quadrupole resonance spectra at out-of-plane $^{121}$Sb site sensitive to in-plane currents reveal anomalous broadening below $T^*\approx$120 K, coinciding with the nematic transition well above the real charge density wave (CDW). Under magnetic fields, the spectra exhibit asymmetric lineshapes, demonstrating that this broadening purely originates from magnetic effects rather than from electric quadrupolar effects associated with CDW fluctuations. The observed lineshapes are quantitatively consistent with ~1 mT local fields induced by chiral loop currents, indicating spontaneous time-reversal symmetry breaking.
