This microscopic identification of the long-sought pure iCDW establishes a novel form of quantum order, potentially revolutionizing our understanding of exotic electronic states in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“site-selective spectroscopic evidence”、“Nuclear quadrupole resonance spectra”、“lineshapes”等实验手段。；研究对象：Kagome非磁性金属CsV₃Sb₅中的虚电荷密度波（imaginary charge density wave, iCDW）及其相关的手性环电流序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CsV₃Sb₅中，通过核四极共振谱发现面外¹²¹Sb位点出现反常展宽，该展宽纯由磁效应引起，与手性环电流产生的约1 mT局域场定量一致，从而提供了纯iCDW存在的微观证据，表明自发的时间反演对称性破缺。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CsV₃Sb₅中，通过核四极共振谱发现面外¹²¹Sb位点出现反常展宽，该展宽纯由磁效应引起，与手性环电流产生的约1 mT局域场定量一致，从而提供了纯iCDW存在的微观证据，表明自发的时间反演对称性破缺。；创新点：首次提供了纯iCDW（虚电荷密度波）的微观光谱学证据，将其与实电荷密度波（real CDW）区分开来，并确认其伴随自发时间反演对称性破缺，从而建立了一种新型的量子有序态。
papers.method_zh: 核四极共振（NQR）谱学，特别是利用对面内电流敏感的面外¹²¹Sb位点进行测量，并结合外加磁场下的谱线形状分析。

papers.title: Interaction-controlled localization in one-dimensional chain: From edges to domain walls
papers.abstract: Using Hartree-Fock mean-field approach, we study the role of on-site ($U$) and extended ($V$) Hubbard interactions on the existence and evolution of edge modes in a half-filled Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain. We analyze the energy spectrum, local probability amplitudes, and site-resolved charge and spin density profiles across topological, critical, and trivial hopping regimes. We find that the localization of bound states is controlled by the ratio $2V/U$, with edge spin-density-wave modes for $U>2V$ and mid-chain charge-density-wave domain walls for $U<2V$, independent of band topology. These results establish the correlation-driven origin of localized states in finite one-dimensional chains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用Hartree-Fock平均场方法进行数值计算与分析。；研究对象：半填充Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链中，在位（U）和扩展（V）Hubbard相互作用对边缘态存在与演化的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域束缚态的局域化由比值2V/U控制：当U>2V时形成边缘自旋密度波模式，当U<2V时形成链中电荷密度波畴壁，且该行为与能带拓扑无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域束缚态的局域化由比值2V/U控制：当U>2V时形成边缘自旋密度波模式，当U<2V时形成链中电荷密度波畴壁，且该行为与能带拓扑无关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: Hartree-Fock平均场方法。具体分析了能量谱、局域概率振幅以及位点分辨的电荷和自旋密度分布，并考察了拓扑、临界和平凡跳迁区域。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium Fluctuation-Response Theory in the Frequency Domain
papers.abstract: We develop a unified fluctuation-response theory in the frequency domain for nonequilibrium steady states governed by overdamped Langevin dynamics and Markov jump processes. The relation expresses the power spectrum of general observables exactly as a quadratic form of local responses measured at the same frequency, thereby extending static nonequilibrium fluctuation-response relations to finite frequencies. The decomposition is spatial for Langevin systems and edge-resolved for Markov jump processes, and applies uniformly to state-dependent observables, current-like observables, and their combinations. As consequences of the same identity, we derive frequency-domain response uncertainty relations, kinetic and thermodynamic uncertainty relations, the equilibrium fluctuation-dissipation theorem, and Harada-Sasa-type relations. Applications to stochastic networks and driven diffusive systems illustrate how the theory resolves fluctuation spectra into edge-wise contributions and reveals frequency-dependent tradeoffs between fluctuations, response, and dissipation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a unified fluctuation-response theory、derive frequency-domain response uncertainty relations。；研究对象：非平衡稳态系统，具体包括过阻尼朗之万动力学和马尔可夫跳跃过程描述的随机网络和驱动扩散系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在频域中建立了非平衡稳态下一般可观测量的功率谱与同一频率下局域响应之间的精确二次型关系，从而将静态非平衡涨落-响应关系推广至有限频率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在频域中建立了非平衡稳态下一般可观测量的功率谱与同一频率下局域响应之间的精确二次型关系，从而将静态非平衡涨落-响应关系推广至有限频率。；创新点：首次在频域中实现了非平衡涨落-响应关系的空间分解（朗之万系统）和边分解（马尔可夫跳跃过程），并统一适用于状态依赖可观测量、流类可观测量及其组合。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于过阻尼朗之万动力学和马尔可夫跳跃过程的随机热力学，推导频域涨落-响应统一理论，并导出响应不确定关系、动力学与热力学不确定关系、平衡涨落-耗散定理以及Harada-Sasa型关系。

papers.title: Uncovering hidden bias in neutron diffraction residual strain measurements
papers.abstract: When calculating residual strain via neutron or X-ray diffraction, uncertainties propagated from the peak fit are often inadequate to describe the true scatter of measurements about a singular strain state, such as one that should describe a macroscopic continuum. Because diffraction is inherently a selective process, orientation dependent scatter arises from the sub-sampling of strong microstructure and strain gradients. This paper investigates the appropriateness of propagated uncertainties with reference to their original intention, i.e., noise about a mean value. Thirty-six unique orientations of strain measurements are taken at multiple locations within an additive friction-stir deposition component with fine-scale gradients (~200 um) of plastic strain, texture, and residual elastic strain. Multiple strain and stress calculation pathways are compared: direct substitution of three measurements into Hooke's law, direct inversion of any six unique orientations into the strain state tensor, and thirty-six measurement least-squares estimation. For the latter two cases, the appropriateness of the uncertainty interval is statistically evaluated based on a physical constraint: common agreement under the strain transformation law. For this sample, the direct inversion of six measurements retains a conservative estimate of the uncertainty. However, propagated uncertainties in the least-squares solution greatly underestimate the true experimental scatter. A simple pathway to estimate appropriate uncertainty intervals is suggested. These results demonstrate that interpretation of uncertainty in residual strain is strongly dependent on intrinsic, sample-dependent effects, and that oversampling orientations and statistical analysis can give more accurate results with realistic uncertainties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：neutron diffraction measurements（中子衍射测量）、experimental scatter（实验散射）、statistical evaluation（统计评估）。；研究对象：增材摩擦搅拌沉积（additive friction-stir deposition）部件中的残余应变（residual strain）测量，以及由微观结构（织构）和应变梯度引起的测量偏差。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过中子衍射测量残余应变时，从峰位拟合传播得到的不确定度会严重低估真实的实验散射，尤其是在存在精细尺度梯度的样品中。直接反演少量取向的测量值能保留保守的不确定度估计，而最小二乘解会过度乐观。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过中子衍射测量残余应变时，从峰位拟合传播得到的不确定度会严重低估真实的实验散射，尤其是在存在精细尺度梯度的样品中。直接反演少量取向的测量值能保留保守的不确定度估计，而最小二乘解会过度乐观。；创新点：系统性地揭示了中子衍射残余应变测量中，由取向依赖的亚采样（sub-sampling）导致的隐藏偏差，并指出传统传播不确定度在此类具有强微观结构和应变梯度的样品中是不充分的。提出了一个通过过采样取向和统计分析来估计合理不确定度区间的简单方法。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，在具有精细尺度（~200微米）塑性应变、织构和残余弹性应变梯度的增材摩擦搅拌沉积部件内，于多个位置测量了36个独特取向的应变。数据分析上，比较了三种应变/应力计算路径：将三个测量值直接代入胡克定律、对任意六个独特取向进行直接反演得到应变张量、以及基于36个测量值的最小二乘估计。通过应变变换定律下的共同一致性这一物理约束，对后两种路径的不确定度区间进行了统计评估。

papers.title: Geometrical control of topology with orbital angular momentum modes
papers.abstract: We study how the topological properties of a one-dimensional staggered lattice, loaded into states with orbital angular momentum $l=1$, can be controlled simply by tuning the relative angle between sites. The original system under consideration can be depicted as a Creutz ladder model when unwrapping the different state circulations in a synthetic dimension. Depending on the hopping strengths of the chain, different topological regimes may be accessed by changing the ladder angle, as determined by the value of the winding number of the chain. We analytically and numerically explore the different available regimes, and determine the number of topologically protected edge states that exist in each case. We also study the emergence of band inversion across topological transitions and show that it agrees with the winding number calculations, thus serving as an additional topological marker. Then, we propose a realistic experimental implementation in a photonic waveguide system, where the topological transition manifests as a sudden change of the behavior of the propagation of light in the system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算和实验提案）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically and numerically explore”“propose a realistic experimental implementation”。；研究对象：一维交错晶格中加载轨道角动量 \( l=1 \) 态的拓扑性质，具体通过调节格点间相对角度实现拓扑控制，并映射为 Creutz 梯子模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变晶格链中格点间的相对角度（梯子角度），可以调控系统的拓扑相，改变缠绕数，从而控制拓扑保护边缘态的数量；拓扑转变伴随能带反转，且该反转与缠绕数计算结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变晶格链中格点间的相对角度（梯子角度），可以调控系统的拓扑相，改变缠绕数，从而控制拓扑保护边缘态的数量；拓扑转变伴随能带反转，且该反转与缠绕数计算结果一致。；创新点：提出利用轨道角动量模式的空间几何自由度（相对角度）作为拓扑控制手段，而非传统的外场或调制，并在光子波导系统中给出可实现的实验方案。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析（缠绕数计算）、数值模拟（能带结构、边缘态）、以及基于光子波导系统的实验实现提案。

papers.title: Nonlinear phonon dispersion in disordered solids and non-Debye vibrational spectra
papers.abstract: All solids, whether crystalline or disordered, support elastic wave propagation with a linear dispersion relation in the long-wavelength limit. These waves, corresponding to low-frequency phonons, feature a vibrational density of states that follows Debye's classical model. Deviations from Debye's predictions with increasing frequency can emerge from phonon dispersion nonlinearity and from non-phononic vibrational modes, which exist in non-crystalline solids due to structural disorder. Both nonlinear phonon dispersion in disordered solids and its relative contribution to non-Debye anomalies, most notably manifested by the controversial boson peak, remain poorly understood. Here we show that nonlinear phonon dispersion in a broad range of disordered solids, including elastic networks and various glasses, emerge from a mesoscopic, disorder-induced lengthscale, which also controls wave attenuation. We subsequently use analysis and large-scale computer simulations to quantitatively determine the relative contributions of nonlinear phonon softening and non-phononic vibrations to the onset of non-Debye anomalies and to the boson peak. We show that the relative magnitude of the two contributions strongly depends on the strength of disorder of the solid, e.g., controlled by the thermal history upon glass formation, and that for realistic laboratory glasses both pieces of physics significantly contribute to the boson peak. These findings constitute basic progress in understanding disordered solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。关键词：analysis and large-scale computer simulations、理论分析。；研究对象：无序固体（包括弹性网络和多种玻璃）中的非线性声子色散及其对非德拜振动谱（特别是玻色峰）的贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无序固体中的非线性声子色散源于一种介观尺度、由无序诱导的特征长度，该长度同时控制波衰减；非线性声子软化与非声子振动对非德拜异常及玻色峰的相对贡献强烈依赖于无序强度（如玻璃形成时的热历史），在真实实验室玻璃中两者均显著贡献于玻色峰。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序固体中的非线性声子色散源于一种介观尺度、由无序诱导的特征长度，该长度同时控制波衰减；非线性声子软化与非声子振动对非德拜异常及玻色峰的相对贡献强烈依赖于无序强度（如玻璃形成时的热历史），在真实实验室玻璃中两者均显著贡献于玻色峰。；创新点：首次定量区分并比较了无序固体中非线性声子色散与非声子振动对非德拜异常及玻色峰的相对贡献，并揭示了该相对贡献对无序强度（如热历史）的依赖性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合大规模计算机模拟（摘要未明确指定具体模拟方法，如分子动力学或有限元等）。

papers.title: Symmetric estimator for discrete self-energy of discrete many-body systems
papers.abstract: We derive a discrete spectral representation of the single-particle self-energy using a discrete evaluation of Kugler's symmetric improved estimator. Our construction can be used on both the real and the complex (Matsubara) frequency axis. It is guaranteed to remain causal at the numerical level, in contrast to standard approaches that may generate unphysical negative spectral weight or require additional broadening. Our representation can be used for any Hamiltonian; here we apply it to quantum impurity models and in dynamical mean-field theory. The latter is formulated with a discrete hybridization function throughout its self-consistency loop. In both cases and across various numerical methods, we obtain significantly improved accuracy for a range of impurity properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：derive, spectral representation, numerical level, causality）；研究对象：离散多体系统的单粒子自能，具体应用于量子杂质模型和动力学平均场理论（DMFT）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于Kugler对称改进估计子的离散谱表示，能在数值上保证自能的因果性，避免标准方法中出现的非物理负谱权重或额外展宽问题，并在多种数值方法下显著提高杂质性质的精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于Kugler对称改进估计子的离散谱表示，能在数值上保证自能的因果性，避免标准方法中出现的非物理负谱权重或额外展宽问题，并在多种数值方法下显著提高杂质性质的精度。；创新点：提出了一种保证数值因果性的离散自能表示方法，克服了传统方法可能产生非物理负谱权重或需要额外展宽的缺陷。
papers.method_zh: 推导了离散自能的离散谱表示，可在实频率和复频率（Matsubara）轴上使用；应用于量子杂质模型和动力学平均场理论，后者在整个自洽循环中使用离散杂化函数。

papers.title: Temperature dependence of the Gibbs energies of formation of point defects in B2 MoTa from ab initio calculations
papers.abstract: Using B2 MoTa, the strongest B2 former among group V/VI refractory binaries, as a model system, we compute temperature-dependent Gibbs energies of formation of vacancies and antisites from ab initio calculations up to 3000 K at the stoichiometric composition. We explicitly account for thermal electronic excitations, vibrational anharmonicity, and electron-vibration coupling. The key finding is that the temperature dependence of the Gibbs energies of vacancy formation exhibits a pronounced sublattice asymmetry. Specifically, the Gibbs energy of formation of a Mo-site vacancy decreases by 1.1 eV from 0 to 3000 K, whereas the decrease for a Ta-site vacancy amounts to 2.1 eV, almost a factor of two larger. Two contributions of distinct origin govern the temperature dependence of this asymmetry: a quasiharmonic contribution associated with the chemical-potential imbalance set by the two antisite structures and an anharmonic contribution associated with the local vibrational response of the vacancy structures. The asymmetry in anharmonic vibrations is traced back to an enlarged local vibrational distribution of the first-nearest neighbors around the Ta-site vacancy. In contrast to the vacancies, the Gibbs energies of antisite formation vary only weakly with temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“ab initio calculations”、“compute”、“DFT”（隐含于第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：B2有序结构的MoTa金属间化合物（属于V/VI族难熔二元合金体系），具体研究其点缺陷（空位和反位）的吉布斯形成能随温度的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空位形成能的温度依赖性表现出显著的亚晶格不对称性：Mo位空位的吉布斯形成能从0 K到3000 K下降1.1 eV，而Ta位空位下降2.1 eV，后者几乎是前者的两倍。反位缺陷的形成能则随温度变化很弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空位形成能的温度依赖性表现出显著的亚晶格不对称性：Mo位空位的吉布斯形成能从0 K到3000 K下降1.1 eV，而Ta位空位下降2.1 eV，后者几乎是前者的两倍。反位缺陷的形成能则随温度变化很弱。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：首次在B2 MoTa体系中系统揭示了空位形成能温度依赖性的亚晶格不对称性，并定量区分了准谐贡献（源于两种反位结构导致的化学势不平衡）和非谐贡献（源于空位结构局域振动响应）两种不同起源的贡献，且将非谐振动的不对称性归因于Ta位空位第一近邻原子局域振动分布的扩大。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算（ab initio calculations），明确考虑了热电子激发、振动非简谐性以及电子-振动耦合效应，计算了化学计量比组成下B2 MoTa中空位和反位缺陷的随温度变化的吉布斯形成能（最高至3000 K）。

papers.title: From Defects to Devices: Design Guidelines for High-Performance Diamond-Based Solar Cells and Single-Dopant Diodes
papers.abstract: This work establishes key technological guidelines for designing diamond-based optoelectronic devices, derived from a first-principles investigation of two architectures: a PIN junction with a boron-vacancy-boron (BVB) intermediate-band absorber, and a PN junction based on phosphorus-vacancy (PV) defects. For the PIN solar cell, practical design principles include: i) aligning incident light in the xz-plane to exploit anisotropic absorption; ii) using graded junctions to mitigate tunnelling losses at abrupt interfaces; iii) targeting an absorber thickness of ~500 nm to balance absorption and carrier extraction; and iv) leveraging the high transparency of both contact layers for bifacial device configurations. For the PN diode, the PV-doped diamond operates via impurity-band conduction, making it suitable for degenerate p-type applications such as tunnel diodes or asymmetric junctions, while its temperature-dependent Seebeck anisotropy and sign-reversal offer opportunities for thermal management applications. When paired with phosphorus-doped n-type regions, these defects enable single-dopant junctions that significantly simplify device manufacturing. Using density functional theory with GW corrections, Bethe-Salpeter equation calculations and carrier transport modelling coupled to device electrostatics via a Poisson solver, we show that the BVB defect introduces intermediate bands without degrading diamond's high carrier mobility or thermal conductivity, while PV-doping provides high conductivity at room temperature through impurity-band transport. Overall, both defect-engineered systems preserve diamond's superior transport and thermal properties even after doping, offering viable pathways for high-performance diamond optoelectronics. These guidelines provide a practical foundation for fabricating efficient diamond-based photovoltaic and diode devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“first-principles investigation”、“density functional theory with GW corrections”、“Bethe-Salpeter equation calculations”、“carrier transport modelling coupled to device electrostatics via a Poisson solver”。；研究对象：基于缺陷工程的金刚石光电器件，具体包括：1）含硼-空位-硼（BVB）中间带吸收层的PIN结太阳能电池；2）基于磷-空位（PV）缺陷的PN结二极管。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BVB缺陷可在不降低金刚石高载流子迁移率和热导率的前提下引入中间带，而PV掺杂通过杂质带输运实现室温高电导率。两种缺陷工程体系均保留了金刚石优异的输运和热学性能，为高性能金刚石光电子学提供了可行路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BVB缺陷可在不降低金刚石高载流子迁移率和热导率的前提下引入中间带，而PV掺杂通过杂质带输运实现室温高电导率。两种缺陷工程体系均保留了金刚石优异的输运和热学性能，为高性能金刚石光电子学提供了可行路径。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但明确提出了针对金刚石PIN太阳能电池和PN单掺杂二极管的设计准则（如各向异性吸收利用、渐变结设计、~500 nm吸收层厚度、双面构型等），并首次系统比较了BVB和PV两种缺陷体系在器件层面的性能优势。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）结合GW准粒子修正、Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）计算光学吸收，以及耦合泊松求解器的载流子输运模型进行器件静电学模拟。

papers.title: Local elastic perturbation of colloidal suspensions near the colloidal glass transition
papers.abstract: Isolated microscopic magnetic particles are used to induce local perturbations in dense colloidal suspensions by rotating an external magnet. Confocal microscopy enables tracking of both the magnetic probe particle and adjacent colloidal particles. A probe particle moves with a circular trajectory. Knowing the external force and measuring the amplitude and phase of the probe motion allows us to infer the storage and loss moduli of colloidal suspensions at various volume fractions. These measurements are in qualitative agreement with previous results from conventional rheology. To further analyze the system's response, the oscillatory amplitude of colloidal particles is evaluated as a function of distance from the probe, revealing a 1/r decay in amplitude, consistent with a homogeneous viscoelastic material. These observations confirm that continuum descriptions of the colloidal samples are effective down to length scales comparable to the particle diameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：confocal microscopy（共聚焦显微镜）、tracking（追踪）、measurements（测量）。；研究对象：胶体悬浮液在接近胶体玻璃化转变时的局部弹性响应。具体体系为含孤立磁性微粒的浓胶体悬浮液。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过旋转外磁场驱动磁性探针粒子做圆周运动，可测量胶体悬浮液的储能模量和损耗模量，结果与传统流变学定性一致；且周围胶体粒子的振荡幅度随距离呈1/r衰减，表明连续介质描述在接近粒子直径的尺度上仍然有效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过旋转外磁场驱动磁性探针粒子做圆周运动，可测量胶体悬浮液的储能模量和损耗模量，结果与传统流变学定性一致；且周围胶体粒子的振荡幅度随距离呈1/r衰减，表明连续介质描述在接近粒子直径的尺度上仍然有效。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：使用共聚焦显微镜追踪磁性探针粒子及周围胶体粒子的运动；通过旋转外磁场对探针施加已知外力，测量其运动振幅和相位，从而推断储能模量和损耗模量；分析胶体粒子振荡幅度随距离的变化关系。

papers.title: Response tensor for the superconducting (Josephson) diode effect
papers.abstract: We propose a response tensor $\mathbf{\hat χ}$ to characterize the non-reciprocal critical current response of the superconducting (Josephson) diode effect. It describes the coupling between the dipole component of the angular distribution of the critical current and the applied magnetic field -- an analogue to the Hall response in the normal state. In quasi-2D systems with Rashba spin-orbit coupling and point group symmetries $C_{3v}$, $C_{4v}$ or $C_{6v}$, this tensor takes a fully antisymmetric form. When nematicity is present, a symmetric contribution emerges, providing an indicator of the nematic order in the superconducting state. In contrast, for systems exhibiting Dresselhaus spin-orbit coupling with the $D_{2d}$ symmetry, the tensor becomes diagonal traceless, and nematicity brings in a trace part. Our analysis not only accounts for the superconducting diode effect under external applied or intrinsic effective magnetic fields, but also predicts the symmetry conditions for realizing the diode effect when the magnetic field is aligned with the current. Beyond this, the proposed tensor provides a promising tool for detecting nematicity and potential nematic transitions deep within the superconducting phase. It may also encode additional information about the underlying electronic structure and symmetry-breaking orders, warranting further experimental investigation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：提出理论模型（response tensor）、对称性分析（point group symmetries）、预测物理效应（symmetry conditions for realizing the diode effect）。；研究对象：超导（约瑟夫森）二极管效应中的非互易临界电流响应。具体涉及具有Rashba自旋轨道耦合（点群对称性C3v, C4v, C6v）的准二维系统，以及具有Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合（D2d对称性）的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个响应张量 $\mathbf{\hat χ}$ 来表征超导二极管效应，该张量在特定对称性下呈现全反对称形式（如Rashba系统），而在存在向列序时出现对称贡献；对于Dresselhaus系统，张量则为对角无迹形式，向列序会引入迹部分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个响应张量 $\mathbf{\hat χ}$ 来表征超导二极管效应，该张量在特定对称性下呈现全反对称形式（如Rashba系统），而在存在向列序时出现对称贡献；对于Dresselhaus系统，张量则为对角无迹形式，向列序会引入迹部分。；创新点：提出了一个统一的响应张量框架来描述超导二极管效应，该框架不仅解释了现有实验现象，还预测了实现电流与磁场平行时二极管效应的对称性条件。此外，该张量被提议作为一种探测超导相内部向列序及向列相变的新工具。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架包括：基于对称性分析（点群理论）构建响应张量 $\mathbf{\hat χ}$，将其类比于正常态的霍尔响应，并分析不同对称性（C3v, C4v, C6v, D2d）及向列序对该张量形式的影响。

papers.title: Efficient Quasi-Resonant, Polarization-Selective Excitation of GaN Quantum Emitters
papers.abstract: Defect centers in GaN emerge as bright sources of single-photons which recently have been demonstrated to optically interface a localized spin. However, the structure and composition of these defects as well as their efficient excitation techniques were not a subject of thorough studies. This work presents evidence that by tuning the excitation laser energy to specific resonance values the excitation efficiency can be enhanced, resulting in relative increase of photoluminescence intensity by up to an order of magnitude. The resonances can be selectively addressed with linearly polarized light, while the emission dipole remains unchanged, enabling polarization-controlled enhancement. These results establish an efficient way of excitation for GaN-based emitters, thereby increasing the generation rate of photons. The data is consistent with excitation via localized vibrational modes associated with point-defect complexes, establishing a practical quasi-resonant route to brighter, polarization-addressable operation of GaN defect emitters and clarifying their energy-level structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：evidence、photoluminescence intensity、linearly polarized light、data is consistent with。；研究对象：GaN（氮化镓）中的缺陷中心（defect centers），具体为可作为单光子源且与局域自旋光接口的发光缺陷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将激发激光能量调谐至特定共振值，可将光致发光强度相对提升一个数量级；该共振可通过线偏振光选择性激发，且发射偶极矩保持不变，实现偏振控制的激发增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将激发激光能量调谐至特定共振值，可将光致发光强度相对提升一个数量级；该共振可通过线偏振光选择性激发，且发射偶极矩保持不变，实现偏振控制的激发增强。；创新点：首次系统研究了GaN缺陷中心的高效准共振激发技术，揭示了通过局域振动模式（与点缺陷复合体相关）实现偏振可寻址的亮度增强机制，并澄清了其能级结构。
papers.method_zh: 光致发光光谱测量（photoluminescence intensity），通过调谐激发激光能量至共振值，并使用线偏振光进行选择性激发，分析发射偶极矩的偏振特性。

papers.title: Guidelines for band gap opening in graphene superlattices with periodic π-vacancy distribution
papers.abstract: Periodic $π$-vacancies in graphene superlattices (GSLs) provide a symmetry-based route to band-gap opening in graphene by modifying the $π$-band dispersion. However, the symmetry conditions that determine whether a vacancy motif can open a band gap remain unclear. Here, we investigate periodic $π$-vacancy GSLs using a nearest-neighbor tight-binding model with one $p_z$ orbital per carbon site to identify the symmetry requirements for gap opening. $π$-vacancies, representing functionalized, substituted, or missing carbon sites, are modeled as site deletions in the $π$ basis, with all hopping matrix elements to and from the deleted sites set to zero. We focus on $π$-vacancy motifs with $C_2$ and $C_3$ point-group symmetry. A $3n \times 3n$ GSL, where $n=1,2,3,\ldots$ is the integer scaling factor multiplying the honeycomb primitive-cell vectors, folds $K$ and $K'$ to $Γ$ and can therefore open a band gap. For $C_3$-type vacancies, the Dirac cones remain pinned at high-symmetry points and thus stay at $Γ$ in folded $3n$ GSLs. In contrast, $C_2$-type vacancies that reduce the global point group of the GSL to $D_{2h}$ by preserving a pair of perpendicular mirror symmetries, $σ_v \perp σ_d$, can also constrain the Dirac cones to $Γ$. When the $σ_v$ and $σ_d$ mirror planes are absent, the cones are allowed to shift away from $Γ$ to $(\pm Δq,\pm Δq)$ in the $3n$ superlattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“nearest-neighbor tight-binding model”（紧束缚模型）进行对称性分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：石墨烯超晶格中周期性π空位（π-vacancy）导致的能带结构，特别是能隙开启的对称性条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于具有C₃对称性的π空位，狄拉克锥在折叠后的3n×3n超晶格中仍被钉扎在高对称点（Γ点），无法打开能隙；而具有C₂对称性且保留垂直镜面对称（σ_v ⊥ σ_d）的空位可将狄拉克锥约束在Γ点，从而打开能隙；若缺失这些镜面对称，狄拉克锥会偏离Γ点，能隙无法开启。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于具有C₃对称性的π空位，狄拉克锥在折叠后的3n×3n超晶格中仍被钉扎在高对称点（Γ点），无法打开能隙；而具有C₂对称性且保留垂直镜面对称（σ_v ⊥ σ_d）的空位可将狄拉克锥约束在Γ点，从而打开能隙；若缺失这些镜面对称，狄拉克锥会偏离Γ点，能隙无法开启。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用最近邻紧束缚模型，每个碳原子仅考虑一个p₂轨道，将π空位（功能化、替代或缺失碳位）建模为删除格点并置零所有相关跃迁矩阵元，重点分析具有C₂和C₃点群对称性的空位构型。

papers.title: Magnetic Brightening and Nanoscale Imaging of Spin-Polarized Helical Edge Modes
papers.abstract: Efficient sub-10 nm electric transport remains a major challenge for nanoelectronics due to high losses and impedance mismatches in conventional Drude metals. Despite their promise of dissipationless, reflection-free conduction, topologically protected chiral edge modes remain little explored in their nanoscale spin polarized transport-particularly regarding real-space visualization, magnetic field tunability, and high-frequency edge conductivity. Here, we report magnetic brightening and nanoscale visualization of highly spin-polarizable infrared helical edge states using cryogenic magneto-infrared scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (cm-IR-sSNOM). Our measurements reveal magnetic field-induced near-field conductivity at step edges, uncovering quantum spin Hall spin-splitting modes with enhanced infrared polarizability and slightly narrowed near-field profiles. In addition, the infrared edge electrodynamic response scales nearly linearly with atomic layer number, providing compelling evidence that magnetic-field-induced gaps do not disrupt individual-layer edge states at energies of around 100 meV. These results sharply contrast with microwave and DC transport, where even small magnetically induced gaps decrease edge conduction. Magnetically tunable, topologically robust high-frequency edge modes open a pathway toward ultralow-loss nanoscale interconnects and quantum logic architectures for next-generation microelectronics, spintronics and quantum information science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：cryogenic magneto-infrared scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (cm-IR-sSNOM)、nanoscale imaging、measurements。；研究对象：拓扑保护的螺旋边缘态（helical edge states）在纳米尺度下的自旋极化输运行为，具体为量子自旋霍尔体系中的红外螺旋边缘模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过低温磁红外近场光学显微镜，首次实现了对高度自旋可极化的红外螺旋边缘态的磁致亮化（magnetic brightening）和纳米尺度实空间成像，发现磁场诱导的边阶近场电导率增强，且红外边缘电动力学响应随原子层数近似线性变化，表明约100 meV能量下磁场诱导能隙不会破坏单层边缘态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过低温磁红外近场光学显微镜，首次实现了对高度自旋可极化的红外螺旋边缘态的磁致亮化（magnetic brightening）和纳米尺度实空间成像，发现磁场诱导的边阶近场电导率增强，且红外边缘电动力学响应随原子层数近似线性变化，表明约100 meV能量下磁场诱导能隙不会破坏单层边缘态。；创新点：首次在纳米尺度实空间可视化并调控自旋极化的红外螺旋边缘态，揭示了磁场对高频边缘电导率的增强效应（磁致亮化），这与传统微波和直流输运中磁场诱导能隙导致边缘电导下降的行为截然不同。
papers.method_zh: 低温磁红外散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（cm-IR-sSNOM），用于测量磁场诱导下的近场电导率、红外极化率及边缘电动力学响应。

papers.title: Understanding the Dynamics of Evaporation-Driven Colloidal Self-Assembly
papers.abstract: Complex colloidal cluster morphologies are desirable for the fabrication of advanced materials, such as photonic crystals and meta-materials, and can be formed through evaporation-driven packing. By coupling lattice Boltzmann and discrete element methods, here we elucidate the rich interplay between fluid and particle dynamics during evaporation-driven self-assembly of spherical colloidal particles. We construct a regime diagram for a wide range of evaporation rates, interparticle friction coefficients, and particle numbers, identifying parameter regimes for open, closed, and minimal moment of inertia cluster configurations. Analyzing the competition between capillary, hydrodynamic, normal, and friction forces, we show that interparticle friction can exert a disproportionately strong influence on the final packing outcome despite being considerably smaller in magnitude than other forces at play. Our simulation results further highlight the potential for tuning colloidal cluster configurations via their dynamic trajectories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：lattice Boltzmann and discrete element methods（格子玻尔兹曼与离散元方法）、simulation results。；研究对象：蒸发驱动的球形胶体颗粒自组装过程，具体研究不同蒸发速率、颗粒间摩擦系数和颗粒数量下形成的胶体团簇构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构建了蒸发速率、摩擦系数和颗粒数量参数空间中的相图，识别出开放、闭合和最小转动惯量三种团簇构型；发现尽管颗粒间摩擦力在量级上远小于毛细力、水动力和法向力，却对最终堆积结果产生不成比例的强烈影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构建了蒸发速率、摩擦系数和颗粒数量参数空间中的相图，识别出开放、闭合和最小转动惯量三种团簇构型；发现尽管颗粒间摩擦力在量级上远小于毛细力、水动力和法向力，却对最终堆积结果产生不成比例的强烈影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 耦合格子玻尔兹曼方法（LBM）与离散元方法（DEM）进行数值模拟，分析毛细力、水动力、法向力和摩擦力之间的竞争关系。

papers.title: A Two-Step Chemical Vapor Deposition Process for the Synthesis of an Ir(111)/Borophene/2D-Hexagonal Boron Nitride Heterostructure by Intrinsic Segregation
papers.abstract: We report on a two-step ultrahigh vacuum chemical vapor deposition synthesis of a vertical Ir(111)/borophene/hexagonal boron nitride heterostructure, using borazine as a single-source precursor. The process takes advantage of the finite solubility of boron in Ir: low precursor pressure at high temperature first establishes a boron reservoir in the near-surface region of the substrate, whereas subsequent growth at higher precursor pressure promotes the formation of a closed hexagonal boron nitride monolayer. During cooldown, the reduced boron solubility drives segregation to the surface, resulting in the formation of a borophene monolayer beneath the hexagonal boron nitride overlayer. The heterostructure, with micron sized grains, homogeneously covers the entire Ir substrate. The study is performed by complementary spot profile analysis low-energy electron diffraction, low-energy electron microscopy, and scanning tunneling microscopy measurements. This intrinsic segregation-assisted growth concept provides a promising route toward scalable synthesis of high-quality, vertical heterostructures of two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“chemical vapor deposition synthesis”、“measurements”、“low-energy electron diffraction”、“low-energy electron microscopy”、“scanning tunneling microscopy”。；研究对象：垂直异质结 Ir(111)/borophene/六方氮化硼（hexagonal boron nitride），具体为在铱单晶衬底上通过硼原子内禀偏析形成的硼烯与六方氮化硼双层结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用硼在铱中的有限溶解度，通过两步化学气相沉积法，在降温过程中硼原子偏析至表面，成功在六方氮化硼单层下方形成硼烯单层，从而制备出高质量、微米级晶粒、均匀覆盖整个衬底的垂直异质结。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用硼在铱中的有限溶解度，通过两步化学气相沉积法，在降温过程中硼原子偏析至表面，成功在六方氮化硼单层下方形成硼烯单层，从而制备出高质量、微米级晶粒、均匀覆盖整个衬底的垂直异质结。；创新点：提出一种“内禀偏析辅助生长”策略，利用衬底中硼的溶解度随温度变化实现自发性分层生长，为可规模化合成高质量二维材料垂直异质结提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 超高真空化学气相沉积（UHV-CVD），以硼吖嗪（borazine）为单一前驱体；表征手段包括：点阵剖面分析低能电子衍射（SPA-LEED）、低能电子显微镜（LEEM）、扫描隧道显微镜（STM）。

papers.title: Role of mass fluctuations in the diffusion of clusters of Brownian particles with activity
papers.abstract: Motivated by the anomalous diffusion observed in clusters of active Brownian particles (ABPs), where the center-of-mass diffusion coefficient scales as $D\sim N^{-1/2}$ with respect to the number $N$ of particles in the cluster, we derive a minimal theoretical framework starting from the single-particle Langevin equations. The model consists of two coupled stochastic equations: one for the cluster center-of-mass trajectory and one for the mass evolution $N(t)$, explicitly accounting for stochastic displacements induced by particle attachment and detachment. We specialize and validate the framework against ABP simulations of isolated clusters in stationary conditions, where $N(t)$ follows a Gaussian process with mean $N_0$, variance $\propto N_0^β$, and persistence time $\propto N_0^κ$. Analytical solution of the coupled equations yields the long-time diffusion coefficient as the sum of two contributions: a conventional term $\propto N_0^{-1}$) due to thermal noise plus summation of active forces, and a fluctuation-driven term $\propto N_0^{-δ}$ with $δ=2-2/d-β+κ$, where $d$ is the spatial dimension. We demonstrate that anomalous scaling emerges whenever the second term becomes dominant. The model predicts $D\sim N^{-α}$ with $α=0.63\pm0.06$, in good quantitative agreement with large-scale ABP simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：derive a minimal theoretical framework、analytical solution、coupled stochastic equations）；研究对象：活性布朗粒子（ABPs）团簇的扩散行为，特别是团簇质心扩散系数随粒子数N的异常标度关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出团簇扩散系数由常规项（∝ N₀⁻¹）和质量涨落驱动项（∝ N₀⁻δ）组成，当后者占主导时出现异常标度D∼N⁻α，理论预测α=0.63±0.06，与大规模ABP模拟定量吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出团簇扩散系数由常规项（∝ N₀⁻¹）和质量涨落驱动项（∝ N₀⁻δ）组成，当后者占主导时出现异常标度D∼N⁻α，理论预测α=0.63±0.06，与大规模ABP模拟定量吻合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 从单粒子朗之万方程出发，建立团簇质心轨迹与质量演化N(t)的耦合随机方程模型；对孤立团簇在稳态条件下的ABP模拟进行验证；解析求解耦合方程得到长时间扩散系数的表达式。

papers.title: Spin-wave bandgap engineering via mode hybridization in dipolar-coupled YIG film/CoFeB nanodisk magnonic crystals
papers.abstract: We investigate spin-wave transport in hybrid two-dimensional magnonic crystals comprising a low-damping yttrium iron garnet (YIG) film coupled to a periodic array of CoFeB nanodisks. Using propagating spin-wave spectroscopy, super-Nyquist magneto-optical Kerr effect microscopy, and micromagnetic simulations, we demonstrate the formation of pronounced and tunable bandgaps that do not originate from conventional Bragg scattering. Instead, these gaps arise from hybridization between the fundamental magnonic-crystal mode and in-plane transverse standing modes induced by the periodic nanodisk array. The spectral position and width of these gaps are controlled by geometric parameters and by the magnetic state of the nanodisks, including their vortex configuration, which governs both static and dynamic dipolar coupling. For larger lattice periods, additional gaps emerge through hybridization with modes quantized both transverse and parallel to the spin-wave propagation direction, reflecting dispersion folding in two dimensions. Our results establish mode hybridization as a versatile mechanism for engineering spin-wave band structures beyond the constraints of Bragg scattering and provide a pathway toward reconfigurable magnonic devices based on dipolar-coupled hybrid architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：propagating spin-wave spectroscopy, super-Nyquist magneto-optical Kerr effect microscopy, micromagnetic simulations。；研究对象：由低阻尼钇铁石榴石（YIG）薄膜与周期性CoFeB纳米盘阵列构成的混合二维磁子晶体中的自旋波输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在YIG/CoFeB混合磁子晶体中，通过磁子晶体基模与周期性纳米盘阵列诱导的面内横向驻波模式之间的杂化，可形成显著且可调的带隙，其起源并非传统的布拉格散射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在YIG/CoFeB混合磁子晶体中，通过磁子晶体基模与周期性纳米盘阵列诱导的面内横向驻波模式之间的杂化，可形成显著且可调的带隙，其起源并非传统的布拉格散射。；创新点：提出并验证了模式杂化作为超越布拉格散射限制的能带工程新机制，并展示了通过纳米盘的几何参数和磁态（包括涡旋构型）对带隙进行可重构调控的路径。摘要未突出说明与纯YIG薄膜或传统布拉格型磁子晶体相比的具体性能提升幅度。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用传播自旋波谱学与超奈奎斯特磁光克尔效应显微镜；理论上结合微磁学模拟。

papers.title: Predicting the Brittle-to-Ductile Transition in Amorphous Polymers
papers.abstract: Brittle-ductile transition (BDT) is an important characteristic of amorphous (and semicrystalline) polymers. For a given strain rate, at temperatures above BDT, the polymers exhibit strain softening followed by yield and strain hardening, while at temperatures below BDT, the same materials exhibit brittle failure at relatively low strains. Surprisingly, today there is no simple model describing BDT as a function of polymer chemistry, sample history, deformation type, and strain rate. Experimental data suggest that BDT is often, though not always, associated with the beta-transition. We formulate a simple scalar model to describe the visco-elasto-plastic shear stress-strain curves as functions of temperature and strain rate. We also show that within this model, there is always an upper bound on the strain rate where the material can have a uniform viscoplastic flow; this upper bound is taken to represent the BDT. We stipulate that this upper bound is inversely proportional to the Johari-Goldstein beta-relaxation time. Using our "general" Sanchez-Lacombe "two-state, two-(time)scale" (SL-TS2) model, we compute the BDT for three polymers (polystyrene, poly(methylmethacrylate), and poly(vinylchloride)) and found a good agreement with experimental data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：formulate a simple scalar model、within this model、using our model）；研究对象：非晶态聚合物（如聚苯乙烯、聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯、聚氯乙烯）的脆性-韧性转变（BDT）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个标量模型，认为存在一个应变率上限，超过该上限材料无法维持均匀粘塑性流动，该上限与Johari-Goldstein β-弛豫时间成反比，从而预测BDT温度；模型对三种聚合物的预测与实验数据吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个标量模型，认为存在一个应变率上限，超过该上限材料无法维持均匀粘塑性流动，该上限与Johari-Goldstein β-弛豫时间成反比，从而预测BDT温度；模型对三种聚合物的预测与实验数据吻合良好。；创新点：首次提出一个简单标量模型，将BDT与聚合物化学结构、样品历史、变形类型和应变率关联起来，并直接通过β-弛豫时间进行预测。
papers.method_zh: 基于Sanchez-Lacombe“两态、两（时间）尺度”（SL-TS2）模型，构建描述粘-弹-塑性剪切应力-应变曲线的标量模型，将BDT定义为均匀粘塑性流动存在的应变率上限，并关联至β-弛豫时间。

papers.title: Nonlocal transport phenomena in coupled quasiperiodic Kitaev chains
papers.abstract: We investigate the topological phases in a coupled one-dimensional p-wave superconducting Fibonacci quasicrystal modeled by the quasiperiodic Kitaev chain. Recent studies have shown that the coupled system can host topological edge modes with Majorana fermions and enhance their topological protection, depending on the pattern of quasiperiodicity. In this work, we elucidate the topological phases of the coupled system and demonstrate the dependence of differential conductance on the lead connecting pattern employing the Keldysh formalism and the recursive Green's function method. Our findings reveal the emergence of topological phases in the coupled system, which are characterized by the presence of Majorana edge modes and the seepage of the Majorana wave function. Furthermore, we identify a new topological phase transition induced by quasiperiodicity in the coupled system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Keldysh formalism、recursive Green's function method、拓扑相分析。；研究对象：耦合的一维p波超导Fibonacci准晶体系，具体由准周期Kitaev链构成，研究其拓扑相及非局域输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 耦合准周期Kitaev链中存在拓扑相，表现为马约拉纳边缘模及其波函数的渗漏；此外，准周期性在耦合体系中诱导出一种新的拓扑相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：耦合准周期Kitaev链中存在拓扑相，表现为马约拉纳边缘模及其波函数的渗漏；此外，准周期性在耦合体系中诱导出一种新的拓扑相变。；创新点：揭示了耦合准周期Kitaev链中由准周期性诱导的新型拓扑相变，并阐明了引线连接模式对微分电导的影响。摘要未突出说明与已有耦合Kitaev链工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用Keldysh形式论和递归格林函数方法，计算微分电导对引线连接模式的依赖关系。

papers.title: Superconductivity in moiré transition metal dichalcogenide bilayers: comparison of two distinct theoretical approaches
papers.abstract: Superconductivity has recently been observed in moiré transition-metal dichalcogenide bilayers. Here, we investigate the superconducting state in twisted WSe$_2$ using two complementary theoretical approaches. The first is based on the negative $U$-Hubbard model and represents a relatively conventional pairing scenario, in which strong electron-electron repulsion does not directly affect the paired state and an isotropic $s$-$wave$ gap emerges. The second approach employs the $t$-$J$-$U$ model, allowing for unconventional gap symmetries and incorporating strong correlation effects via substantial renormalization induced by Coulomb repulsion. We compare the key properties of the superconducting states obtained within these two frameworks and discuss their implications in light of available experimental observations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical approaches、model（负U-Hubbard模型、t-J-U模型）、investigate、compare。；研究对象：扭曲双层过渡金属二硫族化物（twisted WSe₂）中的超导态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过两种互补的理论方法（负U-Hubbard模型与t-J-U模型）对比研究了扭曲WSe₂中的超导态，发现前者给出常规的各向同性s波超导能隙，后者则允许非常规能隙对称性并包含强关联重整化效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过两种互补的理论方法（负U-Hubbard模型与t-J-U模型）对比研究了扭曲WSe₂中的超导态，发现前者给出常规的各向同性s波超导能隙，后者则允许非常规能隙对称性并包含强关联重整化效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用两种理论框架：（1）负U-Hubbard模型，描述相对常规的配对场景，强电子-电子排斥不直接影响配对态；（2）t-J-U模型，允许非常规能隙对称性，并通过库仑排斥引起的显著重整化纳入强关联效应。

papers.title: Dynamical pseudopotentials
papers.abstract: Pseudopotential theory has greatly driven first-principles calculations in materials, replacing the explicit treatment of the chemically inert core electrons with an effective potential acting only on the valence states. This is inherently an embedding problem, where tracing out the core electrons can be formulated in terms of a dynamical embedding potential. Motivated by this perspective, we first introduce a framework for dynamical (i.e., energy-dependent) pseudopotentials, showing how this leads to generalized norm-conservation conditions. Then, adopting a sum-over-poles representation, we disentangle the number of reference energies from the number of projectors; this allows to reproduce all-electron scattering at many reference energies with great accuracy and over very extended energy ranges. We further show that these pseudopotentials enter naturally into many-body total energy functionals, leading for the first time to a consistent and unified treatment of the all-electron atom, the pseudo-atom, and the solid within the same electronic-structure theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“formulated in terms of a dynamical embedding potential”、“introduce a framework”、“adopting a sum-over-poles representation”等理论推导和框架构建关键词。；研究对象：论文研究的是赝势理论中的核心问题——如何更精确地处理核心电子与价电子的相互作用，具体提出了“动力学赝势”（dynamical pseudopotentials）这一新概念，并应用于全电子原子、赝原子和固体体系的统一电子结构描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入能量依赖的动力学赝势，并采用极点求和表示，可以在极宽的能量范围内以极高精度再现全电子散射行为，并首次实现全电子原子、赝原子和固体在多体总能泛函中的一致处理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入能量依赖的动力学赝势，并采用极点求和表示，可以在极宽的能量范围内以极高精度再现全电子散射行为，并首次实现全电子原子、赝原子和固体在多体总能泛函中的一致处理。；创新点：将赝势从传统的能量无关形式推广为动力学（能量依赖）形式，并引入新的表示方法使得在多个参考能量上精确匹配全电子散射成为可能，同时首次将这种动力学赝势自然地纳入多体总能泛函，实现了不同体系（原子、赝原子、固体）在相同电子结构理论框架下的统一描述。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建：基于嵌入视角将核心电子“求迹”转化为动力学嵌入势；采用能量依赖的赝势形式，并引入“sum-over-poles”表示来解耦参考能量数与投影仪数；结合多体总能泛函进行一致性推导。

papers.title: Plastic deformation of B19' martensite where -- where it matters in NiTi technology
papers.abstract: Nitinol technology, besides utilizing the functional thermomechanical properties derived from the B2 cubic to B19' monoclinic martensitic transformation, also exploits the excellent plastic deformability of NiTi in the martensite state. It originates from the unique mechanism of plastic deformation of the B19' martensite by kwinking involving dislocation slip based kinking assisted by deformation twinning. Although the mechanism of plastic deformation of martensite by kwinking was revealed only very recently, various unusual phenomena that can only be rationalized by kwinking, have been reported in literature in the last 50 years. These phenomena include: 1) cold working with a high degree of reduction without introducing cracks, 2) excellent plastic deformability in the martensite state (plastic deformation up to~80% strain at stresses >1GPa), 3) refinement of austenitic microstructure to a quasi-amorphous state by tensile deformation, 4) observation of high density of {114} deformation bands in austenitic microstructures, 5) systematic ruptures of strengthened NiTi wires in tensile tests via necking at the onset of plastic yielding, 6) localized plastic deformation in tensile tests via propagation of Lüders band fronts with very large localized strain (~40%), 7) unusually long upper stress plateaus in superelastic tensile tests (>8% strain), 8) large plastic strains (> 20 %) generated in a single closed-loop cooling/heating cycle under constant stress, 9) shape setting of already annealed NiTi by heating under external constraint. Finally, we discuss how kwinking deformation was considered in constitutive modelling of thermomechanical behaviors of NiTi and, particularly, what is the role of the kwinking deformation in NiTi technology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述型文章。判断依据：摘要未提及具体实验或计算手段，而是系统总结文献中已报道的现象，并讨论机制与建模。；研究对象：NiTi（镍钛）合金中B19'马氏体的塑性变形机制，特别是“kwinking”（位错滑移基扭折与变形孪晶协同作用）这一新机制及其在NiTi技术中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: B19'马氏体的塑性变形主要通过“kwinking”机制实现，该机制能解释过去50年文献中报道的多种异常现象，如高压缩率冷加工、超长应力平台、局部化Lüders带传播等，对NiTi技术的功能与加工性能至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：B19'马氏体的塑性变形主要通过“kwinking”机制实现，该机制能解释过去50年文献中报道的多种异常现象，如高压缩率冷加工、超长应力平台、局部化Lüders带传播等，对NiTi技术的功能与加工性能至关重要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但指出kwinking机制是“非常近期”才被揭示的，并首次系统地将该机制与大量历史实验现象联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验或计算方法，而是基于文献综述和现象学分析，讨论kwinking变形在NiTi热力学行为本构建模中的考虑。

papers.title: Effective long-range attraction of moiré excitons under the influence of atomic reconstructions and anisotropic screening
papers.abstract: The moiré pattern, which emerges due to a relative rotation between two monolayers of transition metal dichalcogenides, features a long lattice period for small twist angles. The resulting band structure modulation acts as an effective potential for interlayer excitons (IXs), which can realize correlated many-body phenomena. Here, we aim for a material-realistic modelling of the exciton-exciton interaction, taking into account lattice reconstructions and an exciton-exciton potential that incorporates the highly anisotropic screening imposed by the two-dimensional bilayer and the dielectric background. We find strong modifications of the on-site interaction induced by the change of the moiré potential during lattice reconstructions, while for long-range interactions on the length scale of the moiré period, anisotropic dielectric screening leads to a crossover from a repulsive to an attractive interaction. The interaction potential and hopping amplitudes serve as parameters for a Bose-Hubbard model on the moiré lattice, which we use to explain correlated behavior of interlayer excitons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“modelling”（建模）、“Bose-Hubbard model”（玻色-哈伯德模型）、“potential”（势能计算），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：过渡金属硫族化物（TMDs）双层异质结中由小转角形成的莫尔超晶格，以及其中的层间激子（interlayer excitons, IXs）及其相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在莫尔周期尺度上，各向异性介电屏蔽导致激子间相互作用从排斥转变为吸引，从而产生有效的长程吸引力；同时，晶格重构会显著改变莫尔势，进而强烈影响激子的在位相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在莫尔周期尺度上，各向异性介电屏蔽导致激子间相互作用从排斥转变为吸引，从而产生有效的长程吸引力；同时，晶格重构会显著改变莫尔势，进而强烈影响激子的在位相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用材料真实的建模方法，考虑了晶格重构（lattice reconstructions）以及由二维双层和介电背景引入的高度各向异性屏蔽，计算了激子-激子相互作用势；并将相互作用势和跃迁振幅作为参数，构建了莫尔晶格上的玻色-哈伯德模型（Bose-Hubbard model）来解释层间激子的关联行为。

papers.title: Quantum Coherence Reshapes Thermodynamic Bounds for Thermal Machines
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relations (TURs) set universal bounds linking current fluctuations to entropy production in nonequilibrium steady states. Their multidimensional generalization (MTUR) introduces matrix inequalities connecting current covariances and mean values. We analyze these bounds in a paradigmatic quantum thermal device, a two-terminal conductor, operating as a heat engine, refrigerator, or heat pump. We show that classical performance limits on efficiency and coefficient of performance remain constrained by the TUR when finite power or heat flow from cold to hot reservoirs is maintained, even in regimes dominated by coherent transport. We further identify the conditions that optimize TUR and MTUR violations, demonstrating that cross-correlations can enhance the joint precision of charge and heat currents near the linear-response regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：分析、推导、建立不等式、识别条件。；研究对象：量子热器件，具体为两端子导体，工作模式包括热机、制冷机和热泵。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使在相干输运主导的量子体系中，经典的热力学不确定关系（TUR）对效率和性能系数的约束依然成立；同时，在近线性响应区，电流间的互关联可以增强电荷流与热流的联合测量精度，从而优化TUR及其多维推广（MTUR）的违反条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使在相干输运主导的量子体系中，经典的热力学不确定关系（TUR）对效率和性能系数的约束依然成立；同时，在近线性响应区，电流间的互关联可以增强电荷流与热流的联合测量精度，从而优化TUR及其多维推广（MTUR）的违反条件。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于热力学不确定关系（TUR）及其多维推广（MTUR）的理论框架，对两端子量子导体中的电流涨落、熵产生及互关联进行解析分析。

papers.title: Dielectric, magnetic, and magnetodielectric behaviors of BaFe12O19 hexaferrite modulated by Mn and Ti substitutions
papers.abstract: We prepared Mn- and Ti mono-doped and co-doped BaFe12O19 hexaferrites via solid-state reaction. Mn ions preferentially occupy the 4f2 and 2b sites, while Ti ions mainly substitute the Fe3+ ions at 4f1 and 12k sites as revealed by the Raman spectroscopy and formation energy. Pure BaFe12O19 exhibits ferrimagnetism. The hexaferrites related to Ti doping have noncollinear longitudinal conical spin order at low temperatures, where BaFe6Mn3Ti3O19 retains this spin order up to room temperature. Ti4+ substitution at 4f1 and 12k sites plays a pivotal role in stabilizing the noncollinear conical spin order through adjusting the superexchange interactions and reducing the uniaxial magnetocrystalline anisotropy along the c-axis. The magnetic response exhibits two distinct transition temperatures because Ti4+ ions interrupt the magnetic superexchange interactions with two inequivalent exchange integrals. Pure BaFe12O19 presents a quantum paraelectric behavior at low temperatures, which is disrupted by Mn-Ti doping due to the decoupling of electric dipoles within the triangular bipyramid. Electron hopping and polaronic effects dominate the dielectric response at 10 - 50 K, while Maxwell-Wagner interfacial polarization and electron hopping contribute to dielectric dispersion at higher temperatures. The negative MD effect of pure BaFe12O19 and BaFe6Mn3Ti3O19 at 10 K originates from spin-phonon coupling and electric polarization induced by noncollinear spin order under magnetic field, respectively. The Mn-Ti co-doped samples achieve relatively higher MD responses at low magnetic fields. In higher temperatures, the MD effect arises mainly from the magnetic field modulation of the electron hopping with non-intrinsic interfacial polarization. This research reveals the physical properties of M-type hexaferrite can be modulated through substituting Fe3+ ions at different sites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“制备”（prepared）、“拉曼光谱”（Raman spectroscopy）、“磁电响应测量”等实验手段。；研究对象：Mn和Ti单掺杂及共掺杂的BaFe12O19 M型六角铁氧体（hexaferrite）的介电、磁性和磁介电行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Mn和Ti离子分别占据不同Fe位点，Ti掺杂通过调控超交换相互作用和降低单轴磁晶各向异性，在低温下稳定非共线纵向锥形自旋序，且BaFe6Mn3Ti3O19可将该自旋序保持至室温；纯BaFe12O19在低温下呈现量子顺电行为，而Mn-Ti共掺杂样品在低磁场下获得较高的磁介电响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Mn和Ti离子分别占据不同Fe位点，Ti掺杂通过调控超交换相互作用和降低单轴磁晶各向异性，在低温下稳定非共线纵向锥形自旋序，且BaFe6Mn3Ti3O19可将该自旋序保持至室温；纯BaFe12O19在低温下呈现量子顺电行为，而Mn-Ti共掺杂样品在低磁场下获得较高的磁介电响应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 固相反应法制备样品；拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy）分析离子占位；形成能计算辅助确定掺杂位点；介电、磁性和磁介电行为测量。

papers.title: Melting upon cooling in a quantum magnet
papers.abstract: Heating enhances thermal fluctuations and typically leads to melting of solids, but in exceptional cases, heating can also cause liquids to solidify. The paradigm of this counterintuitive phenomenon is solidification of liquid $^3$He upon increasing temperature, known as the Pomeranchuk effect. Here we show that such inverse melting also appears in quantum magnetism. We find that, on cooling, the Ising-like triangular-lattice antiferromagnet erbium heptatantalate first develops a three-sublattice long-range magnetic order -- analogous to a solid -- which then, unexpectedly, melts at even lower temperatures into a short-range correlated spin-stripe state -- analogous to a liquid. We propose that such an unprecedented ``spin Pomeranchuk effect" can generically arise from strong competition between spin-spin interactions in frustrated magnets, and provides a novel avenue to transformations between exotic magnetic phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：show、develops、melts、propose，结合具体材料与相变观测）；研究对象：Ising型三角晶格反铁磁体七钽酸铒（erbium heptatantalate）中的磁性相变，特别是“冷却熔化”这一反常现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在冷却过程中，该量子磁体先形成类似固体的三子晶格长程磁有序，随后在更低温度下意外“熔化”为短程关联的自旋条纹态，即出现“冷却熔化”的反常行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在冷却过程中，该量子磁体先形成类似固体的三子晶格长程磁有序，随后在更低温度下意外“熔化”为短程关联的自旋条纹态，即出现“冷却熔化”的反常行为。；创新点：首次在量子磁体中观察到类似液氦-3 Pomeranchuk效应的“自旋Pomeranchuk效应”，即冷却导致磁有序熔化，并指出该现象可普遍源于阻挫磁体中自旋-自旋相互作用的强竞争。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如中子散射、磁化率测量等），仅提及通过观测磁有序随温度的变化得出结论。

papers.title: Regulating oxygen content and superconductivity in La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_{7+δ}$
papers.abstract: The synthesis of high-quality Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates remains challenging due to variations in oxygen content and the prevalence of intergrown RP phases. Precisely controlling the stoichiometry and characterizing the resulting physical properties are essential for understanding the mechanism of high-$T_c$ superconductivity in these materials. In this work, we synthesize a series of La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_{7+δ}$ samples with systematically controlled oxygen content and perform comprehensive structural and compositional analyses. Precise oxygen tuning enables us to tailor the microstructure, yielding a pure bilayer phase, a mixture of bilayer and hybrid single-layer-bilayer phases, and a predominantly bilayer phase containing trilayer intergrowths. High-pressure transport measurements reveal distinct superconducting transitions with contrasting $T_c$ values, corresponding to the bilayer phase, the hybrid phase, and trilayer inclusions. Notably, we find that oxygen content not only governs the phase purity$-$i.e., the presence of intergrowth phases$-$but also directly modulates the upper critical field ($H_{c2}$) of the bilayer superconductivity. By establishing a phase diagram of $T_c$ and $H_{c2}$ as functions of oxygen content in La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_{7+δ}$, this work advances synthetic control and provides new insights into the superconducting mechanism of RP nickelates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“合成”、“高压输运测量”、“结构及成分分析”等实验手段。；研究对象：La₃Ni₂O₇₊δ（一种Ruddlesden-Popper型镍氧化物）中的氧含量调控及其超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确调控氧含量，可以控制La₃Ni₂O₇₊δ的相纯度（如纯双层相、混合相、含三层共生相），并直接调制双层超导的上临界场（Hc₂），建立了Tc和Hc₂随氧含量变化的相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确调控氧含量，可以控制La₃Ni₂O₇₊δ的相纯度（如纯双层相、混合相、含三层共生相），并直接调制双层超导的上临界场（Hc₂），建立了Tc和Hc₂随氧含量变化的相图。；创新点：首次系统揭示了氧含量不仅决定La₃Ni₂O₇₊δ中共生相的存在与否（相纯度），还能直接调控双层超导的上临界场，并建立了氧含量与超导关键参数（Tc、Hc₂）之间的相图。
papers.method_zh: 采用系统控制氧含量的合成方法制备系列样品，结合结构及成分分析（如X射线衍射、能谱等）进行表征，并通过高压输运测量研究超导转变。

papers.title: Second quantization of anyons and spin-anyon duality
papers.abstract: Anyons exhibit a non-trivial interplay between local exclusion rules and non-local braiding and exchange phases, making a consistent commutation algebra and second-quantized formulation challenging. We develop an algebraic framework for Abelian anyons in one dimension with statistical phase $θ$ = $π$/N that enforces a finite on-site occupancy of N-1 anyons with the exchange phase $θ$ between different sites. Moreover, we introduce an exact Jordan-Wigner duality between $π$/3 anyons and spin-1 operators, allowing us to map a tight-binding anyon model to an XY-like spin-1 model. The model exhibits anyon-density-dependent flux, incompressible or gapless regions, and critical points with level crossings that appear as discontinuities in ground-state currents, momenta, fidelities, and correlation functions. Our second-quantization formalism establishes a novel spin anyon duality, offering a conceptually new route to realize anyons from spin Hamiltonians and to engineer corresponding device architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：algebraic framework、second-quantized formulation、Jordan-Wigner duality、spin anyon duality。；研究对象：一维阿贝尔任意子（Abelian anyons），统计相位θ = π/N，以及其与自旋-1算符之间的对偶关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了统计相位为π/N的一维阿贝尔任意子的第二量子化代数框架，并发现了π/3任意子与自旋-1算符之间的精确Jordan-Wigner对偶，从而可将紧束缚任意子模型映射为类XY自旋-1模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了统计相位为π/N的一维阿贝尔任意子的第二量子化代数框架，并发现了π/3任意子与自旋-1算符之间的精确Jordan-Wigner对偶，从而可将紧束缚任意子模型映射为类XY自旋-1模型。；创新点：首次建立了任意子与自旋算符之间的精确对偶关系（spin-anyon duality），为从自旋哈密顿量实现任意子以及设计相应器件架构提供了全新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建：通过定义有限占据数（N-1个任意子）和不同格点间的交换相位θ，建立任意子的代数结构；利用Jordan-Wigner变换实现任意子与自旋算符之间的精确对偶映射；通过基态电流、动量、保真度和关联函数分析模型中的不可压缩区、无能隙区及临界点。

papers.title: Unveiling the Atomistic Mechanisms of Shear-Induced LDA$\leftrightarrow$HDA Transformations and Shear Banding in Amorphous Silicon under High Pressures
papers.abstract: Large-scale molecular dynamics simulations of shear deformation under constant pressures of amorphous silicon, PT from low-density-amorphous (LDA) to high-density-amorphous (HDA) Si, and formation of shear bands (SBs) are performed using the state-of-the-art Gaussian Approximation Potential. The simulations reveal that LDA$\leftrightarrow$HDA shear-induced PTs occur simultaneously until reaching steady state. The developed mechanism-based analytical model well describes shear-strain-governed kinetics and steady states at all pressures, independent of shear stresses. Shear reduces the pressure for initiation and completion of LDA$\rightarrow$HDA PT by $4.36$ and $5.10$ GPa, respectively. Without PT at low pressure, shear-banding occurs, which is partially suppressed by PT at higher pressure with uniform deformation-PT at $9.8$ GPa. Despite the much larger shear and expected fraction of HDA, surprising sharp drop in the HDA atomic fraction within the SB was discovered. In bulk, Si deforms by atomic rearrangement in localized shear transformation zones with high nonaffine displacements, which trigger nucleation of HDA clusters within LDA and, concurrently, of LDA clusters within HDA, without growth and coalescence. In SB, a turbulent-like flow with swirls is revealed, which promotes reverse PT from HDA$\rightarrow$LDA more effectively. Transformation-induced plasticity in amorphous Si is revealed. The findings open up basic research into the mechanisms and kinetics of plastic strain-induced PTs in amorphous materials under high pressure, with numerous important applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：large-scale molecular dynamics simulations、Gaussian Approximation Potential。；研究对象：非晶硅（amorphous silicon）在高压下的剪切诱导低密度非晶态（LDA）与高密度非晶态（HDA）之间的相变，以及剪切带（shear bands）的形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 剪切作用可显著降低LDA→HDA相变的起始和完成压力（分别降低4.36和5.10 GPa）；在剪切带内部发现了HDA原子分数的急剧下降，表明存在从HDA到LDA的逆向相变，且该逆向相变由湍流状流动促进。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：剪切作用可显著降低LDA→HDA相变的起始和完成压力（分别降低4.36和5.10 GPa）；在剪切带内部发现了HDA原子分数的急剧下降，表明存在从HDA到LDA的逆向相变，且该逆向相变由湍流状流动促进。；创新点：揭示了剪切诱导LDA↔HDA相变同时发生的原子尺度机制，发现了剪切带内HDA原子分数异常下降的反直觉现象，并建立了基于机制的解析模型来描述剪切应变控制的动力学和稳态行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用最先进的Gaussian Approximation Potential（高斯近似势）进行大规模分子动力学模拟，模拟非晶硅在恒定压力下的剪切变形过程。

papers.title: The unique, universal entropy for complex systems
papers.abstract: An axiomatic foundation regarding the entropy for complex systems is established. Missing from decades of research was the requirement that entropy must measure the uncertainty at the informational scale of the maximizing distribution, where the log-log slope equals $-1$. Additionally, entropy must be extensive across the full universality scaling classes defined by Hanel-Thurner. The coupled entropy, maximized by the coupled stretched exponential distributions, is proven to be the unique, universal entropy that satisfies these requirements. The non-additivity of the entropy is equal to the long-range dependence or nonlinear statistical coupling. The entropy-matched extensivity is a function of the coupling, stretching parameter, and dimensions. Evidence is provided that the Tsallis $q$-statistics creates misalignment in the physical modeling of complex systems. Information thermodynamic applications are reviewed, including measuring complexity, a zeroth law of temperature, the thermodynamic consistency of the coupled free energy, and a model of intelligence in non-equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：axiomatic foundation（公理化基础）、proven（证明）、information thermodynamic（信息热力学）。；研究对象：复杂系统的熵，具体包括其公理化定义、可加性/广延性、以及与非平衡统计力学（如Tsallis统计、耦合拉伸指数分布）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并证明了耦合拉伸指数分布所对应的熵是唯一满足“在最大熵分布的信息尺度上不确定性度量”和“在Hanel-Thurner全普适标度类中广延性”这两个公理要求的普适熵。该熵的非可加性等价于长程依赖或非线性统计耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并证明了耦合拉伸指数分布所对应的熵是唯一满足“在最大熵分布的信息尺度上不确定性度量”和“在Hanel-Thurner全普适标度类中广延性”这两个公理要求的普适熵。该熵的非可加性等价于长程依赖或非线性统计耦合。；创新点：首次明确提出“熵必须在最大化分布的信息尺度上度量不确定性”（即log-log斜率为-1）这一缺失数十年的公理要求，并证明耦合熵是唯一满足该要求及全标度类广延性的普适熵。同时指出Tsallis q-统计在复杂系统物理建模中会导致“错位”（misalignment）。
papers.method_zh: 采用公理化推导与数学证明，结合Hanel-Thurner标度分类理论，分析熵的广延性、可加性及其与分布参数（耦合、拉伸参数、维度）的关系，并回顾信息热力学应用（如复杂度测量、零温定律、耦合自由能、非平衡智能模型）。

papers.title: Finite-size scaling properties of classical random walk on various two-dimensional lattices
papers.abstract: We consider various two-dimensional lattices such as square, Kagome, Lieb, honeycomb, dice lattices of finite extent, to study the effect of lattice profile in terms of the number of nearest neighbour and connectivity patterns on the classical random walk in the unbiased scenario. We find that the standard deviation of distance travelled by the walker is insensitive to the non-uniformity of the lattice profile leading to diffusive transport even in the finite size lattices. Our study indicates that the mass fractal dimension varies within a window $1.50\pm 0.03$ for all finite-size lattices. A weak ordering within the above window, correlated with the average coordination number, is observed, while Lieb and square lattices yielding the minimum and maximum values, respectively. However, confidence intervals reveal substantial statistical overlap for several lattice pairs even though the lattice profiles vary as far as the average number of connecting bonds and directionality of bonds are concerned. We also study the scaling complexity of the circumference of the closed curve traced by the walker while investigating the hull dimension. We find similar trend for hull fractal dimension as well and that was found to within the window $1.37\pm 0.03$ for finite-size lattices. Within the above window, the ordering remains qualitatively unaltered as compared to mass dimension while the confidence interval rectifies the order quantitatively. The square lattice clearly exhibits the upper bound for hull fractal dimension and the remaining lattices show extensive statistical overlap within the above window. We exhibit a tendency of the mass and hull fractal dimension to reach their thermodynamic values given by Brownian motion when we allow more number of steps within the finite size of the lattice, as confirmed by a data collapse analysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：classical random walk（经典随机游走）、finite-size scaling（有限尺寸标度）、fractal dimension（分形维数）。；研究对象：经典无偏随机游走在多种二维有限晶格（包括正方形、Kagome、Lieb、蜂窝、骰子晶格）上的输运行为，重点研究晶格配位数和连接模式对随机游走的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典随机游走的标准差对晶格非均匀性不敏感，在有限尺寸晶格中仍表现为扩散输运；质量分形维数和 hull 分形维数分别在 1.50±0.03 和 1.37±0.03 的窗口内变化，且随步数增加趋向布朗运动的热力学极限值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典随机游走的标准差对晶格非均匀性不敏感，在有限尺寸晶格中仍表现为扩散输运；质量分形维数和 hull 分形维数分别在 1.50±0.03 和 1.37±0.03 的窗口内变化，且随步数增加趋向布朗运动的热力学极限值。；创新点：系统比较了五种不同拓扑结构二维晶格（包括配位数和连接方向性差异）对经典随机游走分形维数的影响，发现尽管晶格轮廓差异显著，但分形维数统计重叠较大，仅存在与平均配位数相关的弱排序。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值模拟计算有限尺寸二维晶格上经典无偏随机游走的距离标准差、质量分形维数和 hull 分形维数，并进行数据塌缩分析（data collapse analysis）以验证有限尺寸标度行为。

papers.title: Giant orbital-magnon conversion driven perpendicular magnetization switching
papers.abstract: The pursuit of beyond-Moore information technologies has stimulated the exploration of novel information carriers, such as electron spin, orbital, and magnon, beyond electron charge. Efficient interconversion among these degrees of freedom and precise control over the information states are crucial for advancing nanoelectronic devices. However, a direct coupling between orbital angular momentum (L) and magnons (M) has remained elusive, and magnetization switching through orbital-to-magnon (L-M) conversion has not yet been achieved. Here, we report the experimental demonstration of L-M conversion in an orbital metal/antiferromagnetic insulator bilayer at room temperature, with an efficiency over an order of magnitude higher than that in traditional orbital systems lacking the L-M process. Consequently, we achieved efficient room-temperature perpendicular magnetization switching in a CoFeB ferromagnetic layer mediated by this new mechanism. Our findings establish a direct link between orbitronics and magnonics, providing a new platform for the development of advanced nano-devices based on orbital-driven magnonic phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“experimental demonstration”、“we report”、“we achieved”等关键词，明确表明是实验研究。；研究对象：轨道金属/反铁磁绝缘体双层异质结（orbital metal/antiferromagnetic insulator bilayer），以及其中由轨道-磁振子（L-M）转换驱动的垂直磁化翻转现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温下实现了轨道角动量（L）与磁振子（M）之间的直接转换（L-M转换），其效率比传统缺乏L-M过程的轨道系统高一个数量级以上，并基于此新机制实现了CoFeB铁磁层的垂直磁化翻转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温下实现了轨道角动量（L）与磁振子（M）之间的直接转换（L-M转换），其效率比传统缺乏L-M过程的轨道系统高一个数量级以上，并基于此新机制实现了CoFeB铁磁层的垂直磁化翻转。；创新点：首次实验证明了轨道角动量与磁振子之间的直接耦合（L-M转换），并利用该机制实现了磁化翻转，建立了轨道电子学（orbitronics）与磁振子学（magnonics）之间的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 实验构建了轨道金属/反铁磁绝缘体双层异质结，在室温下测量了L-M转换效率，并通过该机制实现了CoFeB铁磁层的垂直磁化翻转。摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如磁光克尔效应、自旋力矩铁磁共振、输运测量等）。

papers.title: Loop Extrusion Reversal by Condensin Motor is Mediated by Catch Bonds
papers.abstract: Structural Maintenance Complexes (SMC) are energy consuming motors that are important in folding the genome by loop extrusion (LE) in all stages of the cell cycle. Single molecule magnetic tweezer pulling experiments have revealed that condensin, a member of the SMC family involved in mitosis, takes occasional backward steps, thus coughing up the gains in the length of the extruded loop. To reveal the mechanism of the forward and backward steps simultaneously, we developed a theory using the stochastic kinetic model and the scrunching mechanism for LE. The calculations quantitatively account for the measured force-dependent step size and dwell time distributions in both the directions. By postulating the existence of an intermediate state in the ATP-driven cycle that is poised to take a forward or a backward step, we predict that its lifetime increases as the external mechanical force increases till a critical value and subsequently decreases at higher forces. The surprising finding of lifetime increase in an active motor, at sub-piconewton forces, is the characteristic of catch bonds, known in force-induced rupture of several passive protein complexes. The identification of catch bond-like states in condensin not only expands our understanding of LE but also highlights the significance of mechanical forces in regulating genome organization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“developed a theory using the stochastic kinetic model and the scrunching mechanism”，并通过计算定量解释实验数据。；研究对象：凝聚素（condensin）在环挤压（loop extrusion）过程中的正向与反向步进机制，特别是外力对步进动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现凝聚素在亚皮牛顿外力下，其ATP驱动循环中一个中间态的寿命随外力增加而先增后减，这种寿命增加行为是“catch bond”的特征，揭示了环挤压反向步进的力学调控机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现凝聚素在亚皮牛顿外力下，其ATP驱动循环中一个中间态的寿命随外力增加而先增后减，这种寿命增加行为是“catch bond”的特征，揭示了环挤压反向步进的力学调控机制。；创新点：首次在主动马达（condensin）中识别出类似catch bond的中间态，将被动蛋白复合物中已知的力诱导断裂特性引入环挤压机制，强调了机械力在基因组组织调控中的新作用。
papers.method_zh: 随机动力学模型（stochastic kinetic model）结合“scrunching mechanism”理论框架，定量计算了力依赖的步长和驻留时间分布，并与单分子磁镊拉伸实验数据对比。

papers.title: Stability and dynamics of dark-bright solitons in spin-orbit- and Rabi-coupled binary Bose-Einstein condensates
papers.abstract: We investigate the stability and nonlinear dynamics of dark-bright solitons in a one-dimensional binary Bose-Einstein condensate subjected to synthetic spin-orbit and Rabi couplings. In the absence of spin-orbit coupling, we map the coupled Gross-Pitaevskii equations onto the integrable Manakov model and obtain exact dark-bright soliton solutions, providing a rigorous theoretical benchmark. We demonstrate that finite spin-orbit coupling breaks integrability by inducing spin-dependent phase gradients, which result in spatial separation of the spin components and the emergence of intrinsic density oscillations. By contrast, Rabi coupling enforces phase locking between components and supports robust breather-like excitations. Using imaginary-time propagation together with Bogoliubov-de Gennes analysis, we systematically characterise ground-state phases and excitation spectra for both symmetric and asymmetric interaction regimes in homogeneous and harmonically trapped systems. Real-time simulations further demonstrate that finite gauge fields and interaction quenches drive the system far from equilibrium, giving rise to diverse nonlinear phenomena, including multi-soliton fragmentation, breathing stripe patterns, and soliton dynamics. Our results highlight the interplay of synthetic gauge fields, external confinement, and interaction engineering as powerful tools for controlling the stability and dynamical behaviour of nonlinear excitations in multicomponent quantum gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate, map onto, exact solutions, Bogoliubov-de Gennes analysis, real-time simulations）；研究对象：一维自旋-轨道耦合和拉比耦合下的二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的暗-亮孤子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋-轨道耦合会破坏可积性，导致自旋分量空间分离和本征密度振荡；而拉比耦合则锁定相位，支持稳定的呼吸子激发。通过调控合成规范场、外部囚禁和相互作用，可有效控制多组分量子气体中非线性激发的稳定性与动力学行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋-轨道耦合会破坏可积性，导致自旋分量空间分离和本征密度振荡；而拉比耦合则锁定相位，支持稳定的呼吸子激发。通过调控合成规范场、外部囚禁和相互作用，可有效控制多组分量子气体中非线性激发的稳定性与动力学行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 将耦合Gross-Pitaevskii方程映射到可积Manakov模型获得精确暗-亮孤子解；使用虚时传播结合Bogoliubov-de Gennes分析表征基态相和激发谱；通过实时模拟研究非平衡动力学。

papers.title: Diffusiophoretic dispersion of a colloidal blob in porous media
papers.abstract: Predicting and controlling the transport of colloids in porous media is essential for applications ranging from contaminant remediation to drug delivery. In these complex environments, solute gradients are ubiquitous and could drive diffusiophoretic particle migration, yet their impact on macroscopic colloid dispersion remains poorly understood. Here we combine experiments and simulations to quantify how diffusiophoresis alters the spreading of a colloidal blob in a 2D ordered/disordered porous medium. A joint blob of colloids and salt at high concentration is introduced into a medium filled with salt at low concentration and advected by a background flow. Intuition suggests that when colloids are attracted toward or repelled from the solute-rich blob, dispersion should be suppressed or enhanced, respectively. Instead, we observe the opposite trend: longitudinal dispersion is enhanced in the attractive case, whereas dispersion is suppressed in the repulsive case. Numerical simulations reveal that this striking reversal arises from diffusiophoretic exchange of particles between slow and fast streamlines, which we capture using a minimal two-layer model of coupled fast and slow plug flows. Finally, we probe how geometric disorder in the medium modulates this mechanism. Our results demonstrate that diffusiophoresis can strongly modulate macroscopic dispersion of colloids in porous media with implications for transport in subsurface and biological environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与数值模拟相结合）。关键词：experiments and simulations、combine experiments and simulations。；研究对象：多孔介质中胶体团的扩散泳分散现象。具体体系为：二维有序/无序多孔介质中，由胶体与高浓度盐组成的联合团块在低浓度盐溶液背景流驱动下的输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 胶体与溶质富集团块之间的吸引或排斥作用对纵向分散的影响与直觉相反：吸引情况下分散增强，排斥情况下分散反而被抑制。这一反转源于扩散泳导致的粒子在慢流线与快流线之间的交换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：胶体与溶质富集团块之间的吸引或排斥作用对纵向分散的影响与直觉相反：吸引情况下分散增强，排斥情况下分散反而被抑制。这一反转源于扩散泳导致的粒子在慢流线与快流线之间的交换。；创新点：首次揭示了扩散泳在多孔介质中可强烈改变胶体宏观分散的机制，并发现了与直觉相反的分散增强/抑制反转现象。摘要未突出说明与已有理论或实验的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用二维有序/无序多孔介质中的胶体团块输运观测；数值模拟用于揭示微观机制，并构建了一个最小两层模型（耦合快、慢塞状流）来捕捉该效应。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of stacking faults and phase stability in cobalt alloys: A combined computational and experimental study
papers.abstract: Stacking fault energy dictates phase stability and deformation behavior in Co alloys and WC-Co cemented carbides, yet a quantitative assessment of alloying effects at finite temperatures remains poorly established. By integrating first-principles thermodynamics with microstructural characterization, we provide a rigorous evaluation of these influences across atomic and macroscopic scales. We show that stacking fault energetics at 0K for transition metal solutes are primarily governed by atomic misfit volume. While 4d and 5d elements follow a consistent linear trend, specific 3d solutes exhibit significant deviations due to non-negligible magnetic contributions. By incorporating phonon, electronic, longitudinal spin-fluctuation, and magnetic free-energy contributions, the model accurately captures the fcc-hcp transformation and quantifies how diverse solutes modulate the phase landscape. We demonstrate that V, Ni, Fe, Mo, and W lower the transformation temperature by stabilizing fcc phase, while Cr and C exhibit the opposite effect, consistent with experimental phase diagrams. Furthermore, microscopic analysis confirms that higher W content dissolved in the Co suppresses stacking-fault formation by elevating the stacking fault energy at finite temperatures. This work clarifies the physical mechanisms by which alloying regulates stacking fault energy and phase stability in Co-based systems, providing guidance for the design of Co-based alloys and WC-Co cemented carbides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“integrating first-principles thermodynamics with microstructural characterization”（第一性原理热力学与微观结构表征相结合），同时包含计算建模和实验验证。；研究对象：钴合金及WC-Co硬质合金中的堆垛层错热力学与相稳定性，具体涉及过渡金属溶质（V、Ni、Fe、Mo、W、Cr、C等）对fcc-hcp相变和堆垛层错能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 溶质原子对堆垛层错能的影响在0K时主要由原子错配体积决定，但3d元素因磁贡献出现显著偏离；V、Ni、Fe、Mo、W通过稳定fcc相降低相变温度，而Cr和C则相反；高温下W含量升高会提高堆垛层错能，抑制堆垛层错形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：溶质原子对堆垛层错能的影响在0K时主要由原子错配体积决定，但3d元素因磁贡献出现显著偏离；V、Ni、Fe、Mo、W通过稳定fcc相降低相变温度，而Cr和C则相反；高温下W含量升高会提高堆垛层错能，抑制堆垛层错形成。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理热力学计算（包含声子、电子、纵向自旋涨落和磁自由能贡献）结合微观结构表征实验。

papers.title: Imaging GHz surface acoustic wave modes in electrostricted LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ heterostructures
papers.abstract: The LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ (LAO/STO) interface hosts a gate-tunable superconducting two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) which can be programmed to create quantum devices such as ballistic electron waveguides and quantum dots. To fully exploit this platform for quantum transport, a key requirement is the ability to shuttle single electrons, electron pairs, and other exotic states between spatially separated devices with precision. Surface acoustic waves (SAWs), which travel along the surface of a solid, offer a powerful route to achieve this through their moving electrical potential that captures and transfers electrons. %acoustoelectric coupling. In particular, SAWs in the GHz regime enable fast, controlled transport of individual quantum particles. Although this approach is well-explored in GaAs-based 2DEG, SAW generation in STO remains largely unexplored due to the lack of intrinsic piezoelectricity at room temperature. Here, we investigate room-temperature SAWs in LAO/STO and observe SAW modes up to 2.2 GHz with very low propagation loss of the order $10^{-3}$ dB per wavelength. To directly visualize these modes, we employ Atomic Acoustic Force Microscopy (AAFM), achieving sub-micron resolution imaging of the SAW wave forms, providing insight into the electrostriction-induced SAW generation mechanism. Our measurements indicate a shear horizontal-type mode, which provides the ability to couple to in-plane degrees of freedom for future acoustoelectric and quantum device applications. This work studies the fundamentals of SAW excitation and propagation on STO, a widely used and commercially available substrate, enabling straightforward coupling of SAWs to a broad range of materials that can be grown or transferred onto STO.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Imaging（成像）、Atomic Acoustic Force Microscopy（原子声学力显微镜）、measurements（测量）。；研究对象：LaAlO₃/SrTiO₃（LAO/STO）异质结中的GHz表面声波（SAW）模式，特别是电致伸缩效应激发的声波及其在室温下的传播特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在LAO/STO异质结中观测到高达2.2 GHz的SAW模式，且传播损耗极低（约10⁻³ dB/波长）；通过原子声学力显微镜直接成像发现该模式为剪切水平型，可耦合面内自由度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在LAO/STO异质结中观测到高达2.2 GHz的SAW模式，且传播损耗极低（约10⁻³ dB/波长）；通过原子声学力显微镜直接成像发现该模式为剪切水平型，可耦合面内自由度。；创新点：首次在室温下对缺乏本征压电性的STO基LAO/STO异质结中实现GHz级SAW的激发与直接成像，揭示了电致伸缩诱导的SAW产生机制，并确认了剪切水平型模式的存在。
papers.method_zh: 原子声学力显微镜（AAFM）用于亚微米分辨率成像SAW波形；室温下测量SAW模式频率（最高2.2 GHz）及传播损耗。

papers.title: Kitaev chain in synthetic dimension with cavity-controlled Majorana modes
papers.abstract: We introduce a tunable synthetic-dimension platform for realizing Kitaev-chain physics with high degree of control over Majorana zero modes. It is based on a generic Landau-quantized two dimensional electron system coupled to the magnetic flux of a superconducting LC circuit. The structured vector potential of a superconducting LC inductor induces attractive interactions between electron angular-momentum states at the lowest Landau level. These states serve as a synthetic dimension for the coveted fermionic Kitaev chain, with Majorana zero modes existing at the boundaries of the angular-momentum lattice. The crucial advantage of this proposal is the possibility of a robust, nonlocal readout and control of the Majorana states by a LC resonator. The platform relies on mature circuit QED and semiconductor technologies and provides a promising pathway to topological quantum computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：proposal、platform、realizing、control。；研究对象：基于合成维度（synthetic dimension）的Kitaev链模型，具体体系为与超导LC电路磁通耦合的朗道量子化二维电子系统，用于实现马约拉纳零模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过超导LC电感器的结构化矢势，在最低朗道能级的电子角动量态之间诱导吸引相互作用，从而构建费米子Kitaev链，并在角动量晶格边界产生马约拉纳零模。该方案的关键优势在于可利用LC谐振器对马约拉纳态进行鲁棒的非局域读出与控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过超导LC电感器的结构化矢势，在最低朗道能级的电子角动量态之间诱导吸引相互作用，从而构建费米子Kitaev链，并在角动量晶格边界产生马约拉纳零模。该方案的关键优势在于可利用LC谐振器对马约拉纳态进行鲁棒的非局域读出与控制。；创新点：提出一种基于电路QED和半导体成熟技术的可调谐合成维度平台，首次实现通过LC谐振器对马约拉纳零模进行非局域、鲁棒的读出与控制，为拓扑量子计算提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论构建：利用朗道量子化二维电子系统与超导LC电路磁通耦合，通过结构化矢势实现角动量态间的有效吸引相互作用，将角动量态作为合成维度映射为Kitaev链模型。

papers.title: Magnetic influence on ion transport in concentrated solid solutions: An analytic investigation
papers.abstract: It is well established that magnetic fields have a significant effect on transport in certain classes of electronic conductors. Less reported, however, are similar effects in solid ionic conductors. Despite the rarity of Hall mobility measurements in ionic conductors, recent experimental work in batteries and other systems has demonstrated that an applied magnetic field can significantly and beneficially alter ionic transport and electrochemical processes in solid materials in a way that would not be predicted from naïve Hall coefficient estimates. In this work, the influence of a magnetic field on ion transport in solids is investigated analytically, and general multi-component transport equations accounting for magnetic effects are presented. Specific models are then derived for solid, isotropic binary and single ion conductors. Material property combinations for which magnetic field influence may become significant are then computed for certain systems subject to compositional constraints. Finally, it is demonstrated that the derived model for binary conductors in a magnetic field fits experimental magneto-resistance data well for the fluoride ion conducting solid Pb$_{0.66}$Cd$_{0.34}$F$_2$, provided an assumption of near degenerate multi-component transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytic investigation、derived、model fits experimental data。；研究对象：固体离子导体中磁场对离子输运的影响，具体体系包括各向同性二元导体和单离子导体，以及氟离子导体Pb₀.₆₆Cd₀.₃₄F₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁场可以显著且有益地改变固体材料中的离子输运和电化学过程，其影响无法通过简单的霍尔系数估计预测；推导的二元导体模型能很好地拟合Pb₀.₆₆Cd₀.₃₄F₂的磁电阻实验数据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁场可以显著且有益地改变固体材料中的离子输运和电化学过程，其影响无法通过简单的霍尔系数估计预测；推导的二元导体模型能很好地拟合Pb₀.₆₆Cd₀.₃₄F₂的磁电阻实验数据。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论推导：建立考虑磁场效应的通用多组分输运方程，并针对各向同性二元导体和单离子导体导出具体模型；通过计算特定材料组合在组分约束下的物性参数，分析磁场影响显著的条件；最后用实验磁电阻数据验证模型。

papers.title: Random sampling of self-avoiding theta-graphs
papers.abstract: Theta-graphs are a type of spatial graph with two vertices connected by three edges. We investigate embeddings of theta-graphs in the square and simple cubic lattices, using a combination of the Wang-Landau Monte Carlo method with a variant of the BFACF algorithm which accommodates vertices of degree 3. This allows us to estimate the critical exponents governing the number of theta-graphs and the distributions of the different arm-lengths. For the cubic lattice these values can be compared to the corresponding exponents for prime knots.
